1658.definition: an unavoidable bad fate, failure, or destruction
1658.en: The novel creates a growing sense of doom.
1658.zh: 這部小說營造出逐漸加深的厄運感。

1658.explanation: 使某人某事注定遭遇失敗或不幸結果。
1658.definition: to make someone or something certain to fail or suffer a bad result
1658.en: Poor planning doomed the project from the start.
1658.zh: 規劃不良使這項計畫一開始就注定失敗。

1659.explanation: 可開關、讓人進出房間、建築物或車輛的板狀構造。
1659.definition: a movable barrier used to enter or leave a room, building, or vehicle

1660.explanation: 牆上供門安裝或人通過的開口。
1660.definition: the opening in a wall where a door is placed or through which people pass
1660.en: She stood in the doorway and waved goodbye.

1661.explanation: 供多人居住與睡眠的房間或建築物，尤指學校宿舍。
1661.definition: a room or building that provides sleeping and living space for several people, especially students
1661.en: She lives in a college dormitory.

1662.explanation: 一次服用或給予的藥物或其他物質的量。
1662.definition: an amount of medicine or another substance taken or given at one time
1662.en: The label states the recommended dose.

1662.explanation: 給某人或某物施予一定劑量的藥物。
1662.definition: to give a measured amount of medicine to a person or animal
1662.en: The veterinarian dosed the animal carefully.
1662.zh: 獸醫謹慎地給動物用藥。

1663.explanation: 表面上的小圓形記號或斑點。
1663.definition: a small round mark or spot
1663.en: A red dot marks the correct answer.

1663.explanation: 使許多小物分散出現在某個區域。
1663.definition: to be scattered over an area or to place small things across it

1664.explanation: 數量為兩倍，或由兩個相同或相關部分組成的。
1664.definition: twice as much or consisting of two similar or connected parts

1664.explanation: 使數量增加為原來的兩倍，或本身變成兩倍。
1664.definition: to make something twice as large or to become twice as large
1664.zh: 銷售額在一年內翻了一倍。

1664.explanation: 兩倍的數量，或外貌非常相像的人。
1664.definition: twice an amount, or a person who closely resembles another
1664.en: The new hall is double the size of the old one.
1664.zh: 新大廳的大小是舊大廳的兩倍。

1664.definition: to twice the degree or amount
1664.en: The tickets cost double last year's price.

1665.explanation: 對某事是否真實、正確或會發生感到不確定。
1665.definition: a feeling of uncertainty about whether something is true, correct, or likely
1665.en: There is little doubt that the plan will work.
1665.zh: 幾乎毫無疑問這項計畫會奏效。

1665.explanation: 對某事的真實性或可能性感到不確定。
1665.definition: to feel uncertain about the truth or likelihood of something
1665.en: I doubt that the train will arrive on time.
1665.zh: 我懷疑火車能否準時抵達。

1666.explanation: 不太可能是真的、成功的，或讓人無法確定。
1666.definition: unlikely to be true or successful, or causing uncertainty
1666.en: It is doubtful whether the event will continue outdoors.
1666.zh: 這場活動是否會繼續在戶外舉行仍不確定。

1667.explanation: 麵粉與液體等混合後、尚未烘烤的柔軟混合物。
1667.definition: a soft mixture of flour and liquid before it is baked
1667.en: She left the dough to rise.

1668.explanation: 環形或圓形、通常經油炸或烘烤的甜麵點。
1668.definition: a sweet ring-shaped or round piece of fried or baked dough
1668.en: He bought a doughnut with his coffee.
1668.zh: 他買了一個甜甜圈配咖啡。

1669.explanation: 體型中小、常呈灰白色的鳥，屬鳩鴿科。
1669.definition: a small to medium-sized bird of the pigeon family, often gray or white
1669.en: A white dove landed on the wall.

1670.explanation: 朝較低的位置或處於較低的位置。
1670.definition: toward or at a lower position

1670.explanation: 從較高處朝較低處沿著某處移動。
1670.definition: from a higher point toward a lower point along something

1670.explanation: 位於較低處、朝下，或暫時無法運作的。
1670.definition: lower, directed downward, or temporarily not working
1670.en: The website is down for maintenance.
1670.zh: 網站因維護而暫停運作。

1670.explanation: 鳥類的柔軟細羽，或類似的柔軟毛。
1670.definition: soft fine feathers of birds or similar soft covering
1670.en: The jacket is filled with down.

1670.definition: to knock a person or thing to the ground
1670.en: The strong wind downed several branches.
1670.zh: 強風吹落了好幾根樹枝。

1671.explanation: 把資料或檔案從遠端系統傳到自己的裝置。
1671.definition: to transfer data or a file from a remote system to your own device
1671.en: I downloaded the worksheet before class.
1671.zh: 我上課前下載了學習單。

1672.explanation: 到較低樓層或位於較低樓層。
1672.definition: to or on a lower floor of a building
1672.en: She went downstairs to answer the door.

1672.explanation: 建築物較低的一層或數層。
1672.definition: the lower floor or floors of a building

1672.explanation: 位於建築物較低樓層的。
1672.definition: located on a lower floor of a building
1672.en: The downstairs bathroom is near the kitchen.
1672.zh: 樓下的浴室在廚房附近。

1673.explanation: 位於城市商業或中心區域的。
1673.definition: located in the central or business part of a city
1673.en: They moved into a downtown apartment.
1673.zh: 他們搬進市中心的一間公寓。

1673.explanation: 到城市中心區域或位於該處。
1673.definition: to or in the central part of a city
1673.zh: 午餐後我們去了市中心。

1673.explanation: 城市的中心或主要商業區。
1673.definition: the central or main business area of a city
1673.en: Downtown is busiest during the afternoon.

1674.explanation: 朝較低位置或數值發展的。
1674.definition: moving or pointing toward a lower position or level
1674.en: The chart shows a downward trend.

1675.definition: toward a lower place or position
1675.en: The path slopes downward toward the river.
1675.zh: 小路向下傾斜通往河邊。

1676.definition: to sleep lightly for a short time
1676.en: He dozed on the bus ride home.
1676.zh: 他搭公車回家時打了個盹。

1676.definition: a short period of light sleep
1676.en: She had a brief doze after lunch.
1676.zh: 她午餐後小睡了一會兒。

1677.explanation: 十二個同類事物的一組。

1678.explanation: 文件、文章或計畫尚未完成的初步版本。
1678.definition: a preliminary version of a document, piece of writing, or plan
1678.en: I finished the first draft of my report.

1678.explanation: 寫出文件、文章或計畫的初步版本。
1678.definition: to prepare a preliminary version of a document or plan
1678.en: The committee drafted a new proposal.
1678.zh: 委員會起草了一份新提案。

1679.explanation: 用力把某人或某物沿著表面拉動。
1679.definition: to pull someone or something along with effort
1679.en: They dragged the heavy box across the floor.
1679.zh: 他們把沉重的箱子拖過地板。

1679.explanation: 使進展變慢的因素，或令人覺得無聊麻煩的事。
1679.definition: something that slows progress or is tiresome and unpleasant
1679.en: Long delays can be a drag on the project.
1679.zh: 長時間延誤可能拖累這項計畫。

1680.explanation: 神話中常被描繪為大型爬蟲狀的生物。
1680.definition: a large reptile-like creature in myths and legends
1680.en: The story tells of a dragon guarding a mountain.
1680.zh: 故事講述一條守護山脈的龍。

1681.explanation: 有細長身體與兩對透明翅膀、常在水邊活動的昆蟲。
1681.definition: an insect with a long body and two pairs of transparent wings, often found near water
1681.en: A dragonfly hovered above the pond.
1681.zh: 一隻蜻蜓在池塘上方盤旋。

1682.explanation: 使液體從某處流出，或液體自行流走。
1682.definition: to remove liquid from something or allow liquid to flow away
1682.en: Drain the water from the pot.

1682.explanation: 讓廢水或其他液體流走的管道或開口。
1682.definition: a pipe or opening through which waste water or other liquid flows away

1683.explanation: 為舞台、電視或廣播創作的嚴肅故事，或戲劇這門藝術。
1683.definition: a serious story written for performance, or the art of writing and performing plays
1683.en: The students performed a historical drama.
1683.zh: 學生演出了一齣歷史劇。

1684.explanation: 突然、明顯而令人注意的，或與戲劇有關的。
1684.definition: sudden and striking, or related to drama and performance
1684.en: The city has seen a dramatic increase in visitors.
1684.zh: 這座城市的遊客人數大幅增加。

1685.explanation: 程度極大、影響深遠，通常指改變或措施。
1685.definition: extreme and likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect
1685.en: The company made drastic changes to reduce waste.
1685.zh: 公司做出大幅改變以減少浪費。

1686.explanation: 穿過房間或其他封閉空間的一股冷空氣。
1686.definition: a current of cool air moving through a room or other enclosed space
1686.en: Close the window; there is a cold draught.
1686.zh: 把窗戶關上；有一股冷風。

1687.explanation: 用筆等畫出圖像，或把某物拉向某處；也可指吸引。
1687.definition: to make a picture with lines, pull something, or attract attention or people
1687.en: She drew a map on the board.
1687.zh: 她在黑板上畫了一張地圖。

1687.explanation: 比賽雙方得分相同的結果，或隨機抽選的行為。
1687.definition: a result in which competitors have equal scores, or an act of selecting at random
1687.en: The match ended in a draw.

1688.explanation: 家具中可拉出、用來收納物品的盒狀部分。
1688.definition: a box-shaped storage part of a piece of furniture that slides in and out
1688.en: The keys are in the top drawer.
1688.zh: 鑰匙在最上面的抽屜裡。

1689.explanation: 以鉛筆、筆或其他工具畫出的圖像，或繪畫這項活動。
1689.definition: a picture made with a pencil or pen, or the activity of making such pictures
1689.en: Her drawing of the old bridge won a prize.

1690.explanation: 對將來可能發生的事情感到強烈害怕或不安。
1690.definition: a strong feeling of fear or anxiety about something that may happen
1690.en: He felt a sense of dread before the exam.
1690.zh: 考試前他感到一陣恐懼。

1690.explanation: 非常不想面對某件將發生的事。
1690.definition: to feel great fear or reluctance about something that may happen
1690.en: She dreaded telling them the bad news.
1690.zh: 她很害怕告訴他們這個壞消息。

1691.explanation: 非常不好、不愉快或令人害怕的。
1691.en: The weather was dreadful all weekend.
1691.zh: 整個週末的天氣都糟透了。

1692.explanation: 睡眠時出現的影像與想法，或非常希望實現的目標。
1692.definition: images and thoughts during sleep, or a goal that you strongly hope to achieve
1692.en: Her dream is to become an engineer.
1692.zh: 她的夢想是成為工程師。

1692.explanation: 睡眠時經歷夢境，或想像並希望某事發生。
1692.definition: to experience dreams while asleep or imagine something you hope will happen
1692.en: He dreams of traveling around the world.

1693.explanation: 一件式女裝，或特定場合穿著的服裝。
1693.definition: a one-piece garment, or clothing of a particular style or for a particular occasion
1693.en: She wore a blue dress to the ceremony.
1693.zh: 她穿著藍色洋裝參加典禮。

1693.explanation: 穿上衣服，或替某人穿衣。
1693.definition: to put clothes on yourself or another person
1693.zh: 他很快穿好衣服準備上學。

1694.explanation: 有抽屜、用來收納衣物的家具；也可指梳妝用家具。
1694.definition: a piece of furniture with drawers for storing clothes, sometimes used as a dressing table
1694.en: She keeps sweaters in the dresser.
1694.zh: 她把毛衣放在五斗櫃裡。

1695.explanation: 加在沙拉上的調味醬，或覆蓋傷口的保護材料。
1695.definition: a sauce added to salad, or a protective covering placed over a wound
1695.en: He chose a light dressing for the salad.
1695.zh: 他為沙拉選了清爽的醬汁。

1696.explanation: 在水、空氣中緩慢移動，或沒有明確方向地逐漸移動。
1696.definition: to move slowly with water or air, or gradually move without a clear direction

1696.explanation: 緩慢的移動，或某種逐漸形成的方向與趨勢。
1696.definition: a slow movement or a gradual direction of change
1696.en: I understood the general drift of the discussion.
1696.zh: 我了解這場討論的大致方向。

1697.explanation: 鑽孔工具，或為應變某種情況而反覆練習的程序。
1697.definition: a tool for making holes, or a repeated practice of a procedure
1697.en: The school held a fire drill.

1697.explanation: 用工具鑽孔，或透過反覆練習訓練某人。
1697.definition: to make a hole with a tool or train someone through repeated practice
1697.en: They drilled a small hole in the wall.
1697.zh: 他們在牆上鑽了一個小孔。

1698.definition: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it
1698.en: Drink plenty of water during the day.

1698.definition: an amount of liquid prepared or served for drinking

1699.explanation: 一小滴液體，或液體滴落的聲音。
1699.definition: a small drop of liquid or the sound of liquid falling in drops
1699.en: I heard the steady drip of water.
1699.zh: 我聽見水持續滴落的聲音。

1699.definition: to fall or let liquid fall in small drops

1700.explanation: 控制車輛行進，或使某事物產生動力與進展。
1700.definition: to control a vehicle or provide the force that makes something move or progress
1700.en: She drives to work every morning.

1700.explanation: 乘車行駛的一段路程，或駕駛這項活動。
1700.definition: a journey in a vehicle or the act of driving
1700.en: It is a short drive to the station.
1700.zh: 開車到車站只要一小段路。

1701.definition: a person who drives a vehicle
1701.en: The driver stopped at the crosswalk.
1701.zh: 駕駛在行人穿越道前停下。

1702.explanation: 從道路通往住宅、車庫或其他建築物的私人車道。
1702.definition: a private road leading from a street to a house, garage, or other building
1702.en: A bicycle was parked in the driveway.
1702.zh: 一輛腳踏車停在車道上。

1703.explanation: 從較高處落到較低處，或使數量、程度下降。
1703.definition: to fall to a lower position or level, or make an amount or level decrease

1703.explanation: 少量液體的一滴，或數量、程度的下降。
1703.definition: a small amount of liquid in a round shape, or a decrease in amount or level
1703.en: There was a sharp drop in temperature.

1704.explanation: 長時間降雨不足，造成缺水的情況。
1704.definition: a long period with little or no rain that causes a shortage of water
1704.en: The region suffered a severe drought.

1705.explanation: 因在水或其他液體中無法呼吸而死亡，或幾乎死亡。
1705.definition: to die or nearly die because you cannot breathe while under water or another liquid
1705.en: The lifeguard rescued a swimmer who was in danger of drowning.
1705.zh: 救生員救起了一名有溺水危險的游泳者。

1706.explanation: 感到想睡、難以保持清醒的。
1706.definition: feeling sleepy and having difficulty staying awake
1706.en: The warm room made him drowsy.
1706.zh: 溫暖的房間讓他昏昏欲睡。

1707.explanation: 用於治療或影響身體功能的物質；在某些語境也指非法成癮性物質。
1707.definition: a substance used as medicine or one that affects the body; in some contexts, an illegal addictive substance
1707.en: Researchers are testing a new drug for the disease.
1707.zh: 研究人員正在測試一種治療該疾病的新藥。

1707.explanation: 使人或動物受到藥物作用。
1707.definition: to give a drug to a person or animal so that it affects the body
1707.en: The animal had been drugged for a medical procedure.
1707.zh: 那隻動物因醫療處置而接受了藥物。

1708.explanation: 販售藥品、個人用品及其他日常商品的商店，美式英文常用。
1708.definition: a store that sells medicines, personal-care items, and other everyday goods, especially in American English
1708.en: She stopped at the drugstore to buy toothpaste.

1709.explanation: 由中空鼓身與鼓面構成、敲擊發聲的樂器。
1709.definition: a musical instrument with a hollow body and a surface that is struck to make sound
1709.en: He plays the drum in the school band.

1709.explanation: 敲鼓，或以手指等反覆敲擊表面。
1709.definition: to play a drum or repeatedly tap a surface
1709.en: She drummed her fingers on the desk.
1709.zh: 她用手指在桌上不停敲著。

1710.explanation: 因飲酒而失去正常的判斷、協調或清醒狀態。
1710.definition: affected by alcohol so that normal judgment, coordination, or awareness is reduced
1710.en: The story describes the risks of driving while drunk.
1710.zh: 這個故事描述酒後駕車的風險。

1710.explanation: 經常喝醉或當時處於醉酒狀態的人；帶貶義。
1710.definition: a person who is drunk, especially one who is often drunk; a disapproving term
1710.en: The old novel portrays him as a lonely drunk.
1710.zh: 那本老小說把他描寫成一名孤獨的醉漢。

1711.explanation: 沒有水分或潮氣；不是濕的。
1711.definition: without water or moisture; not wet
1711.en: Keep the documents in a cool, dry place.
1711.zh: 把文件放在陰涼乾燥的地方。

1711.explanation: 使某物失去水分，或本身逐漸變乾。
1711.definition: to become dry or to make something dry
1711.en: Leave the towels outside to dry.

1712.explanation: 用熱或氣流把衣物或其他物品弄乾的機器或裝置。
1712.definition: a machine or device used to dry clothes or other things
1712.en: She put the wet clothes in the dryer.
1712.zh: 她把濕衣服放進烘乾機。

1713.explanation: 由兩個部分、用途或面向組成的。
1713.definition: having two parts, purposes, or aspects
1713.en: The device has a dual function.
1713.zh: 這個裝置具有雙重功能。

1714.explanation: 不確定是否真實、可靠或正確。
1714.definition: not certain, reliable, or convincing; causing or showing doubt
1714.en: She was dubious about the claim.
1714.zh: 她對這項說法抱持懷疑。

1715.explanation: 常在水邊生活、具有扁嘴和蹼足的水鳥。
1715.definition: a water bird with a broad bill and webbed feet
1715.en: A duck swam across the pond.

1715.explanation: 迅速低下頭或身體以躲避某物。
1715.definition: to lower your head or body quickly to avoid something
1715.en: He ducked as the ball flew toward him.
1715.zh: 球朝他飛來時，他迅速低頭閃避。

1716.explanation: 預計在某個時間發生、到達或應被支付。
1716.definition: expected, scheduled, or required at a particular time
1716.en: The train is due at six.
We drove due east for ten miles.
1716.zh: 我們向正東方行駛了十英里。

1716.explanation: 某人理應得到或應支付的東西。
1716.definition: something that is owed, payable, or deserved
1716.en: Workers should receive their due for the extra hours.
1716.zh: 員工應該因額外工時得到應有的回報。

1717.explanation: 缺乏趣味、刺激或吸引力。
1717.en: The lecture was dull at first.
1717.zh: 這場講座一開始很乏味。

1717.explanation: 使尖銳度、強度、亮度或感受降低。
1717.definition: to make something less sharp, strong, bright, or intense

1718.explanation: 缺乏良好判斷；此用法屬非正式語氣，直接形容人時可能冒犯。
1718.definition: showing poor judgment or lack of intelligence
1718.en: That was a dumb mistake, but we fixed it.
1718.zh: 那是個欠考慮的錯誤，但我們修正了。

1719.explanation: 把不需要的東西丟在某處，尤指廢棄物。
1719.definition: to get rid of something unwanted by leaving or throwing it somewhere
1719.en: Do not dump trash by the river.
1719.zh: 不要把垃圾傾倒在河邊。

1719.explanation: 集中放置或處理垃圾與廢棄物的地方。
1719.definition: a place where waste or unwanted material is taken and left
1719.en: The old furniture was taken to the dump.

1720.explanation: 以麵皮或麵糰製作並煮、蒸或烹調的小份食物，常可包餡。
1720.definition: a small piece of dough, often with a filling, that is cooked by boiling, steaming, or another method

1721.explanation: 能長時間使用而不易損壞或磨損。
1721.definition: strong enough to last a long time without being damaged or worn out
1721.en: This fabric is light but durable.
1721.zh: 這種布料很輕但很耐用。

1722.explanation: 某事件、活動或狀態持續的時間長度。
1722.definition: the length of time that something continues or lasts
1722.en: The duration of the course is six weeks.

1723.explanation: 在某段時間或事件進行的全部或其中某個時點。
1723.definition: at some time within, or throughout, a period or event
1723.en: No phones are allowed during the exam.
1723.zh: 考試期間不准使用手機。

1724.explanation: 傍晚日光逐漸消失、天色轉暗的時段。
1724.definition: the time in the evening when daylight is fading and it is becoming dark
1724.en: We reached the village at dusk.
1724.zh: 我們在黃昏時抵達村莊。

1725.explanation: 由非常細小的乾燥粒子組成、容易附著在表面的物質。
1725.definition: very small dry particles of dirt or other material that collect on surfaces
1725.en: A thin layer of dust covered the shelf.
1725.zh: 架子上覆著一層薄灰塵。

1725.definition: to remove dust from a surface by wiping or brushing it
1725.en: She dusted the bookshelves before the guests arrived.
1725.zh: 客人到來前，她擦拭書架除塵。

1726.explanation: 表面有灰塵，或空氣中有很多灰塵。
1726.definition: covered with dust or containing a lot of dust
1726.en: The attic was dark and dusty.

1727.explanation: 因工作、規則或道德而應做的事情。
1727.definition: something that you are expected or required to do because of your job, rules, or moral responsibility
1727.en: It is my duty to report the problem.
1727.zh: 通報這個問題是我的責任。

1728.explanation: 在故事或民間傳說中，外形像人但體型很小的想像生物。
1728.definition: in stories and folklore, an imaginary humanlike being of very small size
1728.en: The story tells of a dwarf who guards a hidden cave.
1728.zh: 故事描述一個守護隱密洞穴的矮小人形生物。

1728.meaning: 使相形見小；使顯得微小
1728.explanation: 因自身更大或更重要而使另一事物看起來很小。
1728.definition: to make something seem small or unimportant by comparison
1728.en: The new tower dwarfs the older buildings.
1728.zh: 新塔樓使較舊的建築相形見小。

1729.definition: to live in a particular place
1729.en: Few people dwell in that remote valley.
1729.zh: 很少人居住在那座偏遠山谷。

1730.explanation: 供人居住的房屋、公寓或其他地方。
1730.definition: a house, apartment, or other place where someone lives
1730.en: The building contains six private dwellings.
1730.zh: 這棟建築包含六個私人住所。

1731.explanation: 用來改變布料、頭髮或其他材料顏色的物質。
1731.definition: a substance used to change the color of cloth, hair, or another material
1731.en: The artist used a natural dye on the fabric.
1731.zh: 藝術家在布料上使用天然染料。

1731.explanation: 使用染料改變布料、頭髮或其他材料的顏色。
1731.definition: to change the color of something by using dye
1731.en: She dyed the cloth a deep blue.

1732.explanation: 持續變化、活動頻繁或具有強大活力的。
1732.definition: characterized by continuous change, activity, or energy
1732.en: The market is dynamic and changes quickly.
1732.zh: 這個市場充滿變化，而且變動很快。

1733.explanation: 同一家族中一連串相繼掌權的統治者。
1733.definition: a series of rulers from the same family
1733.en: The dynasty ruled the region for centuries.
1733.zh: 這個王朝統治該地區數百年。

1734.explanation: 把兩個或以上的人或事物分別看待時，指其中每一個。
1734.definition: every one of two or more people or things considered separately
1734.zh: 每一個都有不同的答案。

1734.explanation: 放在單數名詞前，表示群體中的每一個個體。
1734.definition: used before a singular noun to refer to every one separately
1734.zh: 每位學生都收到一張卡片。

1734.explanation: 表示每一個各自有相同的數量、價格或程度。
1734.en: The tickets cost ten dollars each.

1735.explanation: 非常想做某事或得到某物。
1735.definition: very willing or strongly wanting to do or have something

1736.explanation: 大型猛禽，具有強壯的鉤狀嘴和利爪。
1736.definition: a large bird of prey with a strong hooked beak and powerful claws
1736.en: An eagle circled above the valley.
1736.zh: 一隻鷹在山谷上方盤旋。

1737.explanation: 人或動物用來聽聲音的器官。
1737.definition: the organ on the side of the head used for hearing
1737.en: She covered her ears when the alarm sounded.
1737.zh: 警報響起時，她摀住耳朵。

1738.explanation: 在通常、預期時間之前，或接近某段時間的開始。
1738.definition: happening before the usual or expected time, or near the beginning of a period
1738.zh: 我們搭上了一班早班火車。

1738.explanation: 在通常或預期時間之前。
1738.definition: before the usual or expected time
1738.en: She arrived early for the interview.

1739.explanation: 因工作、服務或努力而得到金錢或其他回報。
1739.definition: to receive money or another reward for work, service, or effort
1739.en: She earns enough to pay the rent.
1739.zh: 她賺的錢足以支付房租。

1740.explanation: 態度嚴肅而真誠，顯示真正重視某件事。
1740.definition: serious and sincere in intention or attitude
1740.en: He made an earnest effort to improve.

1740.explanation: 認真而真誠的狀態，尤其常見於 in earnest。
1740.definition: serious and sincere intention or activity, especially in the phrase 'in earnest'
1740.en: After a short delay, work began in earnest.
1740.zh: 短暫延誤後，工作正式認真展開。

1741.explanation: 戴在耳上或放入耳中，用來聽音訊的小型裝置。
1741.definition: a small device worn on or in the ear for listening to sound
1741.en: He used earphones to listen to the recording.

1742.explanation: 戴在耳垂或耳部的飾品。
1742.definition: a piece of jewelry worn on the ear
1742.en: She wore silver earrings to the ceremony.
1742.zh: 她在典禮上戴了銀色耳環。

1743.definition: the planet on which humans live

1743.explanation: 植物生長其中的土，或地表的土地。
1743.definition: soil or ground, especially the material in which plants grow
1743.en: The seeds were covered with a thin layer of earth.

1744.explanation: 地殼運動造成地面突然震動的現象。
1744.definition: a sudden shaking of the ground caused by movements in the Earth's crust
1744.en: The earthquake damaged several old buildings.
1744.zh: 這場地震損壞了幾棟老建築。

1745.explanation: 沒有困難、緊張或不適的狀態。
1745.definition: a state of comfort or freedom from difficulty
1745.en: She spoke with ease in front of the class.
1745.zh: 她在全班面前輕鬆地說話。

1745.explanation: 使困難、疼痛、壓力或緊張程度降低。
1745.definition: to make something less difficult, severe, painful, or tense
1745.en: A short break eased the tension.
1745.zh: 短暫休息緩和了緊張氣氛。

1746.explanation: 太陽升起的大致方向，或某地的東部。
1746.definition: the direction where the sun rises, or the eastern part of a place
1746.en: The mountains lie to the east.

1746.explanation: 位於東方、屬於東部或面向東方的。
1746.definition: located in, belonging to, or facing the east
1746.en: They live on the east side of the city.
The road continues east for several miles.
1746.zh: 這條路向東延伸好幾英里。

1747.explanation: 位於、來自或朝向某地的東部。
1747.definition: located in, coming from, or toward the east of a place
1747.en: Heavy rain reached the eastern part of the island.

1748.explanation: 不需要太多努力、技巧或思考即可完成或理解。
1748.definition: not difficult and requiring little effort, skill, or thought

1749.explanation: 把食物放入口中咀嚼並吞下。
1749.definition: to take food into the mouth, chew it, and swallow it
1749.en: We ate dinner together after practice.
1749.zh: 練習結束後我們一起吃晚餐。

1750.explanation: 行為、想法或外表與一般人明顯不同，常帶有獨特而非危險的意味。
1750.definition: unusual in behavior, ideas, or appearance in a noticeable way
1750.en: The inventor was known for his eccentric habits.
1750.zh: 那位發明家以古怪的習慣聞名。

1750.explanation: 行為或想法非常不同於一般人的人。
1750.definition: a person whose behavior or ideas are noticeably unusual
1750.en: The town regarded him as a harmless eccentric.
1750.zh: 鎮上的人把他視為無害的古怪人物。

1751.explanation: 聲音碰到表面反射後再次被聽見的聲音。
1751.definition: a sound heard again because the original sound is reflected from a surface
1751.en: We heard an echo in the cave.
1751.zh: 我們在洞穴裡聽到回聲。

1751.explanation: 聲音因反射而再次被聽見。
1751.definition: to be heard again after being reflected from a surface
1751.en: Her footsteps echoed through the hall.
1751.zh: 她的腳步聲在大廳裡回響。

1752.explanation: 一個天體遮住另一個天體或進入其陰影而使光線被部分或完全遮蔽的現象。
1752.definition: an event in which one celestial body blocks the light from another or moves into its shadow
1752.en: We watched the lunar eclipse from the school field.
1752.zh: 我們在學校操場觀看月食。

1752.explanation: 遮住另一物的光，或在重要性、成就等方面使其顯得不突出。
1752.definition: to block the light of something or to make it seem less important by comparison
1752.en: The moon will eclipse part of the sun.
1752.zh: 月球將遮住太陽的一部分。

1753.explanation: 與生物和環境之間的關係，或與生態學研究有關的。
1753.definition: relating to ecology or to the relationships between living things and their environment
1753.en: The project studies the ecological effects of tourism.
1753.zh: 這項計畫研究觀光活動的生態影響。

1754.explanation: 研究生物彼此之間以及生物與環境之間關係的學科。
1754.definition: the study of the relationships between living things and their environment
1754.en: She studies the ecology of coastal forests.
1754.zh: 她研究沿海森林的生態。

1755.explanation: 與一個國家或地區的金錢、商業、生產與交易有關的。
1755.definition: relating to money, trade, industry, and the economy of a country or region
1755.en: The city has seen strong economic growth.
1755.zh: 這座城市出現強勁的經濟成長。

1756.explanation: 使用金錢、時間、燃料或其他資源時不浪費。
1756.definition: using money, time, fuel, or other resources without waste
1756.en: This small car is economical to run.
1756.zh: 這輛小車的使用成本很經濟。

1757.explanation: 研究商品、服務、資源與金錢如何生產、分配和使用的學科。
1757.definition: the study of how goods, services, resources, and money are produced, distributed, and used
1757.en: She plans to study economics at university.
1757.zh: 她計畫在大學讀經濟學。

1758.explanation: 研究經濟或以經濟分析為專業的人。
1758.definition: a person who studies economics or works professionally with economic analysis
1758.en: The economist explained why prices had risen.
1758.zh: 那位經濟學家解釋價格上漲的原因。

1759.explanation: 一個國家或地區生產、交易商品服務並使用金錢與資源的整體系統。
1759.definition: the system by which a country or region produces and trades goods and services and uses money and resources
1759.en: The local economy depends heavily on tourism.
1759.zh: 當地經濟高度依賴觀光業。

1760.explanation: 某地的生物群落與非生物環境彼此互動而形成的系統。
1760.definition: a community of living things and the physical environment with which they interact
1760.en: The coral reef is a complex ecosystem.
1760.zh: 珊瑚礁是一個複雜的生態系統。

1761.explanation: 物體、區域或表面的最外側或邊界。
1761.definition: the outer limit or boundary of an object, area, or surface
1761.en: She stood near the edge of the platform.

1761.explanation: 以小幅度慢慢移動到某處或某個位置。
1761.definition: to move slowly or gradually in a particular direction
1761.en: The car edged forward in heavy traffic.
1761.zh: 那輛車在壅塞車流中慢慢向前移動。

1762.explanation: 安全且適合當作食物吃的。
1762.definition: safe and suitable to be eaten as food
1762.en: The berries are edible when fully ripe.
1762.zh: 這些莓果完全成熟後可以食用。

1763.explanation: 檢查並修改文字、影像或其他內容，使其更正確、清楚或適合發表。
1763.definition: to review and change text, images, or other material to improve or prepare it for publication
1763.en: She edited the report before sending it.
1763.zh: 她在寄出報告前先加以編輯。

1764.explanation: 書籍、報紙或其他出版物在特定時間或形式發行的版本。
1764.definition: a particular version or issue of a book, newspaper, or other publication
1764.en: I bought the latest edition of the textbook.
1764.zh: 我買了這本教科書的最新版。

1765.explanation: 負責選擇、修改或安排出版內容的人。
1765.definition: a person who selects, revises, or organizes material for publication
1765.en: The editor suggested several changes to the article.
1765.zh: 編輯建議對文章做幾項修改。

1766.explanation: 與編輯工作、編輯政策或社論內容有關的。
1766.definition: relating to editing, editors, or opinion content published by a news organization
1766.en: The paper changed its editorial policy.
1766.zh: 這家報紙改變了編輯方針。

1766.explanation: 由報紙、雜誌或媒體機構表達立場或意見的文章。
1766.definition: an article that expresses the opinion of a newspaper, magazine, or media organization
1766.en: The newspaper published an editorial on public transportation.
1766.zh: 這家報紙刊登了一篇關於大眾運輸的社論。

1767.explanation: 透過教學、訓練或經驗幫助某人獲得知識與能力。
1767.definition: to teach or train someone so that they gain knowledge and skills
1767.en: The program educates students about online safety.
1767.zh: 這個計畫教導學生網路安全知識。

1768.explanation: 教與學的過程，或由學校與其他機構提供的系統性學習。
1768.definition: the process or system of teaching and learning, especially in schools or institutions
1768.zh: 教育可以帶來新的機會。

1769.explanation: 與教育有關，或能幫助人學習知識與技能。
1769.definition: relating to education or helping people learn
1769.en: The museum offers educational programs for children.
1769.zh: 這座博物館為兒童提供教育活動。

1770.explanation: 某件事造成的改變或結果。
1770.definition: a change or result caused by something
1770.en: The new rule had little effect on attendance.
1770.zh: 新規定對出席率影響不大。

1770.explanation: 使某項改變、計畫或結果真正發生。
1770.definition: to cause a change, plan, or result to happen
1770.en: The committee hopes to effect meaningful change.
1770.zh: 委員會希望促成有意義的改變。

1771.explanation: 能產生預期結果；也可指從某日期開始生效。
1771.definition: successful in producing the intended result; also in force from a stated time
1771.en: The new method is simple and effective.
1771.zh: 這個新方法簡單而有效。

1772.explanation: 以較少時間、能源或資源完成工作並避免浪費的能力。
1772.definition: the ability to work or operate well without wasting time, energy, or resources
1772.en: The new system improved office efficiency.
1772.zh: 新系統提升了辦公效率。

1773.explanation: 能以較少時間、能量或資源完成工作而少有浪費。
1773.definition: working well with little waste of time, energy, or resources
1773.en: The new machine is more efficient than the old one.
1773.zh: 新機器比舊機器更有效率。

1774.explanation: 為完成某件事所付出的體力、心力或嘗試。
1774.definition: physical or mental energy used in trying to do something
1774.en: Learning a language requires time and effort.
1774.zh: 學習語言需要時間和努力。

1775.explanation: 由鳥類等動物產下、具有外殼或膜並可發育成幼體的構造；也常作食物。
1775.definition: a rounded object produced by a bird or other animal that may contain a developing young animal and is often eaten as food
1775.en: She boiled two eggs for breakfast.

1776.explanation: 一個人對自己的認知與重要感，也可指過強的自我意識。
1776.definition: a person's sense of self and personal importance
1776.zh: 他的批評傷了她的自尊心。

1777.explanation: 用在否定句尾，表示前面的否定情況也適用。
1777.definition: used after a negative statement to show that the same is true in another case
1777.en: I do not like that option either.

1777.explanation: 指兩個人或事物中的任何一個。
1777.definition: one or the other of two people or things
1777.zh: 兩個中的任何一個我都可以。

1777.explanation: 放在單數名詞前，表示兩者中的任一個。
1777.definition: used before a singular noun to mean one or the other of two
1777.zh: 你可以使用兩扇門中的任一扇。

1777.explanation: 與 or 連用，連接兩個可能選項。
1777.definition: used with 'or' to connect two possible choices
1777.en: Either call me tonight or send a message.
1777.zh: 你今晚可以打給我，或傳訊息給我。

1778.explanation: 包含許多細節、部分或精心安排的。
1778.definition: containing many carefully arranged details or parts
1778.en: They prepared an elaborate display for the festival.
1778.zh: 他們為節慶準備了精心設計的展示。

1778.explanation: 提供更多細節，使內容更完整清楚。
1778.definition: to explain or develop something in greater detail
1778.en: Could you elaborate on your main point?
1778.zh: 你可以進一步說明你的主要觀點嗎？

1779.explanation: 受拉伸或壓縮後能恢復原形。
1779.definition: able to stretch or change shape and then return to its original form
1779.en: The waistband is made from elastic material.
1779.zh: 腰帶部分由彈性材料製成。

1779.explanation: 可拉伸並恢復原狀的帶狀或材料。
1779.definition: a stretchable material or band that returns to its original shape
1779.en: The elastic in these pants has become loose.
1779.zh: 這條褲子的鬆緊帶已經變鬆了。

1780.explanation: 手臂在上臂與前臂相接處的關節。
1780.definition: the joint where the upper and lower parts of the arm meet
1780.en: He rested his elbow on the desk.

1780.explanation: 用手肘或身體推擠，以便移動或取得空間。
1780.definition: to push with the elbow or force a way through a crowd
1780.en: She elbowed her way through the busy station.
1780.zh: 她在人潮擁擠的車站中擠出一條路。

1781.explanation: 某個家庭、群體或社群中年紀較長的人。
1781.definition: an older person, especially one respected in a family or community
1781.en: The village elders met to discuss the issue.
1781.zh: 村中的長者聚在一起討論這個問題。

1781.explanation: 用於比較同一家人中的年齡，表示較年長。
1781.definition: older, especially when comparing members of the same family
1781.en: My elder sister lives in Kaohsiung.

1782.explanation: 年紀相當大、進入老年階段的。
1782.definition: old or in the later years of life
1782.usageLabel: can sound impersonal when referring to people; 'older' is often preferred
1782.en: The center provides meals for elderly residents.
1782.zh: 這個中心為年長居民提供餐食。

1783.explanation: 透過投票選擇某人擔任公職或職位。
1783.definition: to choose someone for an office or position by voting

1783.explanation: 已被選出但尚未正式就任的。
1783.definition: chosen for an office but not yet officially serving in it
1783.usageLabel: usually after a title, as in president-elect
1783.en: The president-elect will take office next month.
1783.zh: 候任總統將於下個月就職。

1784.explanation: 人民或成員透過投票選出代表、官員或方案的正式程序。
1784.definition: a formal process in which people vote to choose a representative, official, or option
1784.en: The election will be held in November.

1785.explanation: 由電力產生、使用電力或依靠電力運作的。
1785.definition: powered by, producing, or relating to electricity
1785.zh: 他們買了一台電動機車。

1786.explanation: 與電、電力系統或使用電力的設備有關的。
1786.definition: relating to electricity, electrical systems, or equipment that uses electricity
1786.en: The building needs new electrical wiring.
1786.zh: 這棟建築需要新的電線配置。

1787.explanation: 安裝、維修或檢查電線與電氣設備的專業人員。
1787.definition: a skilled worker who installs, repairs, or checks electrical wiring and equipment
1787.en: We called an electrician to repair the faulty outlet.
1787.zh: 我們請電工來修理故障的插座。

1788.explanation: 由帶電粒子產生的能量形式，也指供應給家庭與設備使用的電力。
1788.definition: a form of energy involving electric charge, especially power supplied for use in homes and devices
1788.en: The storm caused a temporary loss of electricity.

1789.explanation: 利用電子元件、電路或數位技術運作或儲存資訊的。
1789.definition: using electronic components, circuits, or digital technology
1789.en: The school keeps electronic records of attendance.
1789.zh: 學校以電子方式保存出席紀錄。

1790.explanation: 研究電子裝置與電路的領域；也可泛指電子產品。
1790.definition: the field involving electronic devices and circuits, or electronic equipment in general
1790.en: She studies electronics at a technical college.
1790.zh: 她在技術學院學習電子學。

1791.explanation: 外觀、風格或設計優美且簡潔得體。
1791.definition: graceful, attractive, and refined in appearance, style, or design
1791.en: She wore a simple but elegant dress.
1791.zh: 她穿了一件簡單但優雅的洋裝。

1792.explanation: 構成較大事物的一個基本部分。
1792.definition: a basic part or component of a larger whole
1792.en: Trust is an important element of teamwork.
1792.zh: 信任是團隊合作的重要要素。

1792.explanation: 無法用一般化學方法分解成更簡單物質的基本物質。
1792.definition: a basic substance that cannot be broken down into simpler substances by ordinary chemical means

1793.explanation: 屬於最基本、最簡單或入門程度的。
1793.definition: basic, simple, or at an introductory level
1793.en: The course begins with elementary grammar.
1793.zh: 這門課從基礎文法開始。

1793.explanation: 與小學階段的學校或教育有關的。
1793.en: She teaches at an elementary school.

1794.explanation: 體型大型、具有長鼻和象牙的陸生哺乳動物。
1794.definition: a very large land mammal with a long trunk and, in many cases, tusks
1794.en: The elephant used its trunk to pick up the branch.

1795.explanation: 把某物移到較高位置，或提升程度、地位或品質。
1795.definition: to raise something to a higher position, level, rank, or quality
1795.en: The platform elevates the equipment above the floor.
1795.zh: 平台把設備抬高到地板之上。

1796.explanation: 在建築物樓層之間垂直運送人或物的升降設備。
1796.definition: a platform or enclosed car that carries people or goods between floors of a building
1796.en: Take the elevator to the fifth floor.

1797.explanation: 符合特定規則或條件，因此可以獲得、申請或參加某事。
1797.definition: meeting the required conditions to receive, apply for, or take part in something
1797.en: Students under eighteen are not eligible for this program.
1797.zh: 未滿十八歲的學生不符合這項計畫的資格。

1798.explanation: 完全移除不需要的東西、問題或可能性。
1798.definition: to remove something unwanted completely or rule it out
1798.en: The new filter helps eliminate unpleasant odors.
1798.zh: 新的濾網有助於消除難聞氣味。

1799.meaning: 有說服力的；善於表達的
1799.explanation: 能清楚、有力而優美地表達想法或情感。
1799.definition: able to express ideas or feelings clearly, powerfully, and gracefully
1799.en: She gave an eloquent speech about environmental protection.
1799.zh: 她發表了一篇關於環境保護的有力演說。

1800.explanation: 表示除了已提到的人、事物或情況之外的其他可能。
1800.definition: in addition to or instead of what has already been mentioned
1800.en: Is there anything else you need?

1801.en: The item was sold out, so we looked elsewhere.
1801.zh: 商品賣完了，所以我們到別處找。

1802.meaning: 電子郵件；電子郵件訊息
1802.explanation: 透過網路傳送的電子訊息，或這種通訊系統。
1802.definition: a message sent electronically over the internet, or the system used to send such messages
1802.en: I received your email this morning.
1802.zh: 我今天早上收到你的電子郵件。

1802.explanation: 透過電子郵件傳送訊息給某人。
1802.definition: to send someone a message by email
1802.en: Please email me the final file.
1802.zh: 請把最後的檔案用電子郵件寄給我。

1803.explanation: 使某人感到害羞、不自在或難為情。
1803.definition: to make someone feel ashamed, awkward, or uncomfortable
1803.en: I did not mean to embarrass you in front of the class.
1803.zh: 我不是故意要讓你在全班面前尷尬。

1803.explanation: 因某件事而產生的羞窘、不自在或難為情的感受或情況。
1803.definition: a feeling or situation of awkwardness, shame, or self-consciousness
1803.en: She laughed to hide her embarrassment.
1803.zh: 她用笑來掩飾自己的尷尬。

1804.explanation: 一國派駐另一國、代表政府並處理外交事務的正式機構或辦公場所。
1804.definition: the official office or building representing one country in another country
1804.en: She contacted the embassy for travel information.
1804.zh: 她聯絡大使館詢問旅行資訊。

1805.explanation: 用手臂抱住某人；也可指樂意接受一個想法、改變或機會。
1805.definition: to hold someone closely in the arms, or to accept an idea, change, or opportunity willingly
1805.en: The school embraced the new learning platform.
1805.zh: 學校欣然採用了新的學習平台。

1805.explanation: 以手臂抱住某人的動作。
1805.definition: an act of holding someone closely in the arms
1805.en: They greeted each other with a warm embrace.
1805.zh: 他們以熱情的擁抱互相問候。

1806.explanation: 從看不見、不清楚或被遮蔽的狀態中出現，或逐漸變得明顯。
1806.definition: to come into view or become known, clear, or important
1806.en: A clear pattern emerged from the data.
1806.zh: 資料中逐漸浮現出清楚的模式。

1807.explanation: 需要立即處理、通常涉及危險或嚴重問題的突發情況。
1807.definition: a sudden serious situation requiring immediate action
1807.en: Call this number only in an emergency.
1807.zh: 只有在緊急情況下才撥打這個號碼。

1808.meaning: 移居國外者；移民（從原居國角度）
1808.explanation: 離開自己的國家，前往另一國定居的人。
1808.definition: a person who leaves their own country to live permanently in another country
1808.en: The museum tells the stories of emigrants who left the island.
1808.zh: 博物館講述離開島嶼移居海外者的故事。

1809.explanation: 離開自己的國家，前往另一國長期或永久居住。
1809.definition: to leave one's own country to live permanently in another country
1809.en: Her grandparents emigrated to Canada many years ago.
1809.zh: 她的祖父母多年前移居加拿大。

1810.explanation: 離開自己的國家到另一國定居的行為或現象。
1810.definition: the act or process of leaving one's own country to settle in another country
1810.en: Economic hardship led to increased emigration.
1810.zh: 經濟困難導致更多人移居海外。

1811.definition: the release of gas, heat, light, or other substances into the environment
1811.en: The new system reduces carbon emissions.

1812.definition: a strong feeling such as happiness, fear, anger, or sadness
1812.zh: 她的聲音幾乎沒有流露情緒。

1813.definition: relating to feelings, or showing strong feelings
1813.en: The movie had a strong emotional effect on him.
1813.zh: 這部電影對他產生強烈的情感影響。

1814.definition: a male ruler of an empire
1814.en: The emperor ordered a new palace to be built.
1814.zh: 皇帝下令興建一座新宮殿。

1815.definition: special importance or attention given to something
1815.en: The course places emphasis on clear writing.
1815.zh: 這門課特別重視清楚的寫作。

1816.definition: to give special importance to something in speaking or writing
1816.en: The teacher emphasized the need for evidence.
1816.zh: 老師強調證據的重要性。

1817.definition: a group of countries or territories ruled by one sovereign or government
1817.en: The empire expanded across a large region.
1817.zh: 這個帝國擴張到廣大的地區。

1818.definition: to pay someone to work, or to use something for a purpose
1818.en: The company employs more than two hundred people.
1818.zh: 這家公司僱用超過兩百人。

1818.definition: the state of having paid work or the act of employing people
1818.en: The program helps young people find employment.
1818.zh: 這項計畫幫助年輕人找到工作。

1819.definition: a person who is paid to work for an organization or another person
1819.en: Each employee receives an identification card.
1819.zh: 每位員工都會收到一張識別證。

1820.definition: a person or organization that pays people to work

1821.definition: containing nothing or having no people in it
to remove everything from a container or place
1821.en: Please empty the box before moving it.
1821.zh: 搬動箱子前請先把它清空。

1822.definition: to make it possible for someone or something to do something
1822.en: The scholarship enabled her to continue studying.
1822.zh: 這筆獎學金使她能繼續求學。

1823.definition: to surround something, or to include something inside a letter or package
1823.en: A stone wall encloses the garden.

1824.en: Our first encounter was brief but memorable.
1824.zh: 我們第一次相遇很短暫但令人難忘。

1824.definition: to meet someone unexpectedly or experience a difficulty
1824.en: We encountered heavy traffic on the way home.
1824.zh: 我們回家途中遇到嚴重塞車。

1825.definition: to give someone confidence or support, or to make something more likely
1825.en: Teachers encourage students to ask questions.

1825.definition: words or actions that give someone confidence or hope
1825.en: Her encouragement helped me finish the project.
1825.zh: 她的鼓勵幫助我完成計畫。

1826.definition: a reference work containing information about many subjects or one broad field
1826.en: She checked the encyclopedia for background information.
1826.zh: 她查閱百科全書以取得背景資料。

1827.definition: the final part or point of something
1827.en: We reached the end of the road.

1827.definition: to finish or cause something to finish

1828.definition: to put someone or something in danger
1828.zh: 污染可能危及野生動物。

1829.definition: a serious effort or attempt to achieve something
1829.en: The project was a difficult but worthwhile endeavor.
1829.zh: 這項計畫雖困難但值得努力。

1829.definition: to make a serious effort to do something
1829.en: We endeavor to provide accurate information.
1829.zh: 我們努力提供準確資訊。

1830.definition: the final part of a story, event, or word
1830.en: The novel has a surprising ending.
1830.zh: 這本小說有令人意外的結局。

1831.definition: to publicly state that you support or approve of someone or something
1831.zh: 幾位專家公開支持這項提案。

1831.definition: a public statement or action showing approval or support
1831.en: The plan received the committee's endorsement.
1831.zh: 這項計畫獲得委員會認可。

1832.definition: money or property given to an institution to provide continuing financial support
1832.en: The university used its endowment to fund scholarships.
1832.zh: 這所大學用捐贈基金提供獎學金。

1833.definition: the ability to continue doing something difficult for a long time

1834.definition: to experience something difficult without giving up, or to continue to exist
1834.en: The bridge has endured many storms.
1834.zh: 這座橋經歷了許多暴風雨仍屹立。

1835.definition: a person or group that is hostile to or opposes another
1835.en: The two former enemies later became allies.
1835.zh: 昔日的兩個敵對方後來成為盟友。

1836.meaning: 精力充沛的；積極有力的
1836.explanation: 精力充沛的；積極有力的
1836.definition: having or showing a lot of energy and activity
1836.en: The energetic students organized the event quickly.
1836.zh: 精力充沛的學生很快就籌辦好活動。

1837.definition: the strength needed for physical or mental activity, or power obtained from physical sources
1837.en: I have more energy after a good night's sleep.
1837.zh: 睡飽一晚後我更有精神。

1838.definition: to make sure that a law or rule is obeyed
the act of making sure a law or rule is obeyed
1838.en: Consistent enforcement of the rules is important.

1839.definition: to take part in an activity or attract someone's interest
1839.en: Students engaged in a lively discussion.

1839.definition: an arrangement or commitment, including an agreement to marry
1839.en: She had a previous engagement that afternoon.

1840.definition: a machine that converts energy into motion or power

1841.definition: a person trained to design, build, or maintain machines, structures, or systems
1841.zh: 一位工程師檢查了這座橋。

1842.definition: the science and profession of designing and building machines, structures, and systems

1843.definition: to improve the quality, value, or strength of something
1843.en: Good lighting can enhance the room's appearance.
1843.zh: 良好照明能提升房間的外觀。

1843.definition: an improvement that increases quality, value, or effectiveness
1843.en: The update includes several security enhancements.
1843.zh: 這次更新包含數項安全性提升。

1844.en: We enjoyed the concert very much.
1844.zh: 我們非常享受這場音樂會。

1844.definition: the pleasure that you get from something
1844.zh: 閱讀帶給她很大的樂趣。

1845.en: The trip was short but enjoyable.
1845.zh: 這趟旅行雖短卻很愉快。

1846.en: Click the image to enlarge it.

1846.definition: the act or result of making something larger
1846.en: The enlargement of the library created more study space.
1846.zh: 圖書館的擴建增加了讀書空間。

1847.definition: to give someone greater knowledge or understanding
1847.en: The lecture enlightened us about local history.
1847.zh: 這場演講讓我們更了解地方歷史。

1847.definition: the state or process of gaining greater knowledge or understanding
1847.en: Education can be a path to enlightenment.
1847.zh: 教育可以是通往啟蒙的一條路。

1848.definition: extremely large in size, amount, or degree
1848.en: The project required an enormous amount of work.
1848.zh: 這項計畫需要極大量的工作。

1849.definition: to the degree or amount that is needed
1849.en: The room is warm enough now.

1849.definition: as much or as many as is needed
1849.en: We have enough food for everyone.
1849.zh: 我們有足夠的食物給每個人。

1849.definition: as much or as many as is necessary
1849.en: Enough has been said about the problem.
1849.zh: 關於這個問題已經說得夠多了。

1850.definition: to improve the quality or value of something by adding useful elements
1850.en: Travel can enrich your understanding of other cultures.
1850.zh: 旅行能豐富你對其他文化的理解。

1850.definition: the act or process of improving quality or value
1850.zh: 這項計畫提供文化上的充實。

1851.definition: to officially join a course, school, or program
1851.en: She enrolled in a summer course.
1851.zh: 她註冊了一門暑期課程。

1851.definition: the act of joining a course or institution, or the number of people registered
1851.zh: 今年的註冊人數增加了。

1852.definition: to make certain that something happens or is true
1852.en: Check the address to ensure that the package arrives correctly.
1852.zh: 核對地址以確保包裹正確送達。

1853.definition: to go into a place or put information into a system
1853.en: Please enter your name in the first box.
1853.zh: 請在第一個欄位輸入你的名字。

1854.definition: a business organization or a planned activity requiring effort and initiative
1854.en: The family built a successful farming enterprise.
1854.zh: 這個家庭建立了一個成功的農業企業。

1855.en: The band entertained the crowd for two hours.
1855.zh: 樂團娛樂群眾兩個小時。

1855.definition: activities or performances that give people pleasure
1855.zh: 這個節慶提供免費娛樂活動。

1856.definition: strong interest and excitement about something
1856.en: She showed great enthusiasm for the project.
1856.zh: 她對這項計畫展現高度熱情。

1857.definition: showing strong interest, excitement, or approval
1857.en: The students were enthusiastic about the experiment.
1857.zh: 學生們對這項實驗很有熱情。

1858.en: She read the entire book in one weekend.
1858.zh: 她一個週末就讀完整本書。

1859.definition: to give someone a right to something, or to give a title to a work
1859.en: This ticket entitles you to one free drink.
1859.zh: 這張票使你有權免費獲得一杯飲料。

1860.definition: something that exists as a separate and distinct unit
1860.en: The two departments operate as separate entities.
1860.zh: 這兩個部門以獨立實體運作。

1861.explanation: 進入某地的通道、門口，或進入某地的行為。
1861.definition: a way into a place, or the act of entering it
1861.en: Please wait near the main entrance.
1861.zh: 請在正門入口附近等候。

1862.explanation: 創辦並經營事業、承擔商業風險的人。
1862.definition: a person who starts and runs a business, taking financial risks in the hope of profit
1862.en: The young entrepreneur opened a small design company.
1862.zh: 這位年輕創業者開了一家小型設計公司。

1863.meaning: 進入；登錄項目；參賽作品
1863.explanation: 進入某地的行為或權利，也可指名單、字典、比賽中的一個項目。
1863.definition: the act or right of entering, or one item recorded in a list, reference work, or competition
1863.zh: 每一則日記條目都有日期。

1864.explanation: 用來裝信件或文件、通常可封口的紙套。
1864.definition: a flat paper container used for a letter or document
1864.en: She put the letter in an envelope.

1865.explanation: 因想擁有別人的優勢、成就或物品而產生羨慕或嫉妒。
1865.definition: wanting something that another person has and feeling envy because of it
1865.en: He felt envious of his friend's success.

1866.explanation: 人、動物或事物周遭的條件，也可特指自然世界及其條件。
1866.definition: the conditions and surroundings in which people, animals, or things live or operate, especially the natural world
1866.en: The school is trying to create a safer learning environment.
1866.zh: 學校正努力營造更安全的學習環境。

1867.meaning: 環境的；與自然環境有關的
1867.explanation: 與自然世界、其保護或人類活動對它的影響有關。
1867.definition: relating to the natural world, its protection, or the effects of human activity on it
1867.en: The city introduced new environmental rules.
1867.zh: 這座城市推出新的環境規範。

1868.explanation: 在心中形成對未來情況或可能性的清楚想像。
1868.definition: to imagine a future situation or possibility clearly
1868.en: They envision a city with more public parks.
1868.zh: 他們設想一座擁有更多公共公園的城市。

1869.explanation: 因別人擁有自己想要的優勢或事物而產生的感受。
1869.definition: a feeling of wanting an advantage or possession that another person has
1869.en: His achievement was the envy of his classmates.
1869.zh: 他的成就令同學們羨慕。

1869.explanation: 因想擁有別人的處境、能力或所有物而羨慕某人。
1869.definition: to wish that you had someone else's situation, ability, or possession
1869.en: I envy her ability to stay calm.
1869.zh: 我羨慕她保持冷靜的能力。

1870.explanation: 在某地或某族群中短時間內病例異常大量增加的疾病流行情況。
1870.definition: a situation in which a disease spreads rapidly and affects unusually many people in a community or region
1870.en: The town prepared for a possible flu epidemic.
1870.zh: 這個城鎮為可能出現的流感疫情做準備。

1870.explanation: 以快速而廣泛的方式影響許多人的。
1870.definition: spreading rapidly and affecting many people within a population or area
1870.en: Officials monitored the disease at epidemic levels.
1870.zh: 官員監測該疾病是否達到流行程度。

1871.explanation: 電視、廣播或故事系列中的一個部分，也可指一段重要或特別的事件。
1871.definition: one part of a television, radio, or story series, or a distinct event or period
1871.en: We watched the final episode last night.
1871.zh: 我們昨晚看了最後一集。

1872.explanation: 在數量、大小、價值、權利或地位上相同的。
1872.definition: the same in amount, size, value, rights, or status
1872.en: The two teams had equal chances of winning.

1872.explanation: 在數量、價值或表現上與另一事物相同。
1872.definition: to be the same as another amount, value, or level

1872.meaning: 相等的人或事物；匹敵者
1872.explanation: 在能力、地位或價值上與另一個人或事物相當者。
1872.definition: a person or thing that is the same as another in ability, status, or value
1872.en: She treated everyone as an equal.
1872.zh: 她平等地對待每一個人。

1873.explanation: 人們享有相同權利、機會或地位的狀態。
1873.definition: the state of having the same rights, opportunities, status, or value
1873.en: The policy promotes equality in education.
1873.zh: 這項政策促進教育平等。

1874.explanation: 使兩個或以上的數量、程度或條件變得相同或更均衡。
1874.definition: to make two or more amounts, levels, or conditions the same or more balanced
1874.en: The new rule is intended to equalize opportunities.
1874.zh: 新規則旨在使機會更為均等。

1875.explanation: 把兩件事看成在價值、意義或效果上相同。
1875.definition: to regard or treat two things as being the same in value, meaning, or effect
1875.en: Do not equate wealth with happiness.
1875.zh: 不要把財富等同於幸福。

1876.explanation: 表示兩個數學表達式相等的敘述，通常含有等號。
1876.definition: a mathematical statement showing that two expressions are equal
1876.zh: 求出這個方程式中的 x。

1877.explanation: 為某人或某物提供特定工作或目的所需的工具、設備或能力。
1877.definition: to provide a person or thing with what is needed for a particular purpose
1877.en: The lab is equipped with modern computers.
1877.zh: 實驗室配備了現代化電腦。

1877.explanation: 為特定活動或工作所使用的一組工具、機器或用品。
1877.definition: the tools, machines, or other items used for a particular purpose
1877.en: The school bought new science equipment.
1877.zh: 學校購買了新的科學設備。

1878.explanation: 依公平原則處理人或分配資源的概念；也可指財產中的淨權益。
1878.definition: fairness in treatment or distribution, and in finance the value owned after debts are subtracted
1878.en: The program aims to improve equity in education.
1878.zh: 這項計畫旨在提升教育公平。

1879.explanation: 在價值、功能、意義或數量上相當的人或事物。
1879.definition: a person or thing equal to another in value, function, meaning, or amount
1879.en: One meter is roughly the equivalent of 3.28 feet.
1879.zh: 一公尺約等於 3.28 英尺。

1879.explanation: 在價值、功能、意義或效果上相同。
1879.definition: equal in value, function, meaning, or effect
1879.en: The two qualifications are considered equivalent.
1879.zh: 這兩種資格被視為同等。

1880.explanation: 因特定事件、人物或特徵而被區分的一段歷史時期。
1880.definition: a period of history distinguished by particular events, people, or characteristics
1880.en: The invention marked the beginning of a new era.
1880.zh: 這項發明標誌著新時代的開始。

1881.explanation: 從表面、記錄或記憶中移除文字、標記或資訊。
1881.definition: to remove writing, marks, recorded information, or traces of something
1881.en: Please erase the old note from the board.
1881.zh: 請把黑板上的舊筆記擦掉。

1882.explanation: 用來擦除鉛筆或其他可擦除痕跡的物品。
1882.definition: an object used to remove pencil or other erasable marks
1882.zh: 我可以借你的橡皮擦嗎？

1883.explanation: 把建築物、結構或物體建起或立起。
1883.definition: to build a structure or put something upright
1883.en: Workers erected a temporary fence around the site.
1883.zh: 工人在工地周圍架起臨時圍欄。

1883.explanation: 筆直向上、沒有彎曲或下垂的。
1883.definition: upright and not bent or leaning
1883.en: She sat erect in the chair.

1884.explanation: 為自己或別人外出完成的小任務，例如送件、購物或辦事。
1884.definition: a short trip made to do a small task such as delivering, buying, or collecting something
1884.en: I need to run an errand after school.
1884.zh: 我放學後需要去辦一件差事。

1885.explanation: 不正確的行為、判斷、計算或資料。
1885.definition: a mistake in action, judgment, calculation, or information
1885.en: The report contains a small error.
1885.zh: 這份報告有一個小錯誤。

1886.explanation: 火山突然噴出熔岩、灰或氣體，也可指事件或情緒突然爆發。
1886.definition: to burst out suddenly, especially when a volcano releases lava, ash, or gas
1886.zh: 這座火山可能再次噴發。

1887.explanation: 由連續移動階梯構成、運送人上下樓層的設備。
1887.definition: a moving staircase that carries people between floors
1887.en: Take the escalator to the second floor.

1888.explanation: 從危險、拘束或不想待的地方成功離開。
1888.definition: to get away from danger, confinement, or an unwanted situation
1888.en: The hikers escaped the storm before dark.
1888.zh: 登山客在天黑前逃離了暴風雨。

1888.explanation: 從危險、拘束或困境中成功離開的行為。
1888.definition: an act of getting away from danger, confinement, or a difficult situation
1888.zh: 他們的逃脫經過仔細規畫。

1889.explanation: 陪伴某人前往某地以提供保護、協助或禮貌陪同的人。
1889.definition: a person or group that accompanies someone for protection, assistance, or courtesy
1889.en: A staff member served as our escort.
1889.zh: 一名工作人員擔任我們的陪同人員。

1889.explanation: 陪伴某人前往某地，通常為了保護、引導或禮貌。
1889.definition: to accompany someone somewhere, usually for protection, guidance, or courtesy
1889.en: A guide escorted us through the building.
1889.zh: 一位導覽員陪同我們參觀大樓。

1890.explanation: 用來指出某人或某事比其他人事物更突出或更重要。
1890.definition: used to single out one person or thing as more important, noticeable, or relevant than others
1890.zh: 我喜歡水果，尤其是柳橙。

1891.explanation: 針對某一主題所寫的短篇正式文章，常見於學校作業或出版品。
1891.definition: a relatively short piece of formal writing on a particular subject
1891.en: She wrote an essay about climate change.
1891.zh: 她寫了一篇關於氣候變遷的文章。

1892.explanation: 使某事物成為它本身的最重要或最基本特質。
1892.definition: the most important or fundamental quality that gives something its character
1892.en: Trust is the essence of a strong partnership.
1892.zh: 信任是穩固合作關係的核心。

1893.explanation: 非常重要或不可缺少的。
1893.en: Clean water is essential for health.
1893.zh: 乾淨的水對健康至關重要。

1893.explanation: 完成某事或維持生活不可缺少的東西或基本要素。
1893.definition: something that is necessary or very important
1893.en: Food and water are basic essentials.
1893.zh: 食物和水是基本必需品。

1894.explanation: 創立組織、制度或關係，或使某事被確認為真實、穩定或有效。
1894.definition: to create or set up something intended to last, or to confirm something firmly
1894.en: The group established a community center.
1894.zh: 這個團體成立了一個社區中心。

1894.explanation: 建立某事的過程，也可指已成立的組織、企業或機構。
1894.definition: the act of setting something up, or an organization or business that has been established
1894.en: The establishment of the new school took several years.
1894.zh: 新學校的成立花了好幾年。

1895.explanation: 一大片土地及其建築，或一個人死亡時留下的全部財產。
1895.definition: a large area of land with buildings, or all the property and money left by a person at death
1895.en: The family owns a large estate outside the city.
1895.zh: 這個家庭在城外擁有一大片地產。

1896.explanation: 對某人的品格、能力或成就抱有高度尊重的感受。
1896.definition: a feeling of high respect and admiration for someone's qualities or achievements
1896.en: She is held in high esteem by her colleagues.

1896.explanation: 高度尊重或重視某人或某事。
1896.definition: to respect or value someone or something highly
1896.en: He is widely esteemed for his fairness.

1897.explanation: 根據已有資訊做出的近似數量、成本或大小判斷。
1897.definition: an approximate calculation or judgment of an amount, cost, size, or value
1897.en: The repair estimate was higher than expected.

1897.explanation: 根據現有資訊大致計算或判斷數量、成本、大小或價值。
1897.definition: to calculate or judge an amount, cost, size, or value approximately
1897.en: We estimate that the trip will take three hours.
1897.zh: 我們估計這趟行程需要三小時。

1898.explanation: 沒有開始或結束，或持續極長時間、彷彿永遠存在的。
1898.definition: lasting forever or seeming to have no end
1898.en: The story explores the search for eternal life.
1898.zh: 這個故事探討對永恆生命的追求。

1899.explanation: 沒有盡頭的時間，或感覺極其漫長的一段時間。
1899.definition: time without end, or a period that seems extremely long
1899.en: The wait seemed to last an eternity.
1899.zh: 等待似乎持續了永遠那麼久。

1900.explanation: 判斷行為對錯的原則或研究這些原則的領域。
1900.definition: moral principles governing behavior, or the study of what is right and wrong
1900.en: The course examines ethics in medical research.
1900.zh: 這門課探討醫學研究中的倫理問題。

1901.explanation: 與對錯的道德原則有關，或符合這些原則的。
1901.definition: relating to moral principles, or morally right and acceptable
1901.zh: 研究人員必須遵守倫理準則。

1902.explanation: 與具有共同文化、語言、歷史或傳統的族群有關。
1902.definition: relating to a group of people who share a culture, language, history, or traditions
1902.en: The city is home to many ethnic communities.
1902.zh: 這座城市有許多不同族群社群。

1902.explanation: 屬於特定族群的人；這種名詞用法依語境可能顯得標籤化，宜謹慎使用。
1902.definition: a person belonging to a particular ethnic group; this noun use can sound labeling in some contexts
1902.en: The older text used the word as a noun for an ethnic minority member.
1902.zh: 較舊的文本把這個字當名詞指少數族群成員。

1903.explanation: 因危險而把人移出某地，或離開危險地區。
1903.definition: to move people out of a dangerous place, or to leave such a place for safety
1903.en: Residents were told to evacuate the area.
1903.zh: 居民被告知要撤離該區。

1904.explanation: 仔細判斷某事物的品質、重要性、價值或效果。
1904.definition: to judge the quality, importance, value, or effectiveness of something carefully
1904.en: The team will evaluate the results next week.

1905.explanation: 對品質、價值、重要性或效果所做的系統性判斷。
1905.definition: a systematic judgment of quality, value, importance, or effectiveness
1905.en: The program is undergoing a formal evaluation.
1905.zh: 這項計畫正在接受正式評估。

1906.explanation: 某個重要日子或事件之前的一天或晚上。
1906.definition: the day or evening before an important day or event
1906.en: The streets were crowded on New Year's Eve.
1906.zh: 跨年夜街道上擠滿了人。

1907.explanation: 用來強調某事出乎意料或比預期更極端。
1907.definition: used to emphasize something surprising, unexpected, or more extreme than expected
1907.en: Even the youngest student understood the question.
1907.zh: 連最年幼的學生都理解這個問題。

1907.explanation: 表面平整，或分布、數量、程度相同而均衡。
1907.definition: flat, level, regular, or equal in amount or distribution
1907.en: Place the table on an even surface.
1907.zh: 把桌子放在平坦的表面上。

1907.explanation: 使數量、分布或差距變得更相等。
1907.definition: to make an amount, distribution, or difference more equal
1907.en: The late goal evened the score.
1907.zh: 最後的進球把比分扳平。

1908.explanation: 一天中下午結束後到夜晚之間的時段。
1908.definition: the part of the day between the end of the afternoon and night
1908.en: We went for a walk in the evening.

1909.explanation: 發生的事情，也可指有安排的活動或競賽中的單一項目。
1909.definition: something that happens, an organized occasion, or one competition in a larger program
1909.en: The school held a charity event on Saturday.
1909.zh: 學校星期六舉辦了一場慈善活動。

1910.explanation: 經過一段時間、過程或延遲後最後發生或形成的。
1910.definition: happening or resulting at the end of a process or after a period of time
1910.en: The team's eventual success surprised many people.
1910.zh: 這支隊伍最終的成功讓許多人感到意外。

1911.explanation: 用於談論某人在任何時間是否有過某種經驗，或表示任何時候。
1911.definition: at any time, especially when asking about or referring to experience
1911.en: Have you ever visited New York?

1912.definition: remaining green and keeping leaves throughout the year
1912.en: Evergreen trees provide color in winter.
1912.zh: 常綠樹在冬季仍帶來綠意。

1912.explanation: 全年保持綠葉的樹木或植物。
1912.definition: a tree or plant that keeps its leaves throughout the year
1912.en: This evergreen grows well in cool climates.
1912.zh: 這種常綠植物在涼爽氣候中生長良好。

1913.explanation: 放在單數可數名詞前，表示群體中的每一個成員。
1913.definition: used before a singular noun to refer to all members of a group individually
1913.zh: 每位學生都需要一張票。

1914.explanation: 指某一群體中或一般情況下的所有人。
1914.definition: every person in a group or in general
1914.zh: 每個人都準備好開始了。

1915.explanation: 指所有事物，或某情況中的全部事物。
1915.definition: all things or all the things in a particular situation
1915.en: Everything is ready for the trip.
1915.zh: 旅行所需的一切都準備好了。

1916.explanation: 支持某項結論的事實或資訊。
1916.definition: facts or information that support a conclusion
1916.en: The report provides evidence of climate change.
1916.zh: 這份報告提供氣候變遷的證據。

1916.explanation: 清楚顯示某事存在或為真。
1916.definition: to show clearly that something exists or is true
1916.en: The records evidence a steady rise in demand.
1916.zh: 這些紀錄顯示需求穩定上升。

1917.explanation: 容易看出、注意到或理解的。
1917.definition: easy to see, notice, or understand
1917.en: It was evident that the plan needed revision.
1917.zh: 很明顯這項計畫需要修改。

1918.explanation: 道德上的邪惡或造成嚴重傷害的事物。
1918.definition: moral wickedness or something that causes serious harm
1918.en: The story describes a struggle between good and evil.
1918.zh: 這個故事描述善與惡的鬥爭。

1918.explanation: 道德上邪惡或蓄意造成傷害的。
1918.en: The villain had an evil plan.
1918.zh: 反派有一個邪惡的計畫。

1919.explanation: 使某種感情、記憶、形象或反應浮現。
1919.definition: to cause a feeling, memory, image, or response to come to mind
1919.en: The song evokes memories of childhood.
1919.zh: 這首歌喚起童年的回憶。

1920.explanation: 生物或其他系統逐漸發展與改變的過程。
1920.definition: the gradual process by which living things or other systems develop and change
1920.zh: 這座博物館介紹人類演化。

1921.explanation: 逐漸發展成不同或更進一步的形式。
1921.definition: to develop gradually into a different or more advanced form
1921.en: The idea evolved over several years.
1921.zh: 這個構想經過數年逐漸發展。

1922.explanation: 在每個細節上都完全正確或明確的。
1922.definition: completely correct or specific in every detail
1922.en: We do not know the exact date yet.
1922.zh: 我們還不知道確切日期。

1923.explanation: 把事物描述得比實際更大、更好、更糟或更重要。
1923.definition: to describe something as greater, better, worse, or more important than it really is
1923.en: Do not exaggerate the size of the problem.

1924.explanation: 使某事看起來比實際更極端的說法。
1924.definition: a statement or description that makes something seem more extreme than it really is
1924.en: Calling it a disaster is an exaggeration.
1924.zh: 把它稱為災難是誇張的說法。

1925.explanation: 正式的知識或技能測驗，也可指仔細的檢查。
1925.definition: a formal test of knowledge or skill, or a careful inspection
1925.en: She has a math exam tomorrow.

1926.explanation: 仔細查看、檢查或考量某人或某事物。
1926.definition: to look at or consider someone or something carefully
1926.en: The doctor examined my injured hand.
1926.zh: 醫生檢查了我受傷的手。

1927.explanation: 正在參加考試或接受檢查的人。
1927.definition: a person who is taking an examination or being examined
1927.en: Each examinee received a numbered card.
1927.zh: 每位應試者都拿到一張有編號的卡片。

1928.explanation: 負責測試、檢查或評定某人或某事物的人。
1928.definition: a person who tests, inspects, or judges someone or something
1928.en: The examiner asked two final questions.
1928.zh: 主考人問了最後兩個問題。

1929.explanation: 用來說明某事物特徵的人、事物或情況。
1929.definition: a person, thing, or situation used to show what something is like
1929.en: This sentence is a good example of the pattern.
1929.zh: 這個句子是該句型的好例子。

1930.explanation: 在數量、程度或限制上大於某個標準。
1930.definition: to be greater than a particular number, amount, or limit
1930.en: Costs may exceed the original budget.
1930.zh: 費用可能超過原先的預算。

1931.explanation: 在某項活動或領域中表現非常好。
1931.definition: to be extremely good at an activity or subject
1931.en: She excels at solving complex problems.
1931.zh: 她很擅長解決複雜問題。

1932.explanation: 極高品質或極佳表現的特質。
1932.definition: the quality of being extremely good
1932.en: The school is known for academic excellence.
1932.zh: 這所學校以學術卓越聞名。

1933.explanation: 品質非常高或表現非常好的。
1933.definition: extremely good or of very high quality
1933.zh: 這家餐廳提供極佳的服務。

1934.definition: not including a particular person or thing
1934.zh: 除了 Leo 之外，每個人都來了。

1934.explanation: 用來引出限制或例外情況。
1934.definition: used to introduce a statement that limits or makes an exception to what was just said
1934.en: I would go, except I have to study.
1934.zh: 我本來會去，只是我得念書。

1935.explanation: 不符合一般規則或未被包含在一般敘述中的人或事物。
1935.definition: a person or thing that is not included in a general rule or statement
1935.en: There is one exception to this rule.

1936.explanation: 異常地好，或以不尋常的方式特別突出。
1936.definition: unusually good, or unusual in a way that stands out
1936.en: She showed exceptional skill in the competition.
1936.zh: 她在比賽中展現出傑出的技巧。

1937.explanation: 從較長作品中取出的一小段。
1937.definition: a short passage taken from a longer work
1937.en: We read an excerpt from the novel.
1937.zh: 我們讀了這本小說的一段摘錄。

1937.explanation: 從較長作品中選取一小段供引用或刊載。
1937.definition: to take or publish a short passage from a longer work
1937.en: The article was excerpted from her new book.
1937.zh: 這篇文章摘錄自她的新書。

1938.explanation: 超出需要、允許或正常數量的。
1938.definition: more than is needed, allowed, or usual
1938.en: Excess sugar can affect your health.
1938.zh: 過量的糖可能影響健康。

1938.explanation: 超出必要或正常程度的數量。
1938.definition: an amount beyond what is necessary or usual
1938.en: An excess of salt can spoil the dish.
1938.zh: 過量的鹽會破壞這道菜的味道。

1939.explanation: 超過合理、必要或可接受程度的。
1939.definition: greater than is reasonable, necessary, or acceptable
1939.en: Excessive noise can make it hard to concentrate.
1939.zh: 過度噪音會讓人難以專心。

1940.explanation: 給出某物並收到另一物的行為。
1940.definition: an act of giving something and receiving something in return
1940.en: The students took part in a cultural exchange.
1940.zh: 學生參加了文化交流活動。

1940.explanation: 互相給予並收取物品、資訊或貨幣。
1940.definition: to give something and receive another thing in return
1940.en: We exchanged phone numbers after class.
1940.zh: 下課後我們交換了電話號碼。

1941.explanation: 使某人感到熱切、興奮或有興趣。
1941.definition: to make someone feel enthusiastic, eager, or strongly interested
1941.en: The news excited the whole team.
1941.zh: 這個消息讓整個團隊都很興奮。

1941.explanation: 強烈的熱情、期待或激動感。
1941.definition: a strong feeling of enthusiasm, eagerness, or emotional energy
1941.en: There was great excitement before the final.

1942.explanation: 因某事感到非常開心、熱切或期待。
1942.definition: feeling very happy, enthusiastic, or eager about something
1942.en: The children were excited about the trip.
1942.zh: 孩子們對這趟旅行感到很興奮。

1943.explanation: 能引起強烈興趣、熱情或期待的。
1943.definition: causing strong interest, enthusiasm, or eagerness
1943.en: It was an exciting final game.
1943.zh: 那是一場令人興奮的決賽。

1944.explanation: 因強烈感情而突然大聲說出某話。
1944.definition: to say something suddenly and loudly because of strong feeling

1945.explanation: 刻意把某人或某事物排除在外，或不讓其參與。
1945.definition: to deliberately leave someone or something out or prevent participation
1945.zh: 這個價格不包括交通費。

1946.explanation: 把某人或某事物排除在外或不納入的行為。
1946.definition: the act of leaving someone or something out or preventing inclusion
1946.en: The exclusion of these data changed the result.
1946.zh: 排除這些資料後，結果改變了。

1947.explanation: 只限於某人、群體或來源，或不與他人共享的。
1947.definition: limited to one person, group, or source, or not shared with others
1947.en: The newspaper published an exclusive interview.
1947.zh: 這家報紙刊出一篇獨家專訪。

1948.explanation: 原諒小過失或允許某人不參與。
1948.definition: to forgive a minor fault or allow someone not to take part

1948.explanation: 為解釋或辯護行為而提出的理由。
1948.definition: a reason given to explain or defend an action
1948.en: He gave a reasonable excuse for being late.
1948.zh: 他為遲到提出了一個合理的理由。

1949.explanation: 依計畫、命令或任務實際採取行動。
1949.definition: to carry out a plan, order, or task
1949.en: The team executed the plan successfully.

1950.explanation: 執行計畫、命令或任務的行為或過程。
1950.definition: the act or process of carrying out a plan, order, or task
1950.en: Careful execution is essential to the project's success.
1950.zh: 謹慎執行對計畫成功至關重要。

1951.explanation: 在組織中負責重要管理決策的人。
1951.definition: a senior manager who makes important decisions in an organization
1951.en: The executive approved the new budget.
1951.zh: 這位主管批准了新預算。

1951.explanation: 與管理組織或執行決策有關的。
1951.definition: relating to managing an organization or carrying out decisions
1951.en: She has an executive position at the company.

1952.explanation: 不必遵守某項要求、規則或支付某項費用的。
1952.definition: not required to do something or not subject to a rule or payment
1952.en: Children under six are exempt from the fee.
1952.zh: 六歲以下兒童免繳這項費用。

1953.explanation: 為健康所做的身體活動或用來練習技能的活動。
1953.definition: physical activity for health or an activity used to practice a skill
1953.en: Regular exercise can improve your health.

1953.explanation: 做身體活動，或運用權利、權力或能力。
1953.definition: to do physical activity or use a right, power, or ability
1953.en: Citizens should exercise their right to vote.

1954.explanation: 使用力量、影響力、權威或努力。
1954.definition: to use physical force, influence, authority, or effort
1954.en: The group exerted pressure on the company.
1954.zh: 這個團體向公司施加壓力。

1955.explanation: 引擎運作時排出的廢氣。
1955.definition: waste gases released by an engine
1955.en: The tunnel was filled with vehicle exhaust.

1955.explanation: 使某人極度疲倦或把資源完全用完。
1955.definition: to make someone extremely tired or use a supply completely
1955.zh: 長途健行讓我們筋疲力盡。

1956.explanation: 在博物館、展覽等公開展示的物件。
1956.definition: an object or collection displayed publicly
1956.en: The dinosaur skeleton is the museum's most popular exhibit.
1956.zh: 這具恐龍骨架是博物館最受歡迎的展品。

1956.explanation: 公開展示物品或表現出某種特質。
1956.definition: to show something publicly or display a quality
1956.zh: 博物館展出當地藝術作品。

1957.explanation: 公開展示物品、藝術作品或技能的活動。
1957.definition: a public event at which objects, art, or skills are displayed
1957.zh: 我們參觀了一場攝影展。

1958.explanation: 被迫離開祖國的狀態，或處於此狀態的人。
1958.definition: forced absence from one's country, or a person living away from it for that reason
1958.en: The writer spent many years in exile.

1958.explanation: 迫使某人離開祖國或居住地。
1958.definition: to force someone to live away from their country or home
1958.en: The ruler exiled his political opponents.
1958.zh: 統治者放逐了政治對手。

1959.definition: to be real, present, or alive
1959.zh: 幾種解決方案已經存在。

1960.explanation: 實際存在、出現或活著的狀態或事實。
1960.definition: the state or fact of being real, present, or alive
1960.en: Scientists are searching for evidence of life’s existence elsewhere.
1960.zh: 科學家正在尋找其他地方存在生命的證據。

1961.explanation: 可離開某地的通道，或離開的行為。
1961.definition: a way out of a place, or the act of leaving
1961.en: The emergency exit is beside the stairs.

1961.explanation: 從某地、系統或活動中離開。
1961.definition: to leave a place, system, or activity

1962.explanation: 來自遠方國家，或因罕見而顯得特別有趣。
1962.definition: foreign or strikingly unusual and interesting
1962.en: The market sells exotic fruits from several countries.
1962.zh: 這個市場販售來自多個國家的異國水果。

1962.explanation: 外來、罕見或引人注意的人或事物。
1962.definition: a foreign, rare, or unusually interesting thing
1962.en: The greenhouse contains several rare exotics.
1962.zh: 溫室裡有幾種罕見的外來植物。

1963.explanation: 使某物變大，或本身在大小、範圍或活動上增加。
1963.definition: to become larger or make something larger in size, scope, or activity
1963.en: The company plans to expand its services next year.
1963.zh: 公司計畫明年擴大服務範圍。

1964.explanation: 規模、數量、範圍或活動增加的過程。
1964.definition: the process of becoming greater in size, number, scope, or activity
1964.en: The rapid expansion of the city changed the area.
1964.zh: 城市的快速擴張改變了這個地區。

1965.explanation: 相信某事可能發生，或認為某人應該做某事。
1965.definition: to believe something is likely to happen or require something as reasonable
1965.en: We expect the train to arrive on time.
1965.zh: 我們預期火車會準時抵達。

1966.explanation: 對將發生之事或適當行為的強烈信念。
1966.definition: a strong belief about what will happen or what should happen
1966.en: The new product exceeded our expectations.
1966.zh: 新產品超出了我們的預期。

1967.explanation: 為探索、研究或特定目的而組織的旅程，亦可指參與者。
1967.definition: an organized journey for a particular purpose, or the group making it
1967.en: The research team began an expedition to Antarctica.
1967.zh: 研究團隊展開了前往南極洲的考察。

1968.explanation: 花掉的金錢、時間或能量，或花費的行為。
1968.definition: money, time, or energy spent, or the act of spending it
1968.en: The school reduced its expenditure on energy.
1968.zh: 學校降低了能源方面的支出。

1969.explanation: 為某事支付的金錢，或為達成某事付出的代價。
1969.definition: money spent on something, or a cost paid to achieve something
1969.en: Travel expenses were higher than expected.

1970.explanation: 價格高或需要大量金錢。
1970.en: The new equipment is too expensive for our budget.
1970.zh: 這套新設備對我們的預算來說太昂貴。

1971.explanation: 由親身做事獲得的知識，或一件親身經歷的事情。
1971.definition: knowledge gained by doing things, or an event personally lived through
1971.en: Her internship gave her valuable work experience.
1971.zh: 她的實習帶給她寶貴的工作經驗。

1971.explanation: 親身遭遇某件事或感受到某種情況。
1971.definition: to personally undergo or feel something
1971.zh: 這座城市經歷了快速成長。

1972.explanation: 為檢驗想法或發現事實而進行的科學測試。
1972.definition: a scientific test done to discover facts or test an idea
1972.en: The students conducted a simple experiment in class.
1972.zh: 學生們在課堂上進行了一個簡單的實驗。

1972.explanation: 用新的方法或想法進行試驗。
1972.definition: to test a new method or idea to see what happens
1972.en: The team experimented with a new schedule.
1972.zh: 團隊嘗試了一套新的時程安排。

1973.explanation: 與實驗有關，或仍在測試、尚未完全確立的。
1973.definition: relating to experiments or still being tested
1973.en: The school tested an experimental teaching method.
1973.zh: 學校測試了一種實驗性的教學方法。

1974.explanation: 在某領域具有高度知識或技能的人。
1974.definition: a person with a high level of knowledge or skill in a field
1974.en: She is an expert in marine biology.
1974.zh: 她是海洋生物學的專家。

1974.explanation: 具有高度專門知識或技能的。
1974.definition: having a high degree of specialized knowledge or skill

1975.explanation: 某特定領域中的高度知識或技能。
1975.definition: specialized knowledge or skill in a particular field
1975.zh: 這個專案需要專業技術知識。

1976.explanation: 固定期間或有效期限結束。
1976.definition: the ending of a fixed period or period of validity
1976.en: Check the expiration date on the membership card.
1976.zh: 請查看會員卡的到期日。

1977.explanation: 合約、證件、期限等結束並不再有效。
1977.definition: to reach the end of a period of validity and cease to be valid

1978.explanation: 使某件事的原因、意義或運作方式變得清楚。
1978.definition: to make the reason, meaning, or operation of something clear
1978.en: Can you explain the rule to me?
1978.zh: 你可以向我解釋這條規則嗎？

1979.explanation: 用來說明某事原因、意義或方式的陳述。
1979.definition: a statement that makes the reason, meaning, or method of something clear
1979.en: There is a simple explanation for the delay.
1979.zh: 這次延誤有一個簡單的解釋。

1980.explanation: 清楚完整地表達，不留下猜測空間。
1980.definition: stated clearly and fully, leaving little room for doubt
1980.en: The teacher gave explicit instructions for the assignment.
1980.zh: 老師對作業給了明確的說明。

1981.explanation: 突然猛烈地爆開，或數量、情緒等急劇增加。
1981.definition: to burst violently or increase suddenly and sharply
1981.en: Online demand exploded after the announcement.
1981.zh: 公告後線上需求急遽增加。

1982.explanation: 充分利用資源或機會，或不公平地利用某人。
1982.definition: to make full use of a resource or opportunity, or take unfair advantage of someone
1982.en: The company hopes to exploit new opportunities responsibly.
1982.zh: 公司希望負責任地善用新的機會。

1982.explanation: 引人注目、勇敢或高難度的行動。
1982.definition: a notable, brave, or difficult achievement
1982.en: The team's remarkable exploits were recorded in the history book.
1982.zh: 團隊的傑出事蹟被記錄在歷史書中。

1983.explanation: 為了解某地、主題或可能性而仔細探索的行為。
1983.definition: the act of examining a place, subject, or possibility to learn more
1983.en: The course encourages exploration of new ideas.
1983.zh: 這門課鼓勵探索新想法。

1984.explanation: 旅行或仔細研究以了解某地、主題或可能性。
1984.definition: to travel through or study something carefully in order to learn about it
1984.en: We need to explore several possible solutions.
1984.zh: 我們需要探索幾種可能的解決方案。

1985.explanation: 突然猛烈爆開的事件，或數量的快速大增。
1985.definition: a sudden violent bursting event, or a rapid large increase
1985.en: The city saw an explosion in housing demand.
1985.zh: 這座城市的住房需求大幅激增。

1986.explanation: 能爆炸的，或可能突然猛烈發展的。
1986.definition: able to explode, or likely to develop suddenly and violently
1986.zh: 公司公布了爆發式成長。

1986.explanation: 可發生爆炸的物質或裝置的總稱。
1986.definition: a substance or device capable of exploding
1986.en: The label warned that the material was an explosive.
1986.zh: 標籤警示該物質屬於爆炸物。

1987.explanation: 售往其他國家的商品，或出口活動。
1987.definition: goods sold to another country, or the activity of selling them abroad
1987.en: Coffee is one of the country's major exports.
1987.zh: 咖啡是該國主要出口商品之一。

1987.explanation: 把商品或資料送往另一國家或系統。
1987.definition: to send goods or data to another country or system
1987.en: The software can export the report as a PDF.
1987.zh: 這個軟體可以把報告輸出成 PDF。

1988.explanation: 使某人或某物不再受到遮蔽，或揭示隱藏的事實。
1988.definition: to leave someone or something unprotected or reveal something hidden
1988.en: The investigation exposed serious accounting errors.
1988.zh: 調查揭露了嚴重的會計錯誤。

1989.explanation: 處於某種影響、環境或公眾注意之下的狀態。
1989.definition: the state of being subject to an influence, environment, or public attention
1989.en: The artist gained wider exposure through the exhibition.
1989.zh: 這位藝術家透過展覽獲得更高曝光度。

1990.explanation: 以言語、文字、動作等傳達思想或感受。
1990.definition: to communicate a thought or feeling in words, writing, or actions
1990.zh: 她清楚表達了她的擔憂。

1990.explanation: 特別快速直接的，或明白說出的。
1990.definition: specially fast and direct, or clearly stated
1990.en: We took the express train to the city.

1990.explanation: 用快速、特別安排的運送方式。
1990.definition: by a fast specially arranged delivery service

1990.explanation: 快速運輸服務或快速列車。
1990.definition: a fast transport service or fast train

1991.explanation: 表達思想或感情的方式，也可指臉部呈現的神情。
1991.definition: a way of communicating an idea or feeling, or a look on the face
1991.zh: 他的臉部表情顯示出驚訝。

1992.explanation: 能清楚有力地傳達思想或感情的。
1992.definition: showing thoughts or feelings clearly and effectively

1993.explanation: 使某物在時間、空間或範圍上更長或更廣。
1993.definition: to make something longer or larger in time, space, or scope
1993.en: The library extended its opening hours.
1993.zh: 圖書館延長了開放時間。

1994.explanation: 延長或擴大的行為，也可指附加的部分。
1994.definition: the act of making something longer, or an added part
1994.en: They requested an extension of the deadline.
1994.zh: 他們要求延長截止期限。

1995.explanation: 涵蓋很大的範圍、數量或程度。
1995.definition: covering a large area, amount, range, or degree
1995.en: The report is based on extensive research.
1995.zh: 這份報告以廣泛研究為基礎。

1996.explanation: 某事達到、涵蓋或發生的程度或範圍。
1996.definition: the degree or range to which something happens or applies
1996.en: We did not realize the full extent of the change.
1996.zh: 我們沒有意識到這項改變的完整程度。

1997.explanation: 物體或建築物的外面部分。
1997.definition: the outside part or surface of something
1997.en: The exterior of the building was renovated.
1997.zh: 建築物的外部經過整修。

1997.explanation: 位於或關於某物外面的。
1997.definition: located on or relating to the outside of something

1998.explanation: 來自或位於某人、組織或物體之外的。
1998.definition: coming from or located outside a person, organization, or object
1998.en: The decision was influenced by external factors.
1998.zh: 這項決定受到外部因素影響。

1998.explanation: 位於系統之外或從外部作用的事物。
1998.definition: something outside a system or acting on it from outside
1998.en: The model treats weather and prices as externals.
1998.zh: 這個模型把天氣與價格視為外在因素。

1999.explanation: 某物種已無存活成員，或某事物已停止存在。
1999.definition: having no living members left, or no longer existing
1999.en: Several species became extinct after the climate changed.
1999.zh: 氣候改變後有幾個物種滅絕了。

2000.explanation: 超出通常、預期或需要數量的。
2000.definition: additional to the usual, expected, or required amount
2000.zh: 我們需要一張額外的椅子。

2000.explanation: 額外提供或另外收費的東西。
