2000.definition: an additional item, service, or charge
2000.zh: 早餐是可選的額外服務。

2001.explanation: 從較長作品取出的段落，或從物質取得的濃縮成分。
2001.definition: a passage taken from a longer work, or a concentrated substance obtained from something
2001.en: The article includes an extract from the speech.
2001.zh: 這篇文章包含演說的一段摘錄。

2001.explanation: 以某種方法從整體中取出某物或資訊。
2001.definition: to remove or obtain something or information from a larger whole
2001.en: The program extracts key data from the file.
2001.zh: 這個程式從檔案中擷取重要資料。

2002.explanation: 屬於學校正式課程之外的活動。
2002.definition: relating to activities outside the regular school curriculum
2002.zh: 她參加了幾項課外活動。

2003.explanation: 非常不尋常、令人驚訝或超出一般程度的。
2003.definition: very unusual, remarkable, or beyond what is ordinary

2004.explanation: 達到非常高、嚴重或遠離一般狀態的程度。
2004.definition: very great, severe, or far from what is usual
2004.zh: 這個地區經歷了極端高溫。

2004.explanation: 範圍、程度或立場的最遠端。
2004.definition: the farthest end of a range, degree, or position
2004.en: His opinion lies at one extreme of the debate.
2004.zh: 他的觀點位於這場辯論的一個極端。

2005.explanation: 用來看東西的身體器官。
2005.definition: the organ of the body used for seeing
2005.en: Her eyes adjusted to the dim light.
2005.zh: 她的眼睛適應了昏暗的光線。

2006.explanation: 眼睛上方弧形的一排毛。
2006.definition: the curved line of hair above an eye

2007.definition: one of the hairs growing along the edge of an eyelid
2007.en: Her eyelashes were wet from the rain.
2007.zh: 她的睫毛被雨水打濕了。

2008.explanation: 可以閉合覆蓋眼睛的皮膚摺層。
2008.definition: a fold of skin that can close over and protect the eye
2008.en: He closed his eyelids for a moment.

2009.en: His eyesight is good enough to read the sign from far away.
2009.zh: 他的視力好到能從遠處看清那個標誌。

2010.explanation: 常以動物為角色並傳達道德教訓的短篇故事。
2010.definition: a short story, often with animals as characters, that teaches a moral lesson
2010.en: The teacher read a fable about honesty.
2010.zh: 老師讀了一則關於誠實的寓言。

2011.definition: material made by weaving or joining fibers
2011.en: This fabric is light enough for summer shirts.
2011.zh: 這種布料很輕，適合做夏季襯衫。

2012.en: We had a fabulous view from the top of the hill.
2012.zh: 我們從山頂看到了極美的景色。

2013.explanation: 頭部前方包含眼、鼻、口的部分。
2013.definition: the front part of the head containing the eyes, nose, and mouth
2013.en: Her face lit up when she heard the news.
2013.zh: 她聽到消息時臉上露出喜色。

2013.explanation: 面對或處理困難、問題或情況。
2013.definition: to confront or deal with a difficult situation or problem
2013.en: The team must face several difficult decisions.
2013.zh: 團隊必須面對幾個艱難的決定。

2014.en: The camera can recognize basic facial expressions.
2014.zh: 這台相機可以辨識基本的臉部表情。

2015.explanation: 使某個行動或過程更容易進行。
2015.definition: to make an action or process easier
2015.en: The new system will facilitate communication between teams.
2015.zh: 新系統將促進各團隊之間的溝通。

2016.explanation: 為特定用途提供的建築、設備或服務。
2016.definition: a building, service, or equipment provided for a particular purpose
2016.en: The sports facility is open to students after school.
2016.zh: 這座運動設施在放學後開放給學生使用。

2017.explanation: 已知或可證明為真的事情。
2017.definition: something known or proved to be true
2017.en: It is a fact that water expands when it freezes.
2017.zh: 水結冰時會膨脹是個事實。

2018.explanation: 較大團體內具有不同目標或意見的小團體。
2018.definition: a group within a larger group that has different aims or opinions
2018.en: The party was divided into several rival factions.
2018.zh: 那個政黨分成數個彼此競爭的派系。

2019.definition: one of the things that influences a result
2019.en: Cost is an important factor in our decision.
2019.zh: 成本是我們決策中的重要因素。

2020.definition: a building where goods are manufactured
2020.zh: 這家工廠生產電子零件。

2021.explanation: 學校或大學的教學人員，也可指天生或後天形成的能力。
2021.definition: the teaching staff of an institution, or a natural ability
2021.en: The faculty voted to revise the course requirements.
2021.zh: 教職員投票決定修訂課程要求。

2022.explanation: 逐漸失去顏色、力量或清晰度。
2022.definition: to gradually lose color, strength, or visibility
2022.en: The photograph has faded over the years.
2022.zh: 這張照片多年來已逐漸褪色。

2023.explanation: 水在 32 度結冰的溫度尺度。
2023.definition: a temperature scale in which water freezes at 32 degrees

2024.explanation: 未能成功做到某事或未通過測驗。
2024.definition: to be unsuccessful in doing something or in passing a test
2024.en: He failed to submit the form on time.

2024.explanation: 測驗或課程未達及格標準的結果。
2024.definition: an unsuccessful result in a test or course
2024.en: One fail does not determine your future.
2024.zh: 一次不及格並不能決定你的未來。

2025.explanation: 缺乏成功，或設備未能正常運作的狀態。
2025.definition: lack of success or the state of not working properly
2025.en: The experiment ended in failure because the sensor broke.
2025.zh: 實驗因感測器故障而以失敗告終。

2026.explanation: 很弱或幾乎無法察覺的。
2026.en: We heard a faint sound from the hallway.
2026.zh: 我們聽到走廊傳來微弱的聲音。

2026.en: She nearly fainted in the heat.

2026.explanation: 短暫失去知覺的一次事件。
2026.en: He recovered quickly after a faint.

2027.explanation: 以公正合理的方式對待人或情況。
2027.definition: just and reasonable in the way people or situations are treated
2027.en: The teacher made a fair decision.
2027.zh: 老師做出了公平的決定。

2027.explanation: 有攤位、展示或娛樂活動的公開活動。
2027.definition: a public event with stalls, displays, or entertainment
2027.en: Our school held a science fair on Friday.
2027.zh: 學校星期五舉辦了科學展覽會。

2027.explanation: 以公平方式或達到相當程度。
2027.definition: in a fair manner or to a considerable degree
2027.en: Both teams agreed to play fair.

2028.explanation: 達到中等或相當程度，也可指以公正方式。
2028.definition: to a moderate degree or in a just way

2029.explanation: 傳說或故事中的小型魔法生物。
2029.definition: an imaginary small magical being in stories or folklore
2029.en: The story is about a fairy who helps a lost child.
2029.zh: 這個故事講述一位仙女幫助迷路的小孩。

2029.explanation: 與仙女、魔法故事或童話意象有關的。
2029.definition: relating to fairies or magical stories
2029.en: The stage had a fairy-tale atmosphere.
2029.zh: 舞台有一種童話般的氣氛。

2030.explanation: 對某人、某事或宗教信念的強烈信任。
2030.definition: strong trust or confidence, especially religious belief
2030.en: She has faith in her team's ability.

2031.explanation: 持續忠誠、可靠或忠於原物的。
2031.definition: loyal, reliable, or true to an original
2031.en: She remained faithful to her promise.
2031.zh: 她始終忠於自己的承諾。

2032.explanation: 不是真的或非真正來源的。
2032.en: The website displayed a fake warning.
2032.zh: 那個網站顯示了一則假警告。

2032.explanation: 使某物看似真實，或假裝某種感受或狀態。
2032.definition: to make something seem genuine or to pretend a feeling or condition
2032.en: He tried to fake a smile.

2032.explanation: 仿製品或冒充他人的人。
2032.definition: an imitation or a person who pretends to be someone else
2032.en: Experts quickly identified the painting as a fake.
2032.zh: 專家很快認出那幅畫是假貨。

2033.explanation: 向下掉落的動作；美式英語也常指秋季。
2033.definition: an act of falling; in American English, the season autumn
2033.en: The park is especially beautiful in the fall.
2033.zh: 這座公園在秋天特別美。

2033.explanation: 向較低位置移動或降低。
2033.definition: to move downward or become lower
2033.zh: 今晚氣溫可能大幅下降。

2034.explanation: 不真實、不正確或具有誤導性的。
2034.en: The report contained several false claims.
2034.zh: 那份報告包含數項錯誤說法。

2035.explanation: 失去力量、信心或流暢度。
2035.definition: to lose strength, confidence, or smoothness
2035.en: Her confidence began to falter after the mistake.
2035.zh: 犯錯後，她的信心開始動搖。

2036.explanation: 被很多人知道或認可的狀態。
2036.definition: the state of being widely known
2036.en: The singer gained fame at a young age.
2036.zh: 那位歌手年輕時就成名。

2037.explanation: 因過去經驗而知道或認得的。
2037.en: The street looked familiar to me.
2037.zh: 那條街對我來說很熟悉。

2038.explanation: 因經驗而對某事具有良好認識。
2038.definition: good knowledge of something from experience
2038.en: Familiarity with the software will save time.
2038.zh: 熟悉這套軟體會節省時間。

2039.explanation: 因血緣、婚姻或照護關係而相連的一群人。
2039.definition: a group of people related by birth, marriage, or close family ties
2039.en: Her family meets for dinner every Sunday.
2039.zh: 她的家人每個星期日都會一起吃晚餐。

2040.en: The town is famous for its night market.

2041.explanation: 熱情支持某人或某事的人；也可指推動空氣的裝置。
2041.definition: an enthusiastic admirer, or a device that moves air
2041.en: She is a huge fan of the baseball team.
2041.zh: 她是那支棒球隊的忠實球迷。

2041.explanation: 用扇動方式使空氣移動。
2041.definition: to move air toward something by waving or using a fan
2041.en: He used a newspaper to fan the fire.
2041.zh: 他用報紙搧風讓火更旺。

2042.explanation: 裝飾繁複、精緻或價格較高的。
2042.en: They stayed at a fancy hotel downtown.
2042.zh: 他們住在市中心一間豪華飯店。

2042.explanation: 想像中的念頭或對某物的喜愛。
2042.definition: an imagined idea or a liking for something
2042.en: She took a fancy to the small blue bag.
2042.zh: 她突然很喜歡那個藍色小包。

2042.explanation: 想要某物，或想像、認為某事。
2042.definition: to want something, or to imagine or suppose something
2042.en: Do you fancy some ice cream?

2043.explanation: 非常好，或帶有奇幻、不尋常的特質。
2043.definition: extremely good, or strange and imaginative
2043.en: You did a fantastic job on the presentation.

2044.explanation: 想像中的情況、故事或世界，常包含不可能的元素。
2044.definition: an imagined situation, story, or world, often involving impossible elements
2044.en: The novel mixes history with fantasy.
2044.zh: 這本小說把歷史與奇幻元素融合在一起。

2045.definition: at or to a great distance
2045.en: We could see the mountains far away.
2045.zh: 我們可以看見遠方的山。

2045.en: They traveled to a far corner of the island.
2045.zh: 他們前往島上一個遙遠的角落。

2046.explanation: 搭乘公共運輸工具所支付的費用。
2046.definition: the money paid for a journey on public transportation
2046.en: The bus fare has increased this month.
2046.zh: 這個月公車票價上漲了。

2047.definition: an act or expression of saying goodbye
2047.en: We held a farewell for our exchange student.
2047.zh: 我們為交換學生舉辦了歡送會。

2048.explanation: 用來種植作物或飼養動物的土地與相關建築。
2048.definition: land and buildings used for growing crops or raising animals
2048.en: My uncle owns a small fruit farm.
2048.zh: 我叔叔擁有一座小型果園。

2048.explanation: 經營土地以種植作物或飼養動物。
2048.definition: to use land for growing crops or raising animals
2048.en: They farm the land without chemical pesticides.
2048.zh: 他們不用化學農藥耕作這片土地。

2049.explanation: 擁有、經營或在農場工作的人。
2049.definition: a person who owns, manages, or works on a farm
2049.en: The farmer checked the fields before sunrise.
2049.zh: 那位農夫在日出前查看田地。

2050.definition: at or to a greater physical distance
2050.en: We walked farther than we had planned.
2050.zh: 我們走得比原本計畫的更遠。

2050.en: The farther shore was hidden by fog.
2050.zh: 較遠的岸邊被霧遮住了。

2051.explanation: 強烈吸引並持續抓住某人的興趣。
2051.definition: to attract and hold someone's interest strongly
2051.en: Space exploration continues to fascinate young readers.
2051.zh: 太空探索持續吸引年輕讀者。

2052.en: Her fascination with insects began in childhood.
2052.zh: 她對昆蟲的著迷始於童年。

2053.explanation: 在特定時期流行的服裝、外觀或做事方式。
2053.definition: a popular style of clothing, appearance, or behavior at a particular time
2053.en: Loose jackets are back in fashion.
2053.zh: 寬鬆外套又重新流行了。

2053.explanation: 用材料製作或塑造成某種形式。
2053.definition: to make or shape something from available material
2053.en: The artist fashioned a bowl from clay.
2053.zh: 那位藝術家用黏土塑造成一只碗。

2054.explanation: 在特定時期受歡迎或符合時尚的。
2054.definition: popular or stylish at a particular time
2054.en: That style became fashionable again this year.
2054.zh: 那種風格今年又流行起來。

2055.explanation: 以很快速度或在短時間內。
2055.definition: quickly or within a short time
2055.en: The train was moving too fast.

2055.explanation: 移動、發生或運作速度很快的。
2055.en: We need a fast internet connection.
2055.zh: 我們需要高速的網路連線。

2056.explanation: 關閉、連接或固定某物使其牢靠。
2056.definition: to close, attach, or secure something firmly
2056.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.

2057.explanation: 存在於身體或食物中的天然油性物質。
2057.definition: a natural oily substance found in bodies or food
2057.en: This yogurt contains very little fat.
2057.zh: 這款優格的脂肪含量很低。

2057.explanation: 身體含有較多脂肪，或食物中脂肪含量高的。
2057.definition: having a large amount of body fat, or containing much fat
2057.en: The recipe uses a fat piece of pork.
2057.zh: 這道食譜使用一塊肥肉較多的豬肉。

2058.explanation: 造成或可能造成死亡的。
2058.definition: causing or capable of causing death
2058.en: The driver suffered fatal injuries in the crash.
2058.zh: 那名駕駛在事故中受了致命傷。

2059.explanation: 被認為超出個人控制、注定發生的一連串事件。
2059.definition: events believed to be decided beyond a person's control
2059.en: The story follows a hero trying to escape his fate.
2059.zh: 這個故事描述一名英雄試圖逃離自己的命運。

2060.en: Her father taught her how to ride a bicycle.

2061.definition: extreme tiredness; to make someone very tired
2061.en: The lesson used fatigue in a clear context.
2061.zh: 課堂以清楚語境示範這個單字。

2061.definition: extreme tiredness; to make someone very tired
2061.en: The lesson used fatigue in a clear context.
2061.zh: 課堂以清楚語境示範這個單字。

2062.definition: a device that controls the flow of water from a pipe
2062.en: The lesson used faucet in a clear context.
2062.zh: 課堂以清楚語境示範這個單字。

2063.definition: responsibility for a mistake or defect; to criticize or find a defect
2063.en: The lesson used fault in a clear context.
2063.zh: 課堂以清楚語境示範這個單字。

2063.definition: responsibility for a mistake or defect; to criticize or find a defect
2063.en: The lesson used fault in a clear context.
2063.zh: 課堂以清楚語境示範這個單字。

2064.definition: an act of kindness or approval; to prefer or support
2064.en: The lesson used favor in a clear context.
2064.zh: 課堂以清楚語境示範這個單字。

2064.definition: an act of kindness or approval; to prefer or support
2064.en: The lesson used favor in a clear context.
2064.zh: 課堂以清楚語境示範這個單字。

2065.definition: showing approval or giving an advantage
2065.en: The lesson used favorable in a clear context.
2065.zh: 課堂以清楚語境示範這個單字。

2066.meaning: 最喜愛的；最愛的人事物
2066.explanation: 最喜愛的；最愛的人事物
2066.definition: liked more than others; a person or thing liked most
2066.en: The lesson used favorite in a clear context.

2211.meaning: 髒臭的；犯規的；犯規；弄髒／阻塞
2211.explanation: 形容詞可指骯髒、難聞或違規；名詞指犯規；動詞可指弄髒、阻塞或犯規；副詞可表示以不正當方式。
2211.definition: dirty, offensive, or against the rules; also an illegal play, or to contaminate, block, or commit a foul
2211.en: The referee called a foul after the defender pushed him.
2211.zh: 後衛推人後，裁判判了一次犯規。

2212.explanation: 建立公司、組織、制度或城市，使其開始存在。
2212.definition: to establish or create an organization, institution, or settlement
2212.en: They founded a community library in 2018.
2212.zh: 他們在二〇一八年創立了一座社區圖書館。

2213.explanation: 可指建築物的地基、思想或制度的基礎，也可指為特定目的成立的基金會。
2213.definition: the base on which something is built or developed; also an organization created for a particular purpose
2213.en: Trust is the foundation of a strong friendship.
2213.zh: 信任是深厚友誼的基礎。

2214.explanation: 建立公司、組織、制度或事業的人。
2214.definition: a person who establishes an organization, company, or institution
2214.en: The founder still advises the company.
2214.zh: 這位創辦人仍為公司提供建議。

2215.explanation: 可指把水向上噴出的裝置，也可指天然湧出的泉水。
2215.definition: a structure that sends water into the air, or a natural spring of water

2216.explanation: 通常指飼養作為食物或產蛋用途的雞、鴨等鳥類，也可泛指鳥。
2216.definition: a bird, especially one kept for food or eggs
2216.en: The farm raises fowl for eggs and meat.
2216.zh: 這座農場飼養家禽以生產蛋和肉。

2217.explanation: 一種有尖耳、長吻和蓬鬆尾巴的野生犬科動物。
2217.definition: a wild canine animal with pointed ears, a narrow face, and a bushy tail
2217.en: A fox crossed the road at dawn.
2217.zh: 一隻狐狸在黎明時穿過道路。

2218.explanation: 整體的一小部分；數學上也指以分子和分母表示的數。
2218.definition: a small part of a whole, or a number expressed as one quantity divided by another
2218.en: Only a fraction of the audience stayed.
2218.zh: 只有一小部分觀眾留下來。

2219.explanation: 名詞指骨頭或材料的斷裂；動詞指使其裂開或斷裂。
2219.definition: a break or crack in a bone or material; also to cause such a break
2219.en: The fall caused a small fracture in her wrist.
2219.zh: 這次跌倒造成她手腕輕微骨折。

2220.explanation: 容易破裂、受損或因壓力而失去穩定。
2220.en: Please handle the fragile glass carefully.
2220.zh: 請小心拿取這件易碎的玻璃器皿。

2221.explanation: 名詞指整體破裂後的小部分；動詞指分裂成小片或多個部分。
2221.definition: a small broken or separate piece of something; also to break into pieces
2221.en: Archaeologists found a fragment of ancient pottery.
2221.zh: 考古學家發現一塊古代陶器碎片。

2222.explanation: 令人愉快的氣味，也可指具有香味的香水或產品。
2222.definition: a pleasant smell, or a scented product that produces such a smell
2222.en: The fragrance of roses filled the garden.
2222.zh: 玫瑰的香氣瀰漫整座花園。

2223.explanation: 具有明顯且令人愉快氣味的。
2223.en: The kitchen was fragrant with fresh bread.
2223.zh: 廚房充滿新鮮麵包的香氣。

2224.explanation: 名詞可指支撐或圍住物體的結構；動詞可指建立框架、構成或以某方式表述。
2224.definition: a supporting or enclosing structure; also to construct, shape, or express something in a particular way
2224.en: She placed the photograph in a wooden frame.
2224.zh: 她把照片放進木製相框。

2225.explanation: 支撐實體結構的骨架，或組織思想、制度與規則的基本系統。
2225.definition: a basic structure that supports something or organizes ideas, rules, or a system
2225.en: The law provides a framework for data protection.
2225.zh: 這項法律提供了資料保護的架構。

2226.explanation: 由公司授權他人使用品牌、商品或商業模式經營的權利或事業。
2226.definition: the right to operate a business using another company's name, products, or system
2226.en: They opened a coffee franchise near the station.
2226.zh: 他們在車站附近開了一家咖啡加盟店。

2227.explanation: 誠實而直接地表達想法，不刻意掩飾。
2227.definition: honest and direct in expressing thoughts or opinions
2227.en: Please be frank about the problem.

2228.explanation: 因害怕、焦慮或時間壓力而極度慌張，常伴隨匆忙行動。
2228.en: We made a frantic search for the missing keys.
2228.zh: 我們慌亂地四處尋找遺失的鑰匙。

2229.explanation: 為取得金錢、利益或其他好處而故意欺騙他人的行為。
2229.definition: deliberate deception intended to gain money or another advantage
2229.en: The bank detected the fraud quickly.
2229.zh: 銀行很快就察覺了這起詐欺。

2230.explanation: 名詞可指異常或罕見的人事物；動詞常用於使人突然非常緊張或驚慌。
2230.definition: an unusually strange person or thing; also to make someone suddenly very upset or frightened
2230.en: The sudden alarm made everyone freak out.
2230.zh: 突如其來的警報讓每個人都驚慌失措。

2231.meaning: 自由的；免費的；釋放；免費地
2231.explanation: 形容詞可指不受限制或不收費；動詞指使人或物獲得自由；副詞可表示免費地。
2231.definition: not controlled or restricted, or costing nothing; also to release someone or something
2231.en: Admission to the museum is free on Sundays.
2231.zh: 博物館星期日免費入場。

2232.explanation: 能自行選擇、行動或表達而不受不合理限制的狀態或權利。
2232.definition: the state or right of being able to act, choose, or speak without unreasonable restriction
2232.zh: 言論自由也伴隨著責任。

2233.explanation: 車流高速行駛、出入口受控制且通常分隔雙向車道的主要道路。
2233.definition: a major road designed for fast traffic, usually with controlled entrances and exits
2233.en: Traffic slowed on the freeway after the accident.
2233.zh: 事故發生後，高速公路上的車流變慢了。

2234.explanation: 動詞指變成冰、使非常冷或停止變動；名詞可指凍結狀態或停止調整的期間。
2234.definition: to become or make something solid with cold, or to stop movement or change; also a period of such stopping
2234.en: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.

2235.explanation: 維持低於冰點溫度以保存食物或物品的設備或隔間。
2235.definition: an appliance or compartment kept below freezing temperature for storing food or other items
2235.en: Keep the ice cream in the freezer.
2235.zh: 請把冰淇淋放在冷凍庫裡。

2236.explanation: 名詞指大量運輸的貨物或貨運服務；動詞指用交通工具運送貨物。
2236.definition: goods carried in large quantities, or the transport of such goods; also to transport goods
2236.en: The port handles freight from many countries.
2236.zh: 這座港口處理來自許多國家的貨物。

2237.explanation: 某事發生的次數或頻繁程度；物理上也指週期性波動每秒重複的次數。
2237.definition: how often something happens; in physics, the number of cycles of a wave per unit of time
2237.en: The frequency of storms has increased.
2237.zh: 暴風雨發生的頻率提高了。

2238.explanation: 形容詞指經常發生；動詞指經常造訪某地。
2238.definition: happening often; also to visit a place regularly
2238.en: Tourists frequent this market on weekends.
2238.zh: 觀光客週末常到這座市場。

2239.explanation: 可指剛採收、製作或產生，不陳舊腐敗；也可指新近、清爽或充滿活力。
2239.definition: recently made, gathered, or produced and not stale; also new, clean, or refreshing
2239.en: We bought fresh bread from the bakery.
2239.zh: 我們從麵包店買了新鮮麵包。

2240.explanation: 大學或高中第一年就讀的學生，美式英語常用。
2240.definition: a student in the first year of high school or college, especially in American English
2240.en: As a freshman, he joined the school band.
2240.zh: 身為一年級新生，他加入了學校樂團。

2241.explanation: 物體表面相互接觸時阻礙運動的力；也可指人或團體間的緊張與衝突。
2241.definition: resistance between surfaces that touch, or tension and disagreement between people or groups
2241.en: Poor communication caused friction within the team.
2241.zh: 溝通不良造成團隊內部的衝突。

2242.explanation: 彼此喜歡、信任並保持個人關係的人。
2242.definition: a person whom you know well, like, and trust
2242.en: A good friend listens without judging.
2242.zh: 好朋友會傾聽而不隨意評斷。

2243.explanation: 對人親切、願意幫助；也可指某環境或條件對某事有利。
2243.definition: kind and pleasant toward others; also suitable or favorable to a particular purpose
2243.en: The staff were friendly and helpful.
2243.zh: 工作人員既友善又樂於協助。

2244.explanation: 朋友之間互相信任、喜愛與支持的關係。
2244.definition: a relationship of trust, affection, and support between friends
2244.zh: 他們的友誼維持了數十年。

2245.explanation: 切成長條後油炸的馬鈴薯，常作為餐點配菜。
2245.definition: long thin pieces of potato cooked in hot oil or fat
2245.en: He ordered a sandwich with fries.
2245.zh: 他點了一份附薯條的三明治。

2246.explanation: 突然且強烈的害怕感，常由意外事件造成。
2246.definition: a sudden strong feeling of fear
2246.en: The sudden noise gave the child a fright.
2246.zh: 突如其來的聲響嚇了孩子一跳。

2247.explanation: 使某人感到害怕或驚慌。
2247.en: Loud thunder can frighten young children.
2247.zh: 響亮的雷聲可能會嚇到年幼的孩子。

2248.explanation: 一種兩棲動物，通常有長後腿、光滑皮膚，善於跳躍與游泳。
2248.definition: an amphibian with long back legs and usually smooth skin, able to jump and swim
2248.en: A frog jumped into the pond.

2249.explanation: 介系詞，用來表示起點、來源、距離、原因或分離。
2249.definition: used to show a starting point, source, distance, cause, or separation
2249.en: This train runs from Taipei to Kaohsiung.
2249.zh: 這班火車從臺北開往高雄。

2250.explanation: 名詞指物體或地點朝前的一面；形容詞指位於最前或正面的。
2250.definition: the forward-facing side or part of something; as an adjective, located at or toward that side

2251.explanation: 國家或地區的邊界地帶，也可比喻知識、科技或發展的新前沿。
2251.definition: a border region, or the leading edge of new knowledge, technology, or development
2251.en: The mission explored a new frontier in space science.
2251.zh: 這項任務探索了太空科學的新前沿。

2252.explanation: 名詞指低溫時形成的冰晶；動詞可指覆上一層霜或糖霜。
2252.definition: a thin layer of ice crystals formed by cold; also to cover something with frost or icing
2252.en: Frost covered the grass before sunrise.

2253.explanation: 動詞指因不滿、困惑或擔心而皺起眉頭；名詞指這種表情。
2253.definition: to draw the eyebrows together in displeasure, worry, or concentration; also the resulting expression
2253.en: A frown appeared on her face.
2253.zh: 她的臉上浮現皺眉的表情。

2254.explanation: 植物由花發育而成、通常含種子的部分，許多種類可食用。
2254.definition: the part of a plant that develops from a flower and contains seeds, many kinds of which are eaten
2254.en: Fresh fruit is served with breakfast.

2255.explanation: 使某人因無法達成目標而感到不耐或失望，或阻止某事成功。
2255.definition: to make someone feel annoyed because progress is blocked, or to prevent a plan or effort from succeeding
2255.en: Technical problems frustrated the research team.
2255.zh: 技術問題讓研究團隊感到挫折。

2256.explanation: 因目標或需求受到阻礙而產生的惱怒、失望或無力感。
2256.definition: the feeling of annoyance or disappointment caused by being unable to achieve something
2256.en: He expressed his frustration with the delay.
2256.zh: 他表達了對延誤的挫折感。

2257.explanation: 動詞指在熱油或油脂中烹煮；名詞可指幼小的魚。
2257.definition: to cook food in hot oil or fat; as a noun, a very young fish
2257.en: Fry the onions until they are soft.

2258.explanation: 名詞指產生熱能或動力的物質；動詞可指供應燃料或使情緒、爭議等加劇。
2258.definition: a substance used to produce heat or power; also to supply energy or intensify something
2258.en: Curiosity fueled her desire to learn.
2258.zh: 好奇心助長了她的求知欲。

2259.explanation: fulfill 指完成承諾、責任、需求或潛力；fulfillment 指完成、滿足或由此產生的滿足感。
2259.definition: to carry out a promise or duty, satisfy a need, or realize a potential; fulfillment is the state or feeling of doing so
2259.en: The program helped her fulfill her potential.
2259.zh: 這項計畫幫助她發揮潛能。

2260.explanation: 容器沒有剩餘空間、數量達到容量；也可表示完整，或吃飽。
2260.definition: containing as much as possible, complete in amount, or having eaten enough
2260.en: The bus was full by eight o'clock.
2260.zh: 公車在八點前就坐滿了。

2261.explanation: 冒出煙或氣體；亦指煙霧或強烈氣味。
2261.definition: to give off smoke or gas; also smoke or strong-smelling vapor
2261.en: Smoke began to fume from the old engine.
2261.zh: 老舊引擎開始冒出煙霧。

2262.explanation: 帶來享受、娛樂或愉快的事物。
2262.definition: enjoyment, amusement, or an activity that is enjoyable
2262.en: The picnic was great fun for everyone.
2262.zh: 這場野餐對大家來說都很有趣。

2263.explanation: 某物的用途或作用；亦指正常運作。
2263.definition: the purpose of something; to work or operate
2263.en: This button controls the main function of the device.
2263.zh: 這個按鈕控制裝置的主要功能。

2264.explanation: 設計來執行特定用途，或能正常運作的。
2264.definition: designed for a practical purpose or able to work properly
2264.en: The old radio is simple but still functional.
2264.zh: 這台舊收音機很簡單，但仍可正常使用。

2265.explanation: 為特定目的保留的金錢；亦指提供資金。
2265.definition: money set aside for a purpose; to provide money for something
2265.en: The school created a fund for student projects.
2265.zh: 學校設立基金支持學生專題。

2266.explanation: 構成基礎且非常重要的；亦指基本原則。
2266.definition: basic and essential to the nature or structure of something; also a basic principle or rule
2266.en: Trust is fundamental to a strong friendship.
2266.zh: 信任是穩固友誼的基本要素。

2267.definition: a ceremony held after a person's death, usually for burial or remembrance
2267.en: Family members gathered for the funeral.
2267.zh: 家人聚在一起參加葬禮。

2268.explanation: 引人發笑的，或不尋常而令人覺得奇怪的。
2268.definition: causing laughter or amusement, or strange in a way that is difficult to explain
2268.en: The movie was funny without being silly.
2268.zh: 這部電影很好笑，卻不顯得愚蠢。

2269.explanation: 某些動物身上的濃密柔毛，或由此製成的材料。
2269.definition: the thick soft hair of some animals, or material made from it
2269.en: The rabbit has soft gray fur.
2269.zh: 這隻兔子有柔軟的灰色毛皮。

2270.explanation: 極度生氣的，或非常猛烈的。
2270.definition: extremely angry, or very intense and violent
2270.en: She was furious about the unfair decision.
2270.zh: 她對這個不公平的決定非常生氣。

2271.explanation: 提供所需物品，尤其是為房間配置家具。
2271.definition: to provide a room, building, or person with furniture or other necessary items
2271.en: They furnished the room with a desk and two chairs.
2271.zh: 他們用一張書桌和兩把椅子布置房間。

2272.explanation: 桌椅、床、櫃等供房間使用的大型物品。
2272.definition: large movable objects such as tables, chairs, beds, and cabinets used in rooms
2272.en: The apartment came with basic furniture.
2272.zh: 這間公寓附有基本家具。

2273.explanation: 表示程度或距離增加；亦可指推進某事。
2273.definition: to a greater degree or distance; additional; also to help something progress
2273.en: We need further evidence before reaching a conclusion.
2273.zh: 在下結論前，我們需要更多證據。

2274.explanation: 用來加入另一項支持前述內容的資訊。
2274.definition: in addition to what has already been said; moreover
2274.en: The plan is affordable; furthermore, it is easy to carry out.
2274.zh: 這個計畫負擔得起；此外，也很容易執行。

2275.explanation: 極強烈且難以控制的憤怒。
2275.en: He struggled to control his fury.
2275.zh: 他努力控制自己的怒火。

2276.explanation: 防止電流過大的裝置；亦指使事物熔合或結合。
2276.definition: a safety device that stops excessive electric current; also to join or melt together
2276.en: The two ideas fuse into a single theme.
2276.zh: 這兩個想法融合成一個主題。

2277.explanation: 對小事過度擔心或忙亂；亦指因此抱怨。
2277.definition: unnecessary worry, excitement, or complaint over a small matter; also to behave this way
2277.en: There is no need to make a fuss about a small mistake.
2277.zh: 沒有必要為一個小錯誤大驚小怪。

2278.explanation: 現在之後的時間；亦指將來會發生的。
2278.definition: the time after the present; also relating to a time that has not yet come
2278.en: She hopes to study engineering in the future.

2279.explanation: 取得有價值的事物或增加；亦指所得或進步。
2279.definition: to obtain, increase, or make progress; also an increase, benefit, or profit
2279.en: Students gain confidence through regular practice.
2279.zh: 學生透過規律練習獲得自信。

2280.explanation: 由大量恆星、氣體與塵埃等組成的巨大系統。
2280.definition: a huge system of stars, gas, dust, and other matter held together in space
2280.en: Our solar system lies within the Milky Way galaxy.
2280.zh: 我們的太陽系位於銀河系之中。

2281.explanation: 展示藝術品的場所或空間。
2281.definition: a place or room where works of art are displayed to the public
2281.en: The gallery displays works by local artists.
2281.zh: 這間畫廊展出本地藝術家的作品。

2282.explanation: 英美制中用來測量液體容量的單位。
2282.definition: a unit used mainly in the United States and Britain for measuring liquid capacity
2282.en: The container holds one gallon of water.
2282.zh: 這個容器可裝一加侖的水。

2283.explanation: 馬快速奔跑的步態；亦指以此方式奔跑。
2283.definition: a fast running movement of a horse; also to move at this speed
2283.en: The horse began to gallop across the field.
2283.zh: 那匹馬開始奔馳穿過田野。

2284.explanation: 把有價值的事物置於不確定結果的風險中；亦泛指冒險。
2284.definition: to risk money or something valuable on an uncertain result; also such a risk
2284.en: Changing the whole plan at the last minute would be a gamble.
2284.zh: 在最後一刻更改整個計畫會是一場冒險。

2285.explanation: 依規則進行、供娛樂或競賽的活動。
2285.definition: an activity or contest with rules, usually played for entertainment or competition
2285.en: We played a word game in English class.
2285.zh: 我們在英文課玩了一個文字遊戲。

2286.explanation: 一群經常一起活動的人；動詞可指成群聚集。
2286.definition: a group of people who regularly spend time or act together; also to form or move as a group
2286.en: A gang of friends waited outside the theater.
2286.zh: 一群朋友在戲院外等候。

2287.definition: a member of an organized criminal gang
2287.en: The novel tells the story of a gangster who changes his life.
2287.zh: 這本小說描述一名幫派分子改變人生的故事。

2288.explanation: 兩物之間的空間，或數量、程度上的差異。
2288.definition: an empty space or opening between things, or a difference in amount, level, or understanding
2288.en: The study found a gap between expectations and results.
2288.zh: 研究發現期望與結果之間有差距。

2289.explanation: 停放車輛的建築或修理車輛的場所。
2289.definition: a building for keeping vehicles, or a business where vehicles are repaired
2289.en: The bicycles are stored in the garage.

2290.definition: waste material or unwanted things that are thrown away
2290.en: Please put the garbage in the proper bin.
2290.zh: 請把垃圾放進正確的垃圾桶。

2291.explanation: 種植花草蔬果的土地；亦指從事園藝。
2291.definition: an area where flowers, vegetables, or other plants are grown; also to work in such an area
2291.en: They grow tomatoes in a small garden.
2291.zh: 他們在小花園裡種番茄。

2292.definition: a person who grows and takes care of plants, especially in a garden
2292.en: The gardener planted flowers along the path.

2293.explanation: 具有強烈氣味、常用於調味的植物鱗莖。
2293.definition: a plant bulb with a strong smell and taste that is widely used in cooking
2293.en: She added garlic to the soup.

2294.en: Each garment was labeled with washing instructions.
2294.zh: 每件衣物都標示了洗滌說明。

2295.explanation: 供汽車等引擎使用的液體燃料，美式英語常簡稱 gas。
2295.definition: a liquid fuel used in engines, especially cars; called gas in American English
2295.en: The car is low on gasoline.

2296.explanation: 因驚訝、疼痛或缺氧而突然吸氣；亦指這種吸氣聲。
2296.definition: to take a sudden short breath because of surprise, pain, or lack of air; also such a breath
2296.en: She gave a gasp when the lights suddenly went out.
2296.zh: 燈突然熄滅時，她倒抽了一口氣。

2297.explanation: 控制出入某處的門或入口。
2297.definition: a movable barrier or entrance that controls access through a fence, wall, or passage
2297.en: Meet me at the school gate after class.
2297.zh: 下課後在校門口跟我碰面。

2298.explanation: 使人或物集合在一起，或取得資訊等。
2298.definition: to bring people or things together, or to collect information or materials
2298.en: We gathered enough information to answer the question.
2298.zh: 我們蒐集了足夠資訊來回答問題。

2299.explanation: 人們為某目的集合在一起的場合。
2299.definition: a meeting or occasion when people come together for a particular purpose
2299.en: The family gathering lasted all afternoon.
2299.zh: 家庭聚會持續了整個下午。

2300.explanation: 測量大小或數量的儀器；亦指估計或判斷。
2300.definition: an instrument used for measuring something; also to estimate, measure, or judge
2300.en: The survey helps gauge public opinion.
2300.zh: 這份調查有助於衡量民意。

2301.explanation: 指對同性有情感或性吸引的人，或與此相關的。
2301.definition: sexually or romantically attracted to people of the same sex; also a person with that orientation
2301.en: The article discusses the experiences of gay students respectfully.
2301.zh: 這篇文章以尊重的方式討論同性戀學生的經驗。

2302.explanation: 長時間、專注地看著某人或某物。
2302.definition: to look steadily and for a long time; also such a look
2302.en: They stood quietly and gazed at the night sky.
2302.zh: 他們安靜地站著凝視夜空。

2303.explanation: 機械中的齒輪或特定活動所需裝備；亦可指使適合某用途。
2303.definition: equipment needed for a particular activity, or a toothed machine part; also to adjust or prepare for a purpose
2303.en: Bring the right gear for the science field trip.
2303.zh: 科學校外教學要帶合適的裝備。

2304.explanation: 與男性、女性或其他性別身分相關的社會與個人分類。
2304.definition: the social or personal category of being male, female, or another gender, including roles and identity
2304.en: The form asks for age and gender.
2304.zh: 這份表格會詢問年齡與性別。

2305.explanation: 遺傳資訊的基本單位，會影響生物特徵。
2305.definition: a basic unit of heredity that carries information influencing an organism's traits
2305.en: A gene can influence an inherited trait.

2306.explanation: 涉及大多數情況而非細節的；名詞亦指高階軍官。
2306.definition: relating to most people, things, or situations rather than details; also a high-ranking military officer
2306.en: The report gives a general overview of the issue.
2306.zh: 這份報告提供此議題的一般概述。

2307.explanation: 使某物出現、形成或被創造。
2307.definition: to produce, create, or cause something to exist
2307.en: Solar panels generate electricity from sunlight.
2307.zh: 太陽能板利用陽光發電。

2308.explanation: 年齡相近的一群人，或產生某物的過程。
2308.definition: a group of people born at about the same time, or the process of producing something
2308.zh: 每個世代都面臨不同的挑戰。

2309.explanation: 產生電力或其他形式能量、輸出的裝置。
2309.definition: a machine or device that produces electricity or another form of power or output
2309.en: The backup generator kept the lights on.
2309.zh: 備用發電機讓燈持續亮著。

2310.explanation: 願意給予時間、金錢、幫助等的特質。
2310.definition: the quality of being willing to give or share time, money, help, or other resources freely
2310.en: Her generosity helped the community center buy new books.
2310.zh: 她的慷慨讓社區中心能購買新書。

2311.explanation: 願意給予或分享超過一般程度的。
2311.definition: willing to give or share more than is usual
2311.en: She is generous with her time.
2311.zh: 她很願意慷慨付出時間。

2312.en: The disease has a genetic cause.

2313.explanation: 研究基因與遺傳的科學。
2313.definition: the scientific study of genes and heredity
2313.en: Scientists study the genetics of the species.
2313.zh: 科學家研究這個物種的遺傳機制。

2314.explanation: 非凡的智力或創造力，或具有此能力的人。
2314.definition: exceptional intellectual or creative ability, or a person who has it
2314.en: He is a genius at solving puzzles.

2315.explanation: 具有共同特徵的藝術或文學作品類別。
2315.definition: a category of artistic or literary work with shared features
2315.en: Mystery is a popular genre of fiction.
2315.zh: 推理是很受歡迎的小說類型。

2316.explanation: 友善、平靜或不粗暴強烈的。
2316.definition: kind, calm, or not rough or forceful
2316.en: Be gentle with the injured bird.

2317.explanation: 對男性的禮貌或尊敬稱呼。
2317.definition: a polite or respectful term for a man
2317.en: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the show.
2317.zh: 各位女士先生，歡迎來到本場演出。

2318.explanation: 真實、非偽造或發自內心的。

2319.explanation: 與地理或地方自然特徵有關的。
2319.definition: relating to geography or the physical features of places
2319.zh: 這張地圖顯示地理特徵。

2320.explanation: 研究地方與地球空間配置的學科。
2320.definition: the study or physical arrangement of places and the earth
2320.en: We studied the geography of Taiwan.

2321.explanation: 研究形狀、大小與空間的數學分支。
2321.definition: the branch of mathematics dealing with shapes, sizes, and space
2321.en: We study geometry in math class.

2322.explanation: 可能造成疾病的微生物。
2322.definition: a microorganism that can cause disease
2322.en: Washing your hands helps prevent spreading germs.
2322.zh: 洗手有助於防止病菌傳播。

2323.explanation: 用來表達想法或感受的動作。
2323.definition: a movement or action used to express an idea or feeling
2323.en: He made a gesture toward the door.

2323.definition: to express or indicate something with a movement
2323.en: The teacher gestured toward the empty seat.
2323.zh: 老師朝空位做手勢示意。

2324.definition: to receive, obtain, become, or arrive at a place
2324.en: It gets dark early in winter.

2325.explanation: 想像中死者顯現於活人面前的靈體。
2325.definition: the spirit of a dead person imagined as appearing to the living
2325.en: The story tells of the ghost of a sailor.
2325.zh: 故事講述一名水手的幽靈。

2326.en: A giant tree stood beside the road.

2326.explanation: 非常巨大的人、動物或事物。
2326.definition: a very large person, creature, or thing
2326.en: That company grew into a global giant.
2326.zh: 那家公司成長為全球巨擘。

2327.explanation: 自願送給他人的東西，或天生能力。
2327.definition: something given voluntarily, or a natural ability
2327.en: I bought a gift for my friend.
2327.zh: 我買了一份禮物給朋友。

2328.zh: 她在音樂方面很有天賦。

2329.en: A gigantic wave struck the coast.

2330.explanation: 輕而短促、常帶傻氣的笑聲。
2330.en: A quiet giggle came from the back row.
2330.zh: 後排傳來一聲輕輕的咯咯笑。

2330.definition: to laugh lightly in a repeated way
2330.en: The children giggled at the joke.
2330.zh: 孩子們聽到笑話咯咯笑。

2331.explanation: 烹調使用的辛香植物根莖。
2331.definition: the spicy root of a plant used in cooking
2331.en: Add fresh ginger to the soup.

2332.explanation: 具有很長頸部的高大非洲動物。
2332.definition: a tall African animal with a very long neck
2332.en: We saw a herd of giraffes.

2333.definition: a female child or young woman
2333.en: A young girl waved from the bus.
2333.zh: 一名小女孩從公車上揮手。

2334.definition: to transfer something to another person

2335.explanation: 在陸地上緩慢移動的大量冰體。
2335.definition: a large mass of ice that moves slowly over land
2335.zh: 科學家測量融化中的冰川。

2336.explanation: 因某事感到開心或滿意的。

2337.explanation: 以時髦方式顯得吸引人且令人興奮的。
2337.definition: attractive and exciting in a stylish way
2337.en: The film shows a glamorous lifestyle.
2337.zh: 這部電影呈現光鮮亮麗的生活方式。

2338.explanation: 與美麗、刺激或時尚相關的吸引力。
2338.definition: an attractive quality associated with beauty, excitement, or style
2338.en: The job lacks the glamour of television.
2338.zh: 這份工作缺少電視產業的光鮮魅力。

2339.en: She took a quick glance at the schedule.
2339.zh: 她很快瞥了一眼行程表。

2340.explanation: 兇狠的眼神或刺眼的強光。
2340.definition: a fierce look or a harsh bright light
2340.en: The glare from the screen hurt my eyes.
2340.zh: 螢幕的刺眼強光讓我的眼睛不舒服。

2340.en: He glared at the rude customer.
2340.zh: 他怒視那名無禮的顧客。

2341.explanation: 透明硬質材料或由其製成的容器。
2341.definition: a hard transparent material or a container made from it
2341.en: He drank a glass of water.

2342.explanation: 裝在鏡框中、用於改善或保護視力的一對鏡片。
2342.definition: a pair of lenses in a frame worn to improve or protect vision
2342.en: She bought a new pair of glasses.

2343.definition: a small or brief bright light
2343.en: A gleam of sunlight crossed the floor.
The wet pavement gleamed under the streetlights.
2343.zh: 濕潤的路面在街燈下微微發亮。

2344.en: The swan glided across the lake.
The skater finished with a smooth glide across the ice.
2344.zh: 溜冰者以一段平順的滑行通過冰面作結。

2345.en: I caught a glimpse of the mountain.
I glimpsed a deer between the trees.
2345.zh: 我短暫瞥見樹林間有一隻鹿。

2346.explanation: 許多細小閃光形成的光亮。
2346.definition: light made of many small flashes
2346.en: The glitter of the city lights filled the harbor.
2346.zh: 城市燈火的閃光映滿港灣。

2346.definition: to shine with many small flashes of light

2347.en: Climate change is a global issue.

2348.definition: the earth or a spherical model of it
2348.en: The news spread around the globe.

2349.definition: darkness or a feeling of sadness
2349.en: A sense of gloom filled the room.
2349.zh: 房間裡瀰漫著陰鬱氣氛。

2349.explanation: 顯得陰沉或使氣氛低落。
2349.en: Storm clouds gloomed over the valley.
2349.zh: 暴風雲陰沉地籠罩著山谷。

2350.explanation: 陰暗、令人沮喪或缺乏希望的。
2350.definition: dark, depressing, or without much hope

2351.explanation: 壯觀、美麗或值得高度讚賞的。
2351.definition: splendid, beautiful, or deserving great admiration
2351.zh: 我們欣賞了壯麗的夕陽。

2352.explanation: 極大的榮譽、讚美或欽佩。
2352.en: The team hoped to win glory.

2353.explanation: 覆蓋手部且通常為手指分開設計的穿戴物。
2353.definition: a covering for the hand with separate parts for the fingers
2353.en: He wore a pair of gloves.

2354.en: A warm glow filled the room.
2354.zh: 溫暖的光亮充滿了房間。

2354.definition: to give off a steady light
2354.zh: 她的臉因幸福而容光煥發。

2355.explanation: 用來黏合物品的黏性物質。
2355.definition: a sticky substance used to join things
2355.en: This glue dries in ten minutes.
2355.zh: 這種膠會在十分鐘內乾掉。

2355.en: Glue the label to the box.

2356.explanation: 從一處移動或前往另一處。
2356.definition: to move or travel from one place to another
2356.en: We go to school by bus.

2356.explanation: 一次嘗試、機會或輪到某人的回合。
2356.en: You have one more go at the puzzle.
2356.zh: 你還有一次解這道謎題的機會。

2357.explanation: 想達成的結果或運動中的得分目標。
2357.definition: an aim or desired result, or a scoring target in sport
2357.en: She worked hard to reach her goal.
2357.zh: 她努力達成自己的目標。

2358.explanation: 在某些運動中負責守護球門的球員。
2358.definition: the player who protects the goal in certain sports
2358.en: The team's goalkeeper saved the shot.
2358.zh: 球隊守門員擋下了射門。

2359.explanation: 有角、常為乳肉或纖維而飼養的動物。
2359.definition: a horned animal commonly kept for milk, meat, or fiber
2359.en: A herd of goats crossed the road.

2360.explanation: 宗教或神話中受崇拜的男性或女性神祇。
2360.definition: a male or female deity worshiped in a religion or mythology
2360.en: The myth describes a goddess of wisdom.
2360.zh: 神話描述一位智慧女神。

2361.explanation: 貴重的黃色金屬，可用於珠寶、貨幣或投資。
2361.definition: a precious yellow metal used for jewelry, money, or investment
2361.en: The lesson used gold in a clear context.
2361.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gold」。

2361.explanation: 由黃金製成，或呈現黃金般顏色。
2361.definition: made of gold or having a color like gold
2361.en: She wore a simple gold necklace.
2361.zh: 她戴著一條簡單的金項鍊。

2362.explanation: 具有金色，或像黃金一樣珍貴、美好的。
2362.definition: having the color of gold or qualities associated with gold
2362.en: The lesson used golden in a clear context.
2362.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「golden」。

2363.explanation: 以球桿將小球打入一系列球洞的運動。
2363.definition: a sport in which players hit a small ball into a series of holes
2363.en: The lesson used golf in a clear context.
2363.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「golf」。

2363.definition: to play the game of golf
2363.en: We golfed together on Saturday morning.
2363.zh: 我們星期六早上一起打了高爾夫球。

2364.explanation: 品質高、令人滿意或適合目的的。
2364.definition: of high quality, satisfactory, or suitable for a purpose
2364.en: The lesson used good in a clear context.
2364.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「good」。

2364.explanation: 非正式用法，表示做得好或充分。
2364.definition: informally, in a satisfactory or effective way
2364.en: The repaired car is running good now.
2364.zh: 修好的車現在運轉得很好。

2364.explanation: 有益之事，或道德上的善。
2364.definition: benefit, advantage, or what is morally right
2364.en: Regular exercise can do you a lot of good.
2364.zh: 規律運動能為你帶來許多好處。

2365.explanation: 離開或分別時所說的話或道別行為。
2365.definition: a word, expression, or act used when parting
2365.en: The lesson used goodbye in a clear context.
2365.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「goodbye」。

2366.explanation: 為販售或運送而製造、交易的物品。
2366.definition: items produced, traded, or transported for sale
2366.en: The lesson used goods in a clear context.
2366.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「goods」。

2367.explanation: 對他人的友善、合作與善意態度。
2367.definition: friendly, helpful, or cooperative feelings toward others
2367.en: The lesson used goodwill in a clear context.
2367.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「goodwill」。

2368.definition: a large water bird related to the duck
2368.en: The lesson used goose in a clear context.
2368.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「goose」。

2369.explanation: 非常美麗、吸引人或令人愉悅的。
2369.en: The lesson used gorgeous in a clear context.
2369.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gorgeous」。

2370.explanation: 生活於非洲的大型類人猿。
2370.definition: a very large ape native to forests of central Africa
2370.en: The lesson used gorilla in a clear context.
2370.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gorilla」。

2371.explanation: 基督教關於耶穌的教導，也可指被堅信的觀念。
2371.definition: the Christian message about Jesus, or a belief accepted as unquestionably true
2371.en: The lesson used gospel in a clear context.
2371.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gospel」。

2372.explanation: 關於他人私事的非正式談論，常未經證實。
2372.definition: informal talk about other people's private lives, often without confirmed facts
2372.en: The lesson used gossip in a clear context.
2372.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gossip」。

2372.explanation: 談論他人的私事或傳聞。
2372.definition: to talk informally about other people's private affairs
2372.en: They gossiped about the rumor during lunch.
2372.zh: 他們午餐時聊起了那則傳聞。

2373.explanation: 正式控制、管理國家、組織或活動。
2373.definition: to rule or control a country, organization, or activity
2373.en: The lesson used govern in a clear context.
2373.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「govern」。

2374.explanation: 統治國家的組織或制度。
2374.definition: the group or system responsible for ruling a country
2374.en: The lesson used government in a clear context.
2374.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「government」。

2375.explanation: 治理州、地區或機構的人。
2375.definition: a person who governs a state, region, or institution
2375.en: The lesson used governor in a clear context.
2375.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「governor」。

2376.explanation: 長而正式的服裝或袍子。
2376.definition: a long formal dress or robe
2376.en: The lesson used gown in a clear context.
2376.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gown」。

2377.explanation: 突然或迅速地抓住某物。
2377.definition: to take hold of something suddenly or quickly
2377.en: The lesson used grab in a clear context.
2377.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grab」。

2377.explanation: 迅速抓住或取得某物的動作。
2377.definition: a quick attempt or action to seize or obtain something
2377.en: The child made a grab for the balloon.
2377.zh: 孩子伸手想要抓住氣球。

2378.explanation: 優美的舉止，也可指仁慈或恩惠。
2378.definition: elegance of movement or manner, or kindness and favor
2378.en: The lesson used grace in a clear context.
2378.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grace」。

2378.explanation: 以出席或存在使場合更受尊榮或更美好。
2378.definition: to honor or make a place or occasion more attractive by one's presence
2378.en: The painting will grace the entrance hall.
2378.zh: 這幅畫將為入口大廳增添光彩。

2379.explanation: 動作、姿態或外形流暢而美觀的。
2379.definition: moving, shaped, or expressed in a smooth and attractive way
2379.en: The lesson used graceful in a clear context.
2379.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「graceful」。

2380.explanation: 待人仁慈、有禮且令人愉快的。
2380.definition: kind, polite, and pleasantly courteous toward others
2380.en: The lesson used gracious in a clear context.
2380.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gracious」。

2381.explanation: 學校中的年級、品質等級，或評量結果。
2381.definition: a school level, a rank of quality, or a mark showing achievement
2381.en: The lesson used grade in a clear context.
2381.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grade」。

2381.explanation: 給予分數或依品質分類。
2381.definition: to give a score or place something in a quality category
2381.en: The teacher graded our essays over the weekend.
2381.zh: 老師利用週末為我們的作文評分。

2382.explanation: 緩慢地、分階段發生或改變的。
2382.definition: happening or changing slowly by small degrees
2382.en: The lesson used gradual in a clear context.
2382.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gradual」。

2383.explanation: 已完成學校或大學課程的人。
2383.definition: a person who has completed a course of study at a school or college
2383.en: The lesson used graduate in a clear context.
2383.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「graduate」。

2383.explanation: 成功完成學校或大學課程。
2383.definition: to successfully complete a course of study
2383.en: She will graduate from high school in June.

2384.explanation: 完成學業的行為或慶祝此事的典禮。
2384.definition: the act of completing a course of study or the ceremony marking it
2384.en: The lesson used graduation in a clear context.
2384.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「graduation」。

2385.explanation: 可食用的穀類種子，或極小的顆粒。
2385.definition: a cereal seed used as food, or a very small hard particle
2385.en: The lesson used grain in a clear context.
2385.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grain」。

2386.explanation: 等於千分之一公斤的公制重量單位。
2386.definition: a metric unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram
2386.en: The lesson used gram in a clear context.
2386.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gram」。

2387.explanation: 語言中構成正確詞句的規則系統。
2387.definition: the system of rules governing how words and sentences are formed in a language
2387.en: The lesson used grammar in a clear context.
2387.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grammar」。

2388.explanation: 與文法有關，或符合文法規則的。
2388.definition: relating to grammar or following its accepted rules
2388.en: The lesson used grammatical in a clear context.
2388.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grammatical」。

2389.explanation: 規模、外觀或重要性令人印象深刻的。
2389.definition: impressive in size, appearance, importance, or ambition
2389.en: The lesson used grand in a clear context.
2389.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grand」。

2390.definition: the father of one's father or mother
2390.en: The lesson used grandfather in a clear context.
2390.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grandfather」。

2391.definition: the mother of one's father or mother
2391.en: The lesson used grandmother in a clear context.
2391.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grandmother」。

2392.explanation: 由政府或組織為特定目的提供的一筆資金。
2392.definition: money given by a government or organization for a particular purpose
2392.en: The lesson used grant in a clear context.
2392.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grant」。

2392.explanation: 正式給予某人權利、請求或資源。
2392.definition: to formally give or allow something requested or deserved
2392.en: The city granted permission for the event.
2392.zh: 市政府核准了這場活動。

2393.explanation: 成串生長、可鮮食或釀酒的小型圓形水果。
2393.definition: a small round fruit that grows in bunches and can be eaten or used to make wine
2393.en: The lesson used grape in a clear context.
2393.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grape」。

2394.explanation: 大型、略帶苦味的柑橘類水果。
2394.definition: a large citrus fruit with a slightly bitter taste
2394.en: The lesson used grapefruit in a clear context.
2394.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grapefruit」。

2395.explanation: 以線、點或座標呈現數據關係的圖。
2395.definition: a diagram using lines, points, or axes to show relationships in data
2395.en: The lesson used graph in a clear context.
2395.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「graph」。

2395.explanation: 把數據或關係畫成圖表。
2395.definition: to represent data or relationships on a graph
2395.en: Students graphed the results of the experiment.
2395.zh: 學生把實驗結果繪製成圖表。

2396.explanation: 與視覺圖像有關，或描述得非常清楚直接。
2396.definition: relating to visual images or described in vivid and explicit detail
2396.en: The lesson used graphic in a clear context.
2396.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「graphic」。

2396.explanation: 用於呈現資訊或設計的視覺圖像。
2396.definition: a visual image or design used to present information
2396.en: The report includes a graphic showing population growth.
2396.zh: 報告中有一張呈現人口成長的圖像。

2397.explanation: 牢牢抓住，或理解某個想法。
2397.definition: to hold something firmly or understand an idea clearly
2397.en: The lesson used grasp in a clear context.
2397.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grasp」。

2397.explanation: 抓住的能力，或對某事的理解程度。
2397.definition: a firm hold or a clear understanding of something
2397.en: He has a clear grasp of the main idea.
2397.zh: 他清楚掌握這個主要概念。

2398.explanation: 具有細長葉片、常形成草地的植物。
2398.definition: a common plant with narrow leaves that often forms lawns or fields
2398.en: The lesson used grass in a clear context.
2398.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grass」。

2399.explanation: 後腿強壯、善於跳躍的昆蟲。
2399.definition: an insect with powerful hind legs used for jumping
2399.en: The lesson used grasshopper in a clear context.
2399.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grasshopper」。

2400.explanation: 覆蓋著草，或具有草的特徵。
2400.definition: covered with grass or resembling grass in appearance
2400.en: The lesson used grassy in a clear context.
2400.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grassy」。

2401.explanation: 因得到幫助或好處而感到謝意的。
2401.definition: feeling or showing thanks for help or kindness received
2401.en: The lesson used grateful in a clear context.
2401.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grateful」。

2402.explanation: 對幫助、善意或好處所感到的感謝。
2402.definition: the feeling of being thankful for help, kindness, or benefit
2402.en: The lesson used gratitude in a clear context.
2402.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gratitude」。

2403.definition: a place in the ground where a dead person is buried
2403.en: The lesson used grave in a clear context.
2403.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grave」。

2403.explanation: 非常嚴重、重要或令人擔憂的。
2403.definition: very serious, important, or causing deep concern
2403.en: The doctor warned that the situation was grave.
2403.zh: 醫師警告情況十分嚴重。

2404.explanation: 吸引物體朝向地球的力，也可指事情的嚴重程度。
2404.definition: the force that attracts objects toward Earth, or the seriousness of a situation
2404.en: The lesson used gravity in a clear context.
2404.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gravity」。

2405.explanation: 介於黑色與白色之間的顏色。
2405.definition: having a color between black and white
2405.en: The lesson used gray in a clear context.
2405.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gray」。

2405.definition: the color between black and white
2405.en: She mixed black and white to make gray.
2405.zh: 她把黑色和白色混合成灰色。

2405.explanation: 變成灰色，尤其指頭髮隨年齡變灰。
2405.definition: to become gray or cause something to become gray
2405.en: His hair began to gray in his thirties.
2405.zh: 他的頭髮在三十多歲時開始變灰。

2406.explanation: 動物吃草，也可指輕輕擦過而造成表面傷痕。
2406.definition: to feed on grass, or to scrape lightly against a surface
2406.en: The lesson used graze in a clear context.
2406.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「graze」。

2407.explanation: 濃稠的油性物質，常用於潤滑。
2407.definition: a thick oily substance, often used for lubrication
2407.en: The lesson used grease in a clear context.
2407.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grease」。

2407.explanation: 在表面塗上油脂以減少摩擦。
2407.definition: to apply grease to a surface to reduce friction
2407.en: Please grease the hinges if they squeak.
2407.zh: 如果鉸鏈發出吱嘎聲，請替它們上油。

2408.explanation: 含有或沾有大量油脂的。
2408.definition: containing, covered with, or resembling a lot of grease
2408.en: The lesson used greasy in a clear context.
2408.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「greasy」。

2409.explanation: 程度、品質、規模或重要性很高的。
2409.definition: very high in degree, quality, size, or importance
2409.en: The lesson used great in a clear context.
2409.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「great」。

2409.explanation: 在某領域非常傑出或有影響力的人。
2409.definition: a person of outstanding ability or importance in a field
2409.en: She is remembered as one of the greats of modern tennis.
2409.zh: 她被視為現代網球史上的偉大人物之一。

2410.explanation: 想要比需要或應得更多財富、權力或物品的強烈欲望。
2410.definition: a strong selfish desire for more wealth, power, or possessions than needed
2410.en: The lesson used greed in a clear context.
2410.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「greed」。

2411.explanation: 想要超過合理需要的食物、金錢或物品。
2411.definition: wanting more food, money, or possessions than is reasonable
2411.en: The lesson used greedy in a clear context.
2411.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「greedy」。

2412.explanation: 具有草木般綠色，或有助環境保護的。
2412.definition: having the color of grass, or intended to protect the environment
2412.en: The lesson used green in a clear context.
2412.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「green」。

2412.explanation: 綠色本身，或覆蓋草地的區域。
2412.definition: the color of grass or an area covered with grass
2412.en: The artist added green to the landscape.
2412.zh: 畫家在風景畫中加入綠色。

2412.explanation: 使某事物更符合環保，或使其變綠。
2412.definition: to make something more environmentally friendly or become green
2412.en: The city plans to green several empty lots.
2412.zh: 市政府計畫綠化數塊空地。

2413.explanation: 以玻璃或塑膠建成、用來控制植物生長環境的建築。
2413.definition: a glass or plastic building used for growing plants in controlled conditions
2413.en: The lesson used greenhouse in a clear context.
2413.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「greenhouse」。

2414.explanation: 見面時以言語或動作歡迎某人。
2414.definition: to welcome someone with words or gestures when meeting them
2414.en: The lesson used greet in a clear context.
2414.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「greet」。

2415.explanation: 用來歡迎某人或表達祝福的言語或動作。
2415.definition: words or actions used to welcome someone or express good wishes
2415.en: The lesson used greeting in a clear context.
2415.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「greeting」。

2416.explanation: 尤其因死亡或重大失去而產生的深切悲傷。
2416.definition: deep sadness, especially after a death or serious loss
2416.en: The lesson used grief in a clear context.
2416.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grief」。

2417.explanation: 因失去某人或某物而感受或表達深切悲傷。
2417.definition: to feel or express deep sadness because of a loss
2417.en: The lesson used grieve in a clear context.
2417.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grieve」。

2418.explanation: 以直接熱源烹調食物的金屬架或設備。
2418.definition: a metal frame or cooking device used to cook food over direct heat
2418.en: The lesson used grill in a clear context.
2418.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grill」。

2418.explanation: 以直接熱源烹調，或強烈地質問某人。
2418.definition: to cook over direct heat, or question someone intensely

2419.explanation: 非常嚴重、不愉快或缺乏希望的。
2419.definition: very serious, unpleasant, or lacking hope
2419.en: The lesson used grim in a clear context.
2419.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grim」。

2420.definition: a broad smile that shows the teeth
2420.en: The lesson used grin in a clear context.
2420.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grin」。

2420.definition: to smile broadly so that the teeth can be seen
2420.en: He grinned when he saw the surprise.
2420.zh: 他看到驚喜時咧嘴笑了。

2421.explanation: 藉由壓碎或摩擦使物質變成較小顆粒。
2421.definition: to crush or rub something into smaller particles
2421.en: The lesson used grind in a clear context.
2421.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grind」。

2421.explanation: 艱苦重複的工作，或研磨的動作。
2421.definition: hard repetitive work, or the act of grinding
2421.en: Preparing the data became a daily grind.
2421.zh: 整理資料成了每天的苦差事。

2422.explanation: 牢固的握持，或對某事的強力控制。
2422.definition: a firm hold or strong control over something
2422.en: The lesson used grip in a clear context.
2422.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grip」。

2422.explanation: 牢牢抓住，或強烈吸引注意力。
2422.definition: to hold firmly or strongly attract someone's attention
2422.en: The opening scene gripped the audience immediately.
2422.zh: 開場畫面立刻吸引了觀眾。

2423.explanation: 表達痛苦、煩惱或失望的低沉聲音。
2423.definition: a low sound expressing pain, annoyance, or disappointment
2423.en: The lesson used groan in a clear context.
2423.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「groan」。

2423.explanation: 因痛苦、煩惱或失望發出低沉聲音。
2423.definition: to make a low sound because of pain, annoyance, or disappointment
2423.en: She groaned when she saw the long line.
2423.zh: 她看到長長的隊伍時呻吟了一聲。

2424.explanation: 食品與家庭日用品，或販售這些商品的店。
2424.definition: food and household items sold by a grocer, or a store selling them
2424.en: The lesson used grocery in a clear context.
2424.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grocery」。

2425.explanation: 扣除成本前的總額，或極度令人不快的。
2425.definition: total before deductions, or extremely unpleasant
2425.en: The lesson used gross in a clear context.
2425.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gross」。

2425.explanation: 在扣除成本前取得某一總收入。
2425.definition: to earn a total amount before costs or deductions
2425.en: The film grossed over a million dollars.
2425.zh: 這部電影的總收入超過一百萬美元。

2425.explanation: 一百四十四個物品的數量。
2425.en: The shop ordered a gross of pencils.
2425.zh: 商店訂購了一羅，也就是一百四十四枝鉛筆。

2426.explanation: 地球表面、土地，或支持論點的理由。
2426.definition: the surface of the earth, land, or a basis for an argument
2426.en: The lesson used ground in a clear context.
2426.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「ground」。

2426.explanation: 使飛機停飛、限制活動，或將電路接地。
2426.definition: to keep an aircraft from flying, restrict activity, or connect electrically to earth
2426.en: The airline grounded all flights during the storm.
2426.zh: 航空公司在暴風雨期間讓所有班機停飛。

2427.explanation: 被視為一個整體的一群人或事物。
2427.definition: a number of people or things considered together
2427.en: The lesson used group in a clear context.
2427.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「group」。

2427.explanation: 依共同特徵把人或事物放在一起。
2427.definition: to arrange people or things together according to shared features
2427.en: Please group the books by subject.
2427.zh: 請依主題將這些書分組。

2428.explanation: 變得更大或發展，也可指栽種植物。
2428.definition: to become larger or develop, or to cultivate plants
2428.en: The lesson used grow in a clear context.
2428.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grow」。

2429.explanation: 動物或人發出的低沉粗啞威嚇聲。
2429.definition: a low rough threatening sound made by an animal or person
2429.en: The lesson used growl in a clear context.
2429.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「growl」。

2429.explanation: 發出低沉粗啞的威嚇聲。
2429.definition: to make a low rough threatening sound
2429.en: The dog growled at the stranger.

2430.explanation: 生長、發展或增加的過程。
2430.definition: the process of growing, developing, or increasing
2430.en: The lesson used growth in a clear context.
2430.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「growth」。

2431.explanation: 以低沉或不滿的聲音抱怨。
2431.definition: to complain in a low or annoyed voice
2431.en: The lesson used grumble in a clear context.
2431.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「grumble」。

2431.explanation: 抱怨的話或表示不滿的低沉聲音。
2431.definition: a complaint or a low sound of dissatisfaction
2431.en: A low grumble spread through the crowd.
2431.zh: 人群中傳出低沉的抱怨聲。

2432.explanation: 承諾某事會發生或符合既定標準。
2432.definition: to promise that something will happen or meet a stated standard
2432.en: The lesson used guarantee in a clear context.
2432.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guarantee」。

2432.explanation: 對結果或產品品質所作的承諾。
2432.definition: a promise that something will happen or that a product will meet a standard
2432.en: The repair comes with a one-year guarantee.
2432.zh: 這項維修附有一年保固。

2433.explanation: 保護人或物的人员或裝置。
2433.definition: a person or device that protects someone or something
2433.en: The lesson used guard in a clear context.
2433.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guard」。

2433.explanation: 保護或看守人或物以防危險。
2433.definition: to protect or watch someone or something against danger

2434.explanation: 依法或實際負責保護另一人的人。
2434.definition: a person legally or practically responsible for protecting another person
2434.en: The lesson used guardian in a clear context.
2434.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guardian」。

2435.explanation: 帶有香味果肉和許多小種子的熱帶水果。
2435.definition: a tropical fruit with fragrant flesh and many small seeds
2435.en: The lesson used guava in a clear context.
2435.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guava」。

2436.explanation: 在資訊不足以確定時提出答案或看法。
2436.definition: to give an answer or opinion without enough information to be certain
2436.en: The lesson used guess in a clear context.
2436.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guess」。

2436.explanation: 在資訊不足時提出的答案或看法。
2436.definition: an answer or opinion made without enough information to be certain
2436.zh: 我的第一次猜測是正確的。

2437.explanation: 受邀拜訪、住宿或參加活動的人。
2437.definition: a person invited to visit, stay, or take part in an event
2437.en: The lesson used guest in a clear context.
2437.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guest」。

2438.explanation: 幫助某人做決定或正確行動的建議或資訊。
2438.definition: advice or information that helps someone make decisions or act correctly
2438.en: The lesson used guidance in a clear context.
2438.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guidance」。

2439.explanation: 帶路的人，或提供有用資訊的資源。
2439.definition: a person or resource that shows the way or provides helpful information
2439.en: The lesson used guide in a clear context.
2439.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guide」。

2439.explanation: 帶領某人前進或協助其決策與行動。
2439.definition: to show someone the way or help direct their decisions or actions
2439.en: Clear signs guided us through the airport.
2439.zh: 清楚的標示引導我們通過機場。

2440.explanation: 協助決定如何行動的一般規則或建議。
2440.definition: a general rule or recommendation that helps determine how to act
2440.en: The lesson used guideline in a clear context.
2440.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guideline」。

2441.explanation: 做錯事的感受，或法律上的犯罪責任。
2441.definition: the feeling of having done wrong, or legal responsibility for an offense
2441.en: The lesson used guilt in a clear context.
2441.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guilt」。

2442.explanation: 對不當行為負責，或因所做的事感到羞愧。
2442.definition: responsible for wrongdoing or feeling ashamed about something done
2442.en: The lesson used guilty in a clear context.
2442.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guilty」。

2443.explanation: 以撥弦或刷弦方式演奏的弦樂器。
2443.definition: a stringed musical instrument played by plucking or strumming
2443.en: The lesson used guitar in a clear context.
2443.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guitar」。

2444.explanation: 部分被陸地包圍的大面積海域，或人與觀念間的巨大差異。
2444.definition: a large area of sea partly enclosed by land, or a major difference between people or ideas
2444.en: The lesson used gulf in a clear context.
2444.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gulf」。

2445.explanation: 牙齒周圍組織、口香糖，或植物產生的黏性物質。
2445.definition: the flesh around the teeth, chewing gum, or a sticky substance from plants
2445.en: The lesson used gum in a clear context.
2445.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gum」。

2446.explanation: 發射子彈或其他投射物的武器。
2446.definition: a weapon that fires bullets or other projectiles
2446.en: The lesson used gun in a clear context.
2446.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gun」。

2446.explanation: 以槍射擊，或使引擎高速運轉。
2446.definition: to shoot with a gun or make an engine run very fast
2446.en: The driver gunned the engine at the light.
2446.zh: 駕駛在紅綠燈前猛催引擎。

2447.explanation: 消化器官，或不經推理的本能感受。
2447.definition: the digestive organs, or an instinctive feeling
2447.en: The lesson used gut in a clear context.
2447.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gut」。

2447.meaning: 取出內臟；徹底破壞內部
2447.explanation: 移除內臟，或摧毀建築物內部。
2447.definition: to remove the internal organs or destroy the inside of a building
2447.en: The fire gutted the old warehouse.
2447.zh: 大火徹底燒毀了舊倉庫的內部。

2448.explanation: 口語中指男人，複數時也可泛指一群人。
2448.definition: an informal term for a man or, in the plural, a group of people
2448.en: The lesson used guy in a clear context.
2448.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「guy」。

2449.explanation: 配有運動器材、供鍛鍊或體育活動使用的房間或建築。
2449.definition: a room or building equipped for exercise, sports, or physical training
2449.en: The lesson used gym in a clear context.
2449.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「gym」。

2450.explanation: 經常重複、可能變成自動行為的固定做法。
2450.definition: a regular behavior that is repeated often and may become automatic
2450.en: The lesson used habit in a clear context.
2450.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「habit」。

2451.explanation: 植物或動物通常生活的自然環境。
2451.definition: the natural environment in which a plant or animal normally lives
2451.en: The lesson used habitat in a clear context.
2451.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「habitat」。

2452.explanation: 因習慣而經常或反覆進行的。
2452.definition: done regularly or repeatedly as a habit
2452.en: The lesson used habitual in a clear context.
2452.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「habitual」。

2453.explanation: 熟悉電腦系統的人，尤其可指未經授權存取系統者。
2453.definition: a person skilled at computer systems, especially one who gains unauthorized access
2453.en: The lesson used hacker in a clear context.
2453.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「hacker」。

2454.explanation: 從雲中落下的小冰球或冰塊。
2454.definition: small balls or pieces of ice that fall from clouds
2454.en: The lesson used hail in a clear context.
2454.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「hail」。

2454.explanation: 熱烈讚揚或招呼某人，也可指冰雹落下。
2454.definition: to praise or greet enthusiastically, call to someone, or fall as hail
2454.en: The newspaper hailed the scientist as a pioneer.
2454.zh: 報紙讚揚這位科學家為先驅。

2455.explanation: 從人或動物皮膚長出的細絲狀物。
2455.definition: the fine strands that grow from the skin of people and animals
2455.en: The lesson used hair in a clear context.
2455.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「hair」。

2456.explanation: 剪頭髮的行為或剪完後的髮型。
2456.definition: the act or result of cutting someone's hair
2456.en: The lesson used haircut in a clear context.
2456.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「haircut」。

2457.explanation: 以剪髮、造型或護理頭髮為職業的人。
2457.definition: a person whose job is cutting, styling, or treating hair
2457.en: The lesson used hairdresser in a clear context.
2457.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「hairdresser」。

2458.explanation: 一個整體的兩個相等部分之一。
2458.definition: one of two equal parts of a whole
2458.en: The lesson used half in a clear context.
2458.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「half」。

2458.explanation: 達到一半的程度，或部分地。
2458.definition: to the extent of one half or partly

2458.explanation: 等於一個整體兩個相等部分之一的。
2458.definition: equal to one of two parts of a whole
2458.en: We waited for half an hour.

2459.explanation: 供公共用途的大房間，或建築內的通道。
2459.definition: a large room for public use or a passage inside a building
2459.en: The lesson used hall in a clear context.
2459.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「hall」。

2460.explanation: 建築內連接各房間的通道。
2460.definition: a passage inside a building that connects rooms
2460.en: The lesson used hallway in a clear context.
2460.zh: 課堂在清楚的語境中使用「hallway」。

2461.explanation: 停止移動、運作或進行，或使某事停止。
2461.definition: to stop moving, operating, or progressing, or to cause something to stop
2461.en: The bus halted at the red light.
2461.zh: 公車在紅燈前停了下來。

2461.explanation: 移動、運作或進行中的停止。
2461.definition: a temporary or complete stop in movement, operation, or progress
2461.en: The train came to a halt outside the station.
2461.zh: 火車在車站外停了下來。

2462.explanation: 豬後腿經鹽漬、煙燻等方式製成的肉。
2462.definition: meat from the upper part of a pig's hind leg, usually cured or smoked
2462.en: We added slices of ham to the sandwiches.
2462.zh: 我們在三明治裡加了幾片火腿。

2463.explanation: 以碎牛肉餅夾在圓麵包中食用的食物；burger 也可泛指其他肉或素食餅。
2463.definition: a cooked patty, especially of ground beef, usually served in a split bun
2463.en: She ordered a hamburger with lettuce and tomato.
2463.zh: 她點了一個加生菜和番茄的漢堡。

2464.explanation: 有較重頭部、用來敲擊物體的手工具。
2464.definition: a hand tool with a heavy head used for striking
2464.en: He used a hammer to drive the nail into the board.
2464.zh: 他用錘子把釘子敲進木板。

2464.explanation: 用錘子或類似工具反覆敲擊某物。
2464.definition: to strike something repeatedly with a hammer or a similar tool
2464.en: She hammered the nail firmly into the wood.
2464.zh: 她把釘子牢牢敲進木頭裡。

2465.explanation: 使某事更難進行或限制其進展。
2465.definition: to make an action or progress difficult by creating obstacles or restrictions
2465.en: Heavy rain hampered the rescue effort.

2466.explanation: 直接把某物傳遞或交給某人。
2466.definition: to pass or give something directly to someone
2466.en: Please hand me the blue folder.
2466.zh: 請把藍色資料夾遞給我。

2466.explanation: 手腕以下的身體部位，也可指給予的協助。
2466.definition: the part of the body below the wrist, or help given to someone
2466.en: Could you give me a hand with these boxes?
2466.zh: 你可以幫我搬這些箱子嗎？

2467.explanation: 一隻手能握住的量，也可指少數人或物。
2467.definition: an amount that can be held in one hand, or a small number of people or things
2467.en: Only a handful of students stayed after class.
2467.zh: 下課後只有少數學生留下來。

2468.explanation: 使某人或團體處於不利，或使成功變得更困難。
2468.definition: to put a person or group at a disadvantage or make success more difficult
2468.en: A lack of reliable data can handicap a small research team.
2468.zh: 缺乏可靠資料可能使小型研究團隊處於不利。

2468.explanation: 使某人較難成功或完成事情的情況。
2468.definition: a condition or circumstance that makes success or progress more difficult
2468.en: Lack of reliable transportation is a serious handicap for many workers.
2468.zh: 缺乏可靠的交通工具對許多工作者而言是嚴重的不利條件。

2469.explanation: 主要以手工和技巧製作裝飾品或實用品的工藝。
2469.definition: the craft of making decorative or useful objects mainly by hand
2469.en: The market sells local handicrafts made from bamboo.
2469.zh: 這個市集販售以竹子製作的在地手工藝品。

2470.explanation: 用來擦鼻子、臉或手的小方布。
2470.definition: a small square of cloth carried for wiping the nose, face, or hands
2470.en: He pulled a clean handkerchief from his pocket.
2470.zh: 他從口袋裡拿出一條乾淨的手帕。

2471.explanation: 處理、管理、應付或操作某事物。
2471.definition: to deal with, manage, or operate something
2471.zh: 她冷靜地處理了這起申訴。

2471.explanation: 用手握住以開啟、提起或控制物件的部位。
2471.definition: a part designed to be held when opening, lifting, or controlling an object
2471.en: Turn the handle gently to open the door.

2472.explanation: 外表好看，傳統上常形容男性；也可形容數量相當大。
2472.definition: attractive in appearance, traditionally especially of a man; also considerable in amount
2472.en: He looked handsome in the dark suit.
2472.zh: 他穿著深色西裝看起來很英俊。

2473.explanation: 某人以手寫出的字，或其獨特書寫風格。
2473.definition: writing done by hand, especially the distinctive style in which a person writes
2473.en: I could barely read his handwriting.
2473.zh: 我幾乎看不懂他的筆跡。

2474.explanation: 容易使用、取得或位於方便之處。
2474.definition: convenient to use, easy to reach, or useful for a particular purpose
2474.en: Keep a flashlight handy during the storm.
2474.zh: 暴風雨期間把手電筒放在方便拿取的地方。

2475.explanation: 使某物從上方支撐而垂下，或處於懸垂狀態。
2475.definition: to fasten or support something from above so that it is suspended
2475.en: She hung the picture above the desk.

2476.definition: a shaped frame used for hanging clothes
2476.en: Please put the jacket on a hanger.

2477.explanation: 某事件發生，或某事偶然成為事實。
2477.definition: to take place or occur, especially without being planned
2477.zh: 會議結束後發生了什麼事？

2478.explanation: 感到愉快、滿足或對情況感到滿意。
2478.definition: feeling or showing pleasure, contentment, or satisfaction
2478.en: She was happy with the result.

2479.explanation: 反覆以不受歡迎、令人不安或受壓迫的方式對待某人。
2479.definition: to repeatedly trouble, pressure, or intimidate someone in an unwelcome way
2479.en: The school has rules to prevent students from harassing others.
2479.zh: 學校有規定防止學生騷擾他人。

2479.explanation: 反覆以令人不安或受威脅的方式對待某人的行為。
2479.definition: repeated behavior that troubles, intimidates, or threatens someone
2479.en: The school has a clear policy against harassment.
2479.zh: 學校對騷擾行為有明確的禁止政策。

2480.explanation: 船隻可以安全停泊、通常受到天然或人工遮蔽的水域。
2480.definition: a sheltered area of water where ships and boats can anchor safely
2480.en: Fishing boats returned to the harbor before sunset.
2480.zh: 漁船在日落前返回港口。

2480.explanation: 暗中讓某人或某物停留，或長期保有某種想法或感受。
2480.definition: to shelter someone or something secretly, or to keep a thought or feeling for a long time
2480.en: He still harbors doubts about the proposal.
2480.zh: 他對這項提案仍然心存疑慮。

2481.explanation: 堅硬的，或難以完成、理解或處理的。
2481.definition: firm or solid rather than soft; also difficult to do, understand, or deal with
2481.en: The ground was hard after a week without rain.
2481.zh: 一週沒有下雨後，地面變得很硬。

2481.explanation: 以很大的力氣、強度或投入程度。
2481.definition: with a great deal of effort, force, or intensity
2481.en: She studied hard for the final exam.
2481.zh: 她為期末考非常努力地讀書。

2482.explanation: 變得堅硬，或使某物變硬；也可指態度變得更強硬。
2482.definition: to become hard or make something hard; also to become or make an attitude less flexible
2482.en: The clay will harden as it dries.

2483.explanation: 表示某事幾乎沒有發生、幾乎不存在，或程度很低。
2483.definition: almost not, barely, or only to a very small degree
2483.en: I could hardly hear the announcement.
2483.zh: 我幾乎聽不到那則廣播。

2484.explanation: 使生活變得困難或痛苦的狀況，常涉及金錢、生活條件或其他匱乏。
2484.definition: a difficult condition or experience that causes suffering, lack, or serious inconvenience
2484.en: The family endured financial hardship during the winter.
2484.zh: 那個家庭在冬季承受了經濟困難。

2485.explanation: 電腦或機器的實體設備；也可指工具、金屬配件等五金用品。
2485.definition: the physical equipment of a computer or machine; also tools, metal fittings, and similar equipment
2485.en: The technician replaced the damaged computer hardware.
2485.zh: 技術人員更換了損壞的電腦硬體。

2486.explanation: 對人、動物、財產或福祉造成的傷害、損失或不良影響。
2486.definition: damage, injury, or a bad effect caused to a person, animal, thing, or well-being
2486.en: The chemical can cause serious harm to fish.
2486.zh: 這種化學物質可能對魚類造成嚴重傷害。

2486.explanation: 對人、動物、物品或利益造成傷害或損失。
2486.definition: to cause injury, damage, or loss to a person, animal, object, or interest
2486.en: Excessive noise can harm your hearing.
2486.zh: 過大的噪音可能傷害你的聽力。

2487.explanation: 會造成傷害、損失、健康問題或其他不良影響的。
2487.definition: causing or likely to cause damage, injury, or another bad effect
2487.en: Too much noise can be harmful to your hearing.
2487.zh: 過多噪音可能有害聽力。

2488.explanation: 用嘴吹氣與吸氣，使小型樂器內的金屬簧片振動發聲。
2488.definition: a small musical instrument played by blowing or drawing air through metal reeds with the mouth
2488.en: He learned to play the harmonica by ear.
2488.zh: 他靠聽音學會了吹口琴。

2489.explanation: 人或事物和平一致、協調的狀態；音樂中也指不同音同時形成的悅耳組合。
2489.definition: a state of peaceful agreement or pleasing coordination; in music, a pleasing combination of notes sounded together
2489.en: The two groups worked together in harmony.
2489.zh: 兩個團體和諧地一起合作。

2490.explanation: 由帶子組成、用來固定或控制人或動物，或將設備安全連接在身上的裝置。
2490.definition: a set of straps used to secure or control a person or animal, or to attach equipment safely
2490.en: The climber checked her safety harness twice.
2490.zh: 那名攀登者把安全帶具檢查了兩次。

2490.explanation: 控制並有效利用某種力量、資源或能源。
2490.definition: to control and make effective use of power, resources, or energy
2490.en: Engineers hope to harness the power of ocean waves.
2490.zh: 工程師希望利用海浪的力量。

2491.explanation: 形容言語、規則、環境或感官刺激過於嚴苛、粗糙或令人不舒服。
2491.definition: unpleasantly severe, strict, rough, or difficult to endure
2491.en: The hikers struggled through the harsh winter weather.
2491.zh: 登山者在嚴酷的冬季天候中艱難前行。

2492.explanation: 成熟農作物被採收的成果、數量或採收期。
2492.definition: the gathering of ripe crops, the crops gathered, or the yield produced
2492.en: This year's rice harvest was larger than expected.
2492.zh: 今年稻米收成比預期豐富。

2492.explanation: 採集成熟的農作物，或取得可利用的資源。
2492.definition: to gather a ripe crop or collect a resource for use
2492.en: Farmers harvest the rice in late autumn.

2493.explanation: 因急迫或時間不足而快速行動的狀態，常暗示可能缺乏充分思考。
2493.definition: speed or urgency in acting, often with too little time or care
2493.en: In her haste, she left the documents on the train.
2493.zh: 她因為匆忙，把文件留在火車上。

2494.explanation: 使某事更快發生，或自己加快動作與進程。
2494.definition: to make something happen sooner, or to move or act more quickly
2494.en: The new treatment may hasten recovery.

2495.explanation: 做得或決定得太快，沒有足夠思考、準備或小心。
2495.definition: done or decided too quickly and without enough thought or care
2495.en: He regretted making a hasty decision.
2495.zh: 他後悔做了草率的決定。

2496.explanation: 戴在頭上的覆蓋物，通常有帽冠，並可能帶有帽沿。
2496.definition: a covering worn on the head, usually with a shaped crown and sometimes a brim
2496.en: She wore a wide hat to block the sun.
2496.zh: 她戴了一頂寬邊帽遮陽。

2497.explanation: 船、飛機、屋頂或其他結構上可開啟並通常有蓋子的出入口。
2497.definition: a covered opening in a ship, aircraft, roof, or other structure
2497.en: The sailor opened the hatch and climbed below deck.
2497.zh: 水手打開艙口，爬到甲板下方。

2497.explanation: 從蛋中孵出，或使蛋中的幼體孵化。
2497.definition: to emerge from an egg, or to cause a young animal to emerge from one
2497.en: The eggs should hatch within two weeks.
2497.zh: 這些蛋應該會在兩週內孵化。

2498.explanation: 對某人、某事或某種行為感到非常強烈的不喜歡。
2498.definition: to dislike someone or something very strongly

2498.explanation: 對某人或某事強烈而持久的厭惡。
2498.definition: a strong and lasting feeling of dislike toward someone or something
2498.en: The campaign urges people to reject hate and violence.
2498.zh: 這項活動呼籲人們拒絕仇恨與暴力。

2499.explanation: 引起強烈厭惡，或表現出仇恨、敵意的。
2499.definition: causing strong dislike or expressing hate and hostility
2499.en: The hateful message was removed from the forum.
2499.zh: 那則充滿仇恨的訊息已從論壇移除。

2500.explanation: 對某人、群體或事物持續而強烈的憎惡或敵意。
2500.definition: a strong and lasting feeling of dislike or hostility
2500.en: Years of conflict created deep hatred between the groups.
2500.zh: 多年的衝突在兩個群體之間造成深刻仇恨。

2501.explanation: 用力拉動或運送沉重、難移動的東西。
2501.definition: to pull or transport something heavy or difficult to move, usually with considerable effort
2501.en: They hauled the broken boat onto the shore.
2501.zh: 他們費力地把損壞的船拖上岸。

2501.explanation: 費力拖拉的行動，或一次運送所帶來的一批物品。
2501.definition: an act of pulling something with effort, or the amount moved in one trip
2501.en: The fishermen returned with a large haul of tuna.
2501.zh: 漁民帶著一大批鮪魚回來。

2502.explanation: 記憶、恐懼或景象持續出現在心中並造成困擾；也可指鬼魂經常出現在某處。
2502.definition: to return repeatedly to someone's mind in a disturbing way, or to be repeatedly present in a place as a ghost
2502.en: The memory of the accident haunted him for years.
2502.zh: 那場事故的記憶多年來一直縈繞著他。

2502.explanation: 某人經常前往並停留的場所。
2502.definition: a place that a person visits frequently
2502.en: That café was one of her favorite haunts in college.
2502.zh: 那間咖啡館是她大學時最常去的地方之一。

2503.explanation: 與過去分詞搭配形成現在完成式、過去完成式等完成時態。
2503.definition: used with a past participle to form perfect verb tenses
2503.en: She has finished her homework already.

2503.definition: to own, possess, contain, or experience something
2503.en: Our classroom has two large windows.
2503.zh: 我們的教室有兩扇大窗戶。

2504.explanation: 一類猛禽，具有銳利視力、彎曲的喙與強壯的爪，用來捕捉獵物。
2504.definition: a bird of prey with keen eyesight, a hooked bill, and strong claws used to catch prey
2504.en: A hawk circled slowly above the field.
2504.zh: 一隻鷹在田野上方緩慢盤旋。

2505.explanation: 割下後乾燥、通常儲存作為牲畜飼料的草或其他草本植物。
2505.definition: grass or similar plants that have been cut and dried, especially for use as animal feed
2505.en: The farmer stored dry hay in the barn.
2505.zh: 農夫把乾草儲存在穀倉裡。

2506.explanation: 可能造成傷害、事故、損失或其他不良結果的事物或情況。
2506.definition: something that creates a risk of injury, damage, loss, or another bad result
2506.en: Loose electrical wires can be a serious safety hazard.
2506.zh: 鬆脫的電線可能是嚴重的安全危險。

2506.explanation: 試探性地說出想法，或使某人或某物暴露於危險。
2506.definition: to offer an idea tentatively, or to expose someone or something to risk
2506.en: May I hazard a guess about the answer?
2506.zh: 我可以冒險猜一下答案嗎？

2507.explanation: 第三人稱男性單數主格代名詞，用來指先前已提到或可辨識的男性人物或雄性動物。
2507.definition: the third-person singular subject pronoun used for a male person or animal already identified or understood
2507.en: He left his bag on the chair.
2507.zh: 他把他的袋子留在椅子上。

2508.explanation: 人體或動物身體上包含腦、眼、耳、鼻、口等器官的部位。
2508.definition: the part of a human or animal body that contains the brain and major organs of the face
2508.en: She is the head of the science department.

2508.explanation: 領導團體，或朝某個方向前進。
2508.definition: to lead a group or move in a particular direction
2508.en: Maya will head the research team next year.
2508.zh: Maya 明年將率領研究團隊。

2509.explanation: 頭部內或周圍感受到的疼痛。
2509.definition: pain felt in or around the head
2509.en: I developed a headache after staring at the screen too long.
2509.zh: 我盯著螢幕太久後開始頭痛。

2510.explanation: 新聞報導上方用較醒目文字概括內容的標題。
2510.definition: a prominent title placed above a news story to summarize or identify its subject
2510.en: The headline summarized the main point of the report.
2510.zh: 標題概括了這篇報導的重點。

2510.explanation: 在表演或活動中擔任主要人物，或成為新聞標題的焦點。
