2510.definition: to be the main performer or attraction, or to be featured prominently in news
2510.en: A young violinist will headline the concert.
2510.zh: 一位年輕小提琴家將擔任這場音樂會的主角。

2511.explanation: 戴在耳朵上或耳中的裝置，用來私下聆聽音樂、語音或其他聲音。
2511.definition: a device worn over or in the ears for listening privately to audio
2511.en: She wore headphones while studying in the library.
2511.zh: 她在圖書館讀書時戴著耳機。

2512.explanation: 組織、公司、軍隊或其他機構主要管理與決策所在的中心。
2512.definition: the main office or center from which an organization is directed
2512.en: The company moved its headquarters to Chicago.
2512.zh: 公司把總部遷到芝加哥。

2513.explanation: 傷口、身體或情緒恢復健康；也可使傷口或受傷部位恢復。
2513.definition: to become healthy again after injury or illness, or to make a wound or injury recover
2513.en: The cut should heal within a week.
2513.zh: 這道傷口應該會在一週內癒合。

2514.explanation: 身體與心理的整體狀態，尤其指沒有疾病且功能良好的狀態。
2514.definition: the condition of a person's body and mind, especially whether they are well or ill
2514.en: Regular sleep is important for good health.
2514.zh: 規律睡眠對良好健康很重要。

2515.explanation: 有助於維持或改善身體健康，尤常用來描述食物、飲食或習慣。
2515.definition: good for health and likely to help maintain physical well-being
2515.en: The cafeteria offers several healthful meals.
2515.zh: 這間自助餐廳供應數種有益健康的餐點。

2516.explanation: 身體或心理狀況良好，也可指有助於健康或運作正常。
2516.definition: in good physical or mental condition; also beneficial to health or functioning well
2516.en: Daily exercise helps keep your heart healthy.
2516.zh: 每日運動有助於維持心臟健康。

2517.explanation: 名詞指凌亂或大量堆在一起的東西；動詞指把東西堆成一堆。
2517.definition: a pile of things placed together, often untidily; also to pile things up
2517.en: A heap of wet clothes lay on the floor.
2517.zh: 地板上堆著一堆濕衣服。

2518.explanation: 用耳朵察覺聲音，也可指從他人或消息來源得知某事。
2518.definition: to perceive sound with the ears, or to receive information about something
2518.en: I could hear music from the next room.
2518.zh: 我能聽見隔壁房間傳來的音樂。

2519.explanation: 胸腔內泵送血液的器官，也可比喻情感、勇氣或某地的中心。
2519.definition: the organ that pumps blood through the body; also the center of emotion or the central part of something
2519.en: The doctor listened to his heart.

2520.explanation: 可指熱情真誠，也可形容食物份量大而令人滿足，或身體強健。
2520.definition: warm and enthusiastic, substantial and satisfying, or strong and healthy
2520.en: We enjoyed a hearty meal after the hike.
2520.zh: 健行後，我們享用了一頓豐盛的餐點。

2521.explanation: 名詞指高溫或熱能；動詞指使某物變熱。
2521.definition: high temperature or thermal energy; also to make something hot
2521.en: Heat the soup over low heat.

2522.explanation: 用來加熱房間、水或其他物質的裝置。
2522.definition: a device used to warm a room, water, or another substance
2522.en: The heater kept the room warm.
2522.zh: 暖氣設備讓房間保持溫暖。

2523.explanation: 多數宗教中指善人死後靈魂前往的幸福神聖之地，也可比喻極美好的地方。
2523.definition: in many religions, a place of perfect happiness after death; also a place that feels ideal
2523.en: The quiet beach felt like heaven.
2523.zh: 寧靜的海灘感覺就像天堂。

2524.explanation: 重量大；也可指數量多、程度強或負擔重。
2524.definition: having great weight, or large, strong, or intense in amount or degree
2524.en: The box is too heavy to lift alone.
2524.zh: 這個箱子太重，無法獨自搬起。

2525.explanation: 名詞指由灌木形成的圍籬；動詞可指限制、保護風險或避免明確表態。
2525.definition: a row of bushes forming a boundary; also to limit risk or avoid giving a definite answer
2525.en: A tall hedge separates the two gardens.
2525.zh: 一道高樹籬分隔兩座花園。

2526.explanation: 名詞指腳後部或鞋子後跟；動詞可指船或物體向一側傾斜。
2526.definition: the back part of the foot or shoe; also for a vessel or object to lean to one side
2526.en: She injured her heel while running.

2527.explanation: 從底部到頂部的垂直距離，也可指人的身高或高處。
2527.definition: the vertical distance from bottom to top, or how tall a person or object is
2527.en: The tower reaches a height of 300 meters.
2527.zh: 這座塔的高度達三百公尺。

2528.explanation: 使程度、強度、注意力、情緒等增加。
2528.definition: to increase the degree, strength, intensity, or effect of something
2528.en: The music heightened the tension in the scene.
2528.zh: 音樂加強了場景中的緊張感。

2529.explanation: 依法或依遺囑有權繼承財產、頭銜或地位的人。
2529.definition: a person legally entitled to inherit property, a title, or a position
2529.en: The prince was named heir to the throne.
2529.zh: 王子被指定為王位繼承人。

2530.explanation: 以旋轉翼產生升力、可垂直起降的航空器。
2530.definition: an aircraft with rotating blades that can take off and land vertically
2530.en: A helicopter carried the patient to the hospital.
2530.zh: 一架直升機把病患送到醫院。

2531.explanation: 宗教中常指死後受懲罰之地，也可比喻非常痛苦或惡劣的情況。
2531.definition: in religion, a place of punishment after death; also an extremely unpleasant situation
2531.en: The trapped miners went through hell before the rescue.
2531.zh: 受困礦工在獲救前經歷了地獄般的處境。

2532.explanation: 用於見面、打電話或引起注意時的問候語，也可指這句問候本身。
2532.definition: a greeting used when meeting someone, answering a phone, or attracting attention
2532.en: She said hello to the new student.
2532.zh: 她向新同學說了聲哈囉。

2533.explanation: 戴在頭上以防止撞擊或其他危險造成傷害的保護裝備。
2533.definition: protective headgear worn to reduce injury from impact or danger
2533.en: Always wear a helmet when riding a bicycle.
2533.zh: 騎自行車時一定要戴安全帽。

2534.explanation: 動詞指使某人較容易完成事情；名詞指協助、支援或有用的事物。
2534.definition: to make it easier for someone to do something; also assistance or support
2534.en: Could you help me carry these boxes?
2534.zh: 你可以幫我搬這些箱子嗎？

2535.explanation: 能提供協助、改善情況或讓事情更容易完成。
2535.definition: giving useful assistance or making a situation easier
2535.en: Your comments were helpful and specific.
2535.zh: 你的意見既有幫助又具體。

2536.explanation: 球體的一半，也常指地球分成的北、南、東、西半球或大腦半球。
2536.definition: half of a sphere, especially one half of the Earth or the brain
2536.en: Taiwan lies in the Northern Hemisphere.

2537.explanation: 成年雌性雞，也可指某些其他鳥類的雌鳥。
2537.definition: an adult female chicken, or the female of some other birds
2537.en: The hen laid an egg this morning.
2537.zh: 這隻母雞今天早上下了一顆蛋。

2538.meaning: 因此；所以；從此處／此時起
2538.explanation: 正式副詞，常表示「因此」；也可表示從某個地點或時間起。
2538.definition: for this reason; also from this place or from this time
2538.en: The road was closed; hence, we took another route.
2538.zh: 道路封閉，因此我們改走另一條路。

2539.explanation: 葉、莖或其他部分用於調味、藥用或香氣的植物。
2539.definition: a plant whose leaves or other parts are used for flavoring, medicine, or fragrance
2539.en: Basil is a common herb in Italian cooking.
2539.zh: 羅勒是義大利料理中常見的香草。

2540.explanation: 名詞指牛、鹿等動物形成的群體；動詞指集合或驅趕動物或人群。
2540.definition: a group of animals of the same kind, especially large grazing animals; also to gather or drive them
2540.en: A herd of cattle crossed the road.

2541.explanation: 副詞表示在這個地方、到這裡；名詞可指「這個地方」或當前位置。
2541.definition: in or to this place; as a noun, this place or position
2541.en: Please wait here until your name is called.
2541.zh: 請在這裡等候，直到叫到你的名字。

2542.explanation: 由前人傳下來的文化、傳統、建築、自然資源或財產。
2542.definition: traditions, culture, property, or valued features passed down from earlier generations
2542.en: The museum protects the island's cultural heritage.
2542.zh: 這座博物館保護島上的文化遺產。

2543.explanation: 因勇氣、成就或品格而受敬佩的人，也可指故事中的主要人物。
2543.definition: a person admired for courage or achievement, or the main character of a story
2543.en: The firefighter became a local hero.
2543.zh: 這名消防員成為當地英雄。

2544.meaning: 英勇的；英雄般的；英勇行為
2544.explanation: 形容詞指展現極大勇氣或崇高精神；名詞用法可指英雄式行為或風格。
2544.definition: showing great courage or noble qualities; noun use can refer to heroic behavior or style
2544.en: Her heroic actions saved two lives.
2544.zh: 她的英勇行動拯救了兩條生命。

2545.explanation: 一種高度成癮、由嗎啡製成的非法鴉片類毒品。
2545.definition: a highly addictive illegal opioid drug made from morphine
2545.en: Heroin can cause severe addiction and death.
2545.zh: 海洛因可能造成嚴重成癮與死亡。

2546.explanation: 因不確定、擔心或不知道該怎麼做而短暫停頓。
2546.definition: to pause before doing or saying something because of uncertainty or doubt
2546.en: Do not hesitate to ask questions.
2546.zh: 不要猶豫，儘管提出問題。

2547.explanation: 因不確定或擔心而延遲行動或做決定的狀態，也可指短暫停頓。
2547.definition: a pause or delay caused by uncertainty or doubt
2547.en: After a moment of hesitation, she agreed.

2548.explanation: 形容對異性產生主要浪漫或性吸引的人，也可作名詞指這類人。
2548.definition: sexually or romantically attracted primarily to people of the opposite sex; also a person with that orientation
2548.en: The survey included heterosexual and LGBTQ+ adults.
2548.zh: 這項調查包含異性戀與 LGBTQ+ 成年人。

2549.explanation: 把人或物放在不易看見或發現的地方，或讓自己不被看見。
2549.definition: to put something where it cannot easily be seen or found, or to keep oneself out of sight
2549.en: He hid the key under a flowerpot.
2549.zh: 他把鑰匙藏在花盆下面。

2550.explanation: 依權力、重要性或地位由高到低排列的人、職位或事物系統。
2550.definition: a system in which people or things are ranked according to status, authority, or importance
2550.en: The organization has a clear hierarchy of authority.
2550.zh: 這個組織有明確的權力階層。

2551.explanation: 形容詞指位置、程度或數值高；副詞表示在高處或高程度；名詞可指高點或高水準。
2551.definition: at a great vertical position, level, amount, or degree; also at such a level or a high point
2551.en: The kite flew high above the field.
2551.zh: 風箏高高飛在田野上空。

2552.explanation: 動詞指使重要部分特別受到注意；名詞指最精彩或最重要的部分。
2552.definition: to emphasize something as important; also the most interesting or important part of something
2552.en: The report highlights three major risks.
2552.zh: 報告強調三項主要風險。

2553.meaning: 高度地；非常；受到高度評價地
2553.explanation: 表示程度很高，也可表示受到強烈肯定或評價。
2553.definition: to a great degree, or with a very favorable opinion

2554.explanation: 連接城市或地區、供車輛長距離行駛的主要公共道路。
2554.definition: a major public road connecting places and carrying long-distance traffic
2554.en: The highway connects the city to the coast.
2554.zh: 這條公路連接城市與海岸。

2555.meaning: 劫持；強行奪取；劫持事件
2555.explanation: 動詞指以武力或威脅控制車輛、飛機或系統；名詞指這種行為。
2555.definition: to seize control of a vehicle, aircraft, or system by force or threat; also such an act
2555.en: The attackers tried to hijack the plane.
2555.zh: 攻擊者企圖劫持那架飛機。

2556.meaning: 健行；徒步旅行；大幅提高
2556.explanation: 名詞或動詞指長距離步行，通常在戶外；也可指價格、費用等大幅增加。
2556.definition: a long walk, especially outdoors, or to take such a walk; also a sharp increase in a price or rate
2556.en: We took a two-hour hike through the forest.
2556.zh: 我們在森林裡健行了兩小時。

2557.explanation: 自然形成、比山低且通常坡度較緩的高地。
2557.definition: a naturally raised area of land, generally lower and less steep than a mountain
2557.en: The village sits on a steep hill.
2557.zh: 村莊坐落在一座陡峭的小山上。

2558.explanation: 名詞指幫助理解或猜測的少量資訊；動詞指間接表達或提供提示。
2558.definition: a small or indirect piece of information that helps someone understand something; also to suggest indirectly
2558.en: Her smile gave me a hint that she knew.
2558.zh: 她的微笑給了我一個線索，顯示她知道這件事。

2559.explanation: 身體兩側大腿上端與骨盆相接的部位。
2559.definition: either side of the body where the upper leg joins the pelvis
2559.en: He injured his hip during the game.
2559.zh: 他在比賽中傷到了髖部。

2560.explanation: 生活在非洲河流與湖泊附近的大型半水生哺乳動物，常簡稱 hippo。
2560.definition: a very large semiaquatic African mammal that lives in and near rivers and lakes
2560.en: The hippo stayed in the water during the hottest hours.
2560.zh: 天氣最熱的時候，河馬待在水裡。

2561.explanation: 專門研究、撰寫或解釋歷史的人。
2561.definition: a person who specializes in studying, writing about, or interpreting history
2561.en: The historian compared letters from several archives.
2561.zh: 這位歷史學家比較了數個檔案館的書信。

2562.explanation: 因重要性或影響而值得被歷史記住的。
2562.definition: important enough in history to be remembered for its lasting significance
2562.en: The treaty marked a historic change in regional relations.
2562.zh: 這項條約標誌著區域關係的歷史性變化。

2563.explanation: 與歷史、過去事件或歷史研究與記錄有關的。
2563.definition: connected with history, past events, or the study and record of the past
2563.en: The class examined historical maps of the harbor.
2563.zh: 全班研究了這座港口的歷史地圖。

2564.explanation: 過去發生的事件，以及對這些事件的研究或記錄。
2564.definition: past events considered together, or the study and record of those events
2564.en: She studied the history of Taiwan's railways.
2564.zh: 她研究臺灣鐵路的歷史。

2565.explanation: 以力量碰到、打到或撞上人或物。
2565.definition: to strike or come into forceful contact with a person or thing
2565.en: The ball hit the fence and bounced back.
2565.zh: 球撞上圍欄後彈了回來。

2565.explanation: 一次打擊或命中，也可指廣受歡迎的作品。
2565.definition: an act of striking or reaching a target, or a highly successful work
2565.en: The singer's new song became an international hit.
2565.zh: 這位歌手的新歌成為國際熱門作品。

2566.explanation: 蜜蜂群居的巢，或供蜜蜂生活的人工容器。
2566.definition: a nest or man-made container in which a colony of bees lives
2566.en: Bees returned to the hive before the rain began.
2566.zh: 下雨前，蜜蜂回到了蜂巢。

2567.explanation: 聲音粗啞、低沉或刺耳，常因喉嚨受刺激或過度用聲。
2567.definition: having a rough or harsh voice, often because the throat is strained or irritated
2567.en: His voice sounded hoarse after the long speech.
2567.zh: 長時間演講後，他的聲音聽起來很沙啞。

2568.explanation: 在空閒時間為了樂趣而規律從事的活動。
2568.definition: an activity regularly done for pleasure during one's free time
2568.en: Photography became her favorite hobby in high school.
2568.zh: 攝影成了她高中時最喜歡的嗜好。

2569.explanation: 兩隊用球棍把球或冰球送向對方球門的運動；美式英語中單說 hockey 常指冰上曲棍球。
2569.definition: a team sport played with sticks and a ball or puck; in American English, hockey often refers to ice hockey
2569.en: They practice hockey at the rink every Saturday.
2569.zh: 他們每週六都在冰場練習曲棍球。

2570.explanation: 用手或手臂拿住、支撐某物，或使某物維持在特定位置或狀態。
2570.definition: to keep or support something in the hands or arms, or maintain it in a particular position or state
2570.en: Please hold the ladder steady while I climb.
2570.zh: 我爬上去時，請把梯子扶穩。

2570.explanation: 抓住某物的動作或力量，也可指對某事的控制。
2570.definition: a grip on something, or power and control over a situation
2570.en: Keep a firm hold on the railing.

2571.explanation: 擁有或持有某物的人，或用來承載、固定或容納物品的器具。
2571.definition: a person who possesses something, or a device that supports, contains, or keeps an object in place
2571.en: Each ticket holder must show identification at the gate.
2571.zh: 每位持票人都必須在入口出示身分證明。

2572.explanation: 物體中或表面上的空洞、開口或凹陷處。
2572.definition: an empty space, opening, or cavity in or through something
2572.en: Rainwater filled a deep hole in the road.
2572.zh: 雨水積滿了路上的一個深洞。

2573.explanation: 因宗教、國家紀念或其他特定原因而不用上班或上課、或特別慶祝的一天。
2573.definition: a day set aside for celebration or rest, often for a religious or national occasion
2573.en: The library is closed for the national holiday.
2573.zh: 圖書館因國定假日而休館。

2574.explanation: 內部有空間而不是實心，或表面向內凹陷。
2574.definition: having an empty space inside rather than being solid, or curving inward
2574.en: The old tree is hollow inside.
2574.zh: 這棵老樹的內部是空心的。

2574.explanation: 地面上的低窪處或小山谷。
2574.definition: a low area in the ground or a small valley
2574.en: Mist settled in the hollow before sunrise.
2574.zh: 日出前霧氣沉積在低窪處。

2574.explanation: 移除內部材料，使某物變空或形成凹陷。
2574.definition: to remove material from inside something so that it becomes empty or indented
2574.en: Water had hollowed the stone over many years.
2574.zh: 多年來，流水已把石頭侵蝕出凹洞。

2575.explanation: 與神、宗教或宗教用途相關，因此被視為神聖或值得敬重的。
2575.definition: connected with God, religion, or a sacred purpose and therefore regarded with special reverence
2575.en: Visitors lowered their voices near the holy site.
2575.zh: 遊客在聖地附近放低了音量。

2576.explanation: 一個人居住的地方，或使其感到歸屬的城鎮、地區或國家。
2576.definition: the place where a person lives, or a place where they feel they belong
2576.en: After years abroad, the island still felt like home.
2576.zh: 在海外多年後，那座島對她而言仍像家一樣。

2576.explanation: 在自己的住處，或朝自己的住處。
2576.definition: at or toward the place where one lives
2576.en: We stayed home because of the storm.
2576.zh: 因為暴風雨，我們待在家裡。

2576.explanation: 準確朝向並返回某處或某個目標。
2576.definition: to move or be directed accurately toward a place or target
2576.en: The rescue vessel homed in on the emergency signal.
2576.zh: 救援船循著緊急訊號鎖定目標前進。

2576.explanation: 與住家、家庭或本國相關的。
2576.definition: connected with one's household, family, or own country
2576.en: The team won its first home game of the season.
2576.zh: 這支球隊贏得本季第一場主場比賽。

2577.explanation: 一個人出生、成長、居住或視為本國的國家或地區。
2577.definition: the country or region regarded as one's native land or home
2577.en: She returned to her homeland after many years abroad.
2577.zh: 她旅居海外多年後回到了祖國。

2578.explanation: 離家在外時因思念家人、住處或熟悉環境而感到難過。
2578.definition: unhappy because one is away from home and misses familiar people or surroundings
2578.en: He felt homesick during his first month overseas.
2578.zh: 他在海外的第一個月很想家。

2579.explanation: 一個人出生、長大或長期居住而視為家鄉的城鎮或地方。
2579.definition: the town or place where a person was born, grew up, or considers home
2579.en: She opened a small bakery in her hometown.
2579.zh: 她在家鄉開了一間小麵包店。

2580.explanation: 老師指定學生在課堂之外完成的學習工作。
2580.definition: schoolwork that a teacher assigns to be completed outside class
2580.en: I finished my math homework before dinner.
2580.zh: 我在晚餐前寫完了數學作業。

2581.meaning: 同性戀的；與同性吸引有關的
2581.explanation: 描述對同性產生情感或性吸引，或與同性戀相關。
2581.definition: relating to romantic or sexual attraction toward people of the same sex, or to homosexuality
2581.en: The report discussed discrimination affecting homosexual people.
2581.zh: 這份報告討論了影響同性戀者的歧視問題。

2581.explanation: 對同性具有情感或性吸引的人；作名詞時在部分語境可能顯得過時或不夠尊重。
2581.definition: a person who is emotionally or sexually attracted to people of the same sex
2581.en: Many style guides prefer the noun phrase gay person to homosexual.
2581.zh: 許多寫作指南較建議使用「gay person」而非以 homosexual 作名詞。

2582.explanation: 說真話、不欺騙，或坦率表達真實想法。
2582.definition: truthful and sincere, without intending to deceive
2582.en: Please give me an honest answer.
2582.zh: 請給我一個誠實的答案。

2583.explanation: 說真話並以正直、真誠方式行事的品質。
2583.definition: the quality of being truthful, sincere, and morally straightforward
2583.en: Her honesty earned the team's trust.
2583.zh: 她的誠實贏得了團隊的信任。

2584.explanation: 蜜蜂以花蜜製成的甜而黏稠的食物。
2584.definition: a sweet, thick food produced by bees from flower nectar
2584.en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into the tea.
2584.zh: 她在茶裡攪入一匙蜂蜜。

2585.explanation: 新婚伴侶在結婚後一起度過的旅行或假期。
2585.definition: a trip or vacation taken together by people who have recently married
2585.en: The couple spent their honeymoon in Hokkaido.
2585.zh: 這對夫妻在北海道度蜜月。

2585.definition: to take a trip or vacation together after getting married
2585.en: They honeymooned in Hualien after the wedding.
2585.zh: 他們婚後到花蓮度蜜月。

2586.explanation: 因品格、成就或地位而受到的高度尊敬、肯定或榮耀。
2586.definition: high respect, recognition, or distinction given for character, achievement, or status
2586.en: It was an honor to represent the school.
2586.zh: 能代表學校是一項榮譽。

2586.explanation: 對某人表示高度尊重，或履行承諾與義務。
2586.definition: to show great respect for someone, or to fulfill a promise or obligation
2586.en: The ceremony honors volunteers who serve the community.
2586.zh: 這場典禮表揚服務社區的志工。

2587.explanation: 因正直、良好品格或值得肯定的行為而值得尊敬。
2587.definition: deserving respect because of integrity, good character, or worthy conduct
2587.en: Returning the lost wallet was an honorable act.
2587.zh: 歸還遺失的錢包是值得尊敬的行為。

2588.explanation: 作為榮譽授予，而不一定具有一般職位的職責、資格或報酬。
2588.definition: given as an honor, often without the usual duties, qualifications, or payment of the position
2588.en: The university awarded her an honorary degree.
2588.zh: 這所大學授予她名譽學位。

2589.explanation: 彎曲的器具或部件，用來抓住、懸掛、固定或拉住物品。
2589.definition: a curved device or part used for catching, hanging, fastening, or pulling something
2589.en: Hang the coat on the hook by the door.
2589.zh: 把外套掛在門邊的掛鉤上。

2589.explanation: 用鉤子固定某物，或把物件接在一起。
2589.definition: to fasten something with a hook or connect one thing to another
2589.en: Hook the safety rope to your belt before climbing.
2589.zh: 攀爬前把安全繩鉤在腰帶上。

2590.explanation: 以快速、輕巧的跳躍移動，常指單腳跳或連續短跳。
2590.definition: to move with a quick light jump or a series of short jumps, often on one foot
2590.en: The rabbit hopped across the path and disappeared into the grass.
2590.zh: 那隻兔子跳過小徑後消失在草叢裡。

2590.explanation: 一次短跳，也可指短距離的旅程。
2590.definition: a short jump on one foot or a short trip
2590.en: The island is only a short hop from the coast.
2590.zh: 那座島離海岸只有一小段航程。

2591.explanation: 想要某件事發生或成真，並認為它有可能實現。
2591.definition: to want something to happen or be true and believe that it is possible
2591.en: I hope the rain stops before the game begins.
2591.zh: 我希望比賽開始前雨會停。

2591.explanation: 相信好事可能發生的感受或期待。
2591.definition: a feeling or expectation that something good may happen
2591.en: There is still hope that the missing hikers will be found.
2591.zh: 失蹤的登山客仍有被找到的希望。

2592.explanation: 對未來結果抱持信心，或顯示成功有合理可能性。
2592.definition: feeling confident about a desired outcome, or giving good reason to expect success
2592.en: The team is hopeful that the repairs will be finished tomorrow.
2592.zh: 團隊希望維修工作明天能完成。

2593.explanation: 天空與地面或海面看似相接的遠方界線；也可比喻知識、經驗或可能性的範圍。
2593.definition: the distant line where the earth or sea seems to meet the sky; also the limit of one's knowledge or possibilities
2593.en: Dark clouds were gathering along the horizon.
2593.zh: 烏雲正沿著地平線聚集。

2594.explanation: 與地平線平行，或從一側向另一側延伸而非上下延伸。
2594.definition: parallel to the horizon or extending from side to side rather than up and down
2594.en: Draw a horizontal line across the middle of the page.
2594.zh: 在頁面中央畫一條水平線。

2594.explanation: 與地平線平行的線或平面。
2594.definition: a line or plane that is parallel to the horizon
2594.en: Draw a horizontal across the center of the page.
2594.zh: 在頁面中央畫一條水平線。

2595.explanation: 由活細胞或組織產生並在體內傳遞訊號、調節特定生理活動的化學物質。
2595.definition: a chemical messenger made by living cells that travels through the body and regulates particular biological activities
2595.en: The doctor measured the hormone level in her blood.
2595.zh: 醫師測量了她血液中的荷爾蒙濃度。

2596.explanation: 動物頭上的硬角；也可指用來發出訊號或音樂的號角、喇叭或汽車鳴笛裝置。
2596.definition: a hard growth on an animal's head, or a device or instrument that produces a loud signal or musical sound
2596.en: The driver sounded the horn to warn the cyclist.
2596.zh: 駕駛按喇叭提醒那名騎自行車的人。

2597.meaning: 可怕的；極糟的；令人不舒服的
2597.explanation: 令人感到強烈害怕、厭惡或不愉快；也可泛指非常差勁。
2597.definition: causing strong fear or disgust, or simply being extremely bad or unpleasant
2597.en: The milk smelled horrible, so we threw it away.
2597.zh: 牛奶聞起來很難聞，所以我們把它丟掉了。

2598.meaning: 使感到恐怖；使震驚或厭惡
2598.explanation: 使某人產生強烈的恐懼、震驚或厭惡反應。
2598.definition: to make someone feel intense horror, shock, or disgust
2598.en: The condition of the abandoned building horrified the inspectors.
2598.zh: 那棟廢棄建築的狀況讓檢查人員感到震驚。

2599.explanation: 面對極度令人不安或可怕事物時產生的強烈恐懼、震驚或厭惡感。
2599.definition: a powerful feeling of fear, dread, shock, or revulsion caused by something deeply disturbing
2599.en: She watched in horror as the vase fell from the shelf.
2599.zh: 她驚恐地看著花瓶從架子上掉下來。

2600.explanation: 大型四足家畜，常供騎乘、競賽、運輸或拉載工作。
2600.definition: a large four-legged domesticated animal commonly kept for riding, racing, pulling loads, or other work
2600.en: The children watched a horse run across the field.
2600.zh: 孩子們看著一匹馬跑過田野。

2601.explanation: 可彎曲的管子，用來把水、其他液體或氣體輸送到需要的位置。
2601.definition: a flexible tube used to carry water, another liquid, or gas to a desired place
2601.en: She connected the garden hose to the outdoor faucet.
2601.zh: 她把花園水管接到戶外水龍頭上。

2601.explanation: 用水管噴水清洗或澆灌某物。
2601.definition: to wash, spray, or water something with a hose
2601.en: Please hose the mud off the bicycles.
2601.zh: 請用水管把自行車上的泥沖掉。

2602.explanation: 熱情友善地接待客人；也可指環境適合生存、成長或發展。
2602.definition: warm and generous toward guests, or providing conditions that are favorable for living or growth
2602.en: The family was hospitable to every guest who arrived.
2602.zh: 這家人熱情招待每一位到訪的客人。

2603.explanation: 為生病或受傷的人提供醫療、手術與照護的機構。
2603.definition: an institution where sick or injured people receive medical treatment, surgery, and care
2603.en: The injured cyclist was taken to the hospital for treatment.
2603.zh: 受傷的騎士被送到醫院接受治療。

2604.meaning: 好客；款待；旅宿餐飲服務業
2604.explanation: 友善慷慨地接待客人的行為或態度；也可指為旅客提供住宿、餐飲等服務的產業。
2604.definition: the friendly and generous treatment of guests, or the business of providing lodging, food, and related services to visitors
2604.countability: uncountable; plural possible in specific uses
2604.en: The visitors thanked their hosts for their warm hospitality.
2604.zh: 訪客感謝主人熱情的款待。

2605.explanation: 將某人送入或收治進醫院，作為病人接受治療或觀察。
2605.definition: to place or admit someone in a hospital as a patient for medical care or observation
2605.en: The doctor decided to hospitalize the patient overnight for observation.
2605.zh: 醫師決定讓病人住院一晚接受觀察。

2606.explanation: 接待並招待客人的人，或主持活動、節目的人；hostess 是傳統上指女性的形式。
2606.definition: a person who receives and entertains guests or presents an event or program; hostess is the traditional female form
2606.en: Our host welcomed the guests and introduced the first speaker.
2606.zh: 主人歡迎賓客，並介紹第一位講者。

2607.explanation: 被拘留或扣押，以迫使他人或某個團體答應要求的人。
2607.definition: a person kept captive so that another person or group can be forced to meet demands
2607.en: Negotiators worked to secure the safe release of the hostage.
2607.zh: 談判人員努力促成人質安全獲釋。

2608.explanation: 供旅客短期低價住宿的旅舍，常有共用房間、廚房或其他設施。
2608.definition: an inexpensive place where travelers can stay for a short time, often using shared rooms or facilities
2608.en: We booked a hostel near the station to save money.
2608.zh: 我們訂了車站附近的青年旅館來省錢。

2609.meaning: 敵對的；不友善的；不利的
2609.explanation: 表現強烈反對、敵意或攻擊性的；也可指使事情難以成功或生存的不利環境。
2609.definition: unfriendly, aggressive, or strongly opposed, or describing conditions that make success or survival difficult
2609.en: The proposal received a hostile response from several committee members.
2609.zh: 這項提案遭到幾位委員敵對的回應。

2610.explanation: 對人、團體或想法表現出的不友善、敵對或強烈反對；複數 hostilities 可指公開衝突或交戰。
2610.definition: unfriendly or antagonistic feeling or behavior toward someone or something; also strong opposition
2610.en: Persistent hostility between the neighbors made any agreement impossible.
2610.zh: 鄰居間持續的敵意使任何協議都無法達成。

2611.explanation: 溫度高；食物味道辛辣；也可指受歡迎或熱門。
2611.definition: having a high temperature; also spicy in taste or currently very popular
2611.en: Be careful—the metal handle is still hot.
2611.zh: 小心，那個金屬把手還很燙。

2612.explanation: 提供旅客付費住宿，通常也提供餐飲或其他服務的場所。
2612.definition: a place that provides paid lodging and usually other services for travelers
2612.en: The conference hotel is within walking distance of the station.
2612.zh: 會議飯店離車站很近，步行即可抵達。

2613.explanation: 六十分鐘的時間單位；也可指一天中的某個整點時段。
2613.definition: a period of sixty minutes, or a particular time measured by the clock
2613.en: The repair took less than an hour.
2613.zh: 這次維修花了不到一個小時。

2614.meaning: 每小時的；按小時計算的
2614.explanation: 每隔一小時發生一次，或依工作、費用等按小時計算的。
2614.definition: happening every hour, or calculated according to each hour of time or work
2614.en: The weather service issues hourly updates during a typhoon.
2614.zh: 颱風期間，氣象單位每小時發布一次最新資訊。

2614.explanation: 以每小時一次的頻率，或按每小時計算。
2614.definition: once every hour or at a rate calculated by the hour
2614.en: The shuttle runs hourly from the main station.
2614.zh: 接駁車每小時從中央車站發車一次。

2615.explanation: 供人居住的建築，通常是一戶家庭或住戶的住所。
2615.definition: a building in which people live, especially as a home for one household
2615.en: They bought a small house near the elementary school.
2615.zh: 他們在小學附近買了一棟小房子。

2615.explanation: 提供空間讓人居住、工作，或讓物品存放。
2615.definition: to provide space for people to live or work, or for things to be kept
2615.en: The new building will house the city archive.
2615.zh: 新大樓將用來存放市立檔案。

2616.explanation: 共同住在一個住宅中的人，常視為一個家庭或生活單位。
2616.definition: the people who live together in one home, considered as a unit
2616.en: The survey asks how much each household spends on electricity.
2616.zh: 這份調查詢問每戶家庭的電費支出。

2617.explanation: 受僱負責住宅、旅館等清潔與日常家務的人。
2617.definition: a person employed to clean and manage routine domestic work in a home or hotel
2617.en: The housekeeper prepared the guest room before noon.
2617.zh: 房務人員在中午前整理好客房。

2618.explanation: 主要在家中料理家務、通常沒有外部全職工作的已婚女性。
2618.definition: a married woman whose main work is managing her home and household
2618.en: The biography describes how a housewife became a community leader.
2618.zh: 這本傳記描述一位家庭主婦如何成為社區領袖。

2619.explanation: 維持家庭所做的清潔、整理、洗衣等工作。
2619.definition: work such as cleaning and washing that is done to maintain a home
2619.en: Everyone in the family shares the housework.
2619.zh: 家中每個人都分擔家務。

2620.explanation: 供人居住的房屋或公寓，亦可泛指提供住宅的制度或供給。
2620.definition: houses or apartments provided for people to live in; accommodation collectively
2620.en: Affordable housing remains scarce in the city center.
2620.zh: 市中心的可負擔住宅仍然不足。

2621.explanation: 停留在空中同一位置附近，或在某人、某地附近逗留。
2621.definition: to remain in the air near one place, or to stay close to a person or place
2621.en: A helicopter hovered above the flooded village.
2621.zh: 一架直升機在淹水的村莊上空盤旋。

2621.explanation: 停留在空中或某處附近的狀態。
2621.definition: an act or state of remaining in the air or near one place
2621.en: The drone maintained a steady hover above the field.
2621.zh: 無人機在田野上方穩定盤旋。

2622.explanation: 用來詢問方式、狀態或程度，也可引導表示方式的子句。
2622.definition: in what way or by what means; also used to ask about condition or degree
2622.en: Please show me how this machine works.
2622.zh: 請示範給我看這台機器如何運作。

2623.explanation: 用來引出與前述內容形成對比的陳述；亦可表示「不論以何種方式」。
2623.definition: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with what was said before; also in whatever way
2623.en: The task was difficult; however, the team finished it on time.
2623.zh: 這項任務很困難；然而，團隊仍準時完成了。

2624.meaning: 嚎叫聲；長而響亮的叫聲
2624.explanation: 人或動物發出的長而響亮的叫聲，尤指狼等的長嚎。
2624.definition: a long, loud cry, especially one made by a wolf or by a person in strong emotion
2624.en: We heard the howl of a wolf beyond the trees.
2624.zh: 我們聽見樹林外傳來狼的嚎叫聲。

2624.explanation: 發出長而響亮的叫聲，常表示痛苦、憤怒或興奮。
2624.definition: to make a long, loud cry that may express pain, anger, or excitement
2624.en: The wolves began to howl after dark.

2625.explanation: 用手臂抱住某人或某物的動作，通常用來表達感情。
2625.definition: an act of putting the arms around someone or something and holding closely
2625.en: Her father welcomed her with a long hug.
2625.zh: 她父親用一個長久的擁抱歡迎她。

2625.explanation: 用雙臂環抱某人或某物。
2625.definition: to put one's arms around someone or something and hold them closely
2625.en: She hugged her brother before he left.
2625.zh: 弟弟離開前，她抱了抱他。

2626.explanation: 尺寸、數量或程度非常大。
2626.definition: extremely large in size, amount, or degree
2626.en: A huge wave struck the side of the boat.

2627.explanation: 閉著嘴唱出曲調，或機器、昆蟲等持續發出低沉聲響。
2627.definition: to sing a tune with the lips closed, or to make a steady low continuous sound
2627.en: The refrigerator began to hum quietly in the kitchen.
2627.zh: 冰箱開始在廚房裡發出低沉的嗡嗡聲。

2628.explanation: 與人或整個人類有關的；具有人的特徵。
2628.definition: relating to people or to the human species
2628.en: Trust is a basic human need.
2628.zh: 信任是人類的基本需求。

2628.explanation: 一個人，或作為一個物種的人類成員。
2628.definition: a person or a member of the human species
2628.en: Every human needs clean water to survive.
2628.zh: 每個人都需要乾淨的水才能生存。

2629.explanation: 全體人類；也可指人的特質，尤其是同情與仁慈。
2629.definition: people collectively; also human nature or the quality of being compassionate
2629.en: The doctor treated every patient with patience and humanity.
2629.zh: 醫師以耐心與仁愛對待每位病人。

2630.explanation: 不自大、不誇耀自己的重要性；也可形容地位或條件普通。
2630.definition: not proud or boastful about your importance; also modest in rank or circumstances
2630.en: He remained humble despite receiving the national award.
2630.zh: 儘管獲得國家級獎項，他依然保持謙遜。

2631.explanation: 空氣中含有大量水氣，常使人感到悶熱。
2631.definition: containing a high amount of moisture in the air, often making conditions feel warm and damp
2631.en: The air becomes hot and humid before the afternoon rain.
2631.zh: 午後下雨前，空氣會變得炎熱潮濕。

2632.explanation: 空氣中水蒸氣含量的程度。
2632.definition: the amount or degree of water vapor present in the air
2632.en: The museum controls humidity to protect its paintings.
2632.zh: 博物館控制濕度以保護畫作。

2633.explanation: 使某人感到非常羞恥、難堪或失去尊嚴。
2633.definition: to make someone feel deeply ashamed, embarrassed, or deprived of dignity
2633.en: No student should be humiliated for asking a question.
2633.zh: 不應有學生因提問而受到羞辱。

2634.explanation: 看出或表達有趣、可笑事物的能力或特質。
2634.definition: the quality or ability to notice, express, or appreciate what is funny
2634.en: His gentle humor eased the tension in the room.
2634.zh: 他溫和的幽默緩和了房間裡的緊張氣氛。

2635.explanation: 有趣而使人發笑，或具有幽默感。
2635.definition: funny or amusing, or showing a good sense of humor
2635.en: The article offers a humorous account of life in a busy newsroom.
2635.zh: 這篇文章以幽默方式描述繁忙新聞編輯室的生活。

2636.explanation: 沒有明確證據卻產生、但自己覺得可能正確的強烈感覺。
2636.definition: a strong feeling that something is true or likely without clear evidence
2636.en: My hunch was right: the documents were in the blue folder.
2636.zh: 我的直覺沒錯：文件就在藍色資料夾裡。

2636.explanation: 使背部或身體向上彎曲。
2636.definition: to bend one's back or body upward into a rounded shape
2636.en: He hunched over the desk to read the small print.
2636.zh: 他彎身趴在桌前閱讀小字。

2637.explanation: 數字100，或總數為一百的數量。
2637.definition: the number 100 or a total quantity of one hundred
2637.en: More than a hundred students joined the cleanup.
2637.zh: 超過一百名學生參加了清掃活動。

2637.en: The library received a hundred new books.
2637.zh: 圖書館收到了一百本新書。

2638.explanation: 因缺乏食物而想吃東西的感覺；也可指強烈渴望。
2638.definition: the uncomfortable need for food; also a strong desire for something
2638.en: The relief program provides meals to children facing hunger.
2638.zh: 這項救助計畫為面臨飢餓的兒童提供餐食。

2639.explanation: 需要或想吃食物；亦可比喻非常渴望某事物。
2639.definition: needing or wanting food; also having a strong desire for something
2639.en: The hikers were hungry after the long climb.
2639.zh: 登山客走完漫長上坡後都餓了。

2640.explanation: 追蹤野生動物以捕捉或獵取；也可指仔細尋找某人或某物。
2640.definition: to pursue animals in order to catch them, or to search carefully for a person or thing
2640.en: Volunteers are hunting for clues about the lost dog.
2640.zh: 志工正在搜尋那隻走失狗的線索。

2640.explanation: 為尋找人、物或獵物而進行的一段搜尋或追捕行動。
2640.definition: an act or period of searching for a person, thing, or animal
2640.en: The hunt for the missing painting lasted several months.
2640.zh: 尋找失蹤畫作的行動持續了數月。

2641.explanation: 打獵的人；亦可指尋找特定事物的人。
2641.definition: a person who hunts animals, or someone who searches for a particular thing
2641.en: The hunter identified the animal by its tracks.
2641.zh: 獵人根據足跡辨認出那隻動物。

2642.explanation: 競賽中需跨越的欄架，也可指需要克服的困難或障礙。
2642.definition: a barrier jumped in a race, or a difficulty that must be overcome
2642.en: Obtaining enough funding was the project's final hurdle.
2642.zh: 取得足夠資金是這項計畫的最後一道障礙。

2642.explanation: 跑動時跨過欄架或其他障礙；也可延伸指克服困難。
2642.definition: to jump over a barrier while moving, or to overcome an obstacle or difficulty
2642.en: The athlete hurdled the barrier and kept running.
2642.zh: 那名運動員跨過欄架後繼續奔跑。

2643.explanation: 形成於熱帶海洋、伴隨強風與暴雨的猛烈旋轉風暴。
2643.definition: a powerful rotating tropical storm with very strong winds and heavy rain
2643.en: The hurricane damaged homes along the coast.
2643.zh: 颶風損壞了沿海地區的房屋。

2644.explanation: 快速移動或行動，通常因時間不足或想盡快完成某事。
2644.definition: to move or act quickly because time is limited or something needs to be done soon
2644.en: Hurry, or we will miss the last bus.
2644.zh: 快一點，否則我們會錯過末班公車。

2644.explanation: 因時間有限而快速行動的狀態，或急著完成某事的情況。
2644.definition: a state of acting or moving quickly because there is little time
2644.en: In her hurry to leave, she forgot to lock the door.

2645.explanation: 造成身體疼痛或傷害，也可使人情感受傷或對某事造成不良影響。
2645.definition: to cause physical pain or injury, emotional distress, or damage to someone or something
2645.en: I hurt my shoulder while lifting the heavy box.
2645.zh: 我抬那個重箱子時傷到了肩膀。

2645.explanation: 身體或情感上的疼痛、受傷感或損害。
2645.definition: physical or emotional pain, injury, or harm
2645.en: His apology did little to ease the hurt caused by his words.
2645.zh: 他的道歉幾乎無法減輕那些話造成的傷痛。

2646.explanation: 與某人結婚的男性配偶。
2646.definition: a man who is married to someone; a male spouse
2646.en: Her husband teaches science at a local high school.
2646.zh: 她的丈夫在當地高中教自然科學。

2647.explanation: 完全沒有聲音，或原本有聲音的地方突然安靜下來的狀態。
2647.definition: a state or moment of silence, especially when a place suddenly becomes quiet
2647.en: A respectful hush filled the hall before the ceremony began.
2647.zh: 典禮開始前，大廳裡一片莊重的寂靜。

2647.explanation: 使某人停止說話或使聲音降低，也可指自己變得安靜。
2647.definition: to make someone or something quiet, or to become quiet
2647.en: The teacher raised a hand to hush the noisy class.
2647.zh: 老師舉起手，示意吵鬧的班級安靜。

2648.explanation: 簡陋、小型的房屋或遮蔽物。
2648.definition: a small, simple building or shelter, often made from basic materials
2648.en: The shepherd rested in a stone hut during the storm.
2648.zh: 暴風雨期間，牧羊人在石屋裡休息。

2649.explanation: 由兩種不同類型、系統、來源或技術結合而成的。
2649.definition: formed by combining two different types, systems, sources, or technologies
2649.en: The school uses a hybrid schedule with both online and classroom lessons.
2649.zh: 學校採用結合線上與實體課程的混合式課表。

2649.explanation: 由兩種不同來源、類型或系統結合而成的人、事物、生物或技術。
2649.definition: a person, thing, organism, or system produced by combining two different sources or types
2649.en: The new bus is a hybrid powered by diesel and electricity.
2649.zh: 這輛新公車是以柴油與電力驅動的混合動力車。

2650.explanation: 化學元素氫，符號H，是最輕的元素。
2650.definition: the chemical element hydrogen, symbol H, the lightest element
2650.en: Hydrogen can be used to store energy.

2651.explanation: 為維持健康、防止疾病而保持清潔的原則與做法。
2651.definition: practices and conditions of cleanliness intended to preserve health and prevent disease
2651.en: Proper kitchen hygiene reduces the risk of food poisoning.
2651.zh: 良好的廚房衛生可降低食物中毒的風險。

2652.explanation: 聲稱遵守某些道德標準，但自身行為與所宣稱標準不一致的人。
2652.definition: a person who claims moral standards or beliefs that their own behavior does not follow
2652.en: She called him a hypocrite because he ignored the rules he promoted.
2652.zh: 她稱他為偽君子，因為他無視自己所倡導的規則。

2653.explanation: 為解釋現象而提出、可透過證據或研究檢驗的暫定說法。
2653.definition: a proposed explanation or assumption that can be tested against evidence
2653.en: The experiment produced evidence that supported the hypothesis.
2653.zh: 實驗產生了支持這項假說的證據。

2654.explanation: 第一人稱單數代名詞及其受格、所有格與反身形式，用來指說話者本人。
2654.definition: the first-person singular pronoun and its object, possessive, and reflexive forms, referring to the speaker
2654.en: I checked my calendar before accepting the invitation.
2654.zh: 我在接受邀請前查看了自己的行事曆。

2655.explanation: 水在低溫下凍結形成的固體。
2655.definition: water in its solid frozen state
2655.en: The waiter added ice to the glass.
2655.zh: 服務生在杯子裡加了冰。

2656.explanation: 從冰河或冰棚分離、漂浮在海上的巨大冰塊。
2656.definition: a very large mass of ice floating in the sea after breaking away from a glacier or ice shelf
2656.en: Only the top of the iceberg was visible above the sea.
2656.zh: 海面上只看得到冰山的頂端。

2657.explanation: 電腦介面中的小圖像；也可指廣受認可、具有代表性的人或事物。
2657.definition: a small graphical symbol on a screen; also a widely recognized person or thing regarded as representative
2657.en: Select the printer icon to open the print menu.
2657.zh: 選取印表機圖示以開啟列印選單。

2658.explanation: 覆有冰或非常寒冷；也可形容態度極為冷淡。
2658.definition: covered with ice or extremely cold; also emotionally very cold or unfriendly
2658.en: Drivers were warned about icy conditions on the mountain road.
2658.zh: 駕駛人獲警告山路可能有結冰狀況。

2659.explanation: 心中形成的想法、計畫、意見或對某事的概念。
2659.definition: a thought, plan, opinion, or concept formed in the mind
2659.en: Her idea could help the school save water.
2659.zh: 她的想法可以幫助學校節約用水。

2660.explanation: 完全適合某個目的、情況或人的；也可指符合心中最佳標準的。
2660.definition: exactly suitable for a particular purpose or situation, or matching the best standard one can imagine
2660.en: The library's quiet rooms are ideal for focused study.
2660.zh: 圖書館安靜的房間非常適合專心讀書。

2660.explanation: 被視為完美、優良或值得追求的標準、原則或目標。
2660.definition: a standard, principle, or goal regarded as excellent and worth trying to achieve
2660.en: Equal access to education remains an important ideal.
2660.zh: 教育機會平等仍是一項重要理想。

2661.meaning: 完全相同的；一模一樣的
2661.explanation: 在重要細節上沒有差異，或實質上完全相同。
2661.definition: the same in all important details, with no meaningful difference between the things compared
2661.en: The two keys look identical, but only one opens this door.
2661.zh: 這兩把鑰匙看起來完全相同，但只有一把能開這扇門。

2662.explanation: 確認某人或某物身分的行為或結果；也可指用來證明身分的文件或證據。
2662.definition: the act of establishing who or what someone or something is, or evidence used to prove identity
2662.en: Visitors must show identification before entering the secure area.
2662.zh: 訪客進入管制區前必須出示身分證明。

2663.explanation: 根據特徵、證據或資訊確認某人或某物是誰或是什麼。
2663.definition: to recognize or establish who or what a person or thing is from available features or evidence
2663.en: Scientists identified the bacteria from its genetic sequence.
2663.zh: 科學家根據基因序列辨認出這種細菌。

2664.explanation: 使一個人或事物成為其本身、並可與其他人或事物區別的身分或特徵。
2664.definition: the qualities, characteristics, or facts that make a person or thing who or what they are
2664.en: Moving abroad made her think more deeply about her cultural identity.
2664.zh: 搬到國外後，她更深入思考自己的文化認同。

2665.explanation: 一套用來解釋社會、政治或經濟並引導行動的思想、信念與原則。
2665.definition: a system of ideas and beliefs that explains society or politics and guides how people or groups act
2665.en: The party's economic policy reflects a market-oriented ideology.
2665.zh: 該政黨的經濟政策反映市場導向的意識形態。

2666.explanation: 一組固定用語，其整體意思通常不能只由各個單字的字面意思直接推得。
2666.definition: a fixed expression whose overall meaning is not usually clear from the literal meanings of its individual words
2666.en: That idiom means something different from the literal meanings of its words.
2666.zh: 那個慣用語的意思與其中各字的字面意思不同。

2667.explanation: 用來侮辱被認為愚蠢或做出愚蠢行為的人；現代使用通常帶有強烈貶義。
2667.definition: an insulting word for a person considered very foolish or behaving in a foolish way
2667.en: Calling someone an idiot can be deeply insulting.
2667.zh: 稱別人為笨蛋可能非常侮辱人。

2668.explanation: 沒有被使用、運作或投入工作；也可指人暫時沒有事情做。
2668.definition: not being used, working, or active, or having no work or activity to do
2668.en: Several machines stood idle during the maintenance shutdown.
2668.zh: 維修停機期間有幾台機器處於閒置狀態。

2668.explanation: 使機器在沒有實際工作的情況下低速運轉，或在一段時間內無所事事。
2668.definition: to run an engine without useful work being done, or to spend time doing nothing productive
2668.en: The truck idled outside the warehouse for ten minutes.
2668.zh: 卡車在倉庫外怠速了十分鐘。

2669.explanation: 受到高度敬仰、喜愛或崇拜的人；也可指作為崇拜對象的形象或物件。
2669.definition: a person greatly admired or worshiped, or an image or object treated as an object of worship
2669.en: The singer became a teen idol after her first album succeeded.
2669.zh: 那位歌手在首張專輯成功後成為青少年偶像。

2670.explanation: 用來引出某個條件，表示另一件事只有在該條件成立時才會發生或成立。
2670.definition: used to introduce a condition on which another event, result, or statement depends
2670.en: If it rains tomorrow, the game will move indoors.
2670.zh: 如果明天下雨，比賽會移到室內。

2671.explanation: 對某個主題、事實或情況缺乏知識、資訊或了解的狀態。
2671.definition: a lack of knowledge, information, or understanding about a subject, fact, or situation
2671.en: His ignorance of the safety rules caused a preventable mistake.
2671.zh: 他不了解安全規定，造成了本可避免的錯誤。

2672.explanation: 對某個主題或事實缺乏知識或了解的。
2672.definition: lacking knowledge or understanding about a particular subject or fact
2672.en: I was ignorant of the change until the teacher explained it.
2672.zh: 直到老師解釋，我才知道這項變更。

2673.explanation: 故意不注意、不回應或不考慮某人、某事或某項資訊。
2673.definition: to deliberately give no attention or response to a person, thing, or piece of information
2673.en: Don't ignore a warning just because the problem seems small.
2673.zh: 不要因為問題看似很小就忽視警告。

2674.explanation: 身體健康狀況不佳，正在受疾病或不適影響。
2674.definition: not in good health; suffering from sickness or a health problem
2674.en: She stayed home because she felt ill.
2674.zh: 她因為身體不舒服而待在家。

2674.explanation: 以不好的、不利的或不友善的方式；常見於 think/speak ill of 等用法。
2674.definition: in a bad, unfavorable, or unkind way
2674.en: He spoke ill of a colleague without knowing the full story.
2674.zh: 他在不了解完整情況下說同事的壞話。

2674.explanation: 造成困擾、傷害或社會問題的事物或狀況。
2674.definition: a problem, harmful condition, or source of trouble
2674.en: The report discusses several social ills affecting the city.
2674.zh: 報告探討影響這座城市的幾項社會弊病。

2675.explanation: 用光照亮某處，或使某個主題、問題更清楚易懂。
2675.definition: to light something up or make a subject clearer and easier to understand
2675.en: Small lamps illuminate the path at night.

2676.explanation: 看似真實但其實不符合現實的外觀、印象或信念。
2676.definition: a false appearance, belief, or impression that does not match reality
2676.en: The mirror created the illusion of a larger room.
2676.zh: 鏡子營造出房間更大的錯覺。

2677.explanation: 透過例子、圖片或其他證據，使一個想法或重點更清楚。
2677.definition: to make an idea clear by using examples, pictures, or other evidence
2677.en: This chart illustrates how rainfall changes through the year.
2677.zh: 這張圖表說明一年中降雨量如何變化。

2678.explanation: 用來解釋、說明或裝飾內容的圖片、圖表或例子。
2678.definition: a picture, diagram, or example used to explain or decorate something
2678.en: The book includes an illustration of the human heart.
2678.zh: 這本書包含一幅人類心臟的插圖。

2679.explanation: 某人或某物的視覺呈現，例如照片、圖像或數位畫面。
2679.definition: a visual representation of someone or something, such as a picture or digital display
2679.en: The satellite sent back a clear image of the storm.
2679.zh: 衛星傳回了這場暴風雨的清晰影像。

2680.explanation: 只存在於想像中而非現實存在的。
2680.definition: existing only in the imagination rather than in reality
2680.en: As a child, she often talked to an imaginary friend.
2680.zh: 她小時候常和一位想像中的朋友說話。

2681.explanation: 在心中形成未直接看見或尚不存在的圖像、情境或新想法的能力或過程。
2681.definition: the ability or process of forming mental images, situations, or new ideas beyond what is directly present
2681.en: The students used their imagination to design a new playground.
2681.zh: 學生運用想像力設計一座新的遊樂場。

2682.meaning: 富有想像力的；有創意的
2682.explanation: 能產生新穎想法，或在思考、設計、創作中展現豐富想像力的。
2682.definition: showing creativity and an ability to produce fresh or original ideas
2682.en: Her imaginative solution saved both time and materials.
2682.zh: 她富有創意的解決方法同時節省了時間與材料。

2683.explanation: 在心中形成某人、某事或某種情境的圖像或概念。
2683.definition: to form a mental picture or idea of someone, something, or a situation
2683.en: Can you imagine living in a city without cars?
2683.zh: 你能想像住在一座沒有汽車的城市嗎？

2684.explanation: 複製或仿效某人的行為、聲音、外觀、動作或風格。
2684.definition: to copy the behavior, sound, appearance, movement, or style of someone or something
2684.en: Young children often imitate the way adults speak.
2684.zh: 幼兒常會模仿大人說話的方式。

2685.explanation: 模仿某人或某物的行為，或依照原物製成的複製品。
2685.definition: the act of copying someone or something, or a copy made to resemble an original
2685.en: The bag was an imitation of a much more expensive design.
2685.zh: 這個包是某個昂貴設計的仿製品。

2686.explanation: 沒有延遲、間隔或中介而立刻發生，或位置、關係上最接近的。
2686.definition: happening without delay or intervening steps, or being nearest in position or relationship
2686.en: The alarm required immediate action from the staff.
2686.zh: 警報要求工作人員立即採取行動。

2687.explanation: 在大小、程度、數量或重要性上非常大的。
2687.definition: extremely large in size, degree, amount, or importance
2687.en: The rescue team worked under immense pressure.
2687.zh: 救援隊在極大的壓力下工作。

2688.explanation: 從另一個國家搬來並在新國家居住的人。
2688.definition: a person who moves from another country to live in a new country
2688.en: The neighborhood has a large immigrant community.
2688.zh: 這個社區有一個規模很大的移民群體。

2689.explanation: 搬進另一個國家並在那裡長期或永久居住。
2689.definition: to enter another country in order to live there for the long term or permanently
2689.en: Her grandparents immigrated to Canada many years ago.
2689.zh: 她的祖父母多年前移民到加拿大。

2690.explanation: 人們進入另一個國家居住的過程或現象。
2690.definition: the process or movement of people entering another country in order to live there
2690.en: The country changed its immigration policy last year.
2690.zh: 這個國家去年修改了移民政策。

2691.explanation: 預期很快就會發生或到來的。
2691.definition: likely or expected to happen very soon
2691.en: Dark clouds warned us that a storm was imminent.
2691.zh: 烏雲警告我們暴風雨即將來臨。

2692.meaning: 有免疫力的；不受影響的
2692.explanation: 受到保護而不易感染某種疾病，或不受某種影響、責任或處置。
2692.definition: protected against a disease or not affected by a particular influence, duty, or consequence
2692.en: Vaccination can make people immune to certain diseases.
2692.zh: 接種疫苗可以使人對某些疾病具有免疫力。

2693.explanation: 某事件、行動或情況所造成的強烈效果，或物體碰撞時產生的衝擊。
2693.definition: a strong effect produced by an event or action, or the force of one object striking another
2693.en: The new highway had a major impact on local traffic.
2693.zh: 新公路對當地交通造成重大影響。

2693.explanation: 對某人或某事造成明顯影響，或以力量撞擊。
2693.definition: to have a noticeable effect on someone or something, or to strike with force
2693.en: Rising costs may impact small businesses most strongly.
2693.zh: 成本上升可能對小型企業影響最大。

2694.explanation: 重要或急迫到必須採取行動、遵守或完成的。
2694.definition: extremely important or urgent and therefore requiring action or attention
2694.en: It is imperative that emergency exits remain clear.
2694.zh: 緊急出口保持暢通至關重要。

2694.explanation: 必須完成的重要需求，也可指文法中用來表達命令或要求的形式。
2694.definition: an urgent requirement or necessity, or the grammatical form used to express a command or request
2694.en: Reducing water waste has become an environmental imperative.
2694.zh: 減少水資源浪費已成為環境上的必要之事。

2695.explanation: 與帝國、皇帝或帝國統治有關的。
2695.definition: relating to an empire, an emperor, or imperial rule
2695.en: The museum displays maps from the imperial period.
2695.zh: 博物館展示帝國時期的地圖。

2696.explanation: 把計畫、政策、決定或制度實際付諸執行。
2696.definition: to put a plan, policy, decision, or system into practical effect
2696.en: The school will implement the new safety plan next month.
2696.zh: 學校下個月將實施新的安全計畫。

2696.explanation: 為特定工作而使用的工具或器具。
2696.definition: a tool or piece of equipment used for a particular task
2696.en: The farmer cleaned each implement before storing it.
2696.zh: 農夫在收納前清潔每一件農具。

2697.explanation: 某事暗示出的意思，或一項行動、決定可能帶來的結果。
2697.definition: a meaning suggested indirectly, or a possible result or consequence of an action or decision
2697.en: We should consider the long-term implications of the decision.
2697.zh: 我們應考慮這項決定的長期影響與後果。

2698.explanation: 雖未直接表達，但可從內容、行為或情況中理解的。
2698.definition: suggested or understood without being stated directly
2698.en: There was an implicit promise that the information would remain private.
2698.zh: 其中隱含著資訊會保密的承諾。

2699.explanation: 以不直接說出的方式傳達某個意思，或表示某事必然包含另一結果。
2699.definition: to communicate a meaning indirectly or indicate that something follows as a consequence
2699.en: Her tone implied that she disagreed with the proposal.
2699.zh: 她的語氣暗示她不同意這項提案。

2700.explanation: 從其他國家帶入本國的商品、服務或其進口行為。
2700.definition: the act of bringing goods or services into a country, or goods brought in from abroad
2700.en: Food imports increased after the trade agreement took effect.
2700.zh: 貿易協定生效後，食品進口增加了。

2700.explanation: 把商品從國外帶入本國，或把資料從另一系統帶入目前的程式或檔案。
2700.definition: to bring goods into a country from abroad, or bring data into a program or system from elsewhere
2700.en: The company imports coffee beans from Colombia.
2700.zh: 這家公司從哥倫比亞進口咖啡豆。

2701.explanation: 某人或某事值得重視、具有重大影響或價值的程度。
2701.definition: the quality or degree of being significant, valuable, or deserving serious attention
2701.en: The teacher emphasized the importance of checking reliable sources.
2701.zh: 老師強調查核可靠來源的重要性。

2702.explanation: 具有重大價值、影響或意義，因此值得特別注意的。
2702.definition: having great value, influence, or significance and therefore deserving attention
2702.en: Sleep is important for both memory and concentration.
2702.zh: 睡眠對記憶力和專注力都很重要。

2703.explanation: 以權力或決定使某人必須接受規則、稅負、限制、負擔或條件。
2703.definition: to use authority or a decision to make someone accept a rule, tax, restriction, burden, or condition
2703.en: The city imposed a temporary ban on parking along the road.
2703.zh: 市政府暫時禁止在這條路旁停車。

2704.explanation: 因規模、外觀或氣勢而令人感到敬畏或印象深刻的。
2704.definition: large, dignified, or striking enough in appearance to create a strong impression
2704.en: The courthouse is an imposing stone building in the center of town.
2704.zh: 法院是一棟位於市中心、氣勢不凡的石造建築。

2705.explanation: 因能力、品質、表現或特點而使某人產生敬佩或強烈好感。
2705.definition: to cause someone to feel admiration because of ability, quality, performance, or another strong feature
2705.en: Her clear explanation impressed everyone on the review panel.
2705.zh: 她清楚的說明讓審查小組的每個人都印象深刻。

2706.explanation: 接觸某人、某事或某情況後形成的想法、感覺或判斷。
2706.definition: an idea, feeling, or judgment formed after experiencing or noticing someone, something, or a situation
2706.en: My first impression of the new teacher was very positive.
2706.zh: 我對新老師的第一印象非常好。

2707.meaning: 令人印象深刻的；出色的
2707.explanation: 因品質、規模、技巧或成就優異而令人敬佩的。
2707.definition: causing admiration because of high quality, size, skill, or achievement
2707.en: The team gave an impressive performance in the final match.
2707.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中有令人印象深刻的表現。

2708.explanation: 依法或以武力把某人關在監獄或其他受限制的地方，使其不能自由離開。
2708.definition: to confine someone in prison or another restricted place so that the person cannot leave freely
2708.en: The court may imprison a person convicted of a serious offense.
2708.zh: 法院可能監禁被判犯下嚴重罪行的人。

2708.explanation: 把某人關進監獄的行為、狀態或刑罰期間。
2708.definition: the act or state of being confined in prison, or a period of confinement as punishment
2708.en: The law allows imprisonment for certain serious crimes.
2708.zh: 法律允許對某些嚴重犯罪判處監禁。

2709.explanation: 使某事變得更好，或本身在品質、能力、情況等方面變得更好。
2709.definition: to make something better or to become better in quality, ability, condition, or performance
2709.en: Regular practice can improve your speaking skills.
2709.zh: 規律練習可以改善你的口說能力。

2709.explanation: 變得更好的過程、結果或具體改進之處。
2709.definition: the process or result of becoming better, or a specific change that makes something better
2709.en: There has been a noticeable improvement in air quality this year.
2709.zh: 今年的空氣品質有明顯改善。

2710.explanation: 突然產生、通常未經仔細思考就想採取某個行動的強烈念頭或欲望。
2710.definition: a sudden strong desire or inclination to act, often before careful thought
2710.en: She resisted the impulse to check her phone during class.
2710.zh: 她忍住了上課時查看手機的衝動。

2710.explanation: 在神經、肌肉或電路中短暫傳遞的訊號或激發。
2710.definition: a brief signal or wave of excitation transmitted through a nerve, muscle, or electrical system
2710.en: The nerve carries electrical impulses to the muscle.
2710.zh: 這條神經把電脈衝傳到肌肉。

2711.explanation: 表示某人或某物位於一個地方、容器、範圍或環境的內部。
2711.definition: used to show that someone or something is inside a place, container, area, or surrounding situation
2711.en: The keys are in the top drawer.
2711.zh: 鑰匙在最上層的抽屜裡。

2711.explanation: 表示在某處裡面，或向裡面移動、進入。
2711.definition: inside a place, or moving toward and into it
2711.en: Please come in and take a seat.

2711.explanation: 非正式用法，表示目前受到歡迎、流行或符合潮流。
2711.definition: currently fashionable, popular, or accepted by a particular group
2711.en: That style is in again this year.
2711.zh: 那種風格今年又流行起來了。

2712.explanation: 促使某人採取行動、更加努力或改變行為的事物，常為獎勵或利益。
2712.definition: something, often a reward or benefit, that motivates a person to act or make a greater effort
2712.en: The scholarship gives students an incentive to keep improving.
2712.zh: 這筆獎學金給學生持續進步的動力。

2712.explanation: 用來促使人採取行動或增加努力的。
2712.definition: intended or able to encourage action or greater effort
2712.en: The company introduced an incentive program for new employees.
2712.zh: 公司為新進員工推出一項獎勵方案。

2713.explanation: 英制長度單位，等於十二分之一英尺，也就是 2.54 公分。
2713.definition: a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot, or exactly 2.54 centimeters
2713.en: The shelf is twelve inches deep, so the storage box fits easily.
2713.zh: 這個架子深十二英吋，所以收納盒可以輕鬆放進去。

2714.explanation: 發生的一件事情，尤指不尋常、令人不快或值得注意的事件。
2714.definition: a particular event that happens, especially one that is unusual, unpleasant, or worth noting
2714.en: The school reviewed the incident and changed its safety procedures.
2714.zh: 學校檢討了這起事件，並修改了安全程序。

2715.explanation: 有某種想法或行動傾向，或使某人較可能採取某種態度或行動。
2715.definition: to tend toward a particular opinion or action, or to make someone disposed toward it
2715.en: I incline to agree that the shorter route is safer.
2715.zh: 我傾向同意較短的路線比較安全。

2715.explanation: 以一定角度向上或向下傾斜的地面或表面。
2715.definition: a surface or piece of ground that slopes upward or downward at an angle
2715.en: The road becomes a steep incline near the summit.
2715.zh: 接近山頂時，道路變成陡峭的斜坡。

2716.explanation: 把某人或某物作為整體的一部分，或使其成為所述群體、範圍或活動的一部分。
2716.definition: to contain someone or something as part of a whole, group, range, or activity
2716.en: The price includes breakfast and airport transportation.
2716.zh: 這個價格包含早餐和機場接送。

2717.explanation: 用來引出屬於前述群體或整體的一個或多個例子或部分。
2717.definition: used to introduce one or more people or things that form part of the group or whole already mentioned
2717.en: Several students, including Mia, volunteered for the event.
2717.zh: 包括 Mia 在內的幾位學生自願參加這場活動。

2718.meaning: 包容的；不排斥任何群體的
2718.explanation: 讓不同背景、身分或能力的人都能參與、被接納或受到照顧的。
2718.definition: welcoming and accommodating people from different backgrounds, identities, or abilities rather than excluding particular groups
2718.en: The club is trying to create a more inclusive environment for new members.
2718.zh: 這個社團正努力為新成員營造更具包容性的環境。

2718.meaning: 包括全部費用的；包含……在內的
2718.explanation: 表示價格、範圍或總額已把所提到的項目、費用或界限計算在內。
2718.definition: covering all stated items or costs, or including the limits or elements that have been mentioned
2718.en: The listed price is inclusive of taxes and service fees.
2718.zh: 標示的價格已包含稅金與服務費。

2719.explanation: 個人或組織在一段時間內從工作、商業、投資或其他來源取得的金錢。
2719.definition: money received by a person or organization over a period of time from work, business, investments, or other sources
2719.en: Her part-time job provides a steady monthly income.
2719.zh: 她的兼職工作提供穩定的每月收入。

2720.explanation: 把某事物加入另一個較大的整體，使它成為其中的一部分。
2720.definition: to include or combine something as part of a larger whole
2720.en: The revised plan incorporates feedback from students and teachers.
2720.zh: 修訂後的計畫納入了學生與教師的意見。

2721.explanation: 使數量、程度、大小或強度變大，或自行變得更大。
2721.definition: to become greater, or to make something greater, in amount, number, size, degree, or strength
2721.en: The school increased the number of recycling bins on campus.
2721.zh: 學校增加了校園內的資源回收桶數量。

2721.explanation: 數量、程度、大小或強度的增長，或增加這件事。
2721.definition: a rise or growth in amount, number, size, degree, or strength
2721.en: There was a noticeable increase in attendance this semester.
2721.zh: 這學期的出席人數有明顯增加。

2722.explanation: 非常不尋常、出乎意料或令人印象深刻，以致讓人覺得幾乎難以相信。
2722.definition: extremely unusual, surprising, or impressive, sometimes so much that it is hard to believe
2722.en: The volunteers did an incredible job restoring the park after the typhoon.
2722.zh: 颱風過後，志工們在修復公園方面做得非常出色。

2723.explanation: 因自己的行為而遭受、產生或必須承擔某種通常不利的結果、費用或責任。
2723.definition: to become subject to or acquire an unwanted cost, debt, penalty, or other consequence, often because of one's actions
2723.en: Late payments may incur an additional fee.
2723.zh: 延遲付款可能會產生額外費用。

2724.explanation: 用來確認前述內容為真，或加強、補充前面已提出的說法。
2724.definition: used to confirm that something is true or to add emphasis or a stronger supporting statement
2724.en: The task was difficult indeed, but the team completed it.
2724.zh: 這項任務確實很困難，但團隊還是完成了。

2725.explanation: 不受他人或外部勢力控制、支配或依賴的狀態；也可指國家取得自治主權。
2725.definition: the state of being free from outside control or dependence and able to make one's own decisions
2725.en: Living abroad helped her develop greater independence.
2725.zh: 在國外生活幫助她培養更強的獨立性。

2726.explanation: 不受他人控制或不依賴他人即可行動、運作或作決定的。
2726.definition: free from outside control or able to act, operate, or make decisions without depending on others
2726.en: The committee remains independent of the company.
2726.zh: 這個委員會仍獨立於該公司。

2727.explanation: 按一定方式排列、用來快速找到資料的清單；也可指用於衡量變化或水準的數值。
2727.definition: an organized list used to locate information, or a number used to measure changes in a level or condition
2727.en: Use the index at the back of the book to find the topic.
2727.zh: 利用書後的索引找到這個主題。

2727.explanation: 為文件或資料建立索引，或使數值依某項指標調整或連動。
2727.definition: to provide material with an index, or to link a value so that it changes according to a specified measure
2727.en: The archive indexes each document by date and subject.
2727.zh: 檔案庫依日期與主題為每份文件建立索引。

2728.explanation: 以言語、動作、標誌或證據指出某事，或顯示某種情況很可能存在或為真。
2728.definition: to point out or show something, or to provide a sign that a particular fact or condition exists or is likely true
2728.en: The survey results indicate that most students prefer shorter lessons.
2728.zh: 調查結果顯示，大多數學生偏好較短的課程。

2729.explanation: 顯示某事存在、可能發生或可能為真的跡象、資訊或證據。
2729.definition: a sign, piece of information, or evidence showing that something exists, may happen, or is likely to be true
2729.en: A sudden drop in temperature may be an indication of changing weather.
2729.zh: 氣溫突然下降可能是天氣變化的跡象。

2730.explanation: 對某人、某事或某種情況缺乏興趣、關心或在意的狀態。
2730.definition: a lack of interest, concern, or feeling toward someone, something, or a situation
2730.en: Public indifference to the problem delayed meaningful action.
2730.zh: 大眾對這個問題的冷漠延誤了實際行動。

2731.explanation: 對某人或某事沒有明顯興趣、關心或感受的。
2731.definition: showing little or no interest, concern, or feeling about someone or something
2731.en: He seemed indifferent to the criticism and continued his work.
2731.zh: 他似乎對批評毫不在意，繼續做自己的工作。

2732.meaning: 原生的；本土的；原住民族的
2732.explanation: 自然起源於某一地區的，或屬於某地原有居民及其文化的。
2732.definition: originating naturally in a particular region, or belonging to the original inhabitants and their culture
2732.en: The project protects plant species indigenous to the island.
2732.zh: 這項計畫保護原生於這座島嶼的植物物種。

2733.explanation: 因認為某事不公平、不正當、冒犯人或侮辱人而感到強烈生氣的。
2733.definition: feeling or showing strong anger because something seems unfair, unjust, insulting, or offensive
2733.en: Residents were indignant about the unfair decision.
2733.zh: 居民對這項不公平的決定感到憤慨。

2734.meaning: 不可或缺的；必不可少的
2734.explanation: 非常必要，不能省略、忽視或沒有它就難以正常運作的。
2734.definition: absolutely necessary and not reasonably able to be omitted, ignored, or done without
2734.en: Reliable internet access has become indispensable for many students.
2734.zh: 可靠的網路連線對許多學生來說已變得不可或缺。

2735.explanation: 與單一的人或事物有關，而不是把它視為較大群體的一部分。
2735.definition: relating to one particular person or thing considered separately from a larger group
2735.en: Each individual student received written feedback on the assignment.
2735.zh: 每一位學生都收到這份作業的書面回饋。

2735.explanation: 被視為與群體中其他成員有區別的一個人，或單獨存在的一個個體。
2735.definition: a single person or distinct being considered separately from a group or class
2735.en: The scholarship is awarded to an individual who shows exceptional promise.
2735.zh: 這項獎學金頒給一位展現卓越潛力的個人。

2736.explanation: 位於建築物內、在室內進行，或適合在室內使用的。
2736.definition: located, happening, or intended for use inside a building rather than outdoors
2736.en: The school opened a new indoor swimming pool for winter practice.
2736.zh: 學校新設了一座室內游泳池，供冬季練習使用。

2737.explanation: 表示某事在建築物內發生，或某人移動到建築物裡面。
2737.definition: inside a building, or moving from outside into a building
2737.en: We stayed indoors until the thunderstorm passed.
2737.zh: 我們待在室內，直到雷雨過去。

2738.explanation: 使某種狀態或結果發生，或透過勸說、影響等方式促使某人採取行動。
2738.definition: to cause a state or result to occur, or to persuade or influence someone to take an action
2738.en: The medicine may induce sleep within half an hour.
2738.zh: 這種藥可能在半小時內引起睡意。

2739.explanation: 讓自己享受想要的事物或活動，或過度滿足他人的願望與需求。
2739.definition: to allow yourself to enjoy something you want, or to satisfy another person's wishes too freely
2739.en: After the exam, she indulged in a quiet afternoon of reading.
2739.zh: 考試後，她讓自己享受了一個安靜閱讀的下午。

2740.explanation: 與工業、製造業或工業生產有關，或供工業用途使用的。
2740.definition: relating to industry or manufacturing, or designed for use in industrial production
2740.en: The city developed into a major industrial center.
2740.zh: 這座城市發展成重要的工業中心。

2741.explanation: 使一個國家或地區大規模發展工業，或逐漸成為工業化社會。
2741.definition: to develop large-scale industry in a country or region, or for that place to become industrial
2741.en: The country began to industrialize rapidly.
2741.zh: 這個國家開始迅速工業化。

2742.explanation: 製造或生產活動的總稱，也可指提供某一類產品或服務的所有相關企業。
2742.definition: manufacturing or productive activity as a whole, or the group of businesses providing a particular product or service
2742.en: Tourism is an important industry in the region.
2742.zh: 觀光是這個地區的重要產業。

2743.meaning: 不可避免的；必然發生的
2743.explanation: 無法阻止或逃避，因此一定會發生或出現的。
2743.definition: certain to happen and impossible to prevent or avoid
2743.en: Some change is inevitable when a company grows.
2743.zh: 公司成長時，有些改變是不可避免的。

2744.explanation: 非常年幼的孩子，尤指出生後最早期階段的孩子。
2744.definition: a very young child, especially one in the earliest stage of life
2744.en: The infant slept peacefully in her crib.
2744.zh: 嬰兒在嬰兒床裡安穩地睡著。

2745.explanation: 使人、動物、植物或組織受到致病微生物侵入而生病。
2745.definition: to cause a person, animal, plant, or tissue to become affected by disease-producing microorganisms
2745.en: The virus can infect people before symptoms appear.
2745.zh: 這種病毒可能在人出現症狀前使其感染。

2746.explanation: 病原微生物侵入身體或組織的狀態，或由此造成的疾病。
2746.definition: the state of being invaded by disease-causing microorganisms, or an illness resulting from that process
2746.en: The doctor prescribed medicine for the infection.
2746.zh: 醫師為這次感染開了藥。

2747.explanation: 能透過感染在人或生物之間傳播，或能造成感染的。
2747.definition: capable of being transmitted by infection or of causing infection

2748.explanation: 根據已知事實、證據或線索進行推理而得出結論。
2748.definition: to reach a conclusion by reasoning from facts, evidence, or other available information
2748.en: From the wet ground, we inferred that it had rained.
2748.zh: 從濕潤的地面，我們推斷先前下過雨。

2749.explanation: 形容詞指品質、能力、地位或價值較低；名詞指地位或等級較低的人。
2749.definition: lower in quality, ability, rank, or value; also a person of lower rank or status
2749.en: The cheaper material proved inferior to the original.
2749.zh: 較便宜的材料證明比原來的材料差。

2750.explanation: 沒有界限、終點或可測量的限制；也可表示數量或程度極大。
2750.definition: having no limit or end, or being extremely great in amount or degree
2750.en: The library offers an almost infinite range of digital resources.
2750.zh: 這座圖書館提供近乎無限多樣的數位資源。

2751.explanation: 整體物價隨時間普遍上升，使貨幣的購買力下降。
2751.definition: a general rise in prices over time that reduces the purchasing power of money
2751.en: High inflation has made groceries more expensive this year.
2751.zh: 高通膨使今年的食品雜貨變得更昂貴。

2752.meaning: 使遭受；加諸（痛苦、傷害等）
2752.explanation: 使某人或某物承受不愉快、有害或痛苦的事物，常與 on/upon 搭配。
2752.definition: to cause someone or something to suffer something unpleasant or harmful
2752.en: The storm inflicted serious damage on several coastal roads.
2752.zh: 這場暴風雨使數條沿海道路遭受嚴重損害。

2753.explanation: 使他人的行為、想法或事情的發展產生改變的力量或作用。
2753.definition: the power or effect that changes how someone behaves or how something develops
2753.en: Her teacher had a strong influence on her choice of career.
2753.zh: 她的老師對她的職業選擇有很大的影響。

2753.explanation: 對某人的想法、行為或某件事的結果、發展產生作用。
2753.definition: to affect someone's behavior or thinking, or to affect how something develops
2753.en: Online reviews can influence what customers decide to buy.
2753.zh: 網路評論會影響顧客決定購買什麼。

2754.explanation: 能對人、決策、事件或發展產生重大影響的。
2754.definition: having enough importance or power to strongly affect people, decisions, or events
2754.en: The scientist became an influential voice in public health.
2754.zh: 這位科學家成為公共衛生領域很有影響力的聲音。

2755.explanation: 把事實、消息或相關資訊告訴某人，使其知情。
2755.definition: to give someone facts or information so that they know about something
2755.en: Please inform the office if your address changes.
2755.zh: 如果你的地址有變更，請通知辦公室。

2756.explanation: 關於某人、某事或某主題的事實、消息或知識；一般作不可數名詞。
2756.definition: facts, details, or knowledge about a person, subject, event, or situation
2756.en: The website provides useful information about scholarship deadlines.
2756.zh: 這個網站提供有關獎學金截止日期的實用資訊。

2757.meaning: 提供有用資訊的；增長見聞的
2757.explanation: 能提供有用或有趣的事實與知識，使人更加了解某事的。
2757.definition: providing useful facts or knowledge that helps someone understand a subject better
2757.en: The museum guide gave an informative talk about the old harbor.
2757.zh: 博物館導覽員針對舊港口做了一場資訊豐富的講解。

2758.explanation: 讓國家、城市或組織得以運作的基本系統與設施，如交通、能源、通訊與公共服務。
2758.definition: the basic systems and facilities needed for a society or organization to operate
2758.en: The city is investing in rail and energy infrastructure.
2758.zh: 這座城市正在投資鐵路與能源基礎建設。

2759.explanation: 製作食物或其他混合物時所使用的一種材料；也可指促成某種結果的重要要素。
2759.definition: one of the substances used to make a food or mixture, or an element that helps produce a result
2759.en: Fresh ginger is the key ingredient in this soup.
2759.zh: 新鮮薑是這道湯的關鍵食材。

2760.explanation: 人或動物長期生活在某個地方。
2760.definition: to live in or occupy a place, especially over a period of time
2760.en: Many rare birds inhabit the wetlands along the coast.
2760.zh: 許多稀有鳥類棲息在沿海濕地。

2761.explanation: 居住在某地的人或動物。
2761.definition: a person or animal that lives in a particular place
2761.en: The island has fewer than five hundred permanent inhabitants.
2761.zh: 這座島的常住居民不到五百人。

2762.explanation: 某種特質本身就存在於事物之中，而非後來附加。
2762.definition: existing as a natural or basic part of something
2762.en: Every investment carries some inherent risk.
2762.zh: 每一項投資都帶有某種固有風險。

2763.explanation: 從前一代取得財產、權利或特徵。
2763.definition: to receive property, rights, or characteristics from someone who came before
2763.en: She inherited the small bookstore from her grandfather.
2763.zh: 她從祖父那裡繼承了這間小書店。

2764.explanation: 發生在一連串過程的開頭。
2764.definition: occurring at the beginning of a process or period
2764.en: The initial results were more encouraging than expected.
2764.zh: 最初的結果比預期更令人振奮。

2764.explanation: 人名或字詞開頭的字母。
2764.definition: the first letter of a name or word, especially when used as an abbreviation
2764.en: Please write your initials at the bottom of each page.
2764.zh: 請在每一頁底部寫上你的姓名首字母。

2764.explanation: 在文件上寫下姓名首字母以表示確認。
2764.definition: to mark a document with the first letters of your name
2764.en: The manager initialed the change before the contract was printed.
2764.zh: 經理在合約印出前以姓名首字母確認了這項修改。

2765.explanation: 使某個過程、計畫或行動開始。
2765.definition: to cause a process, plan, or action to begin
2765.en: The school initiated a review of its safety procedures.
2765.zh: 學校啟動了安全程序的檢討。

2765.explanation: 已被正式接納、開始，或已獲得某領域入門知識的。
2765.definition: formally admitted, begun, or introduced to a body of knowledge
2765.en: Only initiate members were allowed to attend the private ceremony.
2765.zh: 只有已正式入會的成員可以參加私人儀式。

2765.explanation: 剛被接納進團體或剛開始學習某領域的人。
2765.definition: a person newly admitted to a group or introduced to a subject
2765.en: Each initiate was paired with an experienced member.
2765.zh: 每位新入會者都會與一位資深成員搭配。

2766.explanation: 主動開始行動的能力；也指為解決問題而提出的新計畫。
2766.definition: the ability to act without being told, or a new plan intended to achieve a goal
2766.en: The city launched an initiative to reduce food waste.
2766.zh: 市政府發起了一項減少食物浪費的倡議。

2766.explanation: 用來開始某事或與開始、入會有關的。
2766.definition: serving to begin something or relating to initiation
2766.en: The committee approved several initiative steps before the full program began.
2766.zh: 委員會在完整計畫開始前核准了幾個起始步驟。

2767.explanation: 把液體、藥物或資金等送入某處。
2767.definition: to force a substance into something, or to add money, energy, or another resource
2767.en: The nurse injected the medicine slowly into the patient's arm.
2767.zh: 護理師把藥物慢慢注射進病人的手臂。

2768.explanation: 注射藥物的行為，或把資金等投入某處。
2768.definition: the act of injecting a substance, or an addition of money or resources
2768.en: The doctor gave him an injection to reduce the pain.
2768.zh: 醫師替他打了一針以減輕疼痛。

2769.explanation: 使人身體受傷，或對名譽、利益等造成損害。
2769.definition: to cause physical harm to someone or damage to something such as a reputation
2769.en: Two cyclists were injured in the accident.
2769.zh: 有兩名自行車騎士在事故中受傷。

2770.explanation: 身體受損的狀態或傷處。
2770.definition: physical harm or damage to the body
2770.en: He returned to practice after recovering from a knee injury.
2770.zh: 他從膝傷康復後重返練習。

2771.explanation: 不公平或違反正義的情況或行為。
2771.definition: a situation or act that is unfair or violates principles of justice
2771.en: The documentary drew attention to a long-standing social injustice.
2771.zh: 這部紀錄片讓人注意到一項長期存在的社會不公。

2772.explanation: 用於書寫、印刷或繪圖的有色液體。
2772.definition: colored liquid used for writing, printing, or drawing
2772.en: The signature was written in blue ink.
2772.zh: 簽名是用藍色墨水寫的。

2772.explanation: 用墨水書寫、簽署或覆蓋表面。
2772.definition: to write, sign, or mark something with ink
2772.en: The artist inked the final outlines after finishing the sketch.
2772.zh: 畫家完成素描後用墨勾出最後的輪廓。

2773.explanation: 位於遠離海岸的陸地內部。
2773.definition: located away from the coast, toward the interior of a country or region
2773.en: The storm weakened as it moved across inland areas.
2773.zh: 暴風雨移經內陸地區時逐漸減弱。

2773.explanation: 在或朝向遠離海岸的地方。
2773.definition: in or toward the interior of the land, away from the coast
2773.en: After reaching the port, the travelers continued inland by train.
2773.zh: 旅客抵達港口後繼續搭火車往內陸前進。

2773.explanation: 遠離海岸的陸地內部地區。
2773.definition: the interior part of a country or region away from the coast
2773.en: Trade routes connected the coast with the inland.
2773.zh: 貿易路線把海岸與內陸連接起來。

2774.explanation: 通常規模不大的住宿場所，有時也供應餐飲。
2774.definition: a small hotel or lodging place, often offering food and drink
2774.en: We stayed at a quiet inn beside the lake.
2774.zh: 我們住在湖邊一間安靜的小旅店。

2775.explanation: 位於裡面的，或與人的內心思想感受有關。
2775.definition: located inside something, or relating to a person's private thoughts and feelings
2775.en: The inner door remained locked during the meeting.
2775.zh: 會議期間內側的門一直上鎖。

2776.explanation: 棒球比賽中雙方各有一次進攻機會的一個回合。
2776.definition: one division of a baseball game in which each team normally has a turn at bat
2776.en: The home team scored three runs in the final inning.
2776.zh: 主隊在最後一局得到三分。

2777.explanation: 沒有犯罪或過錯的狀態；也可指單純、不懂世故。
2777.definition: the state of not being guilty, or the quality of being trusting and inexperienced
2777.en: New evidence supported the prisoner's claim of innocence.
2777.zh: 新證據支持了那名囚犯聲稱自己清白的說法。

2778.explanation: 沒有犯錯或犯罪的；也可指單純而無惡意的。
2778.definition: not guilty of wrongdoing, or simple and without harmful intention
2778.en: Several innocent passengers were delayed by the investigation.
2778.zh: 幾名無辜乘客因調查而受到延誤。

2779.explanation: 引進新方法、想法或產品的行為或成果。
2779.definition: the introduction or development of a new idea, method, or product
2779.en: The company rewards innovation in product design.
2779.zh: 這家公司獎勵產品設計方面的創新。

2780.explanation: 運用新想法或新方法的。
2780.definition: using or introducing new ideas, methods, or designs
2780.en: The team developed an innovative way to reuse waste heat.
2780.zh: 團隊開發出一種創新方法來再利用廢熱。

2781.definition: too numerous to be counted or listed
2781.en: The internet gives students innumerable ways to explore a topic.
2781.zh: 網路提供學生無數種探索主題的方式。

2782.explanation: 投入系統的資料、資源或提供的意見。
2782.definition: information, resources, or advice supplied to a system, process, or discussion
2782.en: The teacher asked for student input before changing the schedule.
2782.zh: 老師在更改時程前徵詢學生的意見。

2782.explanation: 把資料輸入電腦或系統。
2782.definition: to enter data or information into a computer or system
2782.en: Please input your student number before submitting the form.
2782.zh: 送出表單前請輸入你的學號。

2783.explanation: 為取得資訊而提出問題或進一步查問。
2783.definition: to ask for information or investigate by asking questions
2783.en: I called the office to inquire about the application deadline.
2783.zh: 我打電話到辦公室詢問申請截止日期。

2784.explanation: 為取得資訊而提出的問題，或正式的調查。
2784.definition: a request for information or an official investigation into a matter
2784.en: The agency opened an inquiry into the cause of the accident.
2784.zh: 該機構針對事故原因展開調查。

2785.meaning: 精神失常的；極不理智的
2785.explanation: 可指嚴重精神失常；非醫療語境也可指極不合理或瘋狂的。
2785.definition: seriously mentally disturbed, or informally extremely unreasonable or wild
2785.en: It would be insane to ignore the warning and enter the flooded tunnel.
2785.zh: 無視警告進入淹水隧道是極不理智的。

2786.explanation: 有六隻腳、身體通常分為三部分的小型節肢動物。
2786.definition: a small arthropod with six legs and a body typically divided into three main parts
2786.en: A bright green insect landed on the window.
2786.zh: 一隻鮮綠色的昆蟲停在窗戶上。

2787.explanation: 把某物放入另一物內，或在文字、資料中加入內容。
2787.definition: to put something into something else or add material into text or data
2787.en: Insert the card into the reader with the chip facing up.
2787.zh: 將卡片晶片朝上插入讀卡機。

2787.explanation: 被插入的物件或附加在出版物中的頁面。
2787.definition: an object or piece of material placed inside something, especially an added printed sheet
2787.en: The package includes a small insert explaining the warranty.
2787.zh: 包裝內附有一張說明保固的小插頁。

2788.explanation: 表示某人或某物位於某個範圍或容器之內。
2788.definition: in the interior of a place, container, or boundary
2788.en: The keys are inside the top drawer.

2788.explanation: 表示位置或移動方向是在某物內部。
2788.definition: in or into the interior of a place or thing
2788.en: It started raining, so everyone went inside.
2788.zh: 開始下雨了，所以大家都進到裡面。

2788.definition: the inner part or surface of something
2788.en: The inside of the old box was lined with paper.
2788.zh: 那個舊盒子的內部鋪著紙。

2788.explanation: 位於內側或發生於組織內部的。
2788.definition: located on the inner side or known only within a group or organization
2788.en: Use the inside pocket to keep your passport safe.
2788.zh: 把護照放在內側口袋裡比較安全。

2789.explanation: 對複雜問題或情況的深刻理解。
2789.definition: a clear and deep understanding of a complicated subject or situation
2789.en: The interview gave us valuable insight into how the team works.
2789.zh: 這場訪談讓我們深入了解這個團隊如何運作。

2790.explanation: 堅決要求某事，或強調某個說法是真的。
2790.definition: to demand something firmly or state something strongly despite disagreement
2790.en: She insisted on checking the figures one more time.
2790.zh: 她堅持要再檢查一次數字。

2791.explanation: 強烈而持續地要求或主張某事。
2791.definition: firm and continued demand for or assertion of something
2791.en: At his insistence, the team tested the backup system again.
2791.zh: 在他的堅持下，團隊再次測試備援系統。

2792.explanation: 仔細查看以確認品質、安全或狀況。
2792.definition: to examine something carefully to check its condition, quality, or safety
2792.en: Engineers inspect the bridge every year for signs of damage.
2792.zh: 工程師每年檢查這座橋是否有損壞跡象。

2793.explanation: 為確認安全、品質或規定遵守情況而進行的仔細查看。
2793.definition: a careful examination to check condition, quality, safety, or compliance
2793.en: The restaurant passed its health inspection.
2793.zh: 這家餐廳通過了衛生檢查。

2794.explanation: 負責正式檢查、監督或調查的人。
2794.definition: a person whose job is to examine, supervise, or investigate officially
2794.en: A building inspector visited the site before construction resumed.
2794.zh: 工程復工前，一名建築檢查員到現場查看。

2795.explanation: 促使人產生創意或採取正面行動的人事物或感受。
2795.definition: a person, idea, or feeling that stimulates creativity or positive action
2795.en: The landscape became a source of inspiration for her paintings.
2795.zh: 這片風景成為她繪畫的靈感來源。

2796.explanation: 使人產生做某事的動力、信心或創意。
2796.definition: to give someone motivation, confidence, or creative ideas
2796.en: Her science teacher inspired her to study engineering.
2796.zh: 她的自然科老師激勵她去念工程。

2797.explanation: 把設備、軟體或系統放到適當位置並使其可使用。
2797.definition: to put equipment, software, or a system in place and make it ready for use
2797.en: The school installed solar panels on the gym roof.
2797.zh: 學校在體育館屋頂安裝了太陽能板。

2798.explanation: 安裝的行為，或已安裝的設備、設施。
2798.definition: the act of installing something, or equipment and facilities that have been installed
2798.en: The installation of the new air-conditioning system took two days.
2798.zh: 新空調系統的安裝花了兩天。

2799.explanation: 某件事的一個具體例子或發生情況。
2799.definition: a particular example or occurrence of something
2799.en: This is one instance in which asking for help is the best choice.
2799.zh: 這是一個尋求協助才是最佳選擇的例子。

2800.explanation: 幾乎沒有延遲就發生或可取得的。
2800.definition: happening or available immediately, with little or no delay
2800.en: The app gives users instant access to their class schedule.
2800.zh: 這個應用程式讓使用者立即查看課表。

2800.definition: a very short moment of time
2800.en: For an instant, the room became completely silent.
2800.zh: 有一瞬間，整個房間完全安靜下來。

2801.explanation: 表示選擇另一個人、事物或做法來取代原本的。
2801.definition: as an alternative or replacement for something previously mentioned
2801.en: We planned to walk, but it rained, so we took the bus instead.
2801.zh: 我們原本打算走路，但下雨了，所以改搭公車。

2802.explanation: 天生的行為傾向，或沒有經過仔細推理就產生的感覺。
2802.definition: an inborn tendency to behave in a certain way, or a strong natural feeling
2802.en: Her first instinct was to move away from the falling object.
2802.zh: 她的第一個本能反應是躲開掉落的物體。

2803.explanation: 出於本能而非刻意思考的。
2803.definition: arising naturally and automatically rather than from deliberate thought
2803.en: His instinctive reaction was to catch the cup before it hit the floor.
2803.zh: 他的本能反應是在杯子落地前接住它。

2804.explanation: 為教育、研究或特定專業目的而成立的組織。
2804.definition: an organization established for education, research, or a particular professional purpose
2804.en: The research institute publishes a climate report each year.
2804.zh: 這所研究機構每年發布一份氣候報告。

2804.explanation: 正式開始一項制度、程序或措施。
