2804.definition: to formally establish or begin a system, process, or measure
2804.en: The university instituted new rules for laboratory safety.
2804.zh: 大學制定並開始實施新的實驗室安全規定。

2805.explanation: 大型正式組織；也可指社會中長期存在的制度或慣例。
2805.definition: a large formal organization, or an established system or custom in society
2805.en: The library is one of the city's oldest public institutions.
2805.zh: 這座圖書館是該市最古老的公共機構之一。

2806.explanation: 告訴某人如何做某事，或以教學方式傳授知識。
2806.definition: to tell someone what to do or teach them how to do something
2806.en: The guide instructed us to remain behind the safety line.
2806.zh: 導覽員指示我們留在安全線後方。

2807.explanation: 告訴人如何做某事的內容；也可指教導的行為。
2807.definition: directions about how to do something, or the act of teaching
2807.en: Read the instructions carefully before assembling the shelf.
2807.zh: 組裝架子前請仔細閱讀說明。

2808.explanation: 教導某項技能或課程的人。
2808.definition: a person who teaches a subject or practical skill
2808.en: The swimming instructor showed us how to breathe properly.
2808.zh: 游泳教練示範了正確的呼吸方式。

2809.explanation: 用來完成工作、測量或演奏音樂的工具或裝置。
2809.definition: a tool or device used for a task or measurement, or an object used to make music
2809.en: The laboratory uses a sensitive instrument to measure air quality.
2809.zh: 實驗室使用精密儀器來測量空氣品質。

2810.explanation: 不尊重或冒犯他人的話語或行為。
2810.definition: a rude or offensive remark or action that shows disrespect
2810.en: His comment sounded like an insult, but he apologized immediately.
2810.zh: 他的評論聽起來像侮辱人的話，但他立刻道歉了。

2810.explanation: 以無禮或冒犯性的話或行為使人感到受辱。
2810.definition: to offend someone by speaking or behaving in a rude or disrespectful way
2810.en: She did not intend to insult anyone during the discussion.
2810.zh: 她在討論中並沒有打算侮辱任何人。

2811.explanation: 藉由支付保費，在特定損失發生時獲得金錢保障的安排。
2811.definition: an arrangement that provides financial protection against specified loss in return for payment
2811.en: The family reviewed its insurance before the trip.
2811.zh: 這家人在旅行前檢查了保險內容。

2812.explanation: 沒有被破壞、改動或缺少任何重要部分。
2812.definition: complete and not damaged, changed, or missing important parts
2812.en: The package arrived intact despite the long journey.
2812.zh: 儘管運送路程很長，包裹抵達時仍完整無損。

2813.explanation: 在一段時間內吃進、喝進、吸入或接收的數量。
2813.definition: the amount of food, drink, air, or another substance taken in over a period
2813.en: The coach asked the team to record their daily water intake.
2813.zh: 教練請隊員記錄每天的飲水量。

2814.explanation: 把不同部分結合成整體，或使人、事物成為較大群體的一部分。
2814.definition: to combine parts into a whole or become part of a larger group or system
2814.en: The new app integrates notes and calendars in one place.
2814.zh: 這款新應用程式把筆記和行事曆整合在同一處。

2815.explanation: 把不同部分或群體結合成整體的過程或結果。
2815.definition: the process or result of combining different parts or groups into a whole
2815.en: The project improved the integration of several school systems.
2815.zh: 這項專案改善了幾個校務系統之間的整合。

2816.explanation: 誠實並堅持良好道德原則的特質。
2816.definition: the quality of being honest and guided by strong moral principles
2816.en: A good researcher reports results with integrity.
2816.zh: 好的研究者會以誠信報告研究結果。

2817.explanation: 理解、推理與思考複雜事物的能力。
2817.definition: the ability to understand, reason, and think about complex ideas
2817.zh: 這道謎題考驗了他的思考能力。

2818.explanation: 與思考、理解或複雜概念的運用有關。
2818.definition: relating to thinking, understanding, or the use of complex ideas
2818.en: The debate required careful intellectual effort.
2818.zh: 這場辯論需要仔細的智性思考。

2818.explanation: 經常研究、思考或從事需要高度智識活動的人。
2818.definition: a person who studies, thinks about, or works with complex ideas
2818.en: The museum invited a public intellectual to discuss the exhibit.
2818.zh: 博物館邀請一位公共知識分子來討論展覽。

2819.explanation: 學習、理解、推理並處理資訊的能力。
2819.definition: the ability to learn, understand, reason, and deal with information
2819.en: The study examined several different forms of intelligence.
2819.zh: 這項研究探討了幾種不同形式的智力。

2820.explanation: 能快速學習、理解或做出良好判斷的。
2820.definition: able to learn, understand, or make good judgments quickly
2820.en: The program made an intelligent choice based on the data.
2820.zh: 這個程式根據資料做出了明智的選擇。

2821.explanation: 心裡有計畫或目的，準備做某事。
2821.definition: to have a plan or purpose to do something
2821.en: I intend to finish the report before Friday.
2821.zh: 我打算在星期五以前完成報告。

2822.explanation: 程度、感受或活動非常強的。
2822.definition: very strong in degree, feeling, or activity
2822.en: The final round of the debate was intense but respectful.
2822.zh: 辯論的最後一輪很激烈，但仍保持尊重。

2823.explanation: 使程度、力量或感受增強，或自己變得更強。
2823.definition: to make something stronger or more extreme, or to become stronger
2823.en: The rain intensified during the afternoon.

2824.explanation: 某種力量、感覺或活動有多強的程度。
2824.definition: the degree to which a force, feeling, or activity is strong
2824.en: The intensity of the light changed as the sun set.
2824.zh: 隨著太陽下山，光線的強度改變了。

2825.explanation: 在短時間內投入大量努力、活動或注意力的。
2825.definition: involving a great deal of effort, activity, or attention in a short period
2825.en: She took an intensive language course during the summer.
2825.zh: 她暑假參加了一門密集語言課程。

2826.explanation: 做某件事時心中所具有的目的或打算。
2826.definition: the purpose or plan behind an action
2826.en: The message was sent with the intent of clarifying the plan.
2826.zh: 這則訊息的用意是釐清計畫。

2826.explanation: 把注意力集中在某事上，或堅定地想達成某目的。
2826.definition: fully focused on something or determined to achieve a particular purpose
2826.en: He was intent on finishing the model before class ended.
2826.zh: 他專心想在下課前完成模型。

2827.explanation: 你計畫或想要做某事的想法。
2827.definition: an idea or plan about what you mean to do
2827.en: Her intention was to make the instructions easier to follow.
2827.zh: 她的用意是讓說明更容易理解。

2828.explanation: 彼此溝通、行動或產生影響。
2828.definition: to communicate, act, or have an effect on one another
2828.en: Students interact with the simulation by changing its settings.
2828.zh: 學生透過改變設定與模擬系統互動。

2829.explanation: 兩個或更多人、事物之間彼此溝通或影響的過程。
2829.definition: the process of people or things communicating with or affecting one another
2829.en: The activity encourages interaction among students from different classes.
2829.zh: 這項活動鼓勵不同班級學生之間的互動。

2830.explanation: 想知道、了解或參與某事的感受。
2830.definition: a feeling of wanting to know, learn about, or take part in something
2830.en: Her interest in astronomy began after a school project.
2830.zh: 她對天文學的興趣始於一次學校專題。

2830.explanation: 吸引某人的注意，使其想進一步了解。
2830.definition: to attract someone's attention and make them want to know more
2830.en: The documentary may interest students who enjoy science.
2830.zh: 這部紀錄片可能會吸引喜歡科學的學生。

2831.explanation: 對某事想知道更多或願意投入注意力的。
2831.definition: wanting to know more about or pay attention to something
2831.en: I am interested in how the machine works.
2831.zh: 我對這台機器如何運作很感興趣。

2832.explanation: 能吸引注意或使人想進一步了解的。
2832.definition: holding attention or making someone want to know more
2832.en: The museum has an interesting exhibit about early computers.
2832.zh: 博物館有一個關於早期電腦的有趣展覽。

2833.explanation: 不當介入某事，或使某事不能正常進行。
2833.definition: to become involved inappropriately or prevent something from working normally
2833.en: Background noise can interfere with the recording.
2833.zh: 背景雜音可能會妨礙錄音。

2834.explanation: 不必要或不受歡迎的介入，或對正常運作造成的阻礙。
2834.definition: unwanted involvement or an effect that prevents normal operation
2834.en: The thick wall reduced interference between the two rooms.
2834.zh: 厚牆減少了兩個房間之間的干擾。

2835.explanation: 位於建築物、物體或地區內部的。
2835.definition: located on or relating to the inside of something
2835.en: The interior walls were painted a warm white.
2835.zh: 室內牆面被漆成溫暖的白色。

2835.explanation: 建築物或物體的內部部分。
2835.definition: the inside part of a building or object
2835.en: The car's interior is simple but comfortable.
2835.zh: 這輛車的內裝簡單但舒適。

2836.explanation: 程度、階段或難度介於初級與高級之間的。
2836.definition: between basic and advanced in level, degree, or stage
2836.en: She enrolled in an intermediate English course.
2836.zh: 她報名了中級英文課程。

2836.explanation: 位於兩端或兩個階段之間的人或事物。
2836.definition: a person or thing that is between two levels or stages
2836.en: The factory uses this chemical as an intermediate in production.
2836.zh: 工廠在生產過程中把這種化學物質當作中間產物。

2836.explanation: 在雙方之間協助溝通或處理。
2836.definition: to act between two parties in order to help them communicate or reach an arrangement
2836.en: A neutral organization intermediated between the two sides.
2836.zh: 一個中立組織在雙方之間居中協調。

2837.explanation: 存在於組織、系統、身體或事物本身內部的。
2837.definition: existing or happening inside an organization, system, body, or thing
2837.en: The company launched an internal review of its safety rules.
2837.zh: 公司對安全規定展開內部檢討。

2838.explanation: 涉及兩個或以上國家，或在多國之間發生的。
2838.definition: involving or relating to two or more countries
2838.en: The university hosts many international students each year.
2838.zh: 這所大學每年接待許多國際學生。

2839.explanation: 全球互相連結的電腦網路系統。
2839.definition: the worldwide system of connected computer networks
2839.en: The internet makes it easy to compare information from different sources.
2839.zh: 網際網路讓人很容易比較不同來源的資訊。

2840.explanation: 說明某事的意義，或依理解來判斷其含義。
2840.definition: to explain or understand the meaning or significance of something
2840.en: Different readers may interpret the ending in different ways.
2840.zh: 不同讀者可能會用不同方式解讀結局。

2841.explanation: 對某事意義、內容或結果所作的說明或理解。
2841.definition: an explanation or understanding of the meaning or significance of something
2841.en: Her interpretation of the poem focused on memory and loss.
2841.zh: 她對這首詩的詮釋著重於記憶與失落。

2842.explanation: 把一種口語即時轉成另一種語言的人，也可指解釋資訊的人。
2842.definition: a person who translates spoken language, or who explains the meaning of something
2842.en: The interpreter translated the speaker's remarks into Chinese.
2842.zh: 口譯員把講者的發言翻成中文。

2843.explanation: 使某人停止說話或使活動暫時停止。
2843.definition: to stop a person from speaking or an activity from continuing for a time
2843.en: Please do not interrupt while someone else is speaking.
2843.zh: 別人在說話時請不要打斷。

2844.explanation: 使活動、談話或流程暫時停止的事件或行為。
2844.definition: an occasion when an activity, conversation, or process is stopped for a time
2844.en: The power interruption lasted only a few minutes.

2845.explanation: 兩條或多條道路、線或路徑相交的位置。
2845.definition: a place where two or more roads, lines, or paths cross
2845.en: Turn left at the next intersection.
2845.zh: 在下一個十字路口左轉。

2846.explanation: 兩個事件、時間點或活動之間的一段時間或距離。
2846.definition: a period of time or distance between two events, points, or activities
2846.en: The buses leave at ten-minute intervals.

2847.explanation: 為改變結果或阻止問題而介入某情況。
2847.definition: to become involved in a situation in order to change the result or prevent a problem
2847.en: The teacher intervened before the argument became serious.
2847.zh: 爭吵惡化前，老師出面介入。

2848.explanation: 為改變情況、結果或健康狀態所採取的行動。
2848.definition: action taken to become involved in a situation in order to improve or change it
2848.en: Early intervention can prevent a small problem from becoming worse.
2848.zh: 及早介入可以避免小問題惡化。

2849.explanation: 以問答方式取得資訊或評估一個人的正式會談。
2849.definition: a formal meeting in which someone is asked questions for information or assessment
2849.en: She has a job interview tomorrow morning.
2849.zh: 她明天早上有一場工作面試。

2849.explanation: 以問答方式向某人取得資訊或評估其是否適合某職位。
2849.definition: to ask someone questions in order to obtain information or assess them
2849.en: The reporter interviewed three local residents.
2849.zh: 記者採訪了三位當地居民。

2850.explanation: 彼此非常熟悉、信任或感情接近的狀態。
2850.definition: a state of close personal familiarity, trust, or emotional closeness
2850.en: Years of friendship created a sense of intimacy between them.
2850.zh: 多年的友誼讓他們之間產生親密感。

2851.explanation: 關係非常親近，或只適合少數熟悉的人知道的。
2851.definition: very close and personal, or private in nature
2851.en: They had an intimate conversation about their future plans.
2851.zh: 他們針對未來計畫進行了一場親密而私人的談話。

2851.explanation: 關係非常親近、熟悉的人。
2851.definition: a person with whom one has a very close personal relationship
2851.en: Only a few intimates were invited to the private gathering.
2851.zh: 只有幾位密友受邀參加這場私人聚會。

2852.explanation: 利用權力、態度或威脅使某人感到害怕或缺乏信心。
2852.definition: to frighten or discourage someone, especially through threats or a show of power
2852.en: The witness said the threats were meant to intimidate her.
2852.zh: 證人表示，那些威脅是為了嚇唬她。

2853.explanation: 表示從外部移動到某處內部，或進入某種狀態。
2853.definition: used to show movement toward the inside of a place or a change to a state
2853.en: She stepped into the room and closed the door.

2854.explanation: 說話時聲音高低、升降所形成的模式。
2854.definition: the rise and fall of the voice when speaking
2854.en: Her rising intonation made the statement sound like a question.
2854.zh: 她上揚的語調讓這句話聽起來像問題。

2855.explanation: 秘密策劃的活動，或能激起好奇心的複雜情節。
2855.definition: secret plotting or a complex situation that arouses curiosity
2855.en: The novel is full of political intrigue and hidden alliances.
2855.zh: 這本小說充滿政治陰謀與秘密結盟。

2855.explanation: 使某人因神秘、複雜或有趣而很想知道更多。
2855.definition: to make someone very interested and curious, especially because something is unusual or mysterious
2855.en: The unusual pattern intrigued the researchers.
2855.zh: 這個不尋常的模式引起研究人員的好奇。

2856.explanation: 讓人初次認識某人、某事，或開始採用新的事物。
2856.definition: to present someone or something for the first time, or to bring something new into use
2856.en: The teacher introduced a new method for taking notes.
2856.zh: 老師介紹了一種新的筆記方法。

2857.explanation: 把人或事物首次呈現給他人，或文章、演講開頭的說明部分。
2857.definition: the act of presenting something for the first time, or an opening section that explains a topic
2857.en: The first chapter gives a clear introduction to the topic.
2857.zh: 第一章對這個主題做了清楚的介紹。

2858.explanation: 未受邀或不適當地進入某處或干涉他人私事。
2858.definition: to enter a place or become involved in a situation where one is not wanted
2858.en: I did not want to intrude on their private conversation.
2858.zh: 我不想打擾他們的私人談話。

2859.explanation: 未獲允許進入某處的人。
2859.definition: a person who enters a place without permission
2859.en: The alarm sounded when an intruder entered the building.
2859.zh: 有闖入者進入大樓時，警報響了。

2860.explanation: 不經明確推理而直接產生的理解或判斷。
2860.definition: the ability to understand or know something immediately without conscious reasoning
2860.en: Her intuition told her that something was wrong.
2860.zh: 她的直覺告訴她事情不對勁。

2861.explanation: 以武力進入他國或大量進入某地並造成干擾。
2861.definition: to enter a country by force, or to enter a place in large numbers and cause disruption
2861.en: The army attempted to invade the neighboring country.

2862.explanation: 非常有用或重要，以致難以用金錢衡量其價值。
2862.definition: extremely useful, important, or valuable beyond easy measurement
2862.en: Her experience was invaluable during the emergency.
2862.zh: 她的經驗在緊急狀況中極其寶貴。

2863.explanation: 幾乎每一次都以相同方式發生。
2863.definition: always or almost always in the same way
2863.en: He invariably arrives a few minutes early.
2863.zh: 他總是會提早幾分鐘到。

2864.explanation: 武力進入他國，或大量進入某地的行為。
2864.definition: the act of entering a country by force, or entering a place in large numbers
2864.en: The invasion forced many families to leave their homes.
2864.zh: 這次入侵迫使許多家庭離開家園。

2865.explanation: 首次設計或製造新的裝置、方法或想法。
2865.definition: to create or design something new for the first time
2865.en: The team hopes to invent a cheaper way to store energy.
2865.zh: 團隊希望發明更便宜的儲能方式。

2866.explanation: 創造新事物的行為，或被創造出來的新裝置、方法。
2866.definition: the act of creating something new, or a new device, process, or idea
2866.en: The invention greatly reduced the time needed for the task.
2866.zh: 這項發明大幅縮短了完成任務所需的時間。

2867.explanation: 發明或設計新裝置、方法的人。
2867.definition: a person who creates or designs a new device, process, or idea
2867.en: The inventor tested the device many times before selling it.
2867.zh: 這位發明家在販售裝置前測試了許多次。

2868.explanation: 企業或場所現有商品、材料或物品的總量或清單。
2868.definition: the goods and materials a business has in stock, or a list of them
2868.en: The store checks its inventory at the end of every month.
2868.zh: 這家店每月底都會清點庫存。

2868.explanation: 列出並記錄現有物品的數量與種類。
2868.definition: to make a detailed list of the items currently present or in stock
2868.en: Staff inventoried all the equipment before the move.
2868.zh: 搬遷前，員工盤點了所有設備。

2869.explanation: 把金錢、時間或努力投入某事，希望日後獲得回報。
2869.definition: to put money, time, or effort into something with the expectation of future benefit
2869.en: They plan to invest more money in renewable energy.
2869.zh: 他們計畫投入更多資金在再生能源上。

2869.explanation: 為未來回報而投入的金錢、時間或資源。
2869.definition: money, time, or resources put into something in the hope of future benefit
2869.en: The new rail line requires a large public investment.
2869.zh: 這條新鐵路需要大量公共投資。

2870.explanation: 有系統地查明事件、問題或現象的事實與原因。
2870.definition: to examine a matter systematically in order to discover facts or causes
2870.en: Police are investigating the cause of the fire.
2870.zh: 警方正在調查火災原因。

2871.explanation: 為查明事實或原因而進行的系統性查證。
2871.definition: a systematic examination carried out to discover facts or causes
2871.en: The investigation found several safety failures.
2871.zh: 調查發現了幾項安全缺失。

2872.explanation: 負責調查事件、問題或研究資料的人。
2872.definition: a person whose job is to investigate events, problems, or evidence
2872.en: The investigator interviewed everyone who had seen the accident.
2872.zh: 調查員訪問了所有目擊事故的人。

2873.explanation: 請某人參加活動、造訪某處或做某事的請求。
2873.definition: a request asking someone to attend an event, visit a place, or do something
2873.en: I received an invitation to the graduation ceremony.
2873.zh: 我收到畢業典禮的邀請。

2874.explanation: 請某人參加活動、到某處或做某事。
2874.definition: to ask someone to attend an event, come somewhere, or do something
2874.en: We invited our neighbors to dinner.
2874.zh: 我們邀請鄰居來吃晚餐。

2875.explanation: 包含某事作為必要部分，或使某人參與其中。
2875.definition: to include something as a necessary part, or cause someone to take part
2875.en: The project involves students from three different schools.
2875.zh: 這個計畫涉及三所不同學校的學生。

2875.explanation: 參與某活動或與某事有關的狀態或程度。
2875.definition: the state or degree of taking part in or being connected with something
2875.en: Parental involvement can support children's learning.
2875.zh: 家長的參與可以支持孩子的學習。

2876.explanation: 一種金屬元素；也指用來燙平衣物的器具。
2876.definition: a strong metallic element, or a device used for pressing clothes
2876.en: Iron is widely used in construction and manufacturing.
2876.zh: 鐵廣泛用於建築與製造。

2876.definition: to make clothes smooth by pressing them with a heated iron
2876.en: She ironed the shirt before the meeting.

2876.explanation: 由鐵製成，或比喻堅定、強硬的。
2876.definition: made of iron, or figuratively very strong and firm
2876.en: The old gate has an iron frame.
2876.zh: 那扇舊門有鐵製的框架。

2877.explanation: 結果與原先預期形成明顯反差，因而帶有諷刺意味的。
2877.definition: strangely opposite to what is expected, often in a way that seems amusing or meaningful
2877.en: It was ironic that the fire station itself lost power.
2877.zh: 諷刺的是，消防局本身竟然停電了。

2878.explanation: 表面意思與真正意思不同，或結果與預期相反所造成的效果。
2878.definition: the use of words to express the opposite of their literal meaning, or a striking contrast between expectation and reality
2878.en: The irony of the situation was obvious to everyone.
2878.zh: 這個情況的諷刺性反差大家都看得出來。

2879.explanation: 容易生氣，或身體部位容易因刺激而不舒服。
2879.definition: easily annoyed, or easily made sore or uncomfortable by physical irritation
2879.en: Lack of sleep can make people tired and irritable.
2879.zh: 睡眠不足會讓人疲倦又易怒。

2880.explanation: 使某人生氣，或使皮膚、眼睛等感到不適。
2880.definition: to annoy someone, or cause a body part to become sore or uncomfortable
2880.en: Strong perfume can irritate sensitive eyes.
2880.zh: 濃烈的香水可能刺激敏感的眼睛。

2881.explanation: 四周被水包圍的一塊陸地。
2881.definition: an area of land completely surrounded by water
2881.en: The island can be reached by ferry in forty minutes.
2881.zh: 搭渡輪四十分鐘就能到那座島。

2882.explanation: 島嶼的文學或詩意用語，常指較小的島。
2882.definition: a literary or poetic word for an island, often a small one
2882.en: The small isle is known for its quiet beaches.
2882.zh: 那座小島以寧靜的海灘聞名。

2883.explanation: 把某人或某物與其他人事物分開。
2883.definition: to separate a person or thing from others
2883.en: The clinic isolated the patient to reduce the risk of infection.
2883.zh: 診所將病人隔離，以降低感染風險。

2884.explanation: 與他人或其他事物分開的狀態。
2884.definition: the state of being separated from other people or things
2884.en: Long periods of isolation can affect a person's well-being.
2884.zh: 長時間的孤立可能影響一個人的身心健康。

2885.explanation: 需要討論、處理或決定的重要主題或問題。
2885.definition: an important subject or problem that people discuss, consider, or decide about
2885.en: The committee discussed the issue for more than an hour.
2885.zh: 委員會討論這個議題超過一小時。

2885.explanation: 正式提供、發出或公布文件、物品或命令。
2885.definition: to officially provide, publish, or distribute something
2885.en: The bank issued a new card after the old one expired.
2885.zh: 舊卡到期後，銀行發行了一張新卡。

2886.explanation: 用來指先前提到的事物、動物、情況或概念。
2886.definition: used to refer to a thing, animal, situation, or idea already mentioned or understood
2886.en: The phone is old, but it still works well.
2886.zh: 這支手機雖然舊，但它仍然運作良好。

2887.explanation: 皮膚上讓人想抓的刺激感。
2887.definition: an uncomfortable skin sensation that makes you want to scratch
2887.en: I have an itch on my arm that will not go away.
2887.zh: 我的手臂有一處一直不退的癢感。

2887.explanation: 皮膚產生想抓的刺激感。
2887.definition: to have an uncomfortable skin sensation that makes you want to scratch
2887.en: My eyes often itch during spring.
2887.zh: 我的眼睛在春天常常會發癢。

2888.explanation: 清單、集合或一組事物中的一個單位。
2888.definition: one thing in a list, collection, or group of things
2888.en: Each item on the list has a separate price.
2888.zh: 清單上的每個項目都有各自的價格。

2889.explanation: 象牙的硬質材料，也可指淡乳白色。
2889.definition: the hard creamy-white material from elephant tusks, or a creamy-white color
2889.en: The museum keeps old ivory objects in a protected collection.
2889.zh: 博物館把古老的象牙物件保存在受保護的館藏中。

2889.explanation: 由象牙製成或呈淡乳白色的。
2889.definition: made of ivory or having a creamy-white color
2889.en: The walls were painted a soft ivory color.
2889.zh: 牆面被漆成柔和的象牙色。

2890.explanation: 一種常沿牆面或樹木攀爬生長的常綠植物。
2890.definition: an evergreen climbing plant that often grows on walls or trees
2890.en: Ivy covered most of the old brick wall.
2890.zh: 常春藤覆蓋了大部分的老磚牆。

2891.explanation: 穿在上半身、通常較短的外衣。
2891.definition: a short coat worn on the upper body
2891.en: He put on a light jacket before going outside.
2891.zh: 他出門前穿上一件薄外套。

2892.explanation: 常呈綠色、可用於飾品或雕刻的硬質寶石。
2892.definition: a hard stone, often green, used for jewelry and carving
2892.en: The exhibition includes a small bowl carved from jade.
2892.zh: 展覽中有一只以玉雕成的小碗。

2893.explanation: 依法拘留被逮捕或被判刑者的場所。
2893.definition: a place where people are held legally after arrest or conviction
2893.en: He spent several months in jail after the trial.
2893.zh: 審判後，他在監獄裡待了幾個月。

2893.definition: to put someone in jail as a legal punishment or detention
2893.en: The court jailed the offender for violating the law.
2893.zh: 法院因違法而將那名犯人監禁。

2894.explanation: 水果加糖煮成的抹醬，也可指道路或機器的堵塞。
2894.definition: a sweet fruit spread, or a situation in which traffic or machinery is blocked
2894.en: A traffic jam delayed the bus for twenty minutes.
2894.zh: 交通堵塞讓公車延誤了二十分鐘。

2894.explanation: 使通道、道路或機器因擁塞而無法順利運作。
2894.definition: to block or become stuck so that movement or operation is difficult
2894.en: A sheet of paper jammed the printer.

2895.explanation: 負責建築物清潔、維護或基本管理工作的人。
2895.definition: a person employed to clean and maintain a building
2895.en: The janitor cleaned the hallway before school opened.
2895.zh: 學校開門前，管理員清理了走廊。

2896.explanation: 有寬口、常用玻璃或陶製成的容器。
2896.definition: a wide-mouthed container, often made of glass or pottery
2896.en: She filled a glass jar with homemade honey.
2896.zh: 她把自製蜂蜜裝進玻璃罐裡。

2897.definition: a plant with small fragrant flowers
2897.en: The jasmine in the garden smells especially sweet at night.
2897.zh: 花園裡的茉莉在夜晚特別芳香。

2898.explanation: 嘴部上下兩側用來咀嚼、支撐牙齒的骨骼部分。
2898.definition: either of the bony parts of the mouth that hold the teeth and help with chewing
2898.en: His jaw was sore after the dental appointment.
2898.zh: 看完牙醫後，他的下顎有些痠痛。

2899.explanation: 起源於美國、重視節奏與即興演奏的一種音樂。
2899.definition: a style of music originating in the United States that emphasizes rhythm and improvisation
2899.en: She listens to jazz while doing homework.
2899.zh: 她做功課時會聽爵士樂。

2900.explanation: 因別人擁有自己想要的事物，或害怕失去某人的關愛而不快。
2900.definition: upset because someone has something you want, or because you fear losing someone's affection
2900.en: He felt jealous of his friend's sudden success.
2900.zh: 他對朋友突然獲得成功感到嫉妒。

2901.explanation: 因他人擁有自己想要的事物或關係而產生的不快感。
2901.definition: the feeling of being jealous of another person's possessions, success, or relationships
2901.zh: 嫉妒逐漸傷害了他們的友誼。

2902.en: These jeans are comfortable enough for a long trip.
2902.zh: 這條牛仔褲穿去長途旅行也很舒服。

2903.explanation: 適合崎嶇道路行駛的小型堅固車輛。
2903.definition: a small strong vehicle designed for rough roads or off-road use
2903.en: The jeep crossed the rough mountain road without difficulty.
2903.zh: 那輛吉普車順利通過崎嶇的山路。

2904.explanation: 柔軟、透明或半透明的凝膠狀食品或物質。
2904.definition: a soft clear or partly clear food or substance with a gel-like texture
2904.en: She spread strawberry jelly on her toast.
2904.zh: 她在吐司上抹了草莓果醬。

2905.explanation: 以噴射引擎飛行的飛機，或快速噴出的液體／氣體。
2905.definition: a jet-powered aircraft, or a fast narrow stream of liquid or gas
2905.en: The jet landed safely despite the strong wind.
2905.zh: 儘管風很強，那架噴射機仍安全降落。

2905.explanation: 快速噴出，或搭噴射機前往某地。
2905.definition: to spurt out quickly, or to travel somewhere by jet aircraft
2905.en: Water jetted from the broken pipe.
2905.zh: 水從破裂的管子快速噴出。

2906.explanation: 經切割或拋光、常用於飾品的珍貴寶石。
2906.definition: a precious stone, especially one cut and polished for use in jewelry
2906.en: The crown was decorated with several bright jewels.
2906.zh: 皇冠上裝飾著幾顆閃亮的寶石。

2907.explanation: 戒指、項鍊等以金屬或寶石製成的裝飾品總稱。
2907.definition: decorative objects such as rings and necklaces made from precious metals or stones
2907.en: She keeps her jewelry in a small wooden box.
2907.zh: 她把珠寶放在一個小木盒裡。

2908.explanation: 輕快的金屬碰撞聲，或簡短易記的宣傳曲。
2908.definition: a light ringing sound, or a short catchy tune used in advertising
2908.en: The advertising jingle stayed in my head all day.
2908.zh: 那段廣告短歌一整天都在我腦中揮之不去。

2908.explanation: 發出連續、輕快的金屬碰撞聲。
2908.definition: to make a series of light ringing sounds
2908.en: The keys jingled in his pocket as he walked.
2908.zh: 他走路時，口袋裡的鑰匙發出叮噹聲。

2909.explanation: 為獲得報酬而從事的固定工作或具體任務。
2909.definition: regular paid work or a particular piece of work to be done
2909.en: She found a part-time job at a bookstore.
2909.zh: 她在書店找到一份兼職工作。

2910.explanation: 在賽馬中騎乘馬匹的專業騎手。
2910.definition: a professional rider in horse races
2910.en: The jockey guided the horse carefully around the final turn.
2910.zh: 騎師小心地引導馬匹通過最後一個彎道。

2910.explanation: 以策略、競爭或巧妙方式使自己取得有利位置。
2910.definition: to maneuver, compete, or manipulate in order to gain an advantage
2910.en: Several companies jockeyed for a better position in the market.
2910.zh: 幾家公司設法在市場上爭取更有利的位置。

2911.explanation: 以輕鬆速度跑步，或輕輕推動某人或某物。
2911.definition: to run at a slow steady pace, or to push someone or something lightly
2911.en: I jog around the park three times a week.
2911.zh: 我每週在公園慢跑三次。

2911.explanation: 一次輕鬆、速度不快的跑步。
2911.definition: a slow steady run for exercise
2911.en: We went for a short jog before breakfast.
2911.zh: 我們早餐前去慢跑了一小段。

2912.explanation: 成為團體成員，或把兩個事物連接在一起。
2912.definition: to become a member of a group, or connect two things together
2912.en: She joined the school orchestra this semester.
2912.zh: 她這學期加入了學校管弦樂團。

2912.definition: a place where two parts are connected
2912.en: A thin line marks the join between the two panels.
2912.zh: 一條細線標示兩塊面板的接合處。

2913.explanation: 由兩人以上共同進行、擁有或負責的。
2913.definition: shared, done, owned, or controlled by two or more people or groups
2913.en: The two schools launched a joint science project.
2913.zh: 兩所學校共同啟動了一項科學計畫。

2913.explanation: 身體骨骼相連可活動的位置，或物體兩部分的連接處。
2913.definition: a place where two bones meet, or where two parts of an object are connected
2913.en: He injured a joint in his left hand.
2913.zh: 他左手的一個關節受傷了。

2914.explanation: 為逗人發笑而說的故事或話語。
2914.definition: a story or remark intended to make people laugh
2914.en: His joke made everyone at the table laugh.
2914.zh: 他的笑話讓桌邊每個人都笑了。

2914.explanation: 說笑話或說不是認真的話。
2914.definition: to say something humorous or not meant seriously
2914.en: I was only joking when I said I would quit.
2914.zh: 我說要辭職時只是在開玩笑。

2915.explanation: 快樂、友善而充滿好心情的。
2915.en: The host was cheerful and jolly throughout the party.
2915.zh: 主人整場聚會都很開朗愉快。

2915.explanation: 非正式用法，表示程度很高。
2915.en: The room was jolly cold before the heater started.
2915.zh: 暖氣啟動前，房間可是非常冷。

2915.explanation: 用友善或開玩笑的方式逗某人開心或說服某人。
2915.definition: to cheer, amuse, or persuade someone in a friendly humorous way
2915.en: She tried to jolly the children out of their bad mood.
2915.zh: 她試著逗孩子們開心，讓他們擺脫壞心情。

2915.explanation: 非正式用法，指愉快的聚會或遊玩活動。
2915.definition: a cheerful social event or outing
2915.en: The club organized a weekend jolly by the coast.
2915.zh: 社團安排了一趟週末海邊歡樂出遊。

2916.explanation: 定期出版的專業刊物，或個人記錄活動與想法的日誌。
2916.definition: a periodical publication, or a personal record of activities and thoughts
2916.en: She records her field observations in a journal.
2916.zh: 她把田野觀察記錄在日誌裡。

2917.explanation: 蒐集、撰寫、編輯與報導新聞的工作或專業。
2917.definition: the work or profession of gathering, writing, editing, and reporting news
2917.zh: 好的新聞工作需要仔細查證事實。

2918.explanation: 蒐集、撰寫或報導新聞的人。
2918.definition: a person who gathers, writes, or reports news
2918.en: The journalist interviewed witnesses at the scene.
2918.zh: 這位記者在現場訪問了目擊者。

2919.explanation: 從一地前往另一地的一段旅行。
2919.definition: an act of traveling from one place to another
2919.en: The train journey through the mountains took six hours.
2919.zh: 穿越山區的火車旅程花了六小時。

2919.explanation: 從一地前往另一地，通常指較長距離或有目的的行程。
2919.definition: to travel from one place to another, especially over a significant distance
2919.en: They journeyed north in search of safer land.
2919.zh: 他們向北旅行，尋找更安全的土地。

2920.definition: a feeling of great happiness and pleasure
2920.en: The children shouted with joy when the team returned.
2920.zh: 隊伍回來時，孩子們高興地歡呼。

2921.explanation: 充滿快樂或帶來快樂的。
2921.en: It was a joyful reunion after many years apart.
2921.zh: 多年分離後，這是一場喜悅的重逢。

2922.explanation: 非常快樂、值得慶祝或充滿喜悅的。
2922.definition: very happy, celebratory, or full of joy
2922.en: The graduation ceremony was a joyous occasion for the whole family.
2922.zh: 畢業典禮對全家而言是值得歡慶的時刻。

2923.explanation: 在法院作出法律裁決的人，或在競賽中評分的人。
2923.definition: a person who decides legal cases, or evaluates performances in a competition
2923.en: The judge listened carefully to both sides of the case.
2923.zh: 法官仔細聽取案件雙方的說法。

2923.explanation: 根據證據、標準或印象作出決定或評價。
2923.definition: to form an opinion or decision based on evidence, standards, or impressions
2923.en: Do not judge a person only by first impressions.
2923.zh: 不要只憑第一印象評斷一個人。

2924.explanation: 經考量後形成的決定、看法，或作出良好決定的能力。
2924.definition: a decision or opinion reached after consideration, or the ability to make sensible decisions
2924.en: She showed good judgment by checking the facts first.
2924.zh: 她先查證事實，展現了良好的判斷力。

2925.explanation: 有把手、用來盛裝與倒出液體的容器。
2925.definition: a container with a handle used for holding and pouring liquids
2925.en: She filled the jug with cold water.

2925.explanation: 把食物或液體放入壺中，或以壺密封燉煮。
2925.definition: to put something into a jug, or cook food slowly in a covered jug
2925.en: The cook jugged the meat slowly with herbs.
2925.zh: 廚師把肉和香草放在壺中慢燉。

2926.explanation: 水果、蔬菜或其他物質中擠出或自然含有的液體。
2926.definition: the liquid contained in or extracted from fruit, vegetables, or other substances
2926.en: He poured fresh orange juice into a glass.
2926.zh: 他把新鮮柳橙汁倒進杯子裡。

2927.explanation: 含有很多汁液的，也可非正式指內容有趣或引人注意的。
2927.definition: containing a lot of juice, or informally very interesting or exciting
2927.en: The peaches are ripe, sweet, and juicy.
2927.zh: 這些桃子成熟、香甜而多汁。

2928.explanation: 用腳或身體力量使自己突然離開地面或移動。
2928.definition: to push yourself suddenly off the ground or move quickly by springing
2928.en: The child jumped over the puddle.

2928.explanation: 一次跳躍，也可指數量或程度突然上升。
2928.definition: an act of jumping, or a sudden increase in amount or level
2928.en: There was a sudden jump in electricity prices.

2929.explanation: 道路、鐵路或其他路線相交或連接的位置。
2929.definition: a place where roads, railways, or other routes meet or connect
2929.en: The highway junction connects three major routes.
2929.zh: 這個公路交會處連接三條主要路線。

2930.explanation: 炎熱地區中植被非常茂密的森林。
2930.definition: a dense tropical forest with thick vegetation
2930.en: The researchers spent a week working in the jungle.
2930.zh: 研究人員在叢林裡工作了一週。

2931.explanation: 職位、年齡或地位較低的。
2931.definition: lower in rank, status, or age
2931.en: She started in a junior position and was promoted two years later.
2931.zh: 她從資淺職位做起，兩年後獲得升遷。

2931.explanation: 年齡、職位或地位較低的人。
2931.definition: a person who is younger or lower in rank or status
2931.en: He is two years her junior.

2932.explanation: 不需要、價值很低或應丟棄的東西。
2932.definition: unwanted or low-value things that are thrown away or no longer useful
2932.en: The garage was filled with old furniture and other junk.
2932.zh: 車庫裡堆滿舊家具和其他廢物。

2932.explanation: 因認為不再有用而把某物丟掉或停止使用。
2932.definition: to discard something because it is no longer wanted or useful
2932.en: They decided to junk the broken machine instead of repairing it.
2932.zh: 他們決定丟掉壞掉的機器，不再修理。

2933.explanation: 在法院中聽取證據並對案件事實作出裁決的一群人。
2933.definition: a group of people who hear evidence in court and decide the facts of a case
2933.en: The jury returned a verdict after several hours of discussion.
2933.zh: 陪審團討論數小時後作出裁決。

2934.explanation: 表示時間很近、程度恰好，或限制範圍。
2934.definition: used to mean a very short time ago, exactly, or only

2934.explanation: 依照公平、道德或合理原則判斷的。
2934.definition: fair, morally right, or based on reasonable principles
2934.zh: 每個人都應得到公正的決定。

2935.explanation: 公平對待的原則，也可指法律與司法制度。
2935.definition: fairness in the way people are treated, or the administration of law
2935.en: The court system is meant to protect justice.
2935.zh: 法院制度的目的之一是維護正義。

2936.explanation: 提出充分理由說明某事是正當、合理或必要的。
2936.definition: to show or give reasons that something is right, reasonable, or necessary
2936.en: You need strong evidence to justify that conclusion.
2936.zh: 你需要有力證據來證明那個結論合理。

2937.explanation: 與兒童或青少年有關的。
2937.definition: relating to children or young people
2937.en: The center provides services for juvenile readers.
2937.zh: 這個中心為青少年讀者提供服務。

2937.definition: a young person who is not yet an adult
2937.en: The program is designed for juveniles.
2937.zh: 這個計畫是為青少年設計的。

2938.explanation: 澳洲原生、以強健後腿跳躍移動的有袋類動物。
2938.definition: a large Australian marsupial that moves by jumping on strong hind legs
2938.en: A kangaroo can travel long distances by jumping.
2938.zh: 袋鼠可以靠跳躍移動很長的距離。

2939.explanation: 非常有興趣、渴望做某事，或感官與判斷很敏銳的。
2939.definition: very interested or eager, or sharp and perceptive
2939.en: She is keen on learning new languages.

2940.explanation: 使某人或某物維持某狀態，或繼續擁有、進行。
2940.definition: to continue to have, hold, or maintain something or a state
2940.en: Please keep the door closed during the meeting.
2940.zh: 開會期間請保持門關著。

2940.explanation: 維持某人生活所需的食物、住所或費用。
2940.definition: the food, shelter, or money needed to support someone
2940.en: The job provided enough money for his keep.
2940.zh: 這份工作提供了足夠的生活費。

2941.explanation: 負責照管、保護或管理某人、動物或物品的人。
2941.definition: a person who looks after, protects, or manages someone or something
2941.en: The museum keeper checked the room before closing.
2941.zh: 博物館管理員在閉館前檢查了房間。

2942.explanation: 通常以番茄、醋與調味料製成的濃稠醬料。
2942.definition: a thick sauce usually made from tomatoes, vinegar, and seasonings
2942.en: He added a little ketchup to his sandwich.
2942.zh: 他在三明治裡加了一點番茄醬。

2943.explanation: 用來燒水或盛裝熱水的容器。
2943.definition: a container used for boiling or holding water

2944.explanation: 對結果或理解特別重要的。
2944.definition: especially important to a result or understanding
2944.en: Clear communication is a key skill in teamwork.
2944.zh: 清楚溝通是團隊合作中的關鍵能力。

2944.explanation: 開鎖用的工具，也可指解決問題的重要因素。
2944.definition: an object used to open a lock, or an important means of understanding or solving something
2944.en: I found the key under the notebook.
2944.zh: 我在筆記本下面找到鑰匙。

2944.definition: to enter information using a keyboard
2944.en: She keyed the numbers into the computer.

2945.explanation: 電腦、樂器或其他設備上一組按鍵。
2945.definition: a set of keys used to operate a computer, musical instrument, or other device
2945.en: This keyboard is quieter than my old one.
2945.zh: 這個鍵盤比我舊的那個安靜。

2946.definition: to strike something with the foot
2946.en: He kicked the ball toward the goal.

2946.explanation: 用腳做出的快速碰擊動作。
2946.definition: an act of striking with the foot
2946.en: One strong kick sent the ball across the field.
2946.zh: 有力的一踢讓球越過球場。

2947.explanation: 非正式用語，指兒童或年輕人。
2947.definition: an informal word for a child or young person
2947.en: The kids were waiting for the school bus.

2947.explanation: 以不認真的方式說話或逗弄他人。
2947.definition: to joke or tease someone without being serious
2947.en: I was only kidding about the surprise.
2947.zh: 我只是在拿那個驚喜開玩笑。

2948.definition: to take a person away illegally and keep them captive
2948.en: The law treats any attempt to kidnap a person as a serious crime.
2948.zh: 法律把任何綁架他人的企圖視為嚴重犯罪。

2949.explanation: 身體內過濾血液並產生尿液的一對器官之一。
2949.definition: one of a pair of organs that filter the blood and produce urine
2949.en: Each kidney helps remove waste from the blood.
2949.zh: 每個腎臟都有助於把廢物從血液中移除。

2950.definition: to cause a person, animal, or living thing to die
2950.en: A sudden frost can kill young plants.
2950.zh: 突如其來的霜凍可能使幼苗枯死。

2950.explanation: 一次殺死獵物或動物的行為或結果。
2950.definition: an act or result of killing an animal or prey
2950.en: The documentary showed how the predator guarded its kill.
2950.zh: 紀錄片呈現了掠食動物如何守著獵獲物。

2951.explanation: 等於一千公克的重量單位。
2951.definition: a unit of mass equal to one thousand grams

2952.explanation: 等於一千公尺的距離單位。
2952.definition: a unit of distance equal to one thousand meters
2952.en: The station is about one kilometer away.

2953.explanation: 與某人有血緣或家族關係的人們。
2953.definition: people related to someone by blood or family ties
2953.en: Many of her kin still live in the same town.
2953.zh: 她的許多親屬仍住在同一個城鎮。

2953.explanation: 彼此有家族、來源或性質上的關聯。
2953.definition: related by family, origin, or nature
2953.en: The two languages are kin in origin.
2953.zh: 這兩種語言在來源上有親緣關係。

2954.explanation: 對他人友善、關心並願意幫助的。
2954.definition: friendly, caring, and willing to help others
2954.en: It was kind of you to help your classmate.
2954.zh: 你幫助同學真的很體貼。

2954.explanation: 具有共同特徵的一類人或事物。
2954.definition: a type or category of people or things sharing characteristics
2954.en: What kind of music do you like?
2954.zh: 你喜歡哪一種類型的音樂？

2955.explanation: 兒童進入小學前接受教育與活動的學校或班級。
2955.definition: a school or class for young children before primary school
2955.en: Her little brother starts kindergarten next month.
2955.zh: 她的弟弟下個月開始上幼兒園。

2956.explanation: 使火開始燃燒，或引發情感、興趣或想法。
2956.definition: to start a fire, or cause a feeling, interest, or idea to begin
2956.en: The story kindled his interest in astronomy.
2956.zh: 這個故事激起了他對天文學的興趣。

2957.definition: a male monarch who rules a country or kingdom
2957.en: The king addressed the people from the palace.
2957.zh: 國王從王宮向人民發表談話。

2958.explanation: 由國王或女王統治的國家，也可指某一類事物的領域。
2958.definition: a country ruled by a king or queen, or a particular realm or field
2958.en: The old kingdom once controlled the whole valley.
2958.zh: 那個古老王國曾經統治整個山谷。

2959.explanation: 以嘴唇輕觸某人或某物的動作。
2959.definition: an act of touching someone or something with the lips
2959.en: She gave the baby a quick kiss on the forehead.
2959.zh: 她在寶寶額頭上輕輕親了一下。

2959.explanation: 以嘴唇輕觸某人或某物。
2959.definition: to touch someone or something with the lips
2959.en: The mother kissed her child good night.
2959.zh: 母親親了孩子一下道晚安。

2960.explanation: 為特定用途準備的一組工具或物品。
2960.definition: a set of tools or equipment prepared for a particular purpose
2960.en: The repair kit includes several useful tools.
2960.zh: 這套修理工具包含幾樣實用工具。

2961.explanation: 準備與烹調食物的房間或區域。
2961.definition: a room or area where food is prepared and cooked
2961.en: We ate breakfast at the kitchen table.
2961.zh: 我們在廚房餐桌旁吃早餐。

2962.explanation: 以線控制、利用風力在空中飛行的輕型玩具。
2962.definition: a light toy flown in the air at the end of a string
2962.en: The children flew a kite in the park.

2963.explanation: 腿部大腿與小腿相接的關節。
2963.definition: the joint between the upper and lower parts of the leg
2963.en: She hurt her knee while running.

2963.explanation: 用膝部碰到或撞到某物。
2963.definition: to hit or touch something with the knee
2963.en: The verb knee means to make contact with the knee.
2963.zh: 動詞 knee 表示用膝部碰到某物。

2964.definition: to go down or remain with one or both knees on the ground
2964.en: He had to kneel to reach the low shelf.
2964.zh: 他得跪下才能拿到低處的架子。

2965.explanation: 具有刀刃、用於切割的工具或餐具。
2965.definition: a tool or utensil with a blade used for cutting
2965.en: The table setting included a fork and a knife.
2965.zh: 餐桌擺設裡有叉子和餐刀。

2965.explanation: 以刀具切開某物的少見用法。
2965.definition: to cut something with a knife
2965.en: Some dictionaries list knife as a rare verb.
2965.zh: 有些字典把 knife 列為少見的動詞用法。

2966.explanation: 中世紀受封、常為君主服役的武士。
2966.definition: a medieval soldier of noble rank who served a ruler
2966.en: The story is about a knight who serves the king.
2966.zh: 這個故事講的是一位侍奉國王的騎士。

2967.explanation: 用毛線或紗線交織成衣物或布料。
2967.definition: to make clothing or fabric by interlocking loops of yarn
2967.en: My grandmother likes to knit scarves in winter.
2967.zh: 我祖母冬天喜歡織圍巾。

2967.explanation: 針織的布料、衣物或編織方式。
2967.definition: knitted fabric, clothing, or a style of knitting
2967.en: This sweater has a loose knit.
2967.zh: 這件毛衣的針織結構比較鬆。

2968.explanation: 門、抽屜或設備上可抓握或轉動的圓形突出物。
2968.definition: a rounded handle or control that can be grasped or turned
2968.en: Turn the knob to lower the volume.
2968.zh: 轉動旋鈕可以把音量調低。

2969.explanation: 用手或物體敲擊表面，或使物體相撞。
2969.definition: to strike a surface or cause things to hit each other
2969.en: Please knock before entering the office.

2969.explanation: 一次敲擊或其產生的聲音。
2969.definition: an act or sound of striking a surface
2969.en: I heard a knock at the door.

2970.explanation: 繩、線等纏繞並拉緊形成的結。
2970.definition: a fastening made by tying rope, string, or similar material
2970.en: There is a knot in the rope.

2970.definition: to tie rope, string, or similar material into a knot
2970.zh: 那條繩子在收納時打結了。

2971.explanation: 擁有某事的資訊、理解，或與某人熟識。
2971.definition: to have information or understanding about something, or be familiar with someone
2971.en: I know the answer to this question.

2972.explanation: 透過學習、經驗或理解獲得的資訊與認識。
2972.definition: information and understanding gained through learning or experience
2972.en: Reading helps us build knowledge over time.
2972.zh: 閱讀能幫助我們逐漸累積知識。

2973.explanation: 對某主題知道很多或具充分了解的。
2973.definition: having a lot of knowledge about a subject
2973.en: The guide is very knowledgeable about local history.
2973.zh: 這位導覽員非常熟悉當地歷史。

2974.explanation: 澳洲樹棲有袋類動物，主要以尤加利葉為食。
2974.definition: an Australian tree-dwelling marsupial that mainly eats eucalyptus leaves
2974.en: A koala spends much of the day resting in trees.
2974.zh: 無尾熊一天中有很長時間在樹上休息。

2975.explanation: 附在物品上提供名稱、資訊或分類的小片標示。
2975.definition: a piece of paper or other material attached to something to give information
2975.en: Read the label before washing the shirt.
2975.zh: 洗這件襯衫前先看標籤。

2975.explanation: 為某物加上標示，或把人事物歸入某一類。
2975.definition: to attach a label to something, or classify someone or something
2975.en: The boxes were labeled by size.
2975.zh: 這些箱子依尺寸貼上了標示。

2976.explanation: 工作所付出的體力或努力，也可指勞工群體。
2976.definition: physical work or effort, or workers considered as a group
2976.en: The project required months of careful labor.
2976.zh: 這個計畫需要數月細心的勞動。

2976.definition: to work hard, especially for a long time
2976.en: They labored for hours to finish the report.
2976.zh: 他們辛苦工作好幾個小時才完成報告。

2977.explanation: 進行科學實驗、檢驗或研究的房間或建築。
2977.definition: a room or building equipped for scientific experiments, tests, or research
2977.en: The students conducted the experiment in the laboratory.
2977.zh: 學生們在實驗室進行實驗。

2978.explanation: 裝飾用的鏤空織物，也可指鞋帶或細繩。
2978.definition: decorative openwork fabric, or a cord used for fastening shoes
2978.en: The dress has a narrow strip of lace.
2978.zh: 這件洋裝有一道窄窄的蕾絲。

2978.explanation: 用鞋帶或細繩穿過孔洞並固定。
2978.definition: to fasten or thread something with a lace or cord
2978.en: She laced her shoes before leaving.

2979.explanation: 需要或想要之物不足的狀態。
2979.definition: the state of not having enough of something needed or wanted
2979.en: A lack of sleep can make it hard to focus.
2979.zh: 睡眠不足可能讓人難以專心。

2979.definition: to not have enough of something
2979.en: The room lacks enough natural light.
2979.zh: 這個房間缺少足夠的自然光。

2980.explanation: 較舊或非正式用語，指男孩或年輕男子。
2980.definition: an old-fashioned or informal word for a boy or young man
2980.en: The old story follows a young lad from a fishing village.
2980.zh: 這個老故事描述一名來自漁村的年輕小伙子。

2981.explanation: 由兩根長桿與多個橫檔組成、供上下攀爬的工具。
2981.definition: a piece of equipment with steps or rungs used for climbing up or down
2981.en: The painter used a ladder to reach the ceiling.
2981.zh: 油漆工用梯子碰到天花板附近的位置。

2982.explanation: 對女性較禮貌或較正式的稱呼。
2982.definition: a polite or formal word for a woman
2982.en: A lady at the desk showed us where to go.
2982.zh: 櫃檯的一位女士告訴我們該往哪裡走。

2983.explanation: 小型甲蟲，通常有紅色或橘色翅鞘與黑色斑點。
2983.definition: a small beetle, often red or orange with black spots
2983.en: A ladybug landed on the leaf.

2984.explanation: 時間、進度或表現上的落後或延遲。
2984.definition: a delay or gap in time, progress, or performance
2984.en: There was a short lag between the sound and the video.
2984.zh: 聲音與影像之間有短暫延遲。

2984.explanation: 比預期或其他人進展得慢。
2984.definition: to fall behind or move more slowly than expected
2984.en: Our team began to lag behind after the break.
2984.zh: 休息後，我們的隊伍開始落後。

2985.explanation: 被陸地包圍的大型水域。
2985.definition: a large area of water surrounded by land
2985.en: We walked around the lake at sunset.
2985.zh: 我們在日落時繞湖散步。

2986.explanation: 幼小的綿羊，也可指其肉。
2986.definition: a young sheep, or its meat
2986.en: A young lamb followed its mother across the field.
2986.zh: 一隻小羊跟著母羊走過田野。

2986.definition: for a sheep to give birth to lambs
2986.en: The sheep usually lamb in early spring.
2986.zh: 這些綿羊通常在初春產羔。

2987.definition: a device that produces artificial light
2987.en: She turned on the desk lamp to read.

2988.explanation: 地球表面的固體部分，或一塊土地。
2988.definition: the solid part of the earth, or an area of ground
2988.en: The family owns a small piece of land near the river.
2988.zh: 這家人在河邊擁有一小塊土地。

2988.explanation: 從空中降到地面，或從水上到達陸地。
2988.definition: to come down to the ground or arrive on land
2988.en: The plane landed safely despite the rain.
2988.zh: 儘管下雨，飛機仍安全著陸。

2989.explanation: 出租房屋或房間給他人的女性。
2989.definition: a woman who rents a house or room to someone
2989.en: The landlady lives upstairs and is very helpful.
2989.zh: 女房東住在樓上，而且很樂於幫忙。

2990.explanation: 出租房屋、土地或建築物的人。
2990.definition: a person who rents property to another person
2990.en: The landlord repaired the broken window.
2990.zh: 房東修好了破掉的窗戶。

2991.explanation: 容易辨認的重要地點，或具有重大意義的事件。
2991.definition: an important recognizable place, or a significant event
2991.en: The old tower is a famous local landmark.
2991.zh: 那座老塔是當地著名地標。

2992.explanation: 某地區可見的自然或人造景觀。
2992.definition: the visible features of an area of land
2992.en: The mountain landscape was covered in morning mist.
2992.zh: 山區景色籠罩在晨霧中。

2992.explanation: 規劃或改造戶外環境，使其更美觀實用。
2992.definition: to design or improve the visible features of outdoor land
2992.en: They landscaped the garden with native plants.
2992.zh: 他們用原生植物美化花園景觀。

2993.explanation: 大量土石從斜坡滑落；也可比喻選舉中的大勝。
2993.definition: a large mass of earth moving down a slope, or a very large victory
2993.en: Heavy rain caused a landslide on the mountain road.
2993.zh: 大雨造成山路發生山崩。

2994.explanation: 道路上供車輛使用的一條通道，或狹窄小路。
2994.definition: a marked part of a road for traffic, or a narrow road
2994.en: Stay in your lane until it is safe to change.
2994.zh: 在安全換道前請保持在自己的車道。

2995.explanation: 人們用語音、文字或手勢溝通的系統。
2995.definition: a system of communication using words, sounds, or signs
2995.en: Language helps people share ideas and feelings.
2995.zh: 語言幫助人們分享想法與感受。

2996.explanation: 有外殼保護光源、可攜帶或懸掛的燈。
2996.definition: a portable or hanging light protected by a case
2996.en: A lantern hung beside the front door.

2997.explanation: 坐著時腰到膝蓋間的部位；也可指賽道的一圈。
2997.definition: the area from the waist to the knees when seated, or one circuit of a track
2997.en: The child fell asleep on his father's lap.
2997.zh: 孩子在父親的大腿上睡著了。

2998.explanation: 尺寸、數量或程度超過一般的。
2998.definition: big in size, amount, or degree
2998.en: A large crowd gathered outside the theater.
2998.zh: 一大群人聚集在劇院外。

2999.explanation: 表示某事在很大程度上如此。
2999.definition: mainly or to a great extent
2999.zh: 這個計畫大致上很成功。

3000.explanation: 能產生高度集中光束的裝置或光線。
3000.definition: a device or beam producing a highly concentrated form of light
3000.en: The scanner uses a laser to read the code.
3000.zh: 掃描器利用雷射讀取條碼。

3001.explanation: 一系列中的最後一個人或事物。
3001.definition: the final person or thing in a series
3001.en: She was the last to leave the classroom.
3001.zh: 她是最後一個離開教室的人。

3001.explanation: 在一段時間內繼續存在或保持可用。
3001.definition: to continue for a period of time
3001.en: The battery should last all day.
3001.zh: 這顆電池應該可以撐一整天。

3001.explanation: 表示某事在其他事情之後或最近一次發生。
3001.definition: after all others, or on the most recent occasion
3001.en: I last saw him at the school festival.
3001.zh: 我上次看到他是在校慶。

3001.explanation: 位於一系列末尾，或指最近一次的。
3001.definition: coming after all others, or referring to the most recent one
3001.en: The last chapter explains the main idea clearly.
3001.zh: 最後一章清楚說明了主要概念。

3002.explanation: 發生時間比預期晚，或接近某時段末尾。
3002.definition: happening after the expected time or near the end of a period
3002.en: The train was ten minutes late.

3002.definition: at a time later than expected
3002.en: We arrived late because of traffic.

3003.explanation: 在不久以前到現在的一段時間內。
3003.definition: recently or in the period just before now
3003.en: I have been reading more lately.

3004.definition: at a time after the present or after another time
3004.en: We can discuss the details later.
3004.zh: 我們可以晚一點再討論細節。

3005.en: Have you seen the latest version of the app?
3005.zh: 你看過這個應用程式的最新版本嗎？

3006.explanation: 地球表面南北位置的角度；也可指行動上的自由空間。
3006.definition: the angular distance north or south of the equator, or freedom to act
3006.en: Taipei and Kaohsiung are at different latitudes.
3006.zh: 台北和高雄位於不同緯度。

3007.explanation: 兩者中第二個，或接近一段時間末尾的。
3007.definition: the second of two things mentioned, or nearer the end of a period
3007.en: Of the two options, I prefer the latter.
3007.zh: 這兩個選項中，我比較喜歡後者。

3008.explanation: 因覺得有趣或開心而發出笑聲。
3008.definition: to make the sounds and movements of smiling amusement
3008.zh: 這個笑話讓大家都笑了。

3008.definition: an act or sound of laughing
3008.en: His laugh was easy to recognize.

3009.definition: the sound or act of people laughing
3009.en: Laughter filled the room after the funny story.
3009.zh: 有趣的故事說完後，房間裡充滿笑聲。

3010.explanation: 使新產品、計畫或活動開始公開運作。
3010.definition: to start or introduce a new product, project, or activity
3010.en: The company will launch a new service next month.
3010.zh: 公司下個月將推出新服務。

3010.explanation: 新產品、計畫或活動正式開始。
3010.definition: the official start or introduction of a product, project, or activity
3010.en: The product launch attracted a lot of attention.
3010.zh: 產品發表吸引了許多關注。

3011.explanation: 需要清洗或已洗好的衣物，也可指洗衣這件事。
3011.definition: clothes that need washing or have been washed, or the work of washing them
3011.en: I need to do the laundry this evening.

3012.explanation: 昂貴華麗，或在數量上非常充足的。
3012.definition: rich, expensive, or provided in a very generous amount
3012.en: They prepared a lavish dinner for the guests.
3012.zh: 他們為客人準備了豐盛的晚餐。

3013.explanation: 由政府或社會制定並執行的規則。
3013.definition: a rule or system of rules made and enforced by authority
3013.zh: 每個人都必須遵守法律。

3014.en: The court confirmed that the agreement was lawful.
3014.zh: 法院確認該協議是合法的。

3015.explanation: 參與制定法律的人，通常是議會成員。
3015.definition: a person who helps make laws, usually as a member of a legislature
3015.en: The lawmaker spoke about the proposed bill.
3015.zh: 這位立法者談到了提議中的法案。

3016.explanation: 住宅、公園等處修剪整齊的草地。
3016.definition: an area of short, regularly cut grass
3016.en: The children played on the lawn.

3017.explanation: 由法院處理的法律爭議案件。
3017.definition: a legal case brought before a court
3017.en: The company settled the lawsuit before trial.
3017.zh: 公司在審判前和解了這起訴訟。

3018.explanation: 受過法律訓練、提供法律服務的人。
3018.definition: a person trained and qualified to give legal advice or represent others
3018.en: She asked a lawyer for legal advice.
3018.zh: 她向律師尋求法律建議。

3019.explanation: 把某物放在表面上，或指鳥類等產卵。
3019.definition: to put something down in a particular place, or for a bird to produce an egg
3019.en: Please lay the books on the table.

3020.explanation: 覆蓋在另一物體上的一層材料或事物。
3020.definition: a level or thickness of material covering another surface
3020.en: A thin layer of ice covered the road.
Layer the fruit and yogurt in the glass.
3020.zh: 把水果和優格一層層放進杯子裡。

3021.explanation: 對某專業領域沒有受過專門訓練的人。
3021.definition: a person without specialist or professional knowledge in a subject
3021.en: The guide explains the topic for a layman.
3021.zh: 這份指南用非專業人士也能懂的方式解釋這個主題。

3022.explanation: 空間、頁面或物件的安排方式。
3022.definition: the way in which parts of a page, space, or object are arranged
3022.en: The new layout makes the page easier to read.
3022.zh: 新的版面配置讓頁面更容易閱讀。

3023.explanation: 不想工作、努力或活動的。
3023.definition: unwilling to work, make an effort, or be active
3023.en: He felt lazy on the rainy afternoon.
3023.zh: 下雨的午後，他覺得懶洋洋的。

3024.explanation: 走在前面引導，或造成某個結果。
3024.definition: to guide from the front or cause a particular result
3024.en: She will lead the discussion tomorrow.

3024.explanation: 領先的地位或可幫助找出答案的資訊。
3024.definition: a leading position or information that may help solve a problem
3024.en: Our team took the lead in the second half.
3024.zh: 我們隊在下半場取得領先。

3025.explanation: 帶領或指導團體、組織的人。
3025.definition: a person who guides or directs a group or organization
3025.en: A good leader listens to the team.
3025.zh: 好的領導者會傾聽團隊意見。

3026.explanation: 帶領他人的行為、角色或能力。
3026.definition: the action, position, or ability of leading people
3026.en: The course helped her develop leadership skills.
3026.zh: 這門課幫助她培養領導能力。

3027.explanation: 植物枝幹上通常呈扁平綠色的部分。
3027.definition: a usually flat green part growing from a plant stem
3027.en: A yellow leaf fell from the tree.

3028.explanation: 為共同目的組成的團體，或體育競賽組織。
3028.definition: a group formed for a common purpose, or an organized sports competition
3028.en: The club joined a local sports league.
3028.zh: 這個社團加入了當地的體育聯賽。

3028.explanation: 與他人或團體聯合合作。
3028.definition: to join with others for a common purpose
3028.en: Several groups leagued together to support the project.
3028.zh: 幾個團體聯合起來支持這項計畫。

3029.explanation: 液體、氣體或資訊意外流出的地方或情況。
3029.definition: a place or situation where liquid, gas, or information escapes
3029.en: A small leak appeared under the sink.
3029.zh: 水槽下方出現了小漏水處。

3029.explanation: 從破口流出，或讓資訊被不當公開。
3029.definition: to escape through an opening, or allow information to become known
3029.en: Water began to leak from the pipe.

3030.explanation: 把身體或物體靠向某方向。
3030.definition: to bend or rest in a sloping position
3030.en: She leaned against the wall while waiting.

3030.explanation: 含脂肪少的，或身體瘦而結實的。
3030.definition: containing little fat, or thin and fit
3030.en: Choose a lean cut of meat for the soup.
3030.zh: 煮湯時可以選脂肪較少的瘦肉。

3031.explanation: 一次跳躍，或數量突然明顯改變。
3031.definition: a jump, or a sudden large change in amount
3031.en: There was a sudden leap in online orders.
3031.zh: 網路訂單突然大幅增加。

3031.explanation: 突然跳起或快速大幅增加。
3031.definition: to jump suddenly or rise quickly by a large amount
3031.en: The cat leaped onto the chair.

3032.explanation: 透過學習或經驗獲得知識，也可指得知消息。
3032.definition: to gain knowledge through study or experience, or find out information
3032.en: Students learn faster when they practice regularly.
3032.zh: 學生規律練習時會學得更快。

3033.explanation: 具有大量知識，或與學術研究有關的。
3033.definition: having extensive knowledge, or relating to scholarly study
3033.en: The learned professor explained the topic clearly.
3033.zh: 這位博學的教授清楚地解釋了這個主題。

3034.explanation: 獲得知識或技能的過程，也可指所學到的知識。
3034.definition: the process of gaining knowledge or skills, or knowledge gained through study
3034.en: Daily reading is an important part of language learning.
3034.zh: 每天閱讀是語言學習的重要部分。

3035.explanation: 允許某人在一定期間使用房屋、土地或設備的法律協議。
3035.definition: a legal agreement allowing someone to use property or equipment for a period of time
3035.en: They signed a one-year lease for the apartment.
3035.zh: 他們為這間公寓簽了一年租約。

3036.explanation: 表示數量、程度或可能性是最低的。
3036.definition: to the smallest amount, degree, or extent

3036.explanation: 指數量或程度最少的部分。
3036.en: I expected the least from the smallest team.
3036.zh: 我原本對最小的團隊期待最少。

3036.en: Choose the route with the least traffic.

3037.explanation: 經處理後可製作衣物、鞋子等的動物皮。
3037.definition: animal skin treated for use in clothing, shoes, and other goods
3037.en: The bag is made of leather.

3038.explanation: 離開某地，或把某物留在某處。
3038.definition: to go away from a place, or to keep something in a particular place
3038.en: We should leave before the rain starts.
3038.zh: 我們應該在下雨前離開。

3038.explanation: 經允許暫時離開工作或職責的一段時間。
3038.definition: a period of permitted absence from work or duty
3038.en: She is on medical leave this week.

3039.explanation: 向一群人就某主題進行的正式教學或說明。
3039.definition: a formal talk given to teach or explain a subject to a group
3039.en: The professor gave a lecture on climate science.
3039.zh: 教授做了一場氣候科學的講課。

3039.explanation: 向一群人正式講解，也可指嚴肅地勸告某人。
3039.definition: to give a formal talk, or to speak to someone seriously about their behavior
3039.en: He lectures on history at the university.

3040.explanation: 在大學或其他教育機構授課的人。
3040.definition: a person who teaches by giving lectures, especially at a college or university
3040.en: The lecturer answered questions after class.
3040.zh: 講師在下課後回答問題。

3041.explanation: 位於身體或物體左側的。
3041.definition: on or toward the side opposite the right
3041.en: Use the left door to enter the hall.
3041.zh: 請從左邊的門進入大廳。

3041.en: The bank is on your left.

3041.definition: toward or on the left side
3041.en: Turn left at the next corner.

3042.explanation: 人或動物用來站立和行走的肢體，也可指家具的支腳。
3042.definition: a limb used for standing and walking, or a supporting part of furniture
3042.en: He hurt his leg during practice.

3043.explanation: 由過去留下並影響後來的事物、成就或影響。
3043.definition: something handed down from the past that continues to have an effect
3043.en: The scientist left a lasting legacy.
3043.zh: 這位科學家留下了長遠的影響。

3044.explanation: 符合法律，或與法律有關的。
3044.definition: allowed by law, or relating to the law
3044.en: It is legal to park here after six.
3044.zh: 六點後在這裡停車是合法的。

3045.explanation: 流傳很久的故事，也可指非常知名或受敬重的人。
3045.definition: an old traditional story, or a person who is extremely famous or admired
3045.en: The village has an old legend about the mountain.
3045.zh: 這個村莊流傳著一則關於那座山的古老傳說。

3046.explanation: 因卓越、特別或流傳已久而非常有名的。
3046.definition: very famous because of remarkable qualities or long-standing stories
3046.zh: 她成為一位傳奇運動員。

3047.explanation: 制定法律的過程，或已制定的一組法律。
3047.definition: the process of making laws, or laws considered as a group
3047.en: The new legislation aims to protect consumers.
3047.zh: 這項新法規旨在保護消費者。

3048.explanation: 與制定法律的機構或過程有關的。
3048.definition: relating to the making of laws or a lawmaking body
3048.en: The committee discussed the legislative process.
3048.zh: 委員會討論了立法程序。

3049.definition: a person who makes or helps make laws
3049.en: The legislator spoke at the public meeting.
3049.zh: 這位立法者在公開會議上發言。

3050.explanation: 符合法律、規則或合理標準的。
3050.definition: allowed by law or rules, or reasonable and acceptable
3050.zh: 那是一個合理且正當的疑慮。

3050.explanation: 使某事獲得法律或正式認可。
3050.definition: to make something legal or formally acceptable
3050.en: The reform helped legitimate the new system.
3050.zh: 這項改革有助於使新制度取得正式認可。

3051.explanation: 不必工作或處理義務，可以自由安排的時間。
3051.definition: time when a person is free from work or duties
3051.en: She reads novels in her leisure time.
3051.zh: 她在閒暇時間閱讀小說。

3052.en: We took a leisurely walk by the river.
3052.zh: 我們沿著河邊悠閒地散步。

3052.definition: in a relaxed and unhurried way
3052.en: They walked leisurely through the park.

3053.explanation: 一種黃色、味酸的柑橘類水果。
3053.definition: a yellow citrus fruit with a sour taste
3053.en: Add a slice of lemon to the tea.

3054.explanation: 以檸檬汁、水和糖等製成的飲料。
3054.definition: a drink made from lemon juice, water, and usually sugar
3054.en: We made fresh lemonade for lunch.
3054.zh: 我們午餐時做了新鮮檸檬汁飲料。

3055.explanation: 暫時把某物交給別人使用，之後要歸還。
3055.definition: to give something to someone temporarily with the expectation that it will be returned
3055.en: Can you lend me a pencil?
3055.zh: 你可以借我一枝鉛筆嗎？

3056.explanation: 從一端到另一端的距離，或持續的時間、文字篇幅。
3056.definition: the distance from one end to another, or the amount of time or text something has
3056.en: Measure the length of the table.

3057.explanation: 使某物變長，或自行變長。
3057.definition: to make something longer, or to become longer
3057.en: The days begin to lengthen in spring.

3058.explanation: 時間或篇幅長到可能令人覺得過久。
3058.definition: lasting or continuing for a long time, often longer than expected
3058.en: The report includes a lengthy introduction.
3058.zh: 這份報告有一段很長的前言。

3059.explanation: 使光線折射或聚焦的透明曲面材料。
3059.definition: a transparent curved piece of material that focuses or changes the direction of light

3060.explanation: 一種身上有斑點的大型野生貓科動物。
3060.definition: a large wild cat with a spotted coat
3060.en: A leopard rested under a tree.

3061.explanation: 與女同性戀者或女同性戀相關的。
3061.definition: relating to lesbians or lesbian identity
3061.en: The course includes works by several lesbian writers.
3061.zh: 這門課包含幾位女同性戀作家的作品。

3062.explanation: 指比另一數量更少的部分。
3062.en: We spent less than we expected.

3062.explanation: 表示程度比另一情況低。
3062.definition: to a smaller degree or extent
3062.en: Try to worry less about small mistakes.

3062.zh: 我們今天的時間比較少。

3062.explanation: 表示從總數中扣掉某個數量。
3062.en: The total is ten dollars, less the discount.
3062.zh: 總額是十美元，再扣除折扣。

3063.explanation: 使數量、程度或影響變小，或自行變小。
3063.definition: to make something smaller in amount or degree, or to become smaller
3063.en: A short break can lessen stress.
3063.zh: 短暫休息可以減輕壓力。

3064.explanation: 一段教學時間，也可指從經驗中學到的道理。
3064.definition: a period of instruction, or something learned from experience
3064.en: We learned an important lesson from the mistake.
3064.zh: 我們從這個錯誤中學到重要的一課。

3065.explanation: 用來表示為避免某件不希望發生的事。
3065.definition: used to introduce something that should be prevented or avoided
3065.en: She wrote the date down lest she forget it.
3065.zh: 她把日期寫下來，以免忘記。

3066.explanation: 允許某人做某事，或讓某事發生。
3066.definition: to allow someone to do something or allow something to happen
3066.en: Let me explain the idea first.

3067.explanation: 可能造成死亡，或具有非常嚴重的危害。
3067.definition: capable of causing death, or extremely dangerous
3067.en: The infection can be lethal without proper treatment.
3067.zh: 若未妥善治療，這種感染可能致命。

3068.explanation: 寄給某人的書面訊息，也可指字母表中的符號。
3068.definition: a written message sent to someone, or a symbol in an alphabet
3068.en: I received a letter from my cousin.
3068.zh: 我收到表親寄來的一封信。

3069.explanation: 一種葉片常用於沙拉或料理的蔬菜。
3069.definition: a leafy vegetable often eaten in salads or other dishes
3069.en: She added lettuce to the sandwich.
3069.zh: 她在三明治裡加了生菜。

3070.explanation: 某物的位置高度、數量程度或系統中的等級。
3070.definition: a height, amount, degree, or position within a scale or system
3070.en: The water level rose after the rain.

3070.explanation: 表面平坦，或與某物處於相同高度。
3070.definition: flat or at the same height as something else
3070.en: Make sure the shelf is level.

3071.explanation: 法律或財務上的責任，也可指造成困難的人或事物。
3071.definition: legal or financial responsibility, or something that causes difficulty or disadvantage
3071.en: The company accepted liability for the damage.

3072.explanation: 依法或按規定須負責，也可表示容易發生某事。
3072.definition: legally responsible, or likely to experience or do something
3072.en: Drivers are liable for following traffic rules.
3072.zh: 駕駛有責任遵守交通規則。

3073.explanation: 經常或正在說不實話的人。
3073.en: Nobody likes being called a liar.
3073.zh: 沒有人喜歡被叫作說謊者。

3074.meaning: 開明的；寬容的；自由派的
3074.explanation: 願意接受不同想法，也可指支持較自由開放的政治或社會觀點。
3074.definition: open to different ideas, or supporting relatively broad social or political freedoms
3074.en: The school encourages a liberal approach to discussion.
3074.zh: 學校鼓勵較開放的討論方式。

3075.explanation: 使某人或某物脫離控制、限制或束縛。
3075.definition: to free someone or something from control, restriction, or confinement
3075.en: The new policy helped liberate workers from unnecessary paperwork.
3075.zh: 新政策讓工作者免於不必要的文書負擔。

3076.explanation: 獲得自由或解除控制、限制的行動或過程。
3076.definition: the act or process of becoming free from control or restriction
3076.en: The book describes the country's liberation.
3076.zh: 這本書描述了這個國家的解放。

3077.explanation: 能依自己選擇行動或生活、不受不合理限制的狀態。
3077.definition: the state or right of being free to act and live without unreasonable restriction
3077.en: Freedom of speech is an important liberty.
3077.zh: 言論自由是一項重要自由權。

3078.explanation: 在圖書館工作並管理或協助使用館藏的人。
3078.definition: a person who works in a library and manages or helps people use its resources
3078.en: The librarian helped me find the book.
3078.zh: 圖書館員幫我找到那本書。

3079.explanation: 收藏書籍與其他資料供人閱讀、借閱或研究的地方。
3079.definition: a place where books and other resources are kept for reading, borrowing, or study
3079.en: I studied at the library after school.
3079.zh: 我放學後在圖書館讀書。

3080.explanation: 由主管機關正式允許某人進行特定活動的證明。
3080.definition: an official document or permission allowing someone to do a particular activity
3080.en: You need a license to operate the service.
3080.zh: 你需要許可證才能經營這項服務。

3080.explanation: 正式允許某人或某事進行特定活動。
3080.definition: to officially permit a person or activity
3080.en: The city licensed the new business.
3080.zh: 市政府核准了這家新公司。

3081.definition: to pass the tongue over the surface of something
3081.zh: 那隻貓舔了自己的爪子。

3081.explanation: 舔的一下，也可口語指少量。
3081.definition: an act of licking, or informally a small amount
3081.en: The puppy gave my hand a quick lick.
3081.zh: 小狗快速舔了我的手一下。

3082.explanation: 覆蓋容器開口、可移開的部分。
3082.definition: a removable cover for the opening of a container
3082.en: Put the lid back on the jar.

3083.explanation: 說不實的話，或讓身體平放，也可表示某物位於某處。
3083.definition: to say something untrue, to rest in a horizontal position, or to be situated somewhere
3083.en: He admitted that he had lied about the time.
3083.zh: 他承認自己在時間這件事上說了謊。

3083.definition: a statement that is intentionally not true
3083.en: She told a lie and later apologized.
3083.zh: 她說了一個謊，後來道了歉。

3084.explanation: 軍隊中的軍官階級或在某些組織中擔任副手的人。
3084.definition: a junior military officer, or a deputy in some organizations
3084.en: The lieutenant reported to the captain before the meeting.
3084.zh: 中尉在會議前向上尉報到。

3085.explanation: 生物存活的狀態，也可指一個人的生活或一生。
3085.definition: the state of being alive, or a person's way or period of living
3085.en: She has built a quiet life near the coast.
3085.zh: 她在海邊過著平靜的生活。

3086.explanation: 在游泳池、海灘等處負責保護游泳者安全的人。
3086.definition: a person trained to protect and rescue swimmers
3086.en: The lifeguard watched the swimmers closely.
3086.zh: 救生員仔細看著游泳的人。

3087.explanation: 持續一生或幾乎一生的。
3087.definition: lasting for all or most of a person's life
3087.en: Reading became a lifelong habit for him.
3087.zh: 閱讀成了他終身的習慣。

3088.explanation: 一個人或事物存在的整段時間。
3088.definition: the entire period during which a person or thing exists
3088.en: This bridge was designed to last a lifetime.
3088.zh: 這座橋的設計使用年限很長。

3089.explanation: 把某物往上移動或提高。
3089.definition: to raise or move something to a higher position
3089.en: Please lift the box onto the shelf.

3089.explanation: 一次向上移動，也可指電梯或搭便車。
3089.definition: an upward movement, an elevator, or a ride in a vehicle
3089.en: Could you give me a lift to the station?

3090.explanation: 使人能看見物體的能量，或提供照明的光源。
3090.definition: the energy that makes things visible, or a source of illumination
3090.en: Soft light filled the room in the morning.
3090.zh: 早晨柔和的光照滿房間。

3090.explanation: 重量不重，或顏色、亮度較淡或明亮。
3090.definition: not heavy, or pale or bright in color or appearance
3090.en: This bag is light enough to carry all day.
3090.zh: 這個袋子很輕，整天提著也沒問題。

3090.explanation: 使某物燃燒或讓某處變亮。
3090.definition: to make something begin to burn or to illuminate a place
3090.en: They lit the candles before dinner.
3090.zh: 他們在晚餐前點亮蠟燭。

3090.explanation: 以較少重量或較輕程度。
3090.definition: with little weight or in a light manner
3090.en: We traveled light and carried only one bag each.
3090.zh: 我們輕裝旅行，每人只帶一個袋子。

3091.explanation: 使顏色、重量、心情或負擔變輕，或自行變輕。
3091.definition: to make or become lighter in color, weight, mood, or burden
3091.en: A short walk helped lighten her mood.
3091.zh: 短暫散步讓她的心情輕鬆了一些。

3092.explanation: 建在海岸或水域附近、以強光引導船隻的塔。
3092.definition: a tower with a strong light used to guide ships
3092.en: The lighthouse guided ships through the fog.
3092.zh: 燈塔引導船隻穿過濃霧。

3093.explanation: 雷雨時天空中突然出現的強烈放電亮光。
3093.definition: a sudden bright electrical flash in the sky during a storm
3093.en: Lightning flashed across the dark sky.

3094.explanation: 表示某人或某物與另一者相似。
3094.definition: similar to or in the same way as
3094.zh: 這種布料摸起來像絲綢。

3094.explanation: 對某人或某事有好感或享受。
3094.definition: to enjoy or have a positive feeling about someone or something
3094.en: I like this song because it is calm and simple.
3094.zh: 我喜歡這首歌，因為它平靜又簡單。

3094.explanation: 喜歡的事物，或與某人某物相似的人事物。
3094.definition: a preference, or a person or thing of a similar kind
3094.en: People have different likes and dislikes.
3094.zh: 每個人的喜好與厭惡都不同。

3095.explanation: 某事發生或為真的機率或程度。
3095.definition: the degree to which something is likely to happen or be true
3095.en: The likelihood of rain is high this afternoon.
3095.zh: 今天下午下雨的可能性很高。

3096.explanation: 有相當機會發生或為真的。
3096.definition: having a good chance of happening or being true
3096.en: The train is likely to arrive on time.
She will likely join us after class.
3096.zh: 她很可能下課後加入我們。

3097.definition: in the same or a similar way; also
3097.en: He enjoys hiking, and his sister likewise loves the outdoors.
3097.zh: 他喜歡健行，他妹妹也同樣熱愛戶外活動。

3098.explanation: 一種通常有大型花朵的球根植物。
3098.definition: a plant with large showy flowers growing from a bulb
3098.en: A white lily grew beside the pond.
3098.zh: 池塘旁長著一朵白色百合。

3099.explanation: 人的手臂或腿，也可指樹的大枝。
3099.definition: an arm or leg of a person, or a large branch of a tree
3099.en: The fallen tree had several broken limbs.
3099.zh: 倒下的樹有幾根斷裂的大枝。

3100.explanation: 允許或可能達到的最大範圍、數量或程度。
3100.definition: the greatest amount, extent, or boundary allowed or possible
3100.en: There is a limit to how much the box can hold.
3100.zh: 這個箱子能裝的東西有上限。

3100.explanation: 控制某事的數量、程度或範圍。
3100.definition: to control or restrict the amount, degree, or range of something
3100.en: The school limits access to the lab after dark.
3100.zh: 學校限制天黑後進入實驗室。

3101.explanation: 限制能力、可能性或範圍的條件。
3101.definition: a restriction or condition that limits ability, possibility, or scope
3101.en: Cost is the main limitation of the plan.
3101.zh: 成本是這項計畫的主要限制。

3102.explanation: 因腿腳受傷或疼痛而不均勻走路的方式。
3102.definition: an uneven way of walking caused by pain or injury
3102.en: He walked with a slight limp after the injury.

3102.explanation: 因腿腳疼痛或受傷而困難地走路。
3102.definition: to walk with difficulty because of pain or injury in a leg or foot
3102.en: She limped home after twisting her ankle.
3102.zh: 她扭傷腳踝後一瘸一拐地走回家。

3103.explanation: 細長的標記、排成的一列，或分界線。
3103.definition: a long narrow mark, a row of people or things, or a boundary
3103.en: A long line formed outside the theater.

3103.explanation: 沿某處排列，或在內部加上襯層。
3103.definition: to form a row along something, or to cover the inside of something
3103.en: Tall trees line both sides of the road.
3103.zh: 高大的樹排列在道路兩側。

3104.explanation: 由亞麻纖維製成的布，也可指床單等布製品。
3104.definition: cloth made from flax, or household cloth items such as sheets
3104.en: The table was covered with clean linen.
3104.zh: 桌上鋪著乾淨的亞麻布。

3105.explanation: 按固定航線運行的大型客船或飛機。
3105.definition: a large passenger ship or aircraft operating on a regular route
3105.en: The ocean liner arrived at the port at dawn.
3105.zh: 大型客輪在黎明抵達港口。

3106.explanation: 比預期多停留一會兒，或某種感覺、氣味持續存在。
3106.definition: to stay longer than expected, or for a feeling or smell to remain
3106.en: The smell of coffee lingered in the kitchen.
3106.zh: 咖啡香在廚房裡久久不散。

3107.explanation: 衣服、容器等內側的一層材料。
3107.definition: a layer of material covering the inside of clothing or another object
3107.en: The jacket has a warm cotton lining.
3107.zh: 這件外套有溫暖的棉質內襯。

3108.explanation: 兩者之間的連接或關係。
3108.definition: a connection or relationship between two things
3108.en: Researchers found a link between sleep and memory.
3108.zh: 研究人員發現睡眠與記憶之間的關聯。

3108.explanation: 把兩個以上的事物連接或建立關係。
3108.definition: to connect two or more things or show a relationship between them
3108.en: A footbridge links the two buildings.
3108.zh: 一座人行橋連接兩棟建築。

3109.explanation: 一種大型野生貓科動物，雄獅通常有鬃毛。
3109.definition: a large wild cat whose adult males usually have a mane
3109.en: The lion rested in the shade during the hottest hours.
3109.zh: 獅子在最炎熱的時段躺在陰影下休息。

3110.explanation: 嘴巴上下的柔軟邊緣，也可指容器等的邊緣。
3110.definition: one of the soft edges of the mouth, or the edge of an opening
3110.en: She cut her lower lip while eating.
3110.zh: 她吃東西時割傷了下唇。

3111.explanation: 塗在嘴唇上以增加顏色的化妝品。
3111.definition: a cosmetic used to add color to the lips
3111.en: She chose a soft pink lipstick for the event.
3111.zh: 她為活動選了一支淡粉色口紅。

3112.explanation: 能流動但具有一定體積的物質狀態。
3112.definition: a substance that flows and has a fixed volume but no fixed shape
3112.en: Water is a liquid at room temperature.

3113.explanation: 含酒精的飲料，特別可指蒸餾酒。
3113.definition: an alcoholic drink, especially a distilled one
3113.en: The report discusses liquor sales as part of the local economy.
3113.zh: 報告把烈酒銷售列為地方經濟的一部分。

3114.explanation: 依序列出的項目、名稱或資料。
3114.definition: a series of names, items, or pieces of information written in order
3114.en: I made a list of the books I need.
3114.zh: 我列了一張需要的書單。

3114.explanation: 把項目逐一寫出或納入清單。
3114.definition: to write or include items one by one in a list
3114.en: Please list the main reasons in order.

3115.explanation: 注意並試著理解聲音或他人說話。
3115.definition: to pay attention to and try to hear or understand sounds
3115.en: Listen carefully to the instructions before you begin.

3116.explanation: 正在聽某人說話、音樂或節目的人。
3116.definition: a person who listens to someone or something
3116.en: A good listener does not interrupt constantly.
3116.zh: 善於傾聽的人不會一直打斷別人。

3117.explanation: 公制容量單位，等於一千毫升。
3117.definition: a metric unit of volume equal to one thousand milliliters
3117.en: The bottle holds one liter of water.
3117.zh: 這個瓶子可裝一公升的水。

3118.explanation: 閱讀與書寫的能力，也可延伸指某領域的基本素養。
3118.definition: the ability to read and write, or basic competence in a field
3118.en: The program aims to improve digital literacy.
3118.zh: 這項計畫旨在提升數位素養。

3119.explanation: 依照文字最直接、最基本的意思，而非比喻。
3119.definition: following the exact and most direct meaning of words rather than a figurative one
3119.en: The literal meaning of the phrase is different from its figurative use.
3119.zh: 這個片語的字面意思與比喻用法不同。

3120.explanation: 與文學、作家或文學作品有關的。
3120.definition: relating to literature, writers, or literary works
3120.en: She won a prize for her literary essay.
3120.zh: 她以文學評論獲得獎項。

3121.meaning: 有讀寫能力的；有素養的
3121.explanation: 能閱讀與書寫，或對某領域具有基本知識。
3121.definition: able to read and write, or knowledgeable in a particular field
3121.en: Most students in the class are computer literate.
3121.zh: 班上大多數學生都具備基本電腦素養。

3121.explanation: 具有閱讀與書寫能力的人。
3121.definition: a person who can read and write
3121.en: The survey counted each literate adult separately.
3121.zh: 這項調查把每位具讀寫能力的成人分別計算。

3122.explanation: 具文學價值的作品，也可指某主題的書面研究資料。
3122.definition: written works valued as literature, or published writing on a subject
3122.en: We studied modern Taiwanese literature this semester.
3122.zh: 這學期我們研讀現代台灣文學。

3123.explanation: 散落在公共場所的小垃圾，也可指一次出生的一窩幼獸。
3123.definition: small pieces of waste left in public places, or a group of young animals born at one time
3123.en: Volunteers collected litter from the beach.
3123.zh: 志工清理了海灘上的垃圾。

3123.explanation: 在公共場所留下垃圾，或使某處散布雜物。
3123.definition: to leave waste in a place or scatter things untidily
3123.en: Please do not litter in the park.
3123.zh: 請不要在公園亂丟垃圾。

3124.en: A little bird landed on the fence.

3124.explanation: 表示程度很小或幾乎沒有。
3124.definition: to a small degree or almost not
3124.en: He slept little during exam week.
3124.zh: 考試週期間他睡得很少。

3124.en: A little can make a big difference.
3124.zh: 一點點也能帶來很大的改變。

3125.explanation: 存在於生命狀態，或在某地居住。
3125.definition: to be alive or to have one's home in a particular place

3125.explanation: 正在現場發生或由真人即時呈現的。
3125.definition: happening or being presented in real time, or alive rather than recorded
3125.en: The concert will be broadcast live tonight.
3125.zh: 今晚演唱會將現場直播。

3126.explanation: 充滿活力、活動或趣味的。
3126.definition: full of energy, activity, or interest
3126.en: The market was lively on Saturday morning.
3126.zh: 星期六早上的市場很熱鬧。

3127.explanation: 體內協助代謝、解毒等功能的大型器官。
3127.definition: a large organ in the body involved in metabolism and filtering substances
3127.en: The liver helps process many substances in the body.
3127.zh: 肝臟幫助身體處理許多物質。

3128.explanation: 農場中為食物、纖維或工作而飼養的動物。
3128.definition: farm animals kept for food, materials, or work
3128.en: The farm raises livestock on open grassland.
3128.zh: 這座農場在開闊草地上飼養牲畜。

3129.explanation: 一種通常有四肢、長尾巴的爬行動物。
3129.definition: a reptile usually having four legs and a long tail
3129.en: A small lizard warmed itself on the rock.
3129.zh: 一隻小蜥蜴在岩石上取暖。

3130.explanation: 被搬運、承載或處理的一批物品或工作量。
3130.definition: an amount carried, transported, or dealt with at one time
3130.en: The truck carried a heavy load of supplies.
3130.zh: 卡車載著一大批沉重的物資。

3130.explanation: 把貨物放入車輛或容器，或把資料載入系統。
3130.definition: to put goods into a vehicle or container, or put data into a system
3130.en: Workers loaded the boxes onto the truck.

3131.meaning: 一條麵包；一塊成形食物
3131.explanation: 烤成一整塊的麵包或類似成形食物。
3131.definition: a shaped mass of bread or another food baked or prepared as one piece
3131.en: We bought a fresh loaf of bread.
3131.zh: 我們買了一條新鮮麵包。

3132.explanation: 借給某人並預期日後歸還的金錢或物品。
3132.definition: money or an item lent with the expectation that it will be returned
3132.en: She applied for a small business loan.
3132.zh: 她申請了一筆小型企業貸款。

3132.explanation: 暫時把金錢或物品提供給他人使用。
3132.definition: to lend money or an item for a period of time
3132.en: The museum can loan the painting to another gallery.
3132.zh: 博物館可以把這幅畫借給另一間畫廊。

3133.explanation: 建築物入口附近的大廳，也可指試圖影響決策的團體。
3133.definition: an entrance hall in a building, or a group seeking to influence decisions
3133.en: We waited for our guide in the hotel lobby.
3133.zh: 我們在飯店大廳等導遊。

3134.explanation: 一種大型海洋甲殼動物，常有強壯的螯。
3134.definition: a large marine crustacean, often with powerful claws
3134.en: The aquarium displayed a large lobster in a rocky tank.
3134.zh: 水族館在岩石造景的水槽中展示了一隻大龍蝦。

3135.explanation: 與某個特定地區或附近地方有關的。
3135.definition: relating to a particular area or nearby place
3135.en: Local students volunteered at the library.
3135.zh: 當地學生在圖書館擔任志工。

3135.definition: a person who lives in a particular area
3135.en: A local showed us the shortest path to the station.
3135.zh: 一位當地人告訴我們去車站最短的路。

3136.explanation: 找出某人某物的位置，或把某物設置在某處。
3136.definition: to find the position of something or place it in a particular location
3136.en: The map helps visitors locate the museum entrance.
3136.zh: 這張地圖幫助遊客找到博物館入口。

3137.explanation: 某人、某物或事件所在的地方。
3137.definition: the place where someone or something is situated
3137.en: This location is easy to reach by bus.
3137.zh: 這個地點搭公車很容易到達。

3138.explanation: 用來固定門、抽屜等並防止開啟的裝置。
3138.definition: a device used to fasten something and prevent it from being opened
3138.en: The old lock on the cabinet was replaced.
3138.zh: 櫃子上的舊鎖被換掉了。

3138.explanation: 用鎖把某物關好，或使其固定無法移動。
