5486.explanation: 因活動而缺乏精力，或對某事不再有耐心與興趣。
5486.definition: needing rest because of effort, or no longer interested in something
5486.en: I was tired after the long walk.
5486.zh: 走了很長一段路後，我很累。

5487.explanation: 因長時間、重複或麻煩而讓人疲倦或不耐煩。
5487.definition: causing weariness or annoyance because something is long, repetitive, or troublesome
5487.en: Repeating the same task all day became tiresome.
5487.zh: 整天重複同一項工作變得很令人厭煩。

5488.explanation: 可指柔軟薄紙，也可指構成動植物身體的細胞組織。
5488.definition: soft thin paper for personal use, or a group of similar cells forming part of a body
5488.en: She used a tissue to wipe the table.

5489.explanation: 作品的名稱，或表示身分、職位、榮譽的稱號。
5489.definition: the name of a work, or a name that shows a person's position, rank, or honor
5489.en: The title of the article caught my attention.
5489.zh: 這篇文章的標題吸引了我的注意。

5489.explanation: 給作品、文件或其他內容一個名稱。
5489.definition: to give a name or heading to a work, document, or other piece of content
5489.en: The author titled the chapter "A New Beginning."
5489.zh: 作者把這一章命名為「新的開始」。

5490.explanation: 表示方向、目的地、接受者、範圍終點或關係。
5490.definition: used to show direction, destination, recipient, an endpoint, or a relationship
5490.en: We walked to the station before sunrise.
5490.zh: 我們在日出前走到車站。

5491.explanation: 經過烘烤而變褐、變脆的麵包。
5491.definition: bread that has been browned and made crisp by heat
5491.en: I had toast and fruit for breakfast.
5491.zh: 我早餐吃了吐司和水果。

5491.explanation: 以熱使食物表面變褐，或舉杯向某人或某事致意。
5491.definition: to brown food with heat, or to honor someone or something by raising a drink
5491.en: Toast the bread until it is lightly browned.

5492.explanation: 一種植物及其經處理的葉片，常被製成含尼古丁的產品。
5492.definition: a plant and its prepared leaves, commonly used to make nicotine-containing products
5492.en: The report discusses the health effects of tobacco use.
5492.zh: 這份報告討論菸草使用對健康的影響。

5493.explanation: 在說話當天，或在目前這個時期。
5493.definition: on the present day, or during the present period

5493.explanation: 說話當天，或現今這個時代。
5493.definition: the present day, or the present period of time
5493.zh: 當今的科技變化得非常快。

5494.explanation: 腳前端的五個小指狀部位之一。
5494.definition: one of the five small digits at the front of the foot
5494.en: I hurt my little toe on the chair.
5494.zh: 我的小腳趾撞到椅子受傷了。

5495.explanation: 由豆漿凝固後壓製而成的柔軟食品。
5495.definition: a soft food made by coagulating soy milk and pressing the curds
5495.en: We added tofu to the vegetable soup.
5495.zh: 我們在蔬菜湯裡加了豆腐。

5496.explanation: 與其他人或事物在同一處、同一時間或共同做某事。
5496.definition: with other people or things in the same place, at the same time, or in a shared activity
5496.en: The two teams worked together on the project.
5496.zh: 兩個團隊一起完成這個專案。

5497.explanation: 供人排泄使用的衛生設備，也可指設有這種設備的空間。
5497.definition: a sanitary fixture used for waste, or a room containing such a fixture
5497.en: The toilet is at the end of the hallway.

5498.explanation: 可代表某種意義、權利或價值的小物件、符號或表示。
5498.definition: a small object, sign, or symbol that represents meaning, entitlement, or value
5498.en: They gave her a small token of appreciation.
5498.zh: 他們送她一個小禮物表示感謝。

5499.explanation: 雖不理想，但仍可以接受或承受。
5499.definition: not ideal, but still acceptable or possible to endure
5499.en: The room was hot, but the temperature was still tolerable.
5499.zh: 房間很熱，但溫度仍可忍受。

5500.explanation: 接受差異或不適的能力，也可指可容許的變動範圍。
5500.definition: the ability to accept differences or discomfort, or an allowed range of variation
5500.en: The class showed great tolerance for different opinions.
5500.zh: 這個班級對不同意見展現了很大的包容。

5501.explanation: 願意接受不同觀點或行為，或能承受某種環境或物質。
5501.definition: willing to accept differences, or able to withstand a particular condition or substance
5501.en: Good teammates are tolerant of small mistakes.
5501.zh: 好的隊友能包容小錯誤。

5502.explanation: 接受或承受不喜歡、不舒服或不同意的事物而不阻止它。
5502.definition: to accept or endure something disliked, uncomfortable, or disagreeable without preventing it
5502.en: This plant can tolerate dry conditions.
5502.zh: 這種植物能耐受乾燥的環境。

5503.explanation: 使用道路等設施所付的費用，也可指某事造成的損害或負面影響。
5503.definition: a charge for using a road or facility, or the harm and loss caused by something
5503.en: Drivers must pay a toll to use the bridge.
5503.zh: 駕駛使用這座橋必須支付通行費。

5503.explanation: 使鐘緩慢而反覆地響，或收取通行費。
5503.definition: to make a bell sound slowly and repeatedly, or to charge a toll
5503.en: The bell tolled slowly at noon.

5504.explanation: 一種通常呈紅色、可食用的多汁果實，常作為蔬菜料理。
5504.definition: a juicy edible fruit, usually red when ripe, commonly used as a vegetable in cooking
5504.en: She sliced a tomato for the sandwich.
5504.zh: 她切了一顆番茄放進三明治。

5505.explanation: 安放死者遺體或遺骨的墓穴或紀念性建築。
5505.definition: a grave or a structure in which a dead person is buried
5505.en: The ancient tomb was discovered beneath the hill.
5505.zh: 那座古墓在山丘下被發現。

5506.explanation: 在今天之後的那一天，或泛指未來。
5506.definition: on the day after today, or at a future time
5506.en: We will finish the work tomorrow.
5506.zh: 我們明天會完成這項工作。

5506.explanation: 今天之後的那一天，也可比喻未來。
5506.definition: the day after today, or the future

5507.explanation: 用來表示重量或質量的大型單位；美制短噸等於二千磅。
5507.definition: a large unit of weight or mass; a U.S. short ton equals two thousand pounds
5507.en: The truck can carry several tons of material.
5507.zh: 這輛卡車可以載運數噸材料。

5508.explanation: 聲音的品質或高低、說話所傳達的態度，也可指顏色的整體感覺。
5508.definition: the quality or pitch of a sound, the attitude conveyed by speech, or a quality of color
5508.en: Her calm tone made the discussion easier.
5508.zh: 她平靜的語氣讓討論更順利。

5509.explanation: 口腔中用於味覺、吞嚥與說話的肌肉器官，也可指一種語言。
5509.definition: the muscular organ in the mouth used for taste, swallowing, and speech, or a language
5509.en: The doctor asked him to stick out his tongue.

5510.definition: during the evening or night of the present day
5510.en: We are watching a movie tonight.

5510.definition: the evening or night of the present day
5510.en: Tonight will be colder than yesterday evening.

5511.explanation: 表示同樣適用，或表示程度超過合適或需要的範圍。
5511.definition: also, or to a degree that is greater than is suitable or needed
5511.en: The box is too heavy for me to lift alone.
5511.zh: 這個箱子太重，我一個人搬不動。

5512.explanation: 用來完成工作、製作或修理東西的器具，也可指達成目的的方法。
5512.definition: an instrument used to do, make, or repair something, or a means of achieving a purpose
5512.en: A ruler is a useful tool for measuring length.
5512.zh: 尺是測量長度的實用工具。

5513.explanation: 長在上下顎、用來咬和咀嚼食物的硬質構造之一。
5513.definition: one of the hard structures in the jaws used for biting and chewing food
5513.en: One of my front teeth feels sensitive.
5513.zh: 我的一顆門牙感覺很敏感。

5514.explanation: 牙齒或牙齒周圍的疼痛。
5514.definition: pain in or around a tooth
5514.en: He went to the dentist because of a toothache.

5515.explanation: 用來清潔牙齒的小刷子。
5515.definition: a small brush used for cleaning the teeth
5515.en: Replace your toothbrush when the bristles are worn.
5515.zh: 牙刷刷毛磨損時就應更換。

5516.explanation: 物體、區域或排名中最高或最上面的部分。
5516.definition: the highest or uppermost part of an object, place, or ranking
5516.en: We reached the top of the hill before noon.
5516.zh: 我們在中午前到達山頂。

5516.explanation: 位於最高處、排名最前或具有最高程度的重要性。
5516.definition: highest in position, rank, quality, or importance
5516.en: She is one of the top students in the class.
5516.zh: 她是班上成績最好的學生之一。

5516.explanation: 高於某個數量或水準，取得第一，或在某物上方加上一層或部分。
5516.definition: to exceed a level, rank first, or put a covering or upper part on something
5516.en: Sales topped one million units last year.
5516.zh: 去年的銷量超過一百萬件。

5517.explanation: 談話、文章、研究或討論所集中探討的事項。
5517.definition: the subject that a conversation, piece of writing, study, or discussion is about
5517.en: Today's discussion topic is renewable energy.
5517.zh: 今天的討論主題是再生能源。

5518.explanation: 一端燃燒、可用來提供光亮的手持物；美式英語通常不以此字指手電筒。
5518.definition: a handheld object with a burning end used for light; in American English it normally does not mean a flashlight
5518.en: The runners carried the ceremonial torch through the city.
5518.zh: 跑者們把儀式用火炬帶過城市。

5518.explanation: 以火使某物嚴重受損或毀壞。
5518.definition: to seriously damage or destroy something by fire
5518.en: The fire torched several empty sheds before it was contained.
5518.zh: 火勢在受到控制前燒毀了幾間空棚屋。

5519.explanation: 持續而強烈的身心困擾或痛苦。
5519.definition: severe and continuing mental or physical suffering
5519.en: Uncertainty became a source of torment for him.
5519.zh: 不確定感成了他的痛苦來源。

5519.explanation: 使某人長時間感到強烈的痛苦、焦慮或困擾。
5519.definition: to cause someone severe and continuing suffering, anxiety, or distress
5519.en: The constant noise tormented the residents for weeks.
5519.zh: 持續的噪音讓居民困擾了好幾週。

5520.explanation: 由猛烈旋轉的空氣柱形成、從雷暴延伸到地面的強烈風暴。
5520.definition: a violent storm formed by a rapidly rotating column of air extending from a thunderstorm to the ground
5520.en: The weather service issued a tornado warning.
5520.zh: 氣象單位發布了龍捲風警報。

5521.explanation: 快速而強勁的水流，也可比喻大量快速出現的事物。
5521.definition: a fast powerful stream of water, or a large amount of something arriving rapidly
5521.en: Rain turned the narrow stream into a torrent.
5521.zh: 大雨把狹窄的小溪變成了急流。

5522.explanation: 主要生活在陸地、具有硬殼的爬行動物。
5522.definition: a land-dwelling reptile with a hard shell
5522.en: The tortoise moved slowly across the path.

5523.explanation: 故意造成嚴重痛苦的殘酷行為，也可比喻極強烈的痛苦。
5523.definition: the cruel deliberate infliction of severe suffering, or figuratively very great suffering
5523.en: The long delay felt like torture to the impatient passengers.
5523.zh: 漫長的延誤讓沒耐心的乘客覺得非常難熬。

5523.explanation: 故意使人遭受嚴重痛苦，或使某人承受極大的身心痛苦。
5523.definition: to deliberately cause severe suffering, or to cause someone extreme mental or physical distress
5523.en: The law prohibits anyone from torturing prisoners.
5523.zh: 法律禁止任何人對囚犯施以酷刑。

5524.explanation: 用手快速或輕鬆地把某物拋出。
5524.definition: to throw something with a quick or light movement
5524.en: She tossed the keys onto the table.

5524.explanation: 一次拋擲動作，尤其可指擲硬幣來作決定。
5524.definition: a single throwing movement, especially a coin toss used to make a decision
5524.en: A coin toss decided which team would start.
5524.zh: 擲硬幣決定哪一隊先開始。

5525.explanation: 包括所有部分或數量的。
5525.definition: including all parts or the complete amount
5525.en: The total cost was lower than expected.

5525.explanation: 將所有個別數量相加後得到的數字或金額。
5525.definition: the amount or number obtained by adding all the separate parts
5525.en: The total came to eighty dollars.

5525.explanation: 加總成某一數量或金額。
5525.definition: to add up to a particular amount or number
5525.en: The numbers total exactly one hundred.
5525.zh: 這些數字加起來正好是一百。

5526.explanation: 輕微的身體接觸，或感覺接觸的能力。
5526.definition: a light physical contact, or the ability to feel physical contact
5526.en: The fabric has a soft touch.
5526.zh: 這種布料摸起來很柔軟。

5526.explanation: 使身體或物體與另一物體接觸。
5526.definition: to put a body part or object into physical contact with something
5526.en: Please do not touch the wet paint.
5526.zh: 請不要碰還沒乾的油漆。

5527.explanation: 難以完成或處理，或能承受壓力與損耗。
5527.definition: difficult to do or deal with, or strong enough to withstand pressure and wear
5527.en: It was a tough decision, but we made it together.
5527.zh: 那是個艱難的決定，但我們一起做出了選擇。

5528.explanation: 為觀光、表演或了解某地而進行的一段有安排的旅程。
5528.definition: a planned journey for sightseeing, performance, or visiting places of interest
5528.en: We joined a guided tour of the museum.
5528.zh: 我們參加了博物館的導覽行程。

5528.explanation: 到不同地方旅行、參觀或演出。
5528.definition: to travel around different places for sightseeing, visits, or performances
5528.en: The band will tour several cities next month.
5528.zh: 這個樂團下個月會到幾個城市巡演。

5529.explanation: 人們為休閒前往其他地方旅行的活動及相關產業。
5529.definition: the activity and industry of people traveling to other places for leisure
5529.zh: 觀光業支持了許多在地商家。

5530.explanation: 為休閒或觀光而前往某地的人。
5530.definition: a person who visits a place for leisure or sightseeing
5530.en: A tourist asked me for directions to the station.
5530.zh: 一名遊客問我車站怎麼走。

5531.explanation: 由多場比賽組成、用來決定優勝者的競賽活動。
5531.definition: a competition made up of a series of games or matches that determines a winner
5531.en: Our school will host a basketball tournament next week.
5531.zh: 我們學校下週將舉辦籃球錦標賽。

5532.explanation: 由車輛或船隻拉動另一物體的行為或狀態。
5532.definition: the act or condition of one vehicle or boat pulling another object
5532.en: The broken car needed a tow to the repair shop.
5532.zh: 故障的車需要拖到修車廠。

5532.explanation: 用車輛、船或繩索拉動另一個物體。
5532.definition: to pull a vehicle, boat, or other object using another vehicle, boat, or rope
5532.en: A truck towed the broken car away.
5532.zh: 一輛卡車把故障的車拖走了。

5533.explanation: 表示移動、位置或發展的方向，朝向某人、某地或某個結果。
5533.definition: in the direction of someone or something, or closer to a particular result
5533.en: She walked toward the station after class.

5533.explanation: 用來表示對某人或某事的態度、感受或行為方向。
5533.definition: used to show an attitude, feeling, or action directed at a person or thing
5533.en: His attitude toward the new rule became more positive.
5533.zh: 他對新規定的態度變得更正面。

5534.explanation: 用來擦乾身體、物體或吸收水分的布。
5534.definition: a piece of absorbent cloth used for drying a person or thing
5534.en: I hung the wet towel beside the shower.
5534.zh: 我把濕毛巾掛在淋浴間旁。

5534.explanation: 用毛巾擦拭，使身體或物體變乾。
5534.definition: to dry a person or thing by rubbing with a towel
5534.en: He toweled his hair dry after swimming.
5534.zh: 他游泳後用毛巾把頭髮擦乾。

5535.explanation: 高而狹長、通常比周圍建築更高的建築物或建築部分。
5535.definition: a tall narrow building or structure, often rising above its surroundings
5535.en: The old clock tower can be seen from the river.
5535.zh: 從河邊可以看到那座老鐘塔。

5536.explanation: 比村莊大、通常比城市小的聚居地。
5536.definition: a populated place larger than a village and usually smaller than a city
5536.en: The town has a small market near the square.
5536.zh: 這個城鎮的廣場附近有一個小市場。

5537.explanation: 含有毒性、可能傷害生物，或比喻對人際與環境造成嚴重負面影響。
5537.definition: poisonous or harmful, or figuratively causing serious negative effects
5537.en: The factory must store toxic waste safely.
5537.zh: 這家工廠必須安全儲存有毒廢棄物。

5538.explanation: 主要供兒童玩耍或娛樂的物品。
5538.definition: an object made mainly for children to play with
5538.en: The child put the toy back in the box.
5538.zh: 那個孩子把玩具放回盒子裡。

5539.explanation: 某物曾存在或發生後留下的跡象，也可指極少量。
5539.definition: a sign that something existed or happened, or a very small amount
5539.en: There was no trace of smoke in the room.
5539.zh: 房間裡沒有任何煙霧的痕跡。

5539.explanation: 藉由線索找出某人、某物或某事的來源、位置或歷史。
5539.definition: to discover the origin, location, or history of someone or something by following evidence
5539.en: The team traced the error to a damaged cable.
5539.zh: 團隊追查後發現錯誤來自一條受損的電纜。

5540.explanation: 供車輛、跑者或其他物體移動的固定路線、道路或表面。
5540.definition: a fixed path, course, or surface used for movement or travel
5540.en: The runners completed four laps of the track.
5540.zh: 跑者在跑道上完成了四圈。

5540.explanation: 持續觀察某人、物或資訊的位置、變化或進度。
5540.definition: to follow or monitor the position, movement, or progress of someone or something
5540.en: The app tracks how much time you spend studying.
5540.zh: 這個應用程式會追蹤你花多少時間讀書。

5541.explanation: 商品或服務的買賣與交換活動。
5541.definition: the activity of buying, selling, or exchanging goods and services
5541.en: International trade supports many local industries.
5541.zh: 國際貿易支持許多本地產業。

5541.explanation: 與他人買賣、交換商品、服務或其他有價值的東西。
5541.definition: to buy, sell, or exchange goods, services, or other things of value
5541.en: They traded books with each other after class.
5541.zh: 他們下課後彼此交換書籍。

5542.explanation: 用來識別公司或產品的受法律保護名稱或符號，也可指某人的典型特徵。
5542.definition: a legally protected name or symbol identifying a product or company, or a distinctive characteristic
5542.en: The logo is a registered trademark of the company.
5542.zh: 這個標誌是該公司的註冊商標。

5543.explanation: 以買賣商品、服務或金融資產為業的人。
5543.definition: a person who buys and sells goods, services, or financial assets
5543.en: The trader bought fruit from nearby farms.
5543.zh: 那位商人向附近農場購買水果。

5544.explanation: 在群體中長期延續並傳給後代的習俗、信念或做法。
5544.definition: a custom, belief, or practice passed down within a group over time
5544.en: Sharing this meal is a family tradition.
5544.zh: 一起吃這頓飯是我們家的傳統。

5545.explanation: 依循長久存在的習俗、方法或觀念的。
5545.definition: following long-established customs, methods, or beliefs
5545.en: The festival includes traditional music and food.
5545.zh: 這個節慶包含傳統音樂與食物。

5546.explanation: 道路上的車輛及其流動情況。
5546.definition: vehicles moving on roads and the flow they create
5546.en: Traffic is heavy during the morning rush hour.
5546.zh: 早上尖峰時段車流很大。

5546.explanation: 以非法方式買賣或運送某類商品。
5546.definition: to trade in or move goods illegally
5546.en: The group was accused of trafficking in stolen goods.
5546.zh: 該團體被指控非法販運贓物。

5547.explanation: 造成巨大悲傷或損失的事件，也可指悲劇類型的戲劇作品。
5547.definition: a very sad event causing great loss, or a dramatic work with a disastrous ending
5547.en: The accident was a tragedy for the whole community.
5547.zh: 那場事故對整個社區而言是一場悲劇。

5548.explanation: 造成或涉及巨大悲傷、死亡或損失的。
5548.definition: causing or involving great sadness, death, or loss
5548.en: The town remembered the tragic event each year.
5548.zh: 那個城鎮每年都會紀念這起悲慘事件。

5549.explanation: 供步行的狹窄路線，或人與物經過後留下的痕跡。
5549.definition: a narrow path, or a line of signs left by someone or something moving
5549.en: We followed a forest trail to the lake.
5549.zh: 我們沿著森林小徑走到湖邊。

5549.explanation: 跟在某人或某物後面，或在進度、比分上落後。
5549.definition: to follow behind someone or something, or remain behind in progress or score
5549.en: Our team trailed by two points at halftime.
5549.zh: 我們隊在半場時落後兩分。

5550.explanation: 沿鐵路軌道載運乘客或貨物的一連串車廂與機車。
5550.definition: a connected set of railway vehicles used to carry passengers or goods
5550.en: The train leaves the station at six.

5550.explanation: 透過教導與練習，使某人具備特定技能或能力。
5550.definition: to teach and practice with someone so that they develop a particular skill or ability
5550.en: The coach trains the players to react quickly.
5550.zh: 教練訓練球員快速反應。

5551.explanation: 能描述某個人、群體或事物的持久特點。
5551.definition: a lasting characteristic of a person, group, or thing
5551.en: Patience is a useful trait in a teacher.
5551.zh: 耐心是教師很實用的特質。

5552.explanation: 背叛自己的國家、團體、朋友、信念或信任的人。
5552.definition: a person who betrays a country, group, friend, belief, or trust
5552.en: They called him a traitor after he betrayed the group.
5552.zh: 他背叛團體後，大家稱他為叛徒。

5553.explanation: 一次買賣、付款、轉帳或其他正式的業務交換。
5553.definition: an act or instance of doing business, especially an exchange of goods, services, or money
5553.en: The bank records every transaction automatically.
5553.zh: 銀行會自動記錄每一筆交易。

5554.explanation: 依照錄音、演講或談話整理出的書面文字內容。
5554.definition: a written copy of spoken or recorded material
5554.en: I read the transcript of the interview after class.
5554.zh: 我下課後讀了那場訪談的文字稿。

5554.explanation: 學校正式列出課程、成績與學業紀錄的文件。
5554.definition: an official copy of a student's academic record
5554.en: The university asked for an official transcript.
5554.zh: 那所大學要求提供正式成績單。

5555.explanation: 把人、物、權利、金錢或資料從一處或一方移到另一處或另一方的行為。
5555.definition: the act of moving someone or something from one place, person, or situation to another
5555.en: The transfer of the files took only a few minutes.
5555.zh: 檔案轉移只花了幾分鐘。

5555.explanation: 把人、物、金錢、資料或權利從一處或一方移到另一處或另一方。
5555.definition: to move or cause someone or something to move from one place, person, or situation to another
5555.en: Please transfer the money to my savings account.
5555.zh: 請把這筆錢轉到我的儲蓄帳戶。

5556.explanation: 使某人或某事物在形式、性質、功能或狀態上產生重大改變。
5556.definition: to change someone or something greatly in form, nature, function, or condition
5556.en: The new rail line transformed the neighborhood.
5556.zh: 新的鐵路線大幅改變了這個社區。

5557.explanation: 形式、性質、功能或狀態上的重大改變，或發生這種改變的過程。
5557.definition: a major change in form, nature, function, or condition, or the process of making such a change
5557.en: The old factory went through a major transformation.
5557.zh: 那座老工廠經歷了重大改造。

5558.explanation: 人或貨物從一地運送或通過另一地的過程，也可指大眾運輸系統。
5558.definition: the passage or transportation of people or goods from one place to another
5558.en: The goods were damaged while in transit.

5558.explanation: 從某個地區、路線或空間通過。
5558.definition: to pass through or across a place or area
5558.en: The ship transited the canal before dawn.
5558.zh: 那艘船在黎明前通過運河。

5559.explanation: 從一種狀態、階段或情況轉到另一種的過程或時期。
5559.definition: the process or period of changing from one state, stage, or situation to another
5559.en: The transition from school to work can take time.
5559.zh: 從學校生活轉入職場可能需要一些時間。

5560.explanation: 把一種語言中的文字或話語改用另一種語言表達。
5560.definition: to express words or speech in another language
5560.en: Can you translate this message into English?
5560.zh: 你可以把這則訊息翻成英文嗎？

5561.explanation: 把內容由一種語言轉成另一種語言的行為，或翻譯後的文字。
5561.definition: the act of expressing something in another language, or the text produced by doing so
5561.en: Her translation is clear and easy to read.
5561.zh: 她的譯文清楚又容易閱讀。

5562.explanation: 把書面內容從一種語言轉成另一種語言的人。
5562.definition: a person who translates written material from one language into another
5562.en: The translator checked the final document carefully.
5562.zh: 翻譯者仔細檢查了最後文件。

5563.explanation: 把資訊、訊號、能量、疾病等從一處或一方傳到另一處或另一方的過程。
5563.definition: the process of sending or passing information, signals, energy, or disease from one place or person to another
5563.en: The system allows fast transmission of data.
5563.zh: 這套系統能快速傳送資料。

5563.explanation: 車輛中把引擎動力傳到車輪的齒輪與機械系統。
5563.definition: the system of gears and related parts that carries power from a vehicle's engine to its wheels
5563.en: The mechanic checked the car's transmission.
5563.zh: 技師檢查了汽車的變速箱。

5564.explanation: 把訊號、資訊、能量或疾病傳到另一處或另一個人。
5564.definition: to send or pass a signal, information, energy, or disease to another place or person
5564.en: Satellites transmit signals around the world.
5564.zh: 衛星把訊號傳送到世界各地。

5565.explanation: 能讓光線通過，因此可以清楚看到另一側的。
5565.definition: allowing light to pass through so that objects on the other side can be seen clearly
5565.en: The box has a transparent plastic lid.
5565.zh: 這個盒子有透明塑膠蓋。

5565.explanation: 做法、理由或資訊公開清楚，不刻意隱藏。
5565.definition: open, clear, and easy to understand, with little or nothing hidden
5565.en: The school promised a transparent selection process.
5565.zh: 學校承諾採用公開透明的甄選流程。

5566.explanation: 把器官或組織從一個身體或部位移到另一個身體或部位的醫療程序。
5566.definition: a medical procedure in which an organ or tissue is moved to another body or body part
5566.en: The patient is waiting for an organ transplant.
5566.zh: 病人正在等待器官移植。

5566.explanation: 把器官、組織或植物從原處移到另一處，使其繼續生長或發揮作用。
5566.definition: to move an organ, tissue, or plant from one place to another so it can continue to live or grow
5566.en: Doctors transplanted the donated organ successfully.
5566.zh: 醫師成功移植了捐贈器官。

5567.explanation: 運送人或貨物的系統、方式或工具。
5567.definition: a system or means for carrying people or goods from one place to another
5567.en: Public transport is convenient in the city center.
5567.zh: 市中心的大眾運輸很方便。

5567.explanation: 用車輛、船、飛機等把人或貨物從一地送到另一地。
5567.definition: to carry people or goods from one place to another, especially by vehicle
5567.en: Trucks transport fresh food to the market each morning.
5567.zh: 卡車每天早上把新鮮食物運到市場。

5568.explanation: 把人或貨物從一地移到另一地的行為、方式或系統。
5568.definition: the act, means, or system of moving people or goods from one place to another
5568.en: The city needs better public transportation.
5568.zh: 這座城市需要更好的大眾運輸。

5569.explanation: 用來捕捉動物或使人無法輕易逃脫的裝置或處境。
5569.definition: a device or situation designed to catch or prevent someone or something from escaping
5569.en: The mouse escaped from the trap.

5569.explanation: 使某人或某物被抓住，或處在難以逃離的地方或情況。
5569.definition: to catch or confine someone or something so that escape is difficult
5569.en: Heavy snow trapped several cars on the road.
5569.zh: 大雪把幾輛車困在道路上。

5570.explanation: 被丟棄、沒有用途或不再需要的東西。
5570.definition: things that are thrown away because they are no longer wanted or useful
5570.en: Please put the trash in the bin.

5570.explanation: 把某物當作沒有用而丟掉。
5570.definition: to throw something away as useless or unwanted
5570.en: Do not trash the box because we may need it later.
5570.zh: 先別把盒子丟掉，我們之後可能還需要。

5571.explanation: 令人極度痛苦或震驚的經驗，以及它造成的長期心理影響。
5571.definition: a deeply distressing or shocking experience and the lasting emotional effect it can cause
5571.en: The event caused lasting emotional trauma.
5571.zh: 那起事件造成長期的心理創傷。

5571.explanation: 事故或暴力等造成的嚴重身體傷害。
5571.definition: serious physical injury caused by an accident or other force
5571.en: The emergency team treated the patient's physical trauma.
5571.zh: 急救團隊處理了病人的嚴重外傷。

5572.explanation: 從一地到另一地旅行的活動，尤指長程或經常性的移動。
5572.definition: the activity of making journeys from one place to another
5572.en: Air travel is common between the two cities.
5572.zh: 這兩座城市之間搭飛機旅行很常見。

5572.explanation: 從一地到另一地移動或旅行。
5572.definition: to go from one place to another, especially over some distance
5572.en: We traveled by train along the coast.
5572.zh: 我們搭火車沿著海岸旅行。

5573.explanation: 正在旅行或經常旅行的人。
5573.definition: a person who is traveling or who travels regularly
5573.en: The traveler asked for a map of the city.
5573.zh: 那名旅客要了一張城市地圖。

5574.explanation: 用來承載、端送或放置物品的扁平淺盤。
5574.definition: a flat shallow container used for carrying, serving, or holding things
5574.en: She carried the drinks on a tray.

5575.explanation: 具有很高金錢、歷史或情感價值的物品，尤指金銀珠寶等貴重物。
5575.definition: valuable objects such as money or jewels, or something regarded as very precious
5575.en: The museum protects a collection of national treasures.
5575.zh: 博物館保護一批國家珍寶。

5575.explanation: 因某人或某物非常重要而高度重視並珍惜。
5575.definition: to value and care about someone or something greatly
5575.en: She treasures the letters from her grandmother.

5576.explanation: 政府的公共資金，或負責管理政府財政與收入的部門。
5576.definition: public funds of a government, or the government department responsible for managing money and revenue
5576.en: The treasury announced a new financial plan.
5576.zh: 財政部門宣布一項新的財務計畫。

5577.explanation: 以某種方式對待、處理或回應某人或某事物。
5577.definition: to behave toward or deal with a person or thing in a particular way
5577.en: The teacher treats every student with respect.
5577.zh: 老師以尊重的態度對待每位學生。

5577.explanation: 給予醫療照護、藥物或其他方式來處理疾病或傷害。
5577.definition: to give medical care or medicine for an illness or injury

5577.explanation: 治療疾病或傷害的方法與過程，也可指對某人或某事的處理方式。
5577.definition: the medical care or method used to deal with an illness or injury, or the way someone or something is dealt with
5577.en: The patient responded well to the treatment.

5578.explanation: 國家或政府之間正式訂立並具約束力的協議。
5578.definition: a formal binding agreement between countries or governments
5578.en: The two countries signed a peace treaty.

5579.explanation: 具有木質樹幹、通常有枝葉並能多年生長的大型植物。
5579.definition: a large woody plant with a trunk and branches that usually lives for many years
5579.en: A large tree shades the playground.

5580.explanation: 長而通常辛苦的旅程，尤其指徒步前進的旅程。
5580.definition: a long and often difficult journey, especially one made on foot
5580.en: The trek through the mountains took three days.
5580.zh: 穿越山區的跋涉花了三天。

5580.explanation: 進行長距離而通常辛苦的旅程，尤其是徒步旅行。
5580.definition: to make a long and often difficult journey, especially on foot
5580.en: We trekked across the valley before sunset.
5580.zh: 我們在日落前徒步穿越山谷。

5581.explanation: 因寒冷、恐懼、緊張或激動而不由自主地輕微發抖。
5581.definition: to shake slightly and involuntarily because of cold, fear, nervousness, or excitement
5581.en: His hands trembled in the cold.

5581.explanation: 身體、聲音或其他事物的輕微抖動。
5581.definition: a slight shaking movement of the body, voice, or another thing
5581.en: There was a slight tremble in her voice.

5582.explanation: 在數量、程度、力量或成就上非常大或令人印象深刻的。
5582.definition: very great in amount, degree, force, or achievement, and often impressive
5582.en: The project required a tremendous amount of work.
5582.zh: 這項計畫需要大量工作。

5583.explanation: 事情發展、變化或流行的大致方向。
5583.definition: a general direction in which a situation, idea, or style is developing or changing
5583.en: The report shows a clear trend toward online learning.
5583.zh: 報告顯示線上學習有明顯的發展趨勢。

5584.explanation: 法院正式審理案件並判定責任或罪責的程序。
5584.definition: a formal examination of a legal case in court
5584.en: The trial is expected to begin next month.
5584.zh: 這場審判預計下個月開始。

5584.explanation: 為了判斷某方法、產品或做法是否有效而進行的測試。
5584.definition: a test of something to discover how well it works or whether it is suitable
5584.en: The new teaching method is being used on a trial basis.
5584.zh: 這種新的教學方法正以試驗方式使用。

5585.explanation: 具有三條邊和三個角的平面圖形。
5585.definition: a flat shape with three straight sides and three angles
5585.en: Draw a triangle with three equal sides.
5585.zh: 畫一個三邊等長的三角形。

5586.explanation: 與部落或部落式社群及其文化有關的。
5586.definition: relating to a tribe or to the customs and social organization of tribes
5586.en: The museum displays examples of tribal art.
5586.zh: 博物館展出一些部落藝術作品。

5587.explanation: 由共同祖先、文化、語言或社會關係連結的一群人。
5587.definition: a social group whose members share ancestry, culture, language, or community ties
5587.en: The tribe has preserved many of its traditional customs.
5587.zh: 這個部落保存了許多傳統習俗。

5588.explanation: 用言語、行動或作品表達對某人的敬意或讚賞。
5588.definition: something said, done, or given to show respect, admiration, or gratitude
5588.en: The concert was a tribute to the late musician.
5588.zh: 這場音樂會是向已故音樂家致敬。

5589.explanation: 用來欺騙、戲弄或使人產生錯誤印象的方法。
5589.definition: an action or method intended to deceive, surprise, or fool someone
5589.en: He realized that the offer was only a trick.
5589.zh: 他發現那個提議只是一個花招。

5589.explanation: 用不誠實或巧妙的方法使某人相信錯誤的事。
5589.definition: to deceive someone into believing or doing something
5589.en: The message tried to trick users into sharing personal information.
5589.zh: 那則訊息企圖騙使用者提供個人資訊。

5590.explanation: 需要特別小心、技巧或思考才能完成或處理的。
5590.definition: difficult to deal with or solve and requiring care or skill
5590.en: This is a tricky problem, but we can solve it step by step.
5590.zh: 這是一個棘手的問題，但我們可以一步一步解決。

5591.explanation: 價值、重要性或數量很小的事物。
5591.definition: something of very little value, importance, or amount
5591.en: They argued over a trifle and soon forgot about it.
5591.zh: 他們為一件小事爭論，很快就忘了。

5591.explanation: 把人或事情當作不重要，或把時間花在無關緊要的事情上。
5591.definition: to treat someone or something as unimportant, or to spend time idly on unimportant things
5591.en: Do not trifle with a decision that affects everyone.
5591.zh: 不要輕率看待會影響所有人的決定。

5592.explanation: 引起某種反應、事件或過程開始的事物。
5592.definition: something that causes a reaction, event, or process to begin
5592.en: Stress can be a trigger for headaches in some people.
5592.zh: 壓力可能是某些人頭痛的誘發因素。

5592.explanation: 使某個反應、事件或過程開始發生。
5592.definition: to cause a reaction, event, or process to begin
5592.en: The announcement triggered a lively discussion.
5592.zh: 這項宣布引發了熱烈討論。

5593.explanation: 美式英語中表示一後面有十二個零的數字。
5593.en: The figure is measured in trillions of bytes.
5593.zh: 這個數量以數兆位元組計算。

5594.explanation: 去除多餘部分，使某物更整齊、更小或更合適。
5594.definition: to cut away unwanted parts in order to make something neater, smaller, or more suitable
5594.en: She trimmed the branches away from the window.
5594.zh: 她把窗邊多餘的樹枝修剪掉。

5594.explanation: 衣物、家具等邊緣的裝飾材料。
5594.definition: decorative material placed around the edge of clothing, furniture, or another object
5594.en: The jacket has a narrow strip of leather trim.
5594.zh: 這件外套有一圈窄窄的皮革飾邊。

5594.explanation: 外觀整齊、緊實而好看的。
5594.en: The garden looked trim and well cared for.
5594.zh: 花園看起來整潔而且照顧得很好。

5595.explanation: 到某地後通常再返回的一次旅行或行程。
5595.definition: a journey to a place and usually back again, especially a relatively short one
5595.en: We are planning a weekend trip to the coast.
5595.zh: 我們正在規畫週末到海邊旅行。

5595.explanation: 腳被東西絆到或失去平衡而差點跌倒。
5595.definition: to catch your foot on something or lose your balance and nearly fall
5595.en: I tripped on the step but did not fall.
5595.zh: 我在台階上絆了一下，但沒有跌倒。

5596.explanation: 由三部分組成，或數量、程度為三倍的。
5596.definition: consisting of three parts or being three times as much
5596.en: The company reported a triple increase in demand.
5596.zh: 公司報告需求增加到三倍。

5596.explanation: 使數量增加到原來的三倍，或自身增加到三倍。
5596.definition: to become or make something three times as large or numerous
5596.en: Sales nearly tripled in five years.
5596.zh: 銷售量在五年內幾乎變成三倍。

5596.explanation: 三倍的數量，或由三個事物組成的一組。
5596.definition: an amount three times as large, or a group of three things
5596.en: The final score was almost triple the earlier result.
5596.zh: 最後的分數幾乎是先前結果的三倍。

5597.explanation: 重大的勝利、成就或成功。
5597.definition: a great victory, achievement, or success
5597.en: Finishing the project on time was a real triumph.
5597.zh: 準時完成這項計畫是一項真正的成功。

5597.explanation: 在競爭、困難或挑戰中取得勝利或成功。
5597.definition: to achieve a great victory or succeed after difficulty
5597.zh: 耐心最終戰勝了挫折感。

5598.explanation: 重要性、價值或嚴重程度很低的。
5598.definition: having little importance, value, or seriousness
5598.en: We should not spend the whole meeting on trivial details.
5598.zh: 我們不該把整場會議都花在瑣碎細節上。

5599.explanation: 一群士兵；複數 troops 常泛指軍隊人員。
5599.definition: a group of soldiers, or soldiers collectively when used in the plural
5599.en: The troops returned home after the mission ended.
5599.zh: 任務結束後，部隊返回家園。

5600.explanation: 因比賽、競賽或成就而頒發的獎盃或紀念獎品。
5600.definition: a prize, often in the form of a cup or decorative object, given for an achievement or victory
5600.en: The team proudly displayed its championship trophy.
5600.zh: 球隊自豪地展示冠軍獎盃。

5601.explanation: 南、北回歸線之一；複數 the tropics 也可指兩回歸線之間的熱帶地區。
5601.definition: either of the two lines of latitude near 23.5 degrees north and south of the equator, or the region between them in the plural
5601.en: Many tropical islands lie within the tropics.
5601.zh: 許多熱帶島嶼位於熱帶地區。

5601.explanation: 與熱帶地區有關的；相當於 tropical。
5601.en: The species is found in tropic regions near the equator.
5601.zh: 這個物種分布在赤道附近的熱帶地區。

5602.explanation: 與熱帶地區、其氣候或其植物生物有關的。
5602.definition: relating to the hot regions near the equator or their climate and life
5602.en: The island has a warm tropical climate.
5602.zh: 這座島有溫暖的熱帶氣候。

5603.explanation: 造成擔心、困難或不便的問題或狀況。
5603.definition: problems, difficulty, or a situation that causes worry or inconvenience
5603.en: We had trouble finding the correct entrance.
5603.zh: 我們找正確入口時遇到一些麻煩。

5603.explanation: 使某人擔心、不舒服或感到不便。
5603.definition: to cause someone worry, discomfort, or inconvenience
5603.en: The strange noise troubled her all night.
5603.zh: 那個奇怪的聲音讓她整晚感到不安。

5604.explanation: 會造成問題、困難或不便的。
5604.en: A troublesome error kept appearing in the program.
5604.zh: 程式裡一直出現一個麻煩的錯誤。

5605.explanation: 常見於冷水河川與湖泊的一類食用魚。
5605.definition: a freshwater fish that commonly lives in cool rivers and lakes
5605.en: The river is known for its wild trout.
5605.zh: 這條河以野生鱒魚聞名。

5606.explanation: 用來載運貨物、設備或材料的大型道路車輛。
5606.definition: a large road vehicle used for carrying goods, equipment, or materials
5606.en: A delivery truck stopped outside the store.
5606.zh: 一輛送貨卡車停在商店外。

5607.explanation: 符合事實或現實的，而不是虛假或錯誤的。
5607.definition: in accordance with fact or reality; not false or incorrect
5607.en: The story is based on a true event.
5607.zh: 這個故事以真實事件為基礎。

5607.explanation: 以正確、忠實或準確的方式。
5607.definition: in an accurate, faithful, or truthful manner
5607.en: The arrow flew true toward the center of the target.

5607.explanation: 把物體調整到正確、平衡或精準的位置或形狀。
5607.definition: to adjust something so that it is level, balanced, aligned, or mechanically accurate
5607.en: The mechanic trued the wheel before testing it.
5607.zh: 技師在測試前先把輪子校正好。

5608.explanation: 用嘴吹奏、具有明亮音色的銅管樂器。
5608.definition: a brass musical instrument played by blowing through a mouthpiece
5608.en: She plays the trumpet in the school band.

5609.explanation: 樹木主要的粗大木質莖，枝條從上面長出。
5609.definition: the main thick woody stem of a tree from which branches grow
5609.en: The old tree has a thick trunk.
5609.zh: 那棵老樹有粗大的樹幹。

5609.explanation: 汽車用來放置行李或物品的儲物空間。
5609.definition: the enclosed storage space of a car, usually at the rear
5609.en: We put the suitcases in the trunk.
5609.zh: 我們把行李箱放進汽車後車廂。

5610.explanation: 相信某人誠實可靠，或相信某事物可以依賴。
5610.definition: to believe that someone is honest or reliable, or that something can be depended on
5610.en: I trust her judgment on this issue.
5610.zh: 我信任她對這件事的判斷。

5610.explanation: 對某人或某事可靠、誠實或有效的信心。
5610.definition: confidence in the honesty, reliability, or ability of someone or something

5611.explanation: 受法律或組織委託，負責管理財產、基金或機構事務的人。
5611.definition: a person who is legally or formally responsible for managing property, money, or an organization on behalf of others
5611.en: The trustees approved the school's annual budget.
5611.zh: 理事們通過了學校的年度預算。

5612.explanation: 實際的事實或符合事實的內容。
5612.definition: the facts about something, or the quality of being in accordance with reality
5612.en: We may never know the full truth about what happened.
5612.zh: 我們可能永遠無法知道事情的完整真相。

5613.explanation: 說真話、不說謊，或內容符合事實的。
5613.definition: honest and not telling lies, or accurately expressing what is true
5613.en: Please give a truthful account of what you saw.
5613.zh: 請如實描述你看到的事情。

5614.explanation: 為了完成某事而付出努力或進行嘗試。
5614.definition: to make an effort to do or achieve something
5614.en: Try to finish the work before dinner.
5614.zh: 試著在晚餐前完成工作。

5614.explanation: 為了完成或做到某事所做的一次努力。
5614.definition: an attempt or effort to do something

5615.explanation: 通常沒有領子、形狀像字母 T 的休閒上衣。
5615.definition: a casual shirt with short sleeves and no collar, shaped roughly like the letter T
5615.en: He wore a plain white T-shirt.

5616.explanation: 大型、上方開口的容器，可用來裝水或洗澡。
5616.definition: a large open container used for holding water or for washing or bathing
5616.en: The child filled the tub with warm water.

5617.explanation: 長而中空、通常呈圓柱狀的物體，也可指可擠壓的管狀容器。
5617.definition: a long hollow cylindrical object, or a squeezable cylindrical container
5617.en: The liquid flows through a narrow tube.

5618.explanation: 把某物的邊緣或一部分推、摺或放進某處，使它固定或整齊。
5618.definition: to push, fold, or place an edge or part of something into a position so that it is secure or neat
5618.en: She tucked the blanket under the mattress.
5618.zh: 她把毯子的邊緣塞進床墊下面。

5618.explanation: 衣物或布料上縫起或折起形成的窄摺。
5618.definition: a narrow fold or pleat made in cloth or clothing
5618.en: The tailor added a small tuck to the sleeve.
5618.zh: 裁縫在袖子上加了一道小摺褶。

5619.en: One quick tug opened the stuck drawer.
5619.zh: 用力一拉，卡住的抽屜就打開了。

5619.definition: to pull something hard or repeatedly
5619.en: The child tugged at the heavy door.
5619.zh: 孩子用力拉那扇沉重的門。

5620.explanation: 為學校、學院或其他教育機構的教學所支付的費用。
5620.definition: money paid for instruction at a school, college, or other educational institution
5620.en: The scholarship covers most of her tuition.
5620.zh: 獎學金支付了她大部分的學費。

5621.explanation: 突然失去平衡而跌落、翻滾或倒下。
5621.definition: to fall suddenly, often turning or rolling while falling
5621.en: Several books tumbled off the shelf.
5621.zh: 幾本書從架子上掉了下來。

5621.explanation: 一次突然的跌倒、跌落或翻滾。
5621.definition: an act of falling or rolling suddenly
5621.en: The box took a tumble down the stairs.
5621.zh: 盒子從樓梯上滾落下來。

5622.explanation: 身體組織細胞異常生長形成的腫塊。
5622.definition: an abnormal mass of tissue formed by cells growing in an uncontrolled way
5622.en: The scan revealed a small tumor that required further examination.
5622.zh: 掃描發現一個需要進一步檢查的小腫瘤。

5623.explanation: 大型海魚，亦指作為食物的鮪魚肉。
5623.definition: a large ocean fish, or its meat when eaten as food
5623.en: We made sandwiches with tuna and vegetables.
5623.zh: 我們用鮪魚和蔬菜做三明治。

5624.explanation: 容易辨認或哼唱的一連串音符。
5624.definition: a series of musical notes that forms a recognizable melody
5624.en: I cannot get that tune out of my head.
5624.zh: 我一直忘不了那段旋律。

5624.explanation: 調整樂器或設備，使音高或運作狀態正確。
5624.definition: to adjust a musical instrument or device so that it produces the correct pitch or works properly
5624.en: She tuned the guitar before the performance.
5624.zh: 她在表演前先替吉他調音。

5625.explanation: 穿過山體、地下或水下的長通道。
5625.definition: a long passage built through or under the ground, a hill, or water
5625.en: The train passed through a long tunnel.
5625.zh: 火車穿過一條很長的隧道。

5625.explanation: 挖掘或建造隧道，或以隧道方式穿過某處。
5625.definition: to dig or make a tunnel through or under something
5625.en: Workers tunneled through the rock for months.
5625.zh: 工人花了幾個月鑿穿岩石。

5626.explanation: 嚴重的混亂、不安或不確定狀態。
5626.definition: a state of great confusion, disorder, or uncertainty
5626.en: The sudden change threw the organization into turmoil.
5626.zh: 突如其來的變化使這個組織陷入混亂。

5627.explanation: 使某物旋轉、改變方向，或自己改變方向。
5627.definition: to move or make something move around a point, or to change direction
5627.en: Turn the handle slowly to the right.

5627.explanation: 依序由某人進行活動、發言或做事的一次機會。
5627.definition: an occasion when it is someone's time to act, speak, or do something in a sequence
5627.en: It is your turn to choose the next song.

5628.explanation: 有硬殼、屬爬蟲類的動物；美式英語可泛指多種龜類。
5628.definition: a reptile with a hard shell, especially one that lives partly or mainly in water
5628.en: A sea turtle swam beside the boat.

5629.explanation: 個別或小班教導學生某一科目的人。
5629.definition: a person who teaches a student individually or in a small group
5629.en: She meets her math tutor once a week.
5629.zh: 她每週和數學家教見一次面。

5629.explanation: 以個別或小班方式教導某人。
5629.definition: to teach or give individual instruction to someone
5629.en: He tutors younger students in English.
5629.zh: 他替年紀較小的學生做英文家教。

5630.explanation: 表示某動作發生兩次，或數量、程度是兩倍。
5630.definition: two times, or to twice the amount or degree
5630.en: I checked the answer twice before submitting it.
5630.zh: 我在交答案前檢查了兩次。

5631.explanation: 從較大樹枝長出的細小木質枝條。
5631.definition: a small thin branch growing from a larger branch or stem
5631.en: A bird landed on a thin twig.

5632.explanation: 日落後或日出前天空仍有微弱自然光的時段與光線。
5632.definition: the soft natural light in the sky after sunset or before sunrise, and the period when it occurs
5632.en: We reached the village at twilight.
5632.zh: 我們在暮色時分抵達村莊。

5633.explanation: 同一次懷孕出生的兩個孩子中的一個。
5633.definition: one of two children born to the same mother at the same birth
5633.en: Mia is one of the twins in our class.
5633.zh: Mia 是我們班上那對雙胞胎中的一人。

5633.explanation: 外表、性質或功能與另一個非常相像的人或事物。
5633.definition: a person or thing that closely resembles another
5633.en: This small town has a twin on the other side of the border.
5633.zh: 這座小鎮在邊境另一側有一座幾乎一模一樣的城鎮。

5634.explanation: 以忽明忽暗的小亮光發光。
5634.definition: to shine with small quick changes of brightness
5634.en: The lights twinkled across the harbor at night.
5634.zh: 夜裡，港口四周的燈光閃爍著。

5634.explanation: 短暫、細小而快速的亮光。
5634.definition: a small quick flash or sparkle of light
5634.en: There was a playful twinkle in her eyes.
5634.zh: 她的眼神裡閃著一絲俏皮的光。

5635.explanation: 用轉動或彎曲的方式改變物體形狀或方向。
5635.definition: to turn, bend, or wind something into a different shape or direction
5635.en: Twist the cap gently to open the bottle.
5635.zh: 輕輕轉動瓶蓋把瓶子打開。

5635.explanation: 扭動的動作，或道路、物體中的彎曲部分。
5635.definition: an act of turning or a bend in something
5635.en: The road makes a sharp twist near the bridge.
5635.zh: 這條路在橋旁有一個急彎。

5635.explanation: 故事、情勢或事件出人意料的新發展。
5635.definition: an unexpected change in a story, situation, or series of events
5635.en: The final chapter adds an unexpected twist to the story.
5635.zh: 最後一章為故事帶來意外轉折。

5636.explanation: 具有共同特徵的一類人、事、物。
5636.definition: a group or category whose members share particular characteristics
5636.en: This type of plant grows well in shade.
5636.zh: 這種類型的植物在陰涼處長得很好。

5636.explanation: 使用鍵盤輸入文字或資料。
5636.definition: to write or enter text by using a keyboard
5636.en: Please type your name at the top of the form.
5636.zh: 請在表格上方輸入你的名字。

5637.explanation: 發生在西北太平洋一帶的強烈熱帶氣旋。
5637.definition: a powerful tropical cyclone occurring in the western North Pacific region
5637.en: The typhoon forced schools to close for a day.

5638.explanation: 具有某類人事物常見或具代表性的特徵。
5638.definition: having the usual or representative qualities of a particular kind
5638.en: Rainy afternoons are typical of this season.
5638.zh: 午後下雨是這個季節的典型情況。

5639.explanation: 外觀令人不悅或缺乏美感的。
5639.en: The old wall was covered with an ugly stain.
5639.zh: 那面老牆上有一塊難看的污漬。

5640.explanation: 位於一連串過程的最後，或代表最高、最重要程度的。
5640.definition: being final in a series or representing the greatest or most important degree
5640.en: Our ultimate goal is to reduce waste across the school.
5640.zh: 我們的最終目標是減少全校的浪費。

5640.explanation: 某一方面被視為最後、根本或最高形式的事物。
5640.definition: something regarded as the final, fundamental, or highest form of its kind
5640.en: For some runners, finishing that race is the ultimate.
5640.zh: 對某些跑者來說，完成那場比賽就是最高成就。

5641.explanation: 有可張開傘面的手持用品，用來遮雨或遮陽。
5641.definition: a handheld device with a folding canopy used for protection from rain or sun
5641.en: I left my umbrella by the classroom door.
5641.zh: 我把雨傘放在教室門旁。

5642.explanation: 所有參與者都持相同意見或作出相同決定的。
5642.definition: agreed to by everyone involved without opposition
5642.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision.
5642.zh: 委員會作出一致的決定。

5643.meaning: 叔叔；伯伯；舅舅；姨丈／姑丈
5643.explanation: 父母的兄弟，或父母姐妹的丈夫。
5643.definition: the brother of a parent or the husband of a parent's sibling
5643.en: My uncle taught me how to ride a bicycle.

5644.explanation: 不附帶任何條件、限制或要求的。
5644.definition: given or done without conditions, limits, or requirements
5644.en: Her parents gave her unconditional support.
5644.zh: 她的父母給了她無條件的支持。

5645.explanation: 把覆蓋在某物上的東西移開，使其露出。
5645.definition: to remove a covering from something so that it is exposed
5645.en: He uncovered the dish after it had cooled.
5645.zh: 菜放涼後，他掀開了蓋子。

5645.explanation: 經由調查或搜尋發現原本隱藏的事實或資訊。
5645.definition: to discover or reveal facts or information that were previously hidden
5645.en: The investigation uncovered several errors in the report.
5645.zh: 調查揭露了報告中的幾項錯誤。

5646.explanation: 表示某人或某物位於另一物之下。
5646.definition: in or to a position below something
5646.en: The cat is sleeping under the table.

5646.explanation: 表示位置在較低處或移到較低處。
5646.definition: in, at, or toward a lower position
5646.en: The boat went under for a moment and came back up.
5646.zh: 小船短暫沉到水下後又浮了上來。

5646.explanation: 表示數量、年齡、程度或標準低於某個界線。
5646.definition: less than a stated amount, age, level, or standard
5646.en: Children under twelve can enter for free.
5646.zh: 十二歲以下的兒童可以免費入場。

5647.explanation: 把數量、難度、能力或重要性估得低於實際情況。
5647.definition: to judge the amount, difficulty, ability, or importance of something as lower than it really is
5647.en: Do not underestimate how much time the project will take.
5647.zh: 不要低估這個計畫所需的時間。

5647.explanation: 低於實際數量、成本或程度的估計。
5647.definition: an estimate that is lower than the actual amount, cost, or degree
5647.en: Our first cost figure was an underestimate.
5647.zh: 我們最初的成本數字低估了實際費用。

5648.explanation: 經歷某個過程、變化、治療或困難事件。
5648.definition: to experience or be subjected to a process, change, treatment, or difficult event
5648.en: The building will undergo major repairs next year.
5648.zh: 這棟建築明年將進行大規模整修。

5649.explanation: 尚未取得第一個大學學位、正在大學就讀的學生。
5649.definition: a university or college student studying for a first degree
5649.en: She is an undergraduate studying biology.
5649.zh: 她是一名主修生物的大學生。

5650.explanation: 在文字下方畫線以標示或強調。
5650.definition: to draw a line beneath a word or other piece of text
5650.en: Underline the key word in each sentence.
5650.zh: 在每個句子的關鍵字下畫線。

5650.explanation: 寫在文字下方用來標示或強調的水平線。
5650.definition: a horizontal line placed beneath text
5650.en: The title has a blue underline beneath it.
5650.zh: 標題下方有一條藍色底線。

5650.explanation: 使某個事實、需要或重點更加明顯。
5650.definition: to emphasize or make a fact, need, or point especially clear
5650.en: The survey results underline the need for better planning.
5650.zh: 調查結果突顯了更完善規劃的必要性。

5651.meaning: 構成基礎；成為根本原因
5651.explanation: 作為 underlie 的現在分詞形式，表示某事物構成另一現象、想法或情況的基礎或根本原因。
5651.definition: forming the basis or fundamental cause of something as the present participle of underlie
5651.en: The report examines the factors underlying the recent change.
5651.zh: 這份報告檢視了構成近期變化根本原因的各項因素。

5652.explanation: 使某人的權威、信心、制度或力量慢慢變弱。
5652.definition: to weaken someone's authority, confidence, position, or a system gradually
5652.en: Repeated delays can undermine people's trust in the system.
5652.zh: 一再延誤可能逐漸削弱人們對制度的信任。

5653.explanation: 表示位置直接在另一物之下，常可能被其遮住。
5653.definition: directly below something, often partly or completely hidden by it
5653.en: The keys were hidden underneath a stack of papers.
5653.zh: 鑰匙藏在一疊紙的正下方。

5653.explanation: 表示某物位於另一物的下方或較低的一面。
5653.definition: in or on a position below something else
5653.en: Lift the box and check underneath.
5653.zh: 把箱子抬起來，檢查下面。

5653.explanation: 位於某物下側或底部的。
5653.definition: located on the lower side or underside of something
5653.en: Dust had collected around the underneath panel.
5653.zh: 灰塵堆積在底部面板周圍。

5654.explanation: 讓行人或車輛從道路、鐵路等下方通過的通道。
5654.definition: a passage or road that allows people or vehicles to pass beneath another road or railway
5654.en: We used the underpass to cross beneath the busy road.
5654.zh: 我們走地下道穿過繁忙的道路。

5655.explanation: 知道某件事的意思、原因或運作方式。
5655.definition: to know the meaning, reason, or nature of something
5655.en: I understand why you chose that answer.
5655.zh: 我明白你為什麼選那個答案。

5655.explanation: 根據所聽到或掌握的資訊認為某事是真的。
5655.definition: to believe something to be true based on information received
5655.en: I understand that the meeting has been moved to Friday.
5655.zh: 我得知會議已改到星期五。

5656.explanation: 同意負責並開始進行一項工作、任務或責任。
5656.definition: to accept responsibility for and begin a task, project, or duty
5656.en: The team will undertake a full review of the data.
5656.zh: 團隊將著手全面檢查這些資料。

5657.explanation: 表示某項活動、計畫或工作已經開始並正在進行。
5657.en: Preparations are already underway for the school festival.
5657.zh: 學校園遊會的準備工作已經展開。

5658.explanation: 穿在其他衣物裡面、貼近身體的衣服。
5658.definition: clothing worn next to the body beneath other clothes
5658.en: Pack clean underwear for the overnight trip.
5658.zh: 為過夜行程準備乾淨的內衣。

5659.explanation: 打開原本綁住、扣住或固定的東西。
5659.definition: to unfasten or loosen something that has been tied, fastened, or closed
5659.en: She undid the knot and opened the package.
5659.zh: 她解開繩結並打開包裹。

5659.meaning: 撤銷；消除先前動作的效果
5659.explanation: 使先前的行動、變更或結果恢復或失效。
5659.definition: to reverse an earlier action or remove its effect
5659.en: You can undo the last change with one command.
5659.zh: 你可以用一個指令撤銷上一個變更。

5660.explanation: 用來表示說話者非常確信某事是真的。
5660.definition: used to show that the speaker is very certain something is true
5660.en: This is undoubtedly the clearest explanation so far.
5660.zh: 這無疑是目前最清楚的說明。

5661.explanation: 有工作能力且想工作的人沒有工作的狀態，也可指整體失業情況。
5661.definition: the state of being without a job while able and willing to work, or the level of joblessness in a population
5661.en: Unemployment fell as more factories began hiring.
5661.zh: 隨著更多工廠開始招人，失業率下降了。

5662.explanation: 把摺疊、捲起或合起的東西打開。
5662.definition: to open something that has been folded, rolled, or closed
5662.en: She unfolded the map on the table.

5662.explanation: 事件或情勢隨時間逐步發生並變得清楚。
5662.definition: to develop gradually over time and become known or visible
5662.en: We watched the events unfold over several days.
5662.zh: 我們看著事件在幾天內逐步發展。

5663.explanation: 把原本分開的群體、地區或部分結合成一體的過程。
5663.definition: the process of joining separate groups, regions, or parts into one
5663.en: The agreement was an important step toward national unification.
5663.zh: 這項協議是邁向國家統一的重要一步。

5664.explanation: 特定學校、組織或職業成員共同穿著的標準服裝。
5664.definition: a standard set of clothes worn by members of a school, organization, or profession
5664.en: Students must wear the school uniform on Monday.
5664.zh: 學生星期一必須穿校服。

5665.explanation: 把不同的人、團體或部分結合成一個整體。
5665.definition: to bring separate people, groups, or parts together into one whole
5665.en: The project helped unify the two teams around a shared goal.
5665.zh: 這個計畫使兩個團隊為共同目標團結起來。

5666.explanation: 兩個以上的人、組織或事物結合成一體的狀態或行動。
5666.definition: the act or state of joining people, organizations, or things together
5666.en: The new bridge became a symbol of union between the two communities.
5666.zh: 新橋成為兩個社區聯合的象徵。

5666.explanation: 代表勞工並維護其工作權益的組織。
5666.definition: an organization of workers formed to represent and protect their employment interests
5666.en: The workers formed a union to discuss pay and safety.
5666.zh: 工人成立工會來討論薪資與安全。

5667.explanation: 只有一個、沒有完全相同的另一個，或具有非常特殊的特徵。
5667.definition: being the only one of its kind or having qualities unlike anything else
5667.en: Each fingerprint has a unique pattern.
5667.zh: 每枚指紋都有獨特的紋路。

5668.explanation: 用來表示或衡量數量的標準量。
5668.definition: a standard quantity used for measuring or expressing an amount
5668.en: The meter is a unit of length.

5668.explanation: 較大整體中可視為一個獨立部分的人、群體或物件。
5668.definition: a single person, group, or thing regarded as one part of a larger whole
5668.en: The class is divided into four learning units.
5668.zh: 這門課分成四個學習單元。

5669.explanation: 使人或團體結合起來，共同為某目的行動。
5669.definition: to join people or groups together so they act as one
5669.en: The crisis united the neighbors in a common effort.
5669.zh: 這場危機使鄰居們團結合作。

5670.explanation: 人們作為一個整體合作、意見一致或保持團結的狀態。
5670.definition: the state of being joined together or acting together as one
5670.en: The players showed strong unity during the difficult match.
5670.zh: 球員們在艱難的比賽中展現強烈的團結。

5671.explanation: 存在於所有地方、涉及所有人，或在所有情況下都適用的。
5671.definition: existing everywhere, involving everyone, or applying in all cases
5671.en: The desire to be understood may be universal.
5671.zh: 渴望被理解可能是普遍的人類需求。

5671.explanation: 被認為可由同一類多個事物共同具有的一般概念或性質。
5671.definition: a general concept or quality regarded as shared by many particular things
5671.en: Philosophers have long debated whether universals exist independently.
5671.zh: 哲學家長久以來一直爭論共相是否獨立存在。

5672.explanation: 所有空間、時間、物質與天體所構成的整體。
5672.definition: all of space and everything that exists in it
5672.en: Scientists study how the universe began and changed.
5672.zh: 科學家研究宇宙如何形成與演變。

5673.explanation: 提供高等教育、研究並可授予學位的教育機構。
5673.definition: an institution of higher education and research that can award academic degrees
5673.en: She hopes to study engineering at university.
5673.zh: 她希望在大學攻讀工程。

5674.explanation: 表示只有在某條件不成立時，主句所說的情況才會發生。
5674.definition: used to say that something will happen except if a particular condition is met
5674.en: We will go outside unless it starts to rain.
5674.zh: 除非開始下雨，否則我們會到外面去。

5675.explanation: 用鑰匙、密碼等把鎖住的門、裝置或物件打開。
5675.definition: to open something that is locked
5675.en: Use this code to unlock the door.
5675.zh: 用這組密碼解鎖這扇門。

5675.meaning: 開啟；釋放潛力或取得權限
5675.explanation: 使原本不能使用、取得或發展的東西變得可用。
5675.definition: to make something available, accessible, or able to develop
5675.en: The new tool could unlock more opportunities for small teams.
5675.zh: 這項新工具可能為小型團隊開啟更多機會。

5676.explanation: 以前從未發生、出現或達到過的。
5676.definition: never having happened, existed, or been known before
5676.en: The city faced an unprecedented rise in demand.
5676.zh: 這座城市面臨前所未有的需求增加。

5677.explanation: 連接子句，表示某情況持續到另一事件發生的時間點。
5677.definition: used before a clause to show that a situation continues up to the time another event happens
5677.en: Stay here until I come back.

5677.explanation: 放在時間名詞或時間點前，表示某狀態持續到該時刻。
5677.definition: used before a time expression to show that something continues up to that time
5677.en: The library is open until nine o'clock.

5678.explanation: 正式公開展示新產品、計畫、作品或紀念物。
5678.definition: to present or show something publicly for the first time
5678.en: The company will unveil its new design next week.
5678.zh: 公司下週將公開新設計。

5678.explanation: 移去遮蓋物，使某物可以被看見。
5678.definition: to remove a covering so that something can be seen
5678.en: They unveiled the statue after the ceremony began.
5678.zh: 典禮開始後，他們揭開了雕像的覆蓋布。

5679.explanation: 表示移動到較高位置或位於較高處。
5679.definition: toward or in a higher position
5679.en: Look up and you can see the moon above the trees.
5679.zh: 抬頭看，你可以看到樹梢上方的月亮。

5679.explanation: 表示沿斜坡、樓梯、道路等往較高處移動。
5679.definition: along or toward a higher point of a slope, road, stairs, or similar route
5679.en: We walked up the hill before sunrise.
5679.zh: 我們在日出前沿著山坡往上走。

5679.explanation: 表示數量、程度或位置高於先前或正常水準。
5679.definition: higher than before or above a previous or normal level
5679.en: Ticket sales are up this month.
5679.zh: 這個月的票房銷售上升了。

5679.explanation: 提高價格、金額、產量或其他數值。
5679.definition: to increase a price, amount, rate, or level
5679.en: The store upped the price by ten dollars.
5679.zh: 商店把價格提高了十美元。

5679.explanation: 成功、繁榮或向上發展的一段時期或狀態。
5679.definition: a period or state of success, prosperity, or upward movement
5679.en: Every project has its ups and downs.
5679.zh: 每個計畫都有起起伏伏。

5680.explanation: 加入最新資訊或修改內容，使其符合目前狀況。
5680.definition: to make something current by adding new information or making changes
5680.en: Please update the document with the latest figures.
5680.zh: 請用最新數字更新這份文件。

5680.explanation: 提供最新情況的資訊，或一次更新動作／版本。
5680.definition: new information about a situation, or a change that brings something up to date
5680.en: Can you give me an update on the project?
5680.zh: 你可以告訴我這個計畫的最新進度嗎？

5681.explanation: 把設備、系統、服務等提升到較新的或更好的版本或等級。
5681.definition: to improve something by replacing it with a newer or better version or level
5681.en: We need to upgrade the software before using the new feature.
5681.zh: 我們需要先升級軟體才能使用新功能。

5681.explanation: 使設備、系統或服務變得更新或更好的改變或版本。
5681.definition: an improvement or newer version that raises something to a better level
5681.en: The computer received a memory upgrade.
5681.zh: 這台電腦進行了記憶體升級。

5682.explanation: 把本機裝置中的檔案或資料傳送到遠端系統、網站或伺服器。
5682.definition: to transfer a file or data from a local device to a remote system, website, or server
5682.en: Upload the photo before you submit the form.
5682.zh: 送出表格前先上傳照片。

5683.explanation: 表示某物位於另一物表面或上方，語氣通常比 on 正式。
5683.definition: used to indicate a position on or on top of something
5683.en: She placed the book upon the desk.

5683.explanation: 用在事件或動作前，表示另一件事緊接著發生。
5683.definition: used to show that something happens immediately after an event or action
5683.en: Upon arriving home, he called his parents.
5683.zh: 他一到家就打電話給父母。

5684.explanation: 位於某物較高部分，或在位置、程度上較高的。
5684.definition: located in the higher part of something or at a higher position or level
5684.en: The upper floor has a better view.

5685.explanation: 保持豎直、沒有平躺或傾倒的姿勢或位置。
5685.definition: vertical or standing straight rather than lying down or leaning
5685.en: Keep the bottle upright during transport.
5685.zh: 運送時請讓瓶子保持直立。

5685.explanation: 以豎直的位置或方向站立、放置或移動。
5685.definition: in a vertical or straight-up position or direction
5685.en: She sat upright in her chair.

5685.explanation: 建築、家具或設備中直立的支撐部分。
5685.definition: a vertical support, post, or structural member
5685.en: The shelf is supported by two wooden uprights.
5685.zh: 這個架子由兩根木製直立支柱支撐。

5686.explanation: 一群人集體反抗政府、統治者或權力的行動。
5686.definition: an organized act of resistance or rebellion against a government or authority
5686.en: The uprising spread quickly across the region.
5686.zh: 這場起義很快擴散到整個地區。

5687.explanation: 因不愉快的事情而感到不安、失望或難過的。
5687.definition: emotionally troubled, unhappy, or disappointed because of something unpleasant
5687.en: She was upset by the sudden change of plans.
5687.zh: 她因計畫突然改變而感到難過。

5687.explanation: 使某人感到不安、生氣、失望或難過。
5687.definition: to make someone worried, unhappy, angry, or distressed
5687.en: The news upset many people in the town.
5687.zh: 這則消息讓鎮上許多人感到不安。

5687.explanation: 比賽或競爭中出乎預期、通常由較不被看好的一方獲勝的結果。
5687.definition: an unexpected result in a competition, especially a victory by the less favored side
5687.en: The final match ended in a major upset.
5687.zh: 決賽出現了令人意外的爆冷結果。

5688.explanation: 表示移動到較高樓層，或位於較高樓層。
5688.definition: to or on a higher floor of a building
5688.en: I went upstairs to get my jacket.

5688.explanation: 位於建築物較高樓層的。
5688.definition: situated on an upper floor of a building
5688.en: The upstairs bedroom is quiet at night.
5688.zh: 樓上的臥室晚上很安靜。

5688.explanation: 建築物較高的一層或上層區域。
5688.definition: the upper floor or upper part of a building
5688.en: The upstairs of the house is much quieter.
5688.zh: 這棟房子的樓上安靜得多。

5689.explanation: 朝較高位置、程度或數值移動或指向的。
5689.definition: moving, pointing, or tending toward a higher position, level, or amount
5689.en: The chart shows a steady upward trend.
5689.zh: 圖表顯示穩定的上升趨勢。

5690.explanation: 朝較高的位置、方向或程度。
5690.definition: toward a higher place, position, direction, or level

5691.explanation: 與城市、都市生活或城市地區有關的。
5691.definition: relating to cities, towns, or life in densely populated areas
5691.en: Urban areas usually have denser public transport networks.
5691.zh: 都市地區通常有較密集的大眾運輸網路。

5692.explanation: 想要做某件事的強烈而突然的欲望。
5692.definition: a strong or sudden desire or impulse to do something
5692.en: He felt a sudden urge to check the message again.
5692.zh: 他突然有一股想再查看訊息的衝動。

5692.explanation: 強烈建議或勸說某人採取某項行動。
5692.definition: to strongly advise, encourage, or press someone to do something
5692.en: Doctors urge people to get enough sleep.
5692.zh: 醫師力勸大家要有充足睡眠。

5693.explanation: 需要迅速處理或立即採取行動的程度或狀態。
5693.definition: the quality or state of needing immediate attention or action
5693.en: The nurse spoke with urgency because the patient needed help.
5693.zh: 因為病人需要協助，護理師語氣十分急迫。

5694.explanation: 需要立即注意、處理或行動的。
5694.definition: requiring immediate attention, action, or a quick response
5694.en: This is an urgent problem that cannot wait until tomorrow.
5694.zh: 這是不能等到明天的緊急問題。

5695.explanation: 某個字、片語或語言形式通常如何被使用。
5695.definition: the way a word, phrase, or form of language is normally used
5695.en: The dictionary explains the modern usage of the word.
5695.zh: 字典說明這個字的現代用法。

5695.explanation: 使用某物的行為、方式或程度。
5695.definition: the act, manner, or amount of using something
5695.en: Electricity usage rises during very hot weather.
5695.zh: 非常炎熱的天氣裡，用電量會上升。

5696.explanation: 為了某個目的而運用工具、方法、資源或物品。
5696.definition: to employ a tool, method, resource, or object for a particular purpose
5696.en: We use this room for group discussions.
5696.zh: 我們使用這個房間進行小組討論。

5696.explanation: 使用某物的行為，或某物可被用來達成的目的。
5696.definition: the act of using something or the purpose for which it can be used
5696.en: This tool has several practical uses.
5696.zh: 這個工具有好幾種實際用途。

5697.explanation: 之前已被他人使用過的，而不是全新的。
5697.definition: previously owned or used by someone else rather than new
5697.en: They bought a used car to save money.
5697.zh: 他們為了省錢買了一輛二手車。

5697.explanation: 因經常接觸或反覆做某事而覺得熟悉、不再陌生。
5697.definition: accustomed to something because of repeated experience
5697.en: I am used to waking up early on school days.
5697.zh: 我已經習慣上學日早起。

5698.explanation: 能幫助完成某件事、解決問題或達成目的的。
5698.definition: able to help achieve a purpose, solve a problem, or perform a task
5698.en: The chart gives useful information about rainfall.
5698.zh: 這張圖表提供有用的降雨資訊。

5699.explanation: 使用某個產品、服務、系統、設備或資源的人。
5699.definition: a person who uses a product, service, system, device, or resource
5699.en: Each user must create a separate account.
5699.zh: 每位使用者都必須建立獨立帳號。

5700.explanation: 禮貌地帶某人到某個地方，尤其是座位或活動場地。
5700.definition: to guide someone politely to a place, especially to a seat or into an event
5700.en: A staff member ushered us into the hall.
5700.zh: 一名工作人員引導我們進入大廳。

5700.explanation: 在劇院、婚禮或活動中帶領人們入座或前往指定位置的人。
5700.definition: a person who shows people to their seats or guides them at a theater, ceremony, or event
5700.en: An usher showed us to our seats before the show.
5700.zh: 表演開始前，一名引座員帶我們到座位。

5701.explanation: 在多數情況下會發生、使用或出現的，並不特別。
5701.definition: happening, done, or found in the normal or most common way
5701.en: The bus arrived at its usual time.
5701.zh: 公車在平常的時間抵達。

5702.explanation: 表示某事在大多數情況或多數時間都會發生。
5702.definition: in most cases or on most occasions
5702.en: I usually review my notes after dinner.
5702.zh: 我通常晚餐後複習筆記。

5703.explanation: 用來完成特定工作、尤其是烹飪或家務的小型工具或器具。
5703.definition: a tool or implement used for a particular practical task, especially in cooking or household work
5703.en: Keep sharp kitchen utensils away from small children.
5703.zh: 把尖銳的廚房用具放在小孩拿不到的地方。

5704.explanation: 某物實際有用、能達成目的或帶來功能價值的程度。
5704.definition: the quality of being useful or able to serve a practical purpose
5704.en: The utility of this small tool becomes clear when space is limited.
5704.zh: 空間有限時，這個小工具的實用性就很明顯。

5704.meaning: 公用事業；公共服務公司
5704.explanation: 向大眾提供電力、瓦斯、水或其他基本服務的公司或系統。
5704.definition: a company or service that provides electricity, gas, water, or another essential public service
5704.en: The local utility repaired the damaged power line.
5704.zh: 當地公用事業公司修復了受損的電線。

5705.explanation: 為實際目的有效使用某物、資源或方法。
5705.definition: to make practical or effective use of something for a purpose
5705.en: The program utilizes solar energy to reduce electricity costs.
5705.zh: 這項計畫利用太陽能降低電費。

5706.explanation: 用來強調某種狀態達到完全、絕對的程度。
5706.definition: complete or absolute, used to emphasize the full degree of something
5706.en: The room fell into utter silence after the announcement.
5706.zh: 公告後，房間陷入完全的寂靜。

5706.explanation: 用嘴說出詞語，或發出可聽見的聲音。
5706.definition: to say something aloud or make an audible sound
5706.en: He was too surprised to utter a word.
5706.zh: 他驚訝得一句話也說不出來。

5707.explanation: 目前沒有被人擔任、可供申請的工作或職位。
5707.definition: a job or position that is available because no one currently holds it
5707.en: The company posted a vacancy for a lab assistant.
5707.zh: 公司刊登了一個實驗室助理的職缺。

5707.explanation: 旅館、建築物或其他地方目前可供使用的房間或位置。
5707.definition: an available room, place, or accommodation that is not currently occupied
5707.en: We called three hotels before finding a vacancy.
5707.zh: 我們打了三家旅館才找到空房。

5708.explanation: 目前沒有被人占用、居住或使用的。
5708.definition: not occupied, filled, or being used at the present time
5708.en: The apartment has been vacant since June.
5708.zh: 這間公寓從六月起一直空著。

5709.explanation: 暫時離開工作或學校、用來休息或旅行的一段時間。
5709.definition: a period away from work or school used for rest, travel, or recreation
5709.en: We spent our summer vacation near the coast.
5709.zh: 我們在海邊附近度過暑假。

5709.explanation: 到某地或在一段時間內休息、旅行以度過假期。
5709.definition: to spend a period of time away from work or school for rest or travel
5709.en: They vacation in the mountains every winter.
5709.zh: 他們每年冬天都到山區度假。

5710.explanation: 用來刺激免疫反應，使身體對特定疾病產生保護力的製劑。
5710.definition: a preparation given to stimulate an immune response and provide protection against a particular disease
5710.en: The vaccine helps the immune system recognize the virus.
5710.zh: 這種疫苗幫助免疫系統辨識病毒。

5711.explanation: 幾乎沒有物質或空氣存在的空間。
5711.definition: a space containing little or no matter or air
5711.en: Scientists tested the material inside a vacuum.
5711.zh: 科學家在真空環境中測試這種材料。

5711.explanation: 利用吸力清除灰塵與髒污的家用清潔設備。
5711.definition: a household cleaning machine that removes dust and dirt by suction
5711.en: The vacuum is stored in the closet beside the stairs.
5711.zh: 吸塵器收在樓梯旁的櫃子裡。

5711.explanation: 使用吸塵器清除地面、家具或其他表面的灰塵與髒污。
5711.definition: to clean a floor, surface, or object with a vacuum cleaner
5711.en: Please vacuum the carpet before the guests arrive.
5711.zh: 客人來之前請把地毯吸乾淨。

5712.explanation: 資訊、想法或說法缺乏清楚細節，難以精確理解。
5712.definition: not clearly expressed, defined, remembered, or understood because details are lacking
5712.en: His instructions were too vague to follow confidently.
5712.zh: 他的指示太模糊，讓人無法有把握地照做。

5713.explanation: 無法產生預期結果、即使努力也沒有成功的。
5713.definition: failing to achieve the intended result; unsuccessful or useless
5713.en: They made a vain attempt to restart the damaged engine.
5713.zh: 他們徒勞地嘗試重新啟動受損的引擎。

5713.explanation: 對自己的外表、能力或成就過度驕傲。
5713.definition: excessively proud of one's appearance, abilities, or achievements
5713.en: He was too vain to admit that someone else had done better.
5713.zh: 他太自負，不願承認別人做得更好。

5714.explanation: 具有充分理由、證據或邏輯支持，因而可被接受。
5714.definition: based on sound reasoning or evidence and therefore acceptable
5714.en: She gave a valid reason for changing the schedule.
5714.zh: 她提出了一個合理的理由來更改時程。

5714.explanation: 在法律、規則或指定期限內具有正式效力的。
5714.definition: officially or legally acceptable and still in force or usable
5714.en: This ticket is valid until the end of October.

5715.explanation: 位於山丘或山脈之間的低地，常有河流經過。
5715.definition: a low area of land between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it
5715.en: A narrow river runs through the valley.
5715.zh: 一條狹窄的河流穿過山谷。

5716.explanation: 因稀有、品質或需求而具有很高金錢價值的。
5716.definition: worth a large amount of money because of quality, rarity, or demand
5716.en: The museum keeps its most valuable paintings in a secure room.
5716.zh: 博物館把最值錢的畫作保存在安全的房間裡。

5716.explanation: 因能提供重要幫助、知識或利益而具有高度價值的。
5716.definition: very useful or important because it provides help, knowledge, or benefit
5716.en: Her advice was valuable when I had to make the decision.
5716.zh: 在我必須做決定時，她的建議很寶貴。

5717.explanation: 某物以金錢衡量的價值或可交換的價格。
5717.definition: the amount of money something is worth or can be exchanged for
5717.en: The value of the house increased over five years.
5717.zh: 這棟房子的價值在五年間上升了。

5717.explanation: 某事物因有用、重要或能帶來利益而具有的價值。
5717.definition: the importance, usefulness, or benefit of something
5717.en: The course has real value for students who want practical skills.
5717.zh: 這門課對想學實用技能的學生很有價值。

5717.explanation: 認為某人或某事物重要、有益或值得珍惜。
5717.definition: to regard someone or something as important, useful, or worthy of appreciation
5717.en: I value the time I spend with my family.
5717.zh: 我很珍惜和家人相處的時間。

5718.explanation: 有封閉車身、可載貨或載人的中小型道路車輛。
5718.definition: a medium-sized enclosed road vehicle used for carrying goods or people
5718.en: The bakery uses a van to deliver bread each morning.
5718.zh: 麵包店每天早上用廂型車送麵包。

5719.explanation: 由香莢蘭取得、常用於甜點與飲料的香味或調味物。
5719.definition: a flavoring obtained from vanilla plants and widely used in sweets, desserts, and drinks
5719.en: Add a little vanilla to the cake mixture.
5719.zh: 在蛋糕麵糊裡加一點香草。

5720.explanation: 突然或逐漸從視野、某處或存在狀態中消失。
5720.definition: to disappear suddenly or gradually from sight, a place, or existence
5720.en: The fog began to vanish as the sun rose.
5720.zh: 太陽升起後，霧開始消散。

5721.explanation: 對自己的外表、能力或成就過度在意或驕傲。
5721.definition: excessive pride in one's appearance, abilities, or achievements
5721.en: Vanity made him care more about praise than improvement.
5721.zh: 虛榮使他比起進步更在意別人的稱讚。

5722.explanation: 通常為液體或固體的物質變成氣體後的形態。
5722.definition: the gaseous form of a substance that is normally a liquid or solid
5722.en: Water vapor formed on the cold window.
5722.zh: 水蒸氣在冰冷的窗戶上凝結。

5723.explanation: 會改變、且可能影響結果或必須納入考量的數量、條件或因素。
5723.definition: a quantity, condition, or factor that can change and may affect an outcome
5723.en: Weather is an important variable in planning the event.
5723.zh: 天氣是規劃這場活動時的重要變數。

5723.explanation: 會改變而沒有固定狀態、數值或模式的。
5723.definition: able or likely to change rather than remain fixed or constant
5723.en: The mountain region has highly variable weather.
5723.zh: 這個山區的天氣變化很大。

5724.explanation: 某事物與另一事物之間的差別，或同一事物隨時間產生的改變。
5724.definition: a difference between things or a change in something over time
5724.en: There is considerable variation in rainfall across the island.
5724.zh: 島上各地的降雨量有相當大的差異。

5725.explanation: 不同事物、選擇或特徵同時存在的情況。
5725.definition: the presence of many different kinds, choices, or features
5725.en: The market offers a wide variety of fresh fruit.
5725.zh: 市場提供各式各樣的新鮮水果。

5725.explanation: 某一類事物中的一種特定形式或類型。
5725.definition: a particular kind, type, or form within a larger group
5725.en: This variety of tomato grows well in warm weather.
5725.zh: 這個品種的番茄在溫暖天氣下長得很好。

5726.explanation: 包含數個彼此不同的人、事物或種類的。
5726.definition: consisting of or referring to several different people, things, or kinds
5726.en: We discussed various ways to reduce energy use.
5726.zh: 我們討論了各種減少能源使用的方法。

5727.explanation: 在數量、程度、特徵或情況上彼此不同。
5727.definition: to be different from one another in amount, degree, character, or condition
5727.en: Prices vary from store to store.
5727.zh: 價格會因商店不同而有所差異。

5727.explanation: 使某事物改變，或在不同時間、情況採用不同方式。
5727.definition: to change something or make it different at different times or in different situations
5727.en: Try to vary your study methods during the week.
5727.zh: 一週中可以嘗試變換不同的讀書方法。

5728.explanation: 用來插花或作裝飾的容器，通常較高且上方開口。
5728.definition: a decorative container, usually open at the top, used especially for holding flowers
5728.en: She placed the flowers in a blue glass vase.
5728.zh: 她把花插進一個藍色玻璃花瓶裡。

5729.explanation: 在面積、數量、範圍或程度上非常大。
5729.definition: extremely large in area, amount, range, or degree
5729.en: The desert covers a vast area of the country.
5729.zh: 沙漠覆蓋了這個國家廣大的區域。

5730.explanation: 植物中被人當作食物食用的部分，例如葉、根、莖或果實。
5730.definition: a plant or part of a plant eaten as food, such as a leaf, root, stem, or fruit
5730.en: We grow several vegetables in the school garden.
5730.zh: 我們在學校菜園種了好幾種蔬菜。

5731.explanation: 不吃肉或魚的人，有些人也會避免其他動物性食品。
5731.definition: a person who does not eat meat or fish and may also avoid other animal products
5731.en: The restaurant has several dishes for vegetarians.
5731.zh: 這家餐廳有好幾道適合素食者的料理。

5732.explanation: 用來在陸地上運送人或貨物的汽車、卡車、公車等交通工具。
5732.definition: a machine such as a car, truck, or bus used for transporting people or goods on land
5732.en: The road is closed to heavy vehicles tonight.
5732.zh: 今晚這條道路禁止大型車輛通行。

5732.explanation: 用來表達、傳遞或達成某個想法、目的或效果的方式。
5732.definition: a means through which an idea, purpose, message, or effect is expressed or carried
5732.en: Music can be a powerful vehicle for expressing emotion.
5732.zh: 音樂可以是表達情感的強大媒介。

5733.explanation: 覆蓋頭部或臉部的薄布，常用於服飾、婚禮或宗教場合。
5733.definition: a thin piece of cloth worn over the head or face
5733.en: She lifted the veil before the ceremony began.
5733.zh: 儀式開始前，她掀起了頭紗。

5733.explanation: 用覆蓋物或比喻方式使某物不易被看見或理解。
5733.definition: to cover or hide something so that it is less visible or clear
5733.en: Thin clouds veiled the moon for a few minutes.
5733.zh: 薄雲遮住了月亮幾分鐘。

5734.explanation: 把血液由身體各部位送回心臟的血管。
5734.definition: a blood vessel that carries blood toward the heart
5734.en: The nurse could see a vein near his wrist.
5734.zh: 護理師看得到他手腕附近的一條靜脈。

5735.explanation: 表面有短而密、觸感柔軟絨毛的布料。
5735.definition: a soft fabric with a dense short pile
5735.en: The chair is covered in dark blue velvet.
5735.zh: 這張椅子覆著深藍色天鵝絨。

5735.meaning: 天鵝絨製的；如絲絨般柔滑的
5735.explanation: 由天鵝絨製成、覆有天鵝絨，或質地像天鵝絨的。
5735.definition: made of velvet or having a soft smooth quality like velvet
5735.en: She chose a velvet ribbon for the gift.
5735.zh: 她選了一條天鵝絨緞帶來包裝禮物。

5736.explanation: 出售商品或服務的個人或公司。
5736.definition: a person or company that sells goods or services
5736.en: Each food vendor must keep the stall clean.
5736.zh: 每個食品攤販都必須保持攤位整潔。

5737.explanation: 具有失敗風險的新計畫、事業或活動。
5737.definition: a new project or business activity that involves risk
5737.en: Their first business venture began in a small office.
5737.zh: 他們的第一個創業計畫從一間小辦公室開始。

5737.explanation: 在有風險或不確定的情況下前往某處或嘗試某事。
5737.definition: to go somewhere or try something despite risk or uncertainty
5737.en: Few hikers ventured beyond the marked trail.
5737.zh: 很少有健行者冒險走到標示步道之外。

5738.explanation: 活動、會議、比賽或表演舉行的地方。
5738.definition: the place where an event, meeting, competition, or performance is held
5738.en: The school gym will be the venue for the ceremony.
5738.zh: 學校體育館將是典禮的舉辦場地。

5739.explanation: 以說話或文字中的詞語表達，常與書面或非語言方式相對。
5739.definition: expressed in spoken words or relating to words
5739.en: The teacher gave us verbal instructions before the activity.
5739.zh: 活動前老師給了我們口頭指示。

5739.explanation: 具有動詞特徵並可充當名詞、形容詞等功能的語法形式。
5739.definition: a word form related to a verb that can function as another part of speech
5739.en: In grammar class, we learned how a verbal can function in a sentence.
5739.zh: 文法課上，我們學到動詞衍生語如何在句子中發揮功能。

5740.explanation: 法院審理後由陪審團或法官作出的正式決定。
5740.definition: a formal decision reached in a court case
5740.en: The jury returned its verdict in the afternoon.
5740.zh: 陪審團在下午作出裁決。

5740.explanation: 考慮或檢視某事後形成的意見或判斷。
5740.definition: an opinion or judgment formed after considering something
5740.en: After trying both apps, her verdict was that the simpler one worked better.
5740.zh: 試過兩個應用程式後，她的結論是較簡單的那個更好用。

5741.meaning: 多才多藝的；用途廣泛的
5741.explanation: 能適應多種工作或用途，或在多方面表現良好。
5741.definition: able to adapt to many tasks or be useful in many different ways
5741.en: This versatile tool can cut, measure, and open packages.
5741.zh: 這個多用途工具可以切割、測量，也能拆包裹。

5742.explanation: 詩歌中的一行或一組詩行，也可泛指以詩體寫成的文字。
5742.definition: a line or group of lines in a poem, or poetry written in metrical form
5742.en: He read one verse of the poem aloud.
5742.zh: 他大聲讀了這首詩的一節。

5743.explanation: 同一事物因時間、設計或內容不同而形成的特定形式。
5743.definition: a particular form of something that differs in some details
5743.en: I installed the latest version of the program.
5743.zh: 我安裝了這個程式的最新版本。

5743.explanation: 某人對事件所作的特定描述或解釋。
5743.definition: a person's particular account or description of an event
5743.en: Her version of the event differed from mine.
5743.zh: 她對這件事的說法和我的不同。

5744.explanation: 用來表示比賽、爭議或比較中的兩方。
5744.definition: used to show one side competing or being compared with another
5744.en: The final match is North High versus East High.

5745.explanation: 與水平面成直角，或方向直上直下的。
5745.definition: standing or pointing straight up and down, at a right angle to the horizontal
5745.en: Draw a vertical line through the center of the page.
5745.zh: 在頁面中央畫一條垂直線。

5745.explanation: 垂直的線、平面、位置或直立構件。
5745.definition: a vertical line, plane, position, or upright structural element
5745.en: Use the wall edge as a vertical when checking the frame.
5745.zh: 檢查畫框時，可以把牆邊當作垂直基準。

5746.explanation: 用來加強形容詞或副詞的程度。
5746.definition: to a high degree; used to intensify an adjective or adverb
5746.en: The instructions are very clear and easy to follow.
5746.zh: 這些指示非常清楚，也很容易照著做。

5747.explanation: 用於水上運輸的船，尤其是較大的船隻。
5747.definition: a ship or large boat used for transport on water
5747.en: The research vessel left the harbor before sunrise.
5747.zh: 研究船在日出前離開港口。

5747.explanation: 用來盛裝液體或其他物質的容器。
5747.definition: a container used to hold liquids or other substances
5747.en: Pour the mixture into a clean glass vessel.
5747.zh: 把混合物倒進乾淨的玻璃容器。

5747.explanation: 身體或植物中輸送液體的管狀構造。
5747.definition: a tube in a body or plant through which fluid moves
5747.en: Water moves through tiny vessels in the plant stem.
5747.zh: 水會經由植物莖中的細小導管移動。

5748.explanation: 穿在上半身、沒有袖子的衣物；美式英語常指外穿背心。
5748.definition: a sleeveless garment worn on the upper body
5748.en: He wore a light vest over his shirt.
5748.zh: 他在襯衫外穿了一件輕薄背心。

5749.explanation: 在某工作、活動或領域累積多年經驗的人。
5749.definition: a person with long experience in a particular activity or field
5749.en: She is a veteran of the publishing industry.
5749.zh: 她是出版業的資深人士。

5749.explanation: 曾在軍隊服役的人，尤其是已離開現役者。
5749.definition: a person who has served in the armed forces
5749.en: The town held a ceremony to honor local veterans.
5749.zh: 這個城鎮舉行典禮向當地退伍軍人致敬。

5750.explanation: 受過專業訓練、為動物診斷與治療疾病的人；vet 是常用簡稱。
5750.definition: a trained professional who provides medical care for animals
5750.en: The veterinarian examined the dog's injured paw.
5750.zh: 獸醫檢查了那隻狗受傷的腳掌。

5751.explanation: 正式阻止某項提案、法律或決定生效的權力或行動。
5751.definition: an official rejection or the power to prevent a proposal or decision from taking effect
5751.en: The proposal failed after the mayor used a veto.
5751.zh: 市長行使否決權後，這項提案未能通過。

5751.explanation: 以正式權力拒絕或阻止某項提案、法律或決定。
5751.definition: to officially reject or prevent a proposal, law, or decision from taking effect
5751.en: The governor may veto the bill.
5751.zh: 州長可能會否決這項法案。

5752.explanation: 表示路線經過某個地方。
5752.definition: by way of a particular place or route
5752.en: We flew to Rome via Paris.
5752.zh: 我們經由巴黎飛往羅馬。

5752.explanation: 表示使用某種方法、管道或媒介。
5752.definition: by means of a particular method, channel, or medium
5752.en: Please send the document via email.
5752.zh: 請透過電子郵件寄送文件。

5753.explanation: 實際上能運作、成功或持續存在的。
5753.definition: capable of working successfully or continuing in practice
5753.en: The team needs a viable plan that fits the budget.
5753.zh: 團隊需要一個符合預算且可行的計畫。

5754.explanation: 快速而反覆地前後或上下移動。
5754.definition: to move quickly back and forth in repeated small movements
5754.en: The phone began to vibrate on the desk.
5754.zh: 手機開始在桌面上震動。

5755.explanation: 物體快速來回移動的動作或狀態。
5755.en: A slight vibration could be felt through the floor.
5755.zh: 可以透過地板感覺到輕微震動。

5756.explanation: 被視為不道德、不良或有害的習慣或行為。
5756.definition: a bad or harmful habit or form of behavior
5756.en: He described impatience as a vice he wanted to overcome.
5756.zh: 他把缺乏耐心形容為自己想克服的惡習。

5757.explanation: 故意殘酷、傷害性強，或帶有強烈敵意的。
5757.en: A vicious rumor spread through the school.
5757.zh: 一則惡毒的謠言在學校裡傳開。

5758.explanation: 因犯罪、事故、災害或不利情況而受到傷害或損失的人。
